b6dee2704b2c7c3a20ff3b0d2d5f4b1743d55542.description_zh: 音频文件（mp3/m4a/wav/aac/flac/ogg）→ 可读的 Markdown 文字稿；自动完成语音转写 + 说话人分离（阿里云 DashScope paraformer-v2）；最少交互：用户可以选择给每个 SPEAKER_XX 起名字，也可以直接跳过用原始标签；**保留原文不做内容整理、不做错字修正、不做解读**——只做简单排版让你方便阅读；每次运行落到 `~/Downloads/audio-to-transcript/<时间戳>_<音频名>/transcript.md`；当用户说"帮我把这个音频/录音转成文字稿"、"转写一下这个 mp3/m4a"、"这个录音转文字"、"这个音频转逐字稿"、"帮我把这段录音转成可读文字"、"把这个音频转成 markdown 文字稿"等，或者用户丢一个音频文件并提到转写/文字稿/逐字稿/转文字，立即使用此 skill；**不要用于**：①用户说"整理成公众号文章"、"发公众号的稿"、"出一篇稿子"——那是 audio-to-wechat-md 的任务；②视频文件——先让用户提取音频；③已经是文字稿的——直接给用户用。

b0b63986a3aa82f51d4417cfa48e888faafaecc1.description_zh: 在端到端项目建设中按阶段协调 CTO、架构、产品、开发、运维、安全、数据库、测试和管理等十二种团队角色，并在实现前先开展头脑风暴。
b0b63986a3aa82f51d4417cfa48e888faafaecc1.source: You MUST use this when building projects end-to-end. Orchestrates all 12 team roles — automatically switches between CTO, architect, PM, engineers, SRE, security, DBA, QA, and EM based on the current phase of work. Starts with brainstorming before any implementation.

1c794848c983f5699d8caae4c4e97bb42fb8ce5d.description_zh: 从业务与技术结合的角度评估自研或采购、架构方向、资源分配、技术愿景和风险等战略技术决策。
1c794848c983f5699d8caae4c4e97bb42fb8ce5d.source: You MUST use this for strategic technology decisions - build vs buy, architecture direction, resource allocation, technical vision, risk assessment. Evaluates decisions at the intersection of business and technology.

8b32e1ed895d8829ea66bb9f4678f4070adcbc77.description_zh: 为数据库结构设计、查询优化、迁移计划、索引策略、数据建模和性能问题提供决策指导。
8b32e1ed895d8829ea66bb9f4678f4070adcbc77.source: You MUST use this for database decisions - schema design, query optimization, migration planning, indexing strategy, data modeling, and database performance issues.

c7a1fe37142b626a357d3161f9fb865a4becd898.description_zh: 为 CI/CD、容器化、基础设施即代码、部署策略、环境管理和构建自动化提供指导。
c7a1fe37142b626a357d3161f9fb865a4becd898.source: You MUST use this for infrastructure and deployment decisions - CI/CD pipelines, containerization, IaC, deployment strategies, environment management, and build automation.

d5aa1169d0e4a0b76f4cbded702c2928c29e7604.description_zh: 为迭代计划、团队结构、交付估算、流程改进、技术招聘和工程团队运作提供管理指导。
d5aa1169d0e4a0b76f4cbded702c2928c29e7604.source: You MUST use this for team and process decisions - sprint planning, team structure, delivery estimation, process improvements, technical hiring, and engineering team operations.

97831d95086f9255b6f82e4aa023034aa6f51aba.description_zh: 为系统设计、架构模式选择、边界划分、数据建模及后期难以调整的结构决策提供指导。
97831d95086f9255b6f82e4aa023034aa6f51aba.source: You MUST use this for system design and architecture decisions - designing systems, choosing patterns, defining boundaries, data modeling, and making structural decisions that are hard to change later.

d16c8b8e8aea1126ae3594d571730e0732e1e7a7.description_zh: 帮助确定产品建设的内容与理由，并处理功能优先级、用户故事、路线图和需求收集。
d16c8b8e8aea1126ae3594d571730e0732e1e7a7.source: You MUST use this for product decisions - feature prioritization, user stories, roadmap planning, requirement gathering, and defining what to build and why.

0090f1edbb0bd55d96fe907c95023ab1f9627190.description_zh: 为测试策略、测试计划、缺陷分析、测试框架、覆盖缺口和质量保证流程提供指导。
0090f1edbb0bd55d96fe907c95023ab1f9627190.source: You MUST use this for testing and quality decisions - test strategy, test plans, bug analysis, testing frameworks, coverage gaps, and quality assurance processes.

96db5587bfd235601218ecd553cdbd4206f2fef9.description_zh: 执行功能开发、缺陷修复、API 实现和问题调试，并编写清晰的生产代码。
96db5587bfd235601218ecd553cdbd4206f2fef9.source: You MUST use this for hands-on coding tasks - writing features, fixing bugs, implementing APIs, debugging issues, and writing clean production code.

1d9c8ac5285bfc3bd5c44bf150e0b136b6b8ac6f.description_zh: 为威胁建模、漏洞评估、认证与授权设计、安全审查、合规要求和安全加固提供指导。
1d9c8ac5285bfc3bd5c44bf150e0b136b6b8ac6f.source: You MUST use this for security decisions - threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, auth/authz design, security review, compliance requirements, and hardening recommendations.

7bce5fa708cc48bff466619f22f66da85ed6eead.description_zh: 通过代码审查、设计模式、复杂问题调试和工程实践辅导，指导生产质量代码的实现。
7bce5fa708cc48bff466619f22f66da85ed6eead.source: You MUST use this for implementation guidance - code review, design patterns, debugging complex issues, writing production-quality code, and mentoring on engineering best practices.

961b76a8f1be9486be4c315824234566bcdf1e99.description_zh: 为事故响应、监控、服务等级目标、容量规划、性能调试和生产可靠性提供指导。
961b76a8f1be9486be4c315824234566bcdf1e99.source: You MUST use this for reliability and operations decisions - incident response, monitoring, SLOs, capacity planning, performance debugging, and production reliability.

d14de0d028dc7ec803aa28e167a6e2bf449d9c27.description_zh: 处理跨团队技术决策，包括代码质量标准、共享模式、技术债策略、复杂问题辅导和工程实践协调。
d14de0d028dc7ec803aa28e167a6e2bf449d9c27.source: You MUST use this for cross-cutting technical decisions - code quality standards, cross-team patterns, technical debt strategy, mentoring on complex problems, and driving alignment on engineering practices.

a051b9b3c6a1f054ae60989d62c14c4ace1a3ee2.description_zh: 在用户提出想法、计划或方案并指定 MBTI 人格时，以该人格提出追问，帮助用户梳理思考。
a051b9b3c6a1f054ae60989d62c14c4ace1a3ee2.source: Use when the user presents an idea/plan/proposal and wants a specific 16-minds (MBTI) personality to ask probing questions back — instead of giving an answer. Triggers on Japanese phrases like 「ENTPでツッコんで」「INFJに問い詰めて」「ENTJ視点で質問して」「このアイデア叩いて」, English equivalents like "as ENTP, question this" / "INFJ would ask what?", or 16-minds commands with a `--ask` flag. AIに「答えさせる」のではなく「問わせる」ためのSkill。ユーザーが思考を整理したい時に使う。

f5c1e36b1a189f0b881e7f6d32c478fe9ab82c74.description_zh: 在用户指定 MBTI 人格并提供至少两个选项时，按该人格的判断风格作出选择。
f5c1e36b1a189f0b881e7f6d32c478fe9ab82c74.source: Use when the user provides multiple options and wants a specific 16-minds (MBTI) personality to make the decision in that personality's judgment style. Triggers on Japanese phrases like 「ENTJで決めて」「INFPならどっち選ぶ」「INTJとして判断して」, English equivalents like "decide as ESTJ" / "which would ENFP pick", or 16-minds commands with a `--decide` flag. Requires both a personality and 2+ options to be present or extractable from the request.

684a1517c00142389bac859670c1406c646f0145.description_zh: 逐步在 Honeydew 实体上定义业务聚合指标，编写 SQL 表达式并通过 MCP 推送。
684a1517c00142389bac859670c1406c646f0145.source: Guides you step-by-step through defining a business metric (aggregation) on a Honeydew entity. Covers SQL expression building and pushes to Honeydew via the MCP tools.
684a1517c00142389bac859670c1406c646f0145.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

eb2261b24351e75dc8a9e13c64f866b6b32e271c.description_zh: 探索 Honeydew 语义层实体和字段，设置工作区/分支并用结构化查询抽查字段值；趋势、根因和多步骤分析交给 query，新增指标/属性交给对应创建 skill。
eb2261b24351e75dc8a9e13c64f866b6b32e271c.source: Use when exploring Honeydew semantic layer, discovering entities/fields, setting up workspace and branch context, or running structured queries to spot-check field values. Any question about the data itself — "why", "how", trends, root cause, anything needing multiple steps — belongs to the query skill's deep analysis, including when already mid-exploration. For creating metrics use metric-creation skill. For creating attributes use attribute-creation skill.
eb2261b24351e75dc8a9e13c64f866b6b32e271c.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

02c099b15ad06228a5b21376896720b05011a5a5.description_zh: 通过 list_query_history 检查 Honeydew 历史执行，查看客户端、语义定义/编译 SQL、执行者与时间，并诊断失败；新查询和分析交给 query。
02c099b15ad06228a5b21376896720b05011a5a5.source: Use when the user wants to review or inspect past query executions in Honeydew — what ran, from which client (BI tools, SQL interface, MCP, deep analysis), the semantic definition or compiled SQL behind a run, who ran it and when — and to debug failures. Uses the list_query_history MCP tool. For running new queries or analysis use the query skill.
02c099b15ad06228a5b21376896720b05011a5a5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

c72542e00b8ea3e44abdf70c5998d4da171acdd6.description_zh: 通过 Honeydew 语义层执行自然语言问数、深入多步骤分析和结构化查询；模型与字段发现交给 model-exploration。
c72542e00b8ea3e44abdf70c5998d4da171acdd6.source: Use when the user wants to query or analyze data through the Honeydew semantic layer — including natural language analysis questions, deep multi-step investigations, and structured queries. For model/field discovery use the model-exploration skill.
c72542e00b8ea3e44abdf70c5998d4da171acdd6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d29edfda31e8cb9543eb5097db94021d19430a92.description_zh: 定义两个 Honeydew 实体的关联类型、方向、交叉过滤和连接方式，再通过 MCP 推送更新后的实体 YAML。
d29edfda31e8cb9543eb5097db94021d19430a92.source: Guides you through defining a relationship between two Honeydew entities — covering join type, direction, cross-filtering, and connection method — then pushes the updated entity YAML to Honeydew via the MCP tools.
d29edfda31e8cb9543eb5097db94021d19430a92.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

88e353be43475895473a24928b90623323c6e02b.description_zh: 在创建或修改 Honeydew 指标、属性、实体或 domain 后，按对象类型验证功能和结果合理性。
88e353be43475895473a24928b90623323c6e02b.source: Use after creating or modifying ANY Honeydew object (metric, attribute, entity, domain). Provides type-specific validation logic to ensure objects work correctly and return sensible results.
88e353be43475895473a24928b90623323c6e02b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

233e79a6526ee36a9764c764c56aef1d7cc865f6.description_zh: 管理 Honeydew 工作区与分支上下文，支持切换、创建/删除分支、查看历史以及为工作分支创建 PR。
233e79a6526ee36a9764c764c56aef1d7cc865f6.source: Use when setting up workspace and branch context, switching workspaces or branches, creating or deleting branches, reviewing branch history, or creating a pull request for a working branch. This skill should be used when the user asks to "list workspaces", "switch workspace", "create a branch", "delete a branch", "switch branch", "show branch history", "create a PR", or "open a pull request" in Honeydew.
233e79a6526ee36a9764c764c56aef1d7cc865f6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f0d2964efef0e2807a08e93c41b0a079e005fedd.description_zh: 从律师的 3–5 份文稿学习并保存写作风格画像，供 Jurisprudenciator 插件的写作 skill 共用，适用于首次使用或要求按本人样稿更新风格。
f0d2964efef0e2807a08e93c41b0a079e005fedd.source: Aprende la forma de escribir del abogado a partir de 3 a 5 escritos suyos y guarda un perfil de estilo que usan todas las skills de redacción de los plugins de Jurisprudenciator. Se ejecuta la primera vez que se usa cualquiera de estos plugins (cuando aún no hay perfil) y cuando el abogado dice «aquí tienes mis modelos», «escribe como yo», «adapta el estilo a mis escritos» o «actualiza mi estilo».
f0d2964efef0e2807a08e93c41b0a079e005fedd.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8e3ba089634b45d24412ed1cc245a68ec9dd348d.description_zh: 生成 Excel/表格格式的可比公司分析，包含经营指标、估值倍数和统计对标，用于上市公司估值、并购、IPO/融资定价、异常估值识别及投委会/行业汇报；缺少公开可比对象的私企、多元集团、困境公司、未收入初创或独特模式公司不适合。
8e3ba089634b45d24412ed1cc245a68ec9dd348d.source:
Build institutional-grade comparable company analyses with operating metrics, valuation multiples, and statistical benchmarking in Excel/spreadsheet format.

**Perfect for:**
- Public company valuation (M&A, investment analysis)
- Benchmarking performance vs. industry peers
- Pricing IPOs or funding rounds
- Identifying valuation outliers (over/under-valued)
- Supporting investment committee presentations
- Creating sector overview reports

**Not ideal for:**
- Private companies without comparable public peers
- Highly diversified conglomerates
- Distressed/bankrupt companies
- Pre-revenue startups
- Companies with unique business models
8e3ba089634b45d24412ed1cc245a68ec9dd348d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3e5dc52e24c4c59d08009bfd24c7f341d7dd373c.description_zh: 在没有打开 Office 应用的托管智能体环境中，以无界面方式直接生成磁盘上的 .pptx 文件。
3e5dc52e24c4c59d08009bfd24c7f341d7dd373c.source: Produce a .pptx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live PowerPoint document — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
3e5dc52e24c4c59d08009bfd24c7f341d7dd373c.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

bf537986285bd64501352e37c789e8b65767d8c1.description_zh: 为 Netlify 网站与预览选择访问保护层，处理密码保护、团队限制、公开/私有、可见性默认值和访问 SSO 会话问题；应用用户登录交给 netlify-identity，仪表板/团队 SSO 交给其他流程。
bf537986285bd64501352e37c789e8b65767d8c1.source: Picks the right Netlify protection layer for a deployed site and disambiguates the three unrelated things people call "auth". Use when a developer wants to password-protect a site or previews, restrict a project to their team, make a project public/private, set team visibility defaults, require SSO to view a site, or debug SSO-session symptoms like being logged out mid-session / getting 401s on an SSO-protected site / token expiry or refresh. Routes app-user login ("who is this user in my app") to the netlify-identity skill and dashboard/team SSO SSO elsewhere; this skill only chooses the perimeter layer for site/preview access.
bf537986285bd64501352e37c789e8b65767d8c1.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

c6c6a40a0f0cf6cc53f09eadca8310124195011f.description_zh: 使用 Claude、Codex 或 Gemini 在 Netlify 远程运行网站智能体任务，获取其他模型意见或将仓库开发任务交给远程执行。
c6c6a40a0f0cf6cc53f09eadca8310124195011f.source: Run AI agent tasks remotely on Netlify using Claude, Codex, or Gemini. Use when the user wants to run an AI agent on their site, get a second opinion from another model, or delegate development tasks to run remotely against their repo.
c6c6a40a0f0cf6cc53f09eadca8310124195011f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

fc03d50c1521ffe971758f6adc9c274d59402890.description_zh: 从 Netlify Functions/Edge Functions 调用 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 或 OpenRouter，由 AI Gateway 自动注入凭据；涵盖聊天、文本/图片生成、表单摘要、流式响应、SDK、环境变量、模型、限流、费用和本地调试。
fc03d50c1521ffe971758f6adc9c274d59402890.source: Use OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or OpenRouter models from Netlify Functions or Edge Functions without managing provider API keys or accounts — the gateway injects credentials automatically. Reach for this when you add an AI chatbot or completion endpoint, generate images or text with Gemini/GPT/Claude, summarize form submissions with AI, build an LLM-backed API route, stream a long AI generation, or wire up any server-side AI provider call on Netlify. Covers provider SDK setup, injected env vars, model availability, rate limits, credit costs, streaming for long generations, and local dev with netlify dev or the Vite plugin.
fc03d50c1521ffe971758f6adc9c274d59402890.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

75a65cf045f94145e0f722b335905bdf3f1ac02a.description_zh: 通过 @netlify/blobs 在 Functions、Edge Functions 和 Build Plugins 存取非结构化对象、上传文件、表单记录、后台生成物和缓存状态；不用于用户事务、关系数据、余额、计数或会话，此类需求用 Netlify DB。
75a65cf045f94145e0f722b335905bdf3f1ac02a.source: Store and retrieve unstructured objects, file uploads, and cache-like state on Netlify using the @netlify/blobs key/value API from Functions, Edge Functions, and Build Plugins. Use when a task involves saving user file or image uploads, persisting form or contact-form submissions, storing generated output from Background Functions (sitemaps/processed media/bulk-email results), building read-only asset stores, adding client-side blob expiration, or wiring file-based blob uploads at deploy time. Not for per-user, transactional, or relational data (counters/balances/sessions) — reach for Netlify DB there instead.
75a65cf045f94145e0f722b335905bdf3f1ac02a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3f0057d7fdef601f94177e62763e1bdf97cf68da.description_zh: 配置 Netlify CDN 对函数、边缘函数和代理响应的缓存，涵盖 Cache-Control、TTL、stale-while-revalidate、持久缓存、查询/头部/cookie/地区/语言缓存键、标签清除、Cache API、ISR 和 Cache-Status 排障。
3f0057d7fdef601f94177e62763e1bdf97cf68da.source: Cache dynamic and static responses on Netlify's CDN from Functions, Edge Functions, and proxies. Use when you add caching or cache-control headers to a function response, tune cache TTL or stale-while-revalidate, set up the durable cache, vary a cache key by query/header/cookie/country/language, purge or invalidate the cache by site or cache tag, use the programmatic Cache API (caches.open/match/put) or @netlify/cache helpers (fetchWithCache/cacheHeaders/getCacheStatus), speed up an expensive API call, add ISR or on-demand revalidation, or debug why a response is or isn't cached via the Cache-Status header.
3f0057d7fdef601f94177e62763e1bdf97cf68da.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8049ec39e7672202b4e6627f6d73ae9b6884c5d6.description_zh: 通过 netlify.toml、_headers 和 _redirects 配置构建、部署上下文、环境变量作用域、Secrets Controller、重定向/重写/代理、响应头、基础认证、monorepo 和 SPA 回退，并排查函数环境变量问题。
8049ec39e7672202b4e6627f6d73ae9b6884c5d6.source: Configure Netlify projects via netlify.toml and the _headers/_redirects files — covering build settings and deploy contexts alongside environment variables/scopes and the Secrets Controller plus redirect/rewrite/proxy and custom-header rules. Use when setting a build command or publish directory, adding redirect or rewrite or proxy rules, configuring custom headers or basic auth, setting or scoping environment variables and secrets, wiring up a monorepo or SPA fallback, or skipping unnecessary builds. Reach for this whenever you touch netlify.toml or ask "why is my env var undefined in a function" or "how do I redirect this path".
8049ec39e7672202b4e6627f6d73ae9b6884c5d6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6f5a4fd3087a48d93144336a17e3d03bc839391a.description_zh: 通过 @netlify/database 为 Netlify 应用接入 Postgres，支持 Functions/Edge 查询、SQL 迁移、Drizzle ORM、本地开发、预览数据库分支及从 Neon/Supabase/RDS 等既有 Postgres 项目迁移。
6f5a4fd3087a48d93144336a17e3d03bc839391a.source: Zero-config Postgres for Netlify apps via @netlify/database — querying data from Functions/Edge Functions, writing schema migrations, setting up Drizzle ORM, local dev with netlify dev, database branches for deploy previews, and migrating an existing Postgres project onto Netlify. Use when adding a database, building a contact form or CRUD API, writing SQL migrations, wiring up Drizzle, running netlify database commands, testing with a local Postgres, or switching from Neon/Supabase/RDS to Netlify Database.
6f5a4fd3087a48d93144336a17e3d03bc839391a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

2689034b9660615f6b0c574235bf072763bf0491.description_zh: 创建管理 Netlify 部署，涵盖 Git 持续部署、CLI 手动/匿名部署、拖放和 Deploy to Netlify 按钮，配置预览/分支/上下文、版本错配保护和构建钩子，并诊断失败或被密钥检查拦截的部署。
2689034b9660615f6b0c574235bf072763bf0491.source: Create and manage Netlify deploys — Git continuous deployment, CLI manual/anonymous deploys, Deploy to Netlify buttons, drag-and-drop, and per-context netlify.toml build settings. Use when linking a repo, deploying from the CLI, setting up Deploy Previews or branch deploys, configuring deploy contexts, adding skew protection, fixing a failed or secrets-flagged deploy, or wiring build hooks and Deploy to Netlify buttons.
2689034b9660615f6b0c574235bf072763bf0491.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

7b758462a07104320799a1eb4b2005614d973b83.description_zh: 使用 TypeScript/JavaScript 开发、配置和部署 Deno 运行时的 Netlify Edge Functions，处理边缘认证、地理重定向、A/B 测试、个性化、本地化、SSR、响应变换、路径路由、缓存和错误。
7b758462a07104320799a1eb4b2005614d973b83.source: Write, configure, and deploy Netlify Edge Functions (Deno runtime at the network edge) in TypeScript/JavaScript. Use when adding request/response manipulation at the edge — auth middleware, geolocation redirects, A/B testing and personalization, content localization, redirects/rewrites, SSR at the edge, or transforming responses — or when configuring path routing, response caching, or edge error handling. Triggers on tasks like "add auth middleware", "geo-based redirect", "A/B testing at the edge", "rewrite requests", or editing files in netlify/edge-functions.
7b758462a07104320799a1eb4b2005614d973b83.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

bc6a4f63fb23ca576d77feef09fbfde92d9b6181.description_zh: 为 Netlify 网站配置无服务器表单，涵盖部署时识别、提交存储、垃圾过滤、通知、文件上传、AJAX、感谢页、蜜罐/reCAPTCHA、框架适配、API 读取和未注册/未收到提交的排障。
bc6a4f63fb23ca576d77feef09fbfde92d9b6181.source: Serverless form handling on Netlify-hosted sites — detects HTML forms at deploy time, stores submissions, filters spam, and sends notifications. Use when adding a contact form, lead-capture form, file-upload form, or newsletter signup to a Netlify site; wiring AJAX form submission; setting up a custom thank-you page; adding a honeypot or reCAPTCHA to a form; getting forms working in Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, or Gatsby; reading form submissions via the Netlify API; or debugging missing submissions and forms that silently fail to register.
bc6a4f63fb23ca576d77feef09fbfde92d9b6181.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

4b6596553dd5f445aad146e6dca21100df9f174d.description_zh: 部署和配置 Netlify 上的 Next.js、Astro、Nuxt、SvelteKit、Remix 等框架，处理构建目录、SSR/边缘适配、中间件、平台上下文、本地模拟、环境变量、SPA 回退和构建失败。
4b6596553dd5f445aad146e6dca21100df9f174d.source: Deploy and configure web frameworks on Netlify — build settings and SSR/edge adapters plus local platform emulation and env vars. Use when setting up or fixing a framework deploy (Next.js / Astro / Nuxt / SvelteKit / Remix / React Router / TanStack Start / SolidStart / Gatsby / Angular / Vite / Express / Hydrogen / Hugo / Eleventy / Vue / React), adding SSR or edge functions or middleware wired to Netlify context, fixing SPA redirect and catch-all rules, setting a build command or publish directory, or debugging "why isn't my env var updating" and framework build failures.
4b6596553dd5f445aad146e6dca21100df9f174d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

9fe17636f7c6b7ed3cebb4e2aa80b73f593360b0.description_zh: 使用 TypeScript、JavaScript 或 Go 编写部署 Netlify Functions，支持 API、表单、认证钩子、流式/AI 代理、定时与长后台任务、部署/表单事件、限流及区域/内存配置，说明路径、处理器结构和本地测试。
9fe17636f7c6b7ed3cebb4e2aa80b73f593360b0.source: Write, configure, and deploy Netlify serverless functions in TypeScript, JavaScript, or Go. Use this when adding an API endpoint or backend route, adding a contact form handler, wiring auth or Identity signup/login hooks, building streaming or AI-proxy responses, scheduling cron jobs, running long background jobs (batch processing/scraping), reacting to deploy or form events, setting up rate limiting or region/memory config, or reading environment variables and secrets inside a function. Covers file locations, the Request/Context/Response handler shape, path routing, config options, and local testing with netlify dev.
9fe17636f7c6b7ed3cebb4e2aa80b73f593360b0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d35b80827d264cec07ea651829310fc86857f3d3.description_zh: 用 @netlify/identity 为网站实现注册、登录、退出、社交 OAuth、服务端验证、角色权限、用户管理和事件钩子，支持认证邮件与确认/恢复回调；整站公司/团队访问限制交给 netlify-access-control。
d35b80827d264cec07ea651829310fc86857f3d3.source: Add authentication and user management to a Netlify site with @netlify/identity — signup/login/logout, OAuth social login (Google/GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket), server-side user verification in Functions, role-based access control (RBAC), admin user management, and Identity event hooks. Use when adding a login/signup flow, "add social login", gating content by user role, protecting a function or page behind auth, assigning roles at signup, customizing auth emails, or handling OAuth/confirmation/recovery callbacks. Not for locking an entire site to a company/team — that is netlify-access-control.
d35b80827d264cec07ea651829310fc86857f3d3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

fec1313e1341c6676462026110f64a8576900bcc.description_zh: 通过 /.netlify/images 和 Netlify Image CDN 按需裁切、缩放、转换和优化图片，支持响应式图、缩略图、AVIF/WebP/PNG、模糊占位、远程域名允许列表、用户上传和框架图片组件。
fec1313e1341c6676462026110f64a8576900bcc.source: Transform, resize, crop, reformat, and optimize images on demand via Netlify Image CDN's /.netlify/images endpoint. Use when adding responsive images, generating thumbnails, converting formats (avif/webp/png), cropping to aspect ratios, tuning image quality, creating blurred placeholders, allowlisting remote image domains, serving user-uploaded images, or wiring framework image components (Next.js, Astro, Nuxt, Angular, Gatsby) to Netlify. Triggers on tasks like "optimize images", "add image thumbnails", "resize images on the fly", "serve images from an external domain", or "add blur placeholders".
fec1313e1341c6676462026110f64a8576900bcc.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e125d26127fa568ebd52fe457020ab0332988819.description_zh: 在 Netlify 上构建、部署和保护 MCP 服务，通过 Function 的 MCP SDK 与 Streamable HTTP 暴露应用/API 工具，涵盖共享密钥或 Identity 用户密钥认证、读写安全、上传和客户端连接。
e125d26127fa568ebd52fe457020ab0332988819.source: Build, deploy, and secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers on Netlify. Use whenever the task involves creating an MCP server, exposing an app or API to AI agents as MCP tools, letting Claude / Cursor / Claude Code call a custom remote server, or adding MCP tools to an existing Netlify site. Covers the MCP SDK + Streamable HTTP transport on a Netlify Function, authentication (single shared secret vs per-user API keys with Netlify Identity), read/write safety, file uploads, and connecting clients. Use even when the user just says "MCP", "tool server for an agent", or "let an AI use my API".
e125d26127fa568ebd52fe457020ab0332988819.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ad2f72e2a3c8443a293d8a8bb8b7a17e0ee4298e.description_zh: 围绕计划或设计持续访谈，逐个澄清决策分支并形成共同理解，适用于要求压力测试或 grill me 的设计评审。
ad2f72e2a3c8443a293d8a8bb8b7a17e0ee4298e.source: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree. Use when user wants to stress-test a plan, get grilled on their design, or mentions "grill me".

Clarify must finish before Design, Estimate, or Generate. Includes AI provider migration guidance (for example, OpenAI to Amazon Bedrock) by selecting closest-fit Bedrock model families for required modality, latency/quality targets, context windows, and cost constraints. Model mapping is compatibility-guided, not 1:1 parity; validate prompts, tool-calling behavior, and eval metrics before cutover. Runs a 6-phase process: discover Heroku resources live via the authenticated Heroku CLI (read-only, consent-gated) and/or from Terraform files, Procfile/app.json, and optional billing exports, clarify migration requirements, design AWS architecture, estimate costs, generate migration artifacts, and collect optional feedback. After Estimate, an optional what-if workshop can reprice region/HA/compute/Graviton scenarios without re-discovery. Clarify must finish before Design, Estimate, or Generate. Uses a flat resource model (no clustering or dependency graphs) with deterministic mapping tables for core services (Dynos → Elastic Beanstalk by default, Postgres → RDS/Aurora, Redis → ElastiCache, Kafka → MSK) and a fast-path table for 13+ common add-ons. Cedar/Fir generation detection is detect-only in v1. Pipeline/Review Apps are detect-only. Do not use for: GCP or Azure migrations to AWS, AWS-to-Heroku reverse migration, general AWS architecture advice without migration intent, Heroku-to-Heroku refactoring, or multi-cloud deployments that do not involve migrating off Heroku.

b3d27d0d56899fd8429ee2467a551b6de8e8b1d4.description_zh: 比较 CockroachDB 显式多语句事务和单语句 CTE 事务，按公平测试方法分析竞争、重试压力与性能，帮助判断是否将多步骤应用流程改为单 SQL。
b3d27d0d56899fd8429ee2467a551b6de8e8b1d4.source: Guides benchmarking and comparing explicit multi-statement transactions versus single-statement CTE transactions in CockroachDB, with fair test methodology, contention analysis, and performance interpretation. e19e223fe5fac3a66c228ece2a864857a35b36aa.description_zh: 指导 CockroachDB 应用事务设计，涵盖生命周期、隐式/显式事务、指数退避重试、SQL 不变量、选择性悲观锁、集合操作、连接池、预编译语句、键集分页和 follower reads，区分业务与数据库逻辑。

d0c4bfabfdeac23bda2c1e3a7790172eb7159c8a.source: Manages TLS certificate and encryption key lifecycle across all tiers. Advanced/BYOC covers managed TLS (no action) and CMEK (Customer-Managed Encryption Key) rotation in your KMS. Standard and Basic have fully managed TLS and encryption with no customer action. CMEK is only available on Advanced. Use when monitoring cert health, performing rotation, managing CMEK, or responding to key compromise.

af0084594eef62a666bc25eb8cd68c047c236b81.source: Manages CockroachDB cluster capacity across all tiers. Self-Hosted covers node decommissioning for permanent removal and adding nodes for expansion. Advanced/BYOC covers scaling node count and machine size via Cloud Console, API, or Terraform. Standard covers adjusting provisioned compute (vCPUs). Basic auto-scales — guidance covers spending limits and cost management. Use when scaling capacity up or down, permanently removing nodes, or managing costs.

ffcc1084f2c041b3a7048164fa6c7db281bc79bc.source: Reviews, audits, and modifies CockroachDB cluster settings. Self-Hosted has full control over all settings and start flags. Advanced/BYOC can modify most SQL-level settings but infrastructure settings are managed by CRL. Standard has limited settings access — session variables are the primary tuning mechanism. Basic has minimal settings — use session variables and Cloud Console. Use when auditing configuration, tuning performance, or troubleshooting settings-related issues.

eab5f4be87fdd63288e35edec92654bb1737313c.source: Manages planned cluster maintenance across all tiers. Self-Hosted covers node drain procedures for OS patching, hardware changes, and configuration updates. Advanced/BYOC covers maintenance window configuration, patch scheduling, deferral policies, and monitoring during CRL-managed maintenance. Standard and Basic maintenance is fully managed with no customer action. Use when planning maintenance, configuring maintenance windows, or preparing applications for maintenance events.

Advanced/BYOC covers Cloud Console, API, and Terraform provisioning with production settings. Standard covers cluster creation and provisioned compute selection. Basic covers cluster creation and spending limits. Use when creating a new cluster, preparing for production go-live, or validating deployment configuration.
c51b7ad67286b540919cde32ae9c5b2ba903f98f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

Basic monitors Request Unit consumption and connectivity. Use for daily checks, pre-maintenance validation, post-incident verification, or production readiness assessment.

6c0a0b5a79d7d37001b77dd9f850594e498632ab.source:
Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text and rewrite in the author's
actual voice. Based on Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing" guide plus a
statistical voice fingerprint built from the author's own corpus.
Three modes: humanize (default), detect-only, fingerprint-diff.
Requires voice-indexer.py to be run once to build ~/.claude/voice-fingerprint.json.
v2.6.0: pre-flight doc-type detection, non-prose skip pass, incremental mode,
mandatory voice calibration with auto-load, personal overrides file support,
and runbook lessons-learned logging.
v2.7.0: Spanish-language rule library (with bilingual/Spanglish handling),
AI-iness density check for adaptive pass strength (light/mixed/full), and
four-tier ROI-ranked pattern ordering so time-constrained runs hit the
highest-signal rules first.
v3.0.0: Voice fingerprint mode — statistical fingerprint from journal corpus
anchors rewrites to actual author patterns, not generic "sounds human."
New fingerprint-diff mode scores how close any text is to the author's voice.
Indexer script: voice-indexer.py (run once, re-run monthly).
6c0a0b5a79d7d37001b77dd9f850594e498632ab.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

7f5052489fb12060c15a1e7bc7e4a13a6b4d955b.source: Create a Kobiton test run from a test case or suite, then offer to monitor it. After the run is created, offer monitoring in a single prompt — monitor + auto-open live remediation (only when the org's live-remediation flag is ON), monitor only, or don't monitor — and hand off to the monitor-test-run skill if chosen. Use when the user asks to "create / kick off / start / run a test run", "run test case X on N devices", or similar. Wraps the createTestRun MCP tool (and getOrgSettings / listDevices for defaults); delegates the watch to monitor-test-run. Not for running a compiled UIAutomator/XCUITest bundle - that is the CLI's `test run` command in run-interactive-session.
7f5052489fb12060c15a1e7bc7e4a13a6b4d955b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

441b82a8158ab42100b4a7b0e89c6678026b634f.source: Drive an already-reserved Kobiton device from a natural-language intent. Opens an automation Appium session directly against the Kobiton WebDriver hub, runs an observe-decide-act loop with one action per iteration, pauses to ask the user when stuck (same-action repetition, screen unchanged, or model self-declared blocker), and returns the session id. Use when the user says "drive the device to X", describes a flow they want exercised on a reserved device, or asks to "automate this intent on Kobiton". Complements run-interactive-session (which uses the CLI session type) by using the automation session type so the resulting session is consumable by saveTestCase and the existing test-run authoring flow.
441b82a8158ab42100b4a7b0e89c6678026b634f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

cf75155c06d8ed4c0c292894951a302fd8ac4812.description_zh: 监控 Kobiton 测试运行直到所有执行结束，按实际状态变化报告阻断和最终结果；核对在线修复设置，避免把带 BLOCKER_ENCOUNTERED 的完成状态误报为通过。
cf75155c06d8ed4c0c292894951a302fd8ac4812.source: Watch a running Kobiton test run and narrate it to the user: read the org''s live-remediation flag up front, poll the run until every execution is terminal, surface the live-remediation URL the moment an execution is blocked, and give a correct post-mortem so a COMPLETED-with-BLOCKER_ENCOUNTERED execution is never reported as passed. Quiet on passes, loud on blockers and the final summary; suite runs are grouped by test case. When live remediation is enabled, it asks up front whether to auto-open the live-remediation browser window when a blocker hits. Use when the user asks to "watch", "monitor", "track", or "follow" a test run, or as the natural follow-up right after createTestRun returns a testRunId. The watch runs a bundled poller that emits only on real state changes (no per-poll chatter); uses getOrgSettings up front and terminateTestRun on request, plus the shared chromeless launcher — it does not drive or resolve the blocker itself.
cf75155c06d8ed4c0c292894951a302fd8ac4812.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

58b49d966c2a83a95fc007b755f39f204827532e.description_zh: 对 agentic-harness 运行开展改善复盘，将经过脱敏的工具改进反馈整理为标准格式，仅在用户明确批准后提交上游 GitHub issue。
58b49d966c2a83a95fc007b755f39f204827532e.source: Run a kaizen retrospective on an agentic-harness run and, with the user's consent, file tool-improvement feedback as a GitHub issue on the upstream agentic-harness repo. It gathers what was done and the choices made during the run into the standard feedback format, redacts project-identifying details, and creates the issue only after explicit approval. Boundary: this files feedback about the agentic-harness TOOL upstream — it is not harness-review (which assesses THIS project's own harness and writes a review context), and not tracker-advisor or issue triage in the user's own project.
58b49d966c2a83a95fc007b755f39f204827532e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

9c471508220bd05cb5221529b89224e5b54cb5d3.description_zh: 只读审核既有代理执行框架，核对技能和代理实际使用、文件与 CLAUDE.md 的偏差、触发及连接，形成供 harness-setup 使用的优先整改背景。
9c471508220bd05cb5221529b89224e5b54cb5d3.source: Assess an existing agentic harness — read-only. Use to review, audit, or assess a harness, to judge how well its skills and agents are actually used, to check drift between the files and the CLAUDE.md record, or to validate that skills trigger and agents wire up. It produces a prioritized review context that hands off to harness-setup, and writes nothing. To build or change a harness, use harness-setup. Not for reviewing ordinary code or a pull request (that is code review).
9c471508220bd05cb5221529b89224e5b54cb5d3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

36fe05612aa89cd131081d136d8d2c4247028f60.description_zh: 创建、扩展和维护项目 .claude 中的代理、技能及编排器，应用审核发现；按请求注册适用 MCP 或插件，也可生成仓库与 Jira/Linear 等双跟踪系统同步。
36fe05612aa89cd131081d136d8d2c4247028f60.source: Build, extend, and maintain a project's agentic harness — the agents, skills, and orchestrator under .claude/. This skill writes files. Use it to set up, scaffold, extend, rebuild, or sync a harness, to add or change an agent or skill, or to apply a review context from harness-review; on request it also discovers and registers fitting MCP/plugin tools. When a project runs both a repo-native tracker and a human tracker (Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues), it also generates the dual-tracker sync — use it for 'keep the trackers in sync', 'sync issues to Jira/Linear', or 'tracker sync setup'. For read-only assessment of an existing harness, use harness-review — this skill is the writer, that one is the reader. Not for authoring a single standalone skill or plugin (use plugin-dev or skill-creator), or one-shot automation recommendations (use claude-code-setup). Not for choosing a project's spec-driven development system or issue tracker — use spec-advisor or tracker-advisor.
36fe05612aa89cd131081d136d8d2c4247028f60.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8217338316bfea516ce940d353fac2c38556f54a.description_zh: 先检查项目是否缺少规格驱动开发系统，再建议适用框架并交由其安装器设置；已有规格或 ADR 注册表时不介入，也不直接编写规格。
8217338316bfea516ce940d353fac2c38556f54a.source: Detect whether a software project lacks a spec-driven development system and, if so, advise which one fits (GitHub Spec Kit, OpenSpec, BMAD-METHOD, Agent OS, Taskmaster, AWS Kiro, ADR tooling) and delegate setup to that system's own installer. Use when setting up a project's spec or planning process, when asked which spec system or SDD framework a project should use, when adopting spec-driven development, or when harness-setup detects a software project with no spec system. Scans first for any existing spec or ADR registry and stays out if one is present. Does NOT author specs itself (the installed system owns that), does NOT build the .claude/ agent harness (that is harness-setup), does NOT create Claude Code components (that is plugin-dev or skill-creator), and does NOT choose an issue or bug tracker (that is tracker-advisor).
8217338316bfea516ce940d353fac2c38556f54a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b4ed27a99466ef18cc24ed84644cee633953fffb.source: Detect whether a software project lacks an issue tracker suited to agentic work and, if so, advise which one fits (Beads, Backlog.md, git-bug, git-issues, Beans, or GitHub Issues, Linear, Jira via their official access paths) and delegate setup to that system's own installer. Use when choosing or setting up a project's issue, bug, or work tracker, when asked how agents should pull ready work or record work state, or when harness-setup detects a software project with no tracker. Scans first and stays out if a tracker is already present. Does NOT author, triage, or groom issues (the installed tracker owns that), does NOT choose a spec system or spec-derived task decomposition such as Taskmaster (that is spec-advisor), does NOT build the .claude/ agent harness (that is harness-setup), and does NOT sync two trackers with each other (harness-setup generates that, via its dual-tracker sync sub-step).
b4ed27a99466ef18cc24ed84644cee633953fffb.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

688609281742803f68eb635b33b95c32eaa367bb.description_zh: 作为 Agentics Beyond Code 的平台中立入口，评估团队现状、流程与瓶颈，设计应采用的代理工作流、持续维护文档和人工批准节点，再选择实现平台。
688609281742803f68eb635b33b95c32eaa367bb.source: The platform-neutral front door to Agentics Beyond Code. Use it to assess how a team or organization works today and to design which agentic workflows, living documents, and human approval points it should adopt, before building on GitHub, Claude, Productboard, Atlassian, or Google Workspace. Trigger on assessment requests such as a pre-work or readiness assessment, current-state and gap analysis, org health readout, delivery or process diagnosis, bottleneck analysis, or a review of GitHub, Jira, Linear, project boards, incidents, discussions, and operating docs. Also trigger on design requests from non-coding operators (product managers, product ops, compliance, GTM, program owners, researchers, designers, support leads, team leads) such as "what agentic workflows do I need", "turn my process into agentic workflows", "set up workflows for my team", "bootstrap Agentics Beyond Code", "steal from this repo for our team", or "where should these workflows run".

9c2a6920ac7c3db6d613a10c4c478651ea8e8f64.source: Architecture patterns for AI agents that communicate over email -- why agents need dedicated inboxes rather than human email accounts, infrastructure/provider tradeoffs, one-inbox-per-agent, two-way conversation loops, human-in-the-loop drafts, WebSocket vs webhook event design, multi-agent topologies, OTP flows, and the threat model (prompt injection, webhook spoofing, credential exposure, data leakage). 9c2a6920ac7c3db6d613a10c4c478651ea8e8f64.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

597e322f4f664a01b29131b86a5b7770b4a6ad1f.source: Operate AgentMail from a shell with the official CLI. 1dbc6fe31f4661b2a1878b2d3b1fc6b1bc83e42f.description_zh: 使用 AgentMail TypeScript/Python SDK 实现收件箱、消息、线程、草稿、附件、域名、名单、pod、webhook 和 WebSocket 流程，处理 DNS 与投递故障。
1dbc6fe31f4661b2a1878b2d3b1fc6b1bc83e42f.source: Build with the AgentMail TypeScript or Python SDK for inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, domain, allow/block list, pod, webhook, and WebSocket workflows, including programmatic agent sign-up, domain/DNS administration, and deliverability triage (bounces, spam, blocked mail). 71b7734b66aa439c016ad01621df838b1738a522.description_zh: 通过已连接的 AgentMail MCP 阅读、搜索、总结和分类邮件，检查附件与会话，管理已读标签并识别待回复项。
71b7734b66aa439c016ad01621df838b1738a522.source: Read, search, summarize, and triage AgentMail inboxes through the connected MCP server. Use for ANY request to look at, search, or process mail — even a simple 'search my inbox for X' or 'any new mail?'; the read workflow applies regardless of task size. Also use to summarize conversations, inspect attachments, manage read/unread labels, or find messages needing a reply; do not use for sending or drafting (send-email), inbox administration (manage-inboxes), or MCP connection setup (agentmail-mcp).
71b7734b66aa439c016ad01621df838b1738a522.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a6c5b42d85747f4e90654fa1ed4b8bcb21e081e8.source: Create, list, inspect, update, or delete AgentMail inboxes through the connected MCP server. Use for ANY inbox lifecycle request — even a quick list-inboxes or a simple delete; deletion safeguards apply regardless of task size. Also use when the user asks for a new agent email address, wants inbox details changed, or removes an inbox; do not use for sending mail (send-email), reading or triage (check-email), or MCP connection setup (agentmail-mcp).
a6c5b42d85747f4e90654fa1ed4b8bcb21e081e8.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

909283ec5249b2b4ce837fd244dab66b2453469d.description_zh: 通过 AgentMail MCP 起草、发送、回复或转发邮件，支持供审核的草稿及定时安排；原文要求所有发送请求遵循发送规则。
909283ec5249b2b4ce837fd244dab66b2453469d.source: Draft, send, reply to, or forward email through the connected AgentMail MCP server. Use for ANY request to send, reply to, or forward mail — even a quick one-line send or a simple forward that looks like a single tool call; the sending rules apply regardless of task size. Also use to compose messages, create or schedule drafts for review, or send to named recipients; do not use for reading or triaging mail (check-email), inbox administration (manage-inboxes), or MCP connection setup (agentmail-mcp).
909283ec5249b2b4ce837fd244dab66b2453469d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

7a5d6676349e5ff624f1e29acbaf18df1f4daa07.description_zh: 顺序处理全部未关闭 PR，执行分支更新、深入审核、修复、新 CI、合并及 Jira 复盘；单轮无法修复的 PR 标为阻塞。
7a5d6676349e5ff624f1e29acbaf18df1f4daa07.source: Process every open PR sequentially: rebase → deep review → fix → fresh CI → merge → Jira postmortem + Done. Block PRs too broken to fix in one pass. Triggers: merge train, process all open prs, /merge-train.
7a5d6676349e5ff624f1e29acbaf18df1f4daa07.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

fa6b6cb789c40cbbc6a9416ae47bc5c0aca36ec5.source: Fix every PR review issue, commit, push, re-check until satisfied. Triggers: fix all, fix everything, /fix-until-satisfied. After merge-review-pr.
fa6b6cb789c40cbbc6a9416ae47bc5c0aca36ec5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b82f064d820115987796cf8e6b4916c7b40ccb94.source: Post structured post-merge comment to Jira ticket + transition to Done (skip transition in blocked mode). Mandatory even on 0-issue PRs. Triggers: jira postmortem, comment jira, /jira-postmortem.
b82f064d820115987796cf8e6b4916c7b40ccb94.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

cbce7ace25dc28480f3ee9f9570d032f19976668.source: Deep PR review: read every changed file in full, check correctness/security/naming/tests/docs/ACs. Report by severity. Triggers: review pr, /review-pr. Use instead of /review for file-level depth.
cbce7ace25dc28480f3ee9f9570d032f19976668.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e834f5bf70cea73dd64123399ceae2015448ca1a.source: Rebase PR branch on main: merge --no-ff, resolve conflicts intelligently, lint-after-rebase gate, push only if merge commit created. Triggers: update pr, merge main into, /update-pr.

7cf97138778ee4047272709734d7830c96854dc4.source: Vision Doc in Confluence. Triggers: new idea, start project, create vision doc. Cycle start, before skill 2.

93ca5d794a980e6086729ee5d19fd6ae95050b85.source: Mandatory end-of-sprint epic gate, 3 lenses: engineer (smoke + integration), architect (Confluence specs vs delivered code), tech lead (deep severity-graded review of all sprint diffs). Triggers: sprint closeout, close sprint, /sprint-closeout. After last merge + agile-12-tech-debt-sweep, before retro.
93ca5d794a980e6086729ee5d19fd6ae95050b85.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ac90ced7c7ebc2d5efcf2323f9b9de2573dcdfb6.source: QA validation, confirm-after-merge: Story already Done (merged) — confirm ACs hold on main, stamp sign-off, no transition. Regression → file a Bug, never reopen. Triggers: validate story, QA story, QA check, confirm ACs. After agile-13-sprint-closeout, before skill 15.
ac90ced7c7ebc2d5efcf2323f9b9de2573dcdfb6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

36a5c5770792b872862b1db05e245c7ce523c534.description_zh: 所有故事完成后，在 Confluence 进行冲刺复盘并更新路线图，适用于运行复盘、关闭冲刺及总结经验；完成后交给技能 5。
36a5c5770792b872862b1db05e245c7ce523c534.source: Sprint retro in Confluence + Roadmap update. Triggers: run retro, close sprint, what did we learn. After all Stories Done, hands off to skill 5.
36a5c5770792b872862b1db05e245c7ce523c534.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5a68dd28377d14eebcc2f2af2c4c0b7d6a48ea9e.description_zh: 交替运行 agile-10-implement 实现与 agile-11-merge-train 合并，直到当前冲刺两端都清空（DRAINED）或受阻（STUCK）。支持 concurrency=N 与 dispatch=session，适用于持续实现合并、清空看板和完成冲刺。
5a68dd28377d14eebcc2f2af2c4c0b7d6a48ea9e.source: Drain the active sprint to a fixed point: auto-alternate agile-10-implement (build) and agile-11-merge-train (merge) until both empty (DRAINED) or blocked (STUCK). Optional concurrency=N, dispatch=session. Triggers: drain the sprint, run the sprint to completion, implement and merge until done, clear the whole board, ship the sprint.
5a68dd28377d14eebcc2f2af2c4c0b7d6a48ea9e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

18e4fa4ef32872489f59bc66a9d475dc28fe2474.description_zh: 集成 Agora 到应用，构建语音 AI 智能体、音视频通话、直播、屏幕共享、应用内消息和在线状态、录制及令牌认证流程；也用于 agora CLI 登录、快速入门、环境配置、诊断、能力查询、技能和 MCP 服务。
18e4fa4ef32872489f59bc66a9d475dc28fe2474.source: Activate when the user wants to build voice AI agents, video or voice calls, live streaming, screen sharing, in-app messaging and presence, recording, token or auth flows, or use the `agora` CLI for login, quickstarts, env setup, diagnostics, introspection, skills, or MCP serving, especially when integrating Agora into an app.
18e4fa4ef32872489f59bc66a9d475dc28fe2474.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

9ee883834db0213f2f337ed379f041ab3ec095a9.description_zh: 分析用户的 Claude Code 与 Cowork 历史会话，整理任务类型、频率、成功程度和阻力，提出减少反复迭代的独立技能建议。适用于分析 Claude 使用、任务画像和令牌花费模式；输出可分享的 profile.csv、含 AI 优先原则对比及令牌图表的个人辅导 explorer.html，以及 skill-proposals.md。
9ee883834db0213f2f337ed379f041ab3ec095a9.source: Mine the user's Claude Code + Cowork session history into a structured task profile, what they do with AI, how often, how successfully where friction lives, then propose atomic skills that would reduce iteration. Use when the user asks to "analyse my Claude use", "build a task profile", "what tasks do I do with Claude", "where am I spending tokens", "what skills would help me", or mentions reviewing past sessions for patterns. Produces profile.csv (shareable), explorer.html (personal coaching view with AI-first principle comparison + token-spend chart), and skill-proposals.md.
9ee883834db0213f2f337ed379f041ab3ec095a9.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

61d6dd9103505898257514fa6aa34d3cb0befdf4.description_zh: 读取本地 Claude Code 与 Cowork 会话，诊断对话长度分布、超长会话占比、缓存重建费用及各项目的使用效率，在终端展示结果；可进一步用并行 Haiku 子智能体分析高成本和高效率会话并生成简洁 Markdown 报告。适用于个人令牌成本和使用习惯诊断。
61d6dd9103505898257514fa6aa34d3cb0befdf4.source: Personal diagnosis of where your Claude Code + Cowork spend goes. Reads local transcripts, prints your conversation length distribution, marathon share, cache rebuild costs, and per-project diagnosis (good projects and problem projects) right in the terminal. Then offers a deeper dive that fans out parallel Haiku subagents over your most expensive (and most efficient) sessions and writes a tight Markdown report. Use when the user asks "why is my Claude spend so high", "where am I burning tokens", "diagnose my Claude habits", "audit my Claude usage", or asks for a personal token-cost diagnosis.
61d6dd9103505898257514fa6aa34d3cb0befdf4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8d10b8fa43acf32a58d0a3816939fa2aa07d8364.description_zh: 在已连接 DataLabs 的 AI Context Bridge for HubSpot MCP（mcp.datalabs.store）时，分析 HubSpot 交易、销售管道、联系人、公司、互动、邮件活动及工作流；也用于表和模式探索、SQL 生成调试，以及复用或调整加权管道、预测校准、停滞交易、互动与赢单率、收入集中度和邮件归因分析。
8d10b8fa43acf32a58d0a3816939fa2aa07d8364.source: Use when the user has connected their DataLabs "AI Context Bridge for HubSpot" MCP connector (tools like execute_query, get_tables_list, get_full_database_schema, get_semantic_metadata, save_query, list_saved_queries pointed at mcp.datalabs.store) and asks analytical questions about their HubSpot data — deals, pipeline, contacts, companies, engagements, email campaigns, or workflows. Also use for schema exploration ("what tables do I have"), SQL generation/debugging against this connector, or reproducing/adapting known revenue-ops analyses (weighted pipeline, forecast calibration, stuck deals, engagement-vs-win-rate, revenue concentration, email attribution).
8d10b8fa43acf32a58d0a3816939fa2aa07d8364.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e43b71324220821d3d0b54dcdd4b60b75a21847b.description_zh: 首日手动初始化广告管理，之后每月运行：先研究企业公开资料，读取账户结构，建立计划、看板、创意准则、仪表板和定时任务。只询问决定支出上限的月度预算与每日限额；月度运行重新读取证据、按台账纠错并校正偏差。
e43b71324220821d3d0b54dcdd4b60b75a21847b.source: Runs once by hand on the first day and once a month after that. On the first run it researches the business from its own public surfaces before asking anything, reads the account structure once, writes the plan folder, seeds the board, creates the creative doctrine, builds the dashboard, and registers the recurring jobs. It asks about exactly two things, the monthly ceiling and the daily cap, because those are the two numbers that decide how much money can leave. On every monthly run it re reads the evidence, corrects what the ledgers prove wrong, and reconciles drift.
e43b71324220821d3d0b54dcdd4b60b75a21847b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

c65ae96cc4e27dc2476f17dbeb3e84e655c99c25.description_zh: 工作日只读广告账户：先确认读取窗口内主要转化事件仍有发生，再按账户、广告活动、广告组和创意读取昨日花费、投放及结果。每个对象每天追加一行指标并附界面、日期范围和读取日；未经渠道放行不创建、保存、激活或花费。
c65ae96cc4e27dc2476f17dbeb3e84e655c99c25.source: Weekdays. The only routine in this kit that opens a screen inside an account that can spend, and everything it does there is read. It confirms the primary conversion event still fired inside the read window before it trusts any other figure, then reads yesterday's spend, delivery, and result rows at account, campaign, ad set, and creative level and appends one row per object per day to the daily metrics ledger with the screen, the date range, and the read date beside every figure. It creates nothing, saves nothing, activates nothing, and spends nothing, unless you released the channel.
c65ae96cc4e27dc2476f17dbeb3e84e655c99c25.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

662fb23898f81c95719427288b07a52d51ebb132.description_zh: 工作日每次处理一张就绪卡片，制作可直接粘贴的本地广告活动配置表、否定关键词文件、转化动作规格、受众定义或上传包。在 RELEASES.md 放行账户前全程只用文本编辑器；放行后由步骤 6a 通过已有连接发布批准包，并为平台返回的每个 ID 留存回执。
662fb23898f81c95719427288b07a52d51ebb132.source: Weekdays. Works the next ready card on the board, one card per run, and assembles what it needs as a complete local file ready to paste: a campaign build sheet, a negative keyword file, a conversion action specification, an audience definition, or an upload packet. The whole step happens in a text editor until you release the ad account in RELEASES.md, and then Step 6a publishes the approved package through a connection you already have and writes a receipt for every id the platform returns.
662fb23898f81c95719427288b07a52d51ebb132.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

4e7ab7f634157052e99f0d85f06cb12008edbbdd.description_zh: 每周五全程只读，依据每日指标台账给本周评分，制作下周账户调整的优先列表；每项列出改动、准确界面、现值、建议值及证据行。不提出无来源的变更，不执行调整；支出仅限已放行范围。
4e7ab7f634157052e99f0d85f06cb12008edbbdd.source: Weekly, on a Friday, read only everywhere. Scores the week from the daily metrics ledger alone, with the screen and the date range beside every number, then writes the ranked paste ready list of what to change in the account next week. Each line names one change, the exact screen, the current value, the proposed value, and the evidence row it came from. It proposes no change it cannot source, it names no action it took because it takes none, and it spends only where you released it.
4e7ab7f634157052e99f0d85f06cb12008edbbdd.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

72859677897865b2937b6f484fd27336e972a019.description_zh: 每月最后一个工作日，将创意台账与每日指标核对，按角度、形式、开场钩子及优惠表达评估成效，而非逐文件评分。用当月实测结果复核并修订创意准则，记录疲劳曲线、淘汰未见收益的方案；样本不足以区分角度时不调整。
72859677897865b2937b6f484fd27336e972a019.source: Monthly, on the last weekday. Folds a month of the creative ledger against the daily metrics ledger to score angle, format, hook, and offer framing rather than individual files, tests every line currently in the creative doctrine against what the month actually measured, and rewrites the doctrine where the evidence disagrees with the assumption. It records the fatigue curve it observed, retires what has not earned, and changes nothing where the month holds too few rows to tell one angle from another.
72859677897865b2937b6f484fd27336e972a019.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

2a43a3b64ae284822b3490a84da4e3e4e13f220b.description_zh: 工作日按现有创意准则和指标衰减证据，每次制作一套创意，将图片和准确文案写入注明目标界面的日期文件夹并登记卡片。不打开账户或上传；发送与花费仅限已放行渠道，不接触凭据。
2a43a3b64ae284822b3490a84da4e3e4e13f220b.source: Weekdays. Produces one creative set per run against evidence rather than taste, reading the standing doctrine for the angles currently earning and the metrics ledger for what has decayed. It writes the images and the exact strings into a dated local set folder with the destination screen named, files one card, and uploads nothing to any account. It never opens an account screen, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
2a43a3b64ae284822b3490a84da4e3e4e13f220b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

290d71f0c130fe23acaff0c6b7484d39534fa579.description_zh: 工作日只处理文件、不使用浏览器：读取运行记录并汇总指标、变更和创意台账，将昨日勾选变为可统计事实，合并卡片收件箱、重写看板并生成晨报。外发须先放行渠道，不接触凭据。
290d71f0c130fe23acaff0c6b7484d39534fa579.source: Weekdays, file work only, no browser at all. Reads every run record, folds the metrics, change, and creative ledgers, turns yesterday's ticks into facts a machine can count, folds the card inbox, rewrites the board, and writes the short morning brief the member opens first. It holds every outbound action unless you released the channel, and it never touches a credential.
290d71f0c130fe23acaff0c6b7484d39534fa579.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

47e7ee51a5631936d8ceba1d7b3adda68db39788.description_zh: 首日手动建立参谋长职责与 AI 员工清单，之后每月复核：研究企业公开资料，为章程结论标注来源日期，在限定范围内发现本机已安装员工，生成共享映射、优先事项、观察列表和仪表板，并注册自身七项任务。月度重新发现和校正清单；不写其他员工目录、不注册他人任务，发送和支出限已放行渠道，不接触凭据。
47e7ee51a5631936d8ceba1d7b3adda68db39788.source: Runs once by hand on the first day and once a month after that. On the first run it researches the business from its own public presence, writes the charter with a source and a date beside every conclusion, discovers the AI Employees actually installed on this machine within a bounded search, writes the map every other routine in this kit reads, seeds the priorities and the watchlist once, builds the fleet dashboard, and registers this Employee's own seven jobs. On every monthly run it re-runs discovery and reconciles the map against what is really there. It never writes into another Employee's folder, never registers a job it does not own, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
47e7ee51a5631936d8ceba1d7b3adda68db39788.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

32f8db1eb77577bf7fa56d2c1b60b71e75e2b335.description_zh: 每周只读本地文件，选出恰好三项行动建议，逐一论证正反两面，每个论据附文件中的数字或观察。最后反驳自身首选建议，记录预测效果及可检验指标并登记各项行动，供月度复核；发送和支出限放行范围，不部署、不接触凭据。
32f8db1eb77577bf7fa56d2c1b60b71e75e2b335.source: Weekly, file work only, no browser at all. Reads everything the week produced, picks exactly three moves, and argues both sides of each one before the member reads a word of it, with every clause carrying a number or an observation from a file it names. It argues against its own top recommendation last, records a predicted effect and the metric that would show it so the monthly review can score it, and files each move onto the register. It sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, never deploys, and never touches a credential.
32f8db1eb77577bf7fa56d2c1b60b71e75e2b335.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f9c453c65025356f40ecfcbf1c4ba3db1533fcee.description_zh: 每月最后一个工作日只处理文件，以实际指标文件评估自身决策，汇总决策台账并给已关闭决策追加结果；淘汰提出三次仍未获采纳的行动，按证据重写优先事项。关闭决策太少时不公布校准指标，不写自身目录外、不向他人提案；发送和支出限放行范围，不接触凭据。
f9c453c65025356f40ecfcbf1c4ba3db1533fcee.source: Monthly, on the last weekday, file work only, no browser at all. Folds the decision ledger, scores this Employee's own judgement against the metric files that measured it rather than against its own predictions, appends one outcome line per closed decision, retires a move proposed three times and never accepted, and rewrites the priorities where the evidence disagrees with them. It refuses to publish a calibration figure on too few closed decisions, changes nothing outside its own folder, proposes nothing to anybody, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
f9c453c65025356f40ecfcbf1c4ba3db1533fcee.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8d6b02ed7b9412fbd7e784eae737dcc5de56ed77.description_zh: 工作日只处理文件，将员工群中排名最高的未解决故障整理成可快速行动的档案：一句话故障、首个记录、同期变化、三项带证据的排序原因、损失及带准确路径的可粘贴修正。其他员工资料严格只读，只写自身目录；发送和支出限放行范围，不接触凭据。
8d6b02ed7b9412fbd7e784eae737dcc5de56ed77.source: Weekdays, file work only, no browser at all. Takes the single highest ranked open fault on the fleet and turns it into something the member can act on in a minute: the fault in one sentence, the first record that shows it, what changed around that date, three ranked causes each with its evidence line, what the failure has cost, and one paste ready correction line with the exact path it belongs in. It reads other Employees strictly read only, writes nothing outside its own folder, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
8d6b02ed7b9412fbd7e784eae737dcc5de56ed77.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

c101f001c20d500b0f38fd1ca82a4b744f8f4121.description_zh: 工作日只读本机各 AI 员工运行日志，将例程分为运行中、明确停机、静默停机或暂停，更新故障持续时间、汇总决策登记并写晨报。不写其他员工目录；发送和支出限放行范围，不接触凭据。
c101f001c20d500b0f38fd1ca82a4b744f8f4121.source: Weekdays, file work only, no browser at all. Walks every AI Employee installed on this machine, reads each one's own run log strictly read only, classifies every routine as running, stopped loudly, stopped silently, or paused, ages the faults, folds the decision register, and writes the one short brief the member opens first. It never writes into another Employee's folder, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
c101f001c20d500b0f38fd1ca82a4b744f8f4121.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

4c7cd039d06f59a2363ae54cd7621f03709aaded.description_zh: 每周集中浏览自身观察列表，对真实变化记录日期、原文引述和准确 URL，并写有篇幅上限的周报。没有基线的资料不报告变化；对外全程只读，不输入会改变状态的内容，绝不在 LinkedIn 操作；发送和支出限放行范围，不接触凭据。
4c7cd039d06f59a2363ae54cd7621f03709aaded.source: Weekly, heavy browser lane, read only toward the world with no exception. Works the surfaces on its own watchlist through one contiguous browser phase, captures one dated observation per real change with a verbatim quote and the exact URL, refuses to report any change against a surface it has no baseline for, and writes one capped weekly page. It types nothing that changes anything, takes no action on LinkedIn ever, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
4c7cd039d06f59a2363ae54cd7621f03709aaded.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

76bc9ff50f93cbe73375c2dc88ea709903461629.description_zh: 每周只读评估员工群与业务，每个数字必须有来源，引用指标所属员工的结果而不重新计算；低于规定样本门槛时不报告比率，输出限篇幅周报。仅在指标映射指定实时界面时打开浏览器，不写其他员工目录；发送和支出限放行范围，不接触凭据。
76bc9ff50f93cbe73375c2dc88ea709903461629.source: Weekly, conditional browser lane, read only everywhere. Scores the fleet and the business for the week with a source beside every single number and no number anywhere without one, cites the Employee that owns a metric rather than recomputing it, refuses a rate below the floor, and writes one capped weekly page. It opens a browser only where the metric map names a live screen, never writes into another Employee's folder, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
76bc9ff50f93cbe73375c2dc88ea709903461629.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5675b677213bce4a1f1ab1afad02fc2c30f9c766.description_zh: 工作日读取工单台账以及用户指定的账户、账单和使用资料，识别可能流失的付费客户。每个标记包含触发规则、准确证据、完整客户历史及带成本和操作界面的挽留建议；账单界面只读，仅说明退款、抵扣、套餐变更和取消，不执行。
5675b677213bce4a1f1ab1afad02fc2c30f9c766.source: Weekdays, conditional browser lane. Reads the ticket ledger and the account, billing, and usage surfaces the member named, and decides which paying customers are about to leave. Every flag is a dossier carrying the trip wires that fired, the exact evidence behind each one, that account's whole history, and one suggested save with its cost and the screen it happens on. It reads billing screens and touches no control on them: a refund, a credit, a plan change, and a cancellation are named and never made.
5675b677213bce4a1f1ab1afad02fc2c30f9c766.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b68dc62076d7b41eb4565f74070032b30e70423d.description_zh: 每周三从工单台账的重复窗口中找出超阈值主题，先查自有帮助中心和已有快捷回复，对没有答案的主题制作可复用回复与帮助文章草稿。文章只在已放行渠道发布，不编辑在线帮助页；发送和花费限放行范围，不接触凭据。
b68dc62076d7b41eb4565f74070032b30e70423d.source: Weekly on a Wednesday, light browser lane. Turns the questions that keep coming back into the answer that only has to be written once. It reads the ticket ledger over the recurrence window, finds every theme that crossed its threshold, checks the member's own help center and the existing macros for an answer that already covers it, and writes a reusable macro and a help article draft for every theme that has neither. It publishes only where you released the channel an article, never edits a live help center page, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
b68dc62076d7b41eb4565f74070032b30e70423d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

fd8463addf43170bd549a1b2ad72eefb04e8e4eb.description_zh: 首日手动初始化客服工作台，之后每月运行：先研究企业公开资料，再建立策略、台账、初始卡片和单页仪表板，核对计划表并注册八项定时任务。月度重读本套件证据、更新变化，为增量渠道添页签，重建并核对全部任务；外发须放行，不输入凭据。
fd8463addf43170bd549a1b2ad72eefb04e8e4eb.source: Runs once by hand on the first day and once a month after that, light browser lane. On the first run it researches the business from its own published surfaces before asking anything, writes the strategy folder, creates the ledgers, seeds the opening cards, builds the single page dashboard, reconciles the schedule table, and registers the eight recurring jobs. On every monthly run it re-reads a month of the kit's own evidence, applies what changed, adds a tab for a channel that gained volume, rebuilds, and reconciles every registered job against the table. It holds every outbound action unless you released the channel, and it never enters a credential.
fd8463addf43170bd549a1b2ad72eefb04e8e4eb.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

587c9d50968c693f428c22d0f9fb464dbf261275.description_zh: 工作日只处理文件，读取各台账、队列及游标后的运行记录，将用户勾选转成已回复行和关闭卡片，计算首响与解决时长供周五报告使用，合并收件箱、重绘看板并生成晨报；外发须放行，不接触凭据。
587c9d50968c693f428c22d0f9fb464dbf261275.source: Weekdays, file work only, no browser at all. Reads every ledger, every queue file, and every run record since its cursor, turns the member's ticks into replied lines and closed cards, computes the first response and time to resolution clocks the Friday report is built from, folds the card inbox, re-renders the desk board, and writes the short morning brief the member opens first. It holds every outbound action unless you released the channel, and it never touches a credential.
587c9d50968c693f428c22d0f9fb464dbf261275.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

af3713a18d633b64d5ed3d5af19c44ef85f2c340.description_zh: 工作日浏览 strategy/channels.md 指定的邮箱、工单、评价列表、市场页面和产品讨论论坛，把新建或变化事项按日期、来源和严重度写入工单台账。不回复、不互动、不标已读或已解决，绝不在 LinkedIn 操作；外发须放行，不接触凭据。
af3713a18d633b64d5ed3d5af19c44ef85f2c340.source: Weekdays, heavy browser lane. Reads every support channel named in strategy/channels.md, meaning the mailbox, the helpdesk queue, the review and rating listings, the marketplace pages, and the forums where the member's products are discussed, and captures every new or changed item as one dated, sourced, severity graded line on the ticket ledger. It replies to nothing, reacts to nothing, marks nothing read or resolved, and takes no action of any kind on LinkedIn. It holds every outbound action unless you released the channel, and it never touches a credential.
af3713a18d633b64d5ed3d5af19c44ef85f2c340.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5757d0e6e0f20baee4ae75153c8b9024c4716f56.description_zh: 工作日按严重度优先、同级按时间先后选工单，将逐客户回复写入日期队列，供用户审阅、修改和手动发送。退款、抵扣、改套餐或取消只写明方案、准确金额和界面，由用户执行；仅向放行渠道发送，不发帖、不关闭工单，花费须放行，不接触凭据。
5757d0e6e0f20baee4ae75153c8b9024c4716f56.source: Weekdays, conditional browser lane. Selects from the ticket ledger hardest first, meaning by severity and then by age within severity, and writes each customer a reply into a dated queue file the member reads, edits, and sends by hand. Where the right answer is a refund, a credit, a plan change, or a cancellation, it names the remedy, the exact amount, and the exact screen, and leaves the granting to the member. It sends only where you released the channel, never posts, never resolves a ticket, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
5757d0e6e0f20baee4ae75153c8b9024c4716f56.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6fac61da903da3fdf6c40e72ff0a79df9e48da38.description_zh: 每周五按台账给本周评分，每个数字附来源且不使用估算；读取自有列表中的评价变化，重放工作日例程依赖的浏览流程，并指出最能减少本周工单的一项产品改进。发送和支出须放行，不发帖、不解决事项、不接触凭据。
6fac61da903da3fdf6c40e72ff0a79df9e48da38.source: Weekly on a Friday, conditional browser lane. Scores the week from the ledgers with a source beside every number and an estimate nowhere, reads the review and rating movement off the member's own listing screens, replays the browser flows the weekday routines depend on, and names the one product change that would have removed the most tickets this week. It sends only where you released the channel, never posts, never resolves anything, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
6fac61da903da3fdf6c40e72ff0a79df9e48da38.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

313bbe209974b41d60f247daee580de51fd47d57.description_zh: 每月最后一个工作日，用真实工单复测主题与严重度规则，按证据改写 strategy/themes.md：合并同类主题、拆分答案不同的主题、淘汰无量主题、为持续未分类簇新建主题，并纠正与结果矛盾的严重度规则。主题 ID 不复用或重编号；外发须放行，不接触凭据。
313bbe209974b41d60f247daee580de51fd47d57.source: Monthly on the last weekday, light browser lane. Re-tests every theme and every severity rule against a month of real ticket evidence and rewrites strategy/themes.md wherever the evidence disagrees with the assumption. It merges two themes the evidence shows are one, splits a theme whose tickets have two different answers, retires a theme with no volume, creates a theme for a cluster that kept landing unclassified, and rewrites a severity rule wherever the outcomes contradict it. Theme ids are never reused and never renumbered. It holds every outbound action unless you released the channel, and it never touches a credential.
313bbe209974b41d60f247daee580de51fd47d57.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

fbe4a2e57741adde95b39efa5fce5ff1d78e793a.description_zh: 工作日只处理文件，读取各台账、队列和运行记录，将昨日勾选转为发送日期及关闭卡片，合并卡片收件箱、重写上市看板并生成晨报。外发须放行，不接触凭据。
fbe4a2e57741adde95b39efa5fce5ff1d78e793a.source: Weekdays, file work only, no browser at all. Reads every ledger, queue file, and run record, turns yesterday's ticks into sent dates and closed cards, folds the card inbox, rewrites the launch board, and writes the short morning brief the member opens first. It holds every outbound action unless you released the channel, and it never touches a credential.
fbe4a2e57741adde95b39efa5fce5ff1d78e793a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

bae69d78b8afa26f454bd8e22297a7e4439040f3.description_zh: 每月最后一个工作日，依据本套件台账重新检验 strategy/icp.md 中各客户细分，按证据修订目标选择，并在 strategy/CHANGELOG.md 记录变化。只向放行渠道发送，不将人员重新入队、不改已联系台账、不写无明确文件来源的数字。
bae69d78b8afa26f454bd8e22297a7e4439040f3.source: Monthly, on the last weekday. Re-tests every segment in strategy/icp.md against the evidence in this kit's own ledgers, then rewrites the targeting itself where the evidence disagrees with the assumption the segment was written on. It records every change in strategy/CHANGELOG.md. It sends only where you released the channel, never re-queues anyone, never edits the contacted ledger, and never writes a number it did not read out of a named file.
bae69d78b8afa26f454bd8e22297a7e4439040f3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d8f7a68bca728e7c2d96152760155b4695833955.description_zh: 首日手动初始化市场进入工作台，之后每月运行：先研究企业公开资料，建立策略、上市看板和定制指挥中心，核对计划表、注册定时任务。月度重读套件证据、应用变化、校正偏差并重建；外发须放行，不输入凭据。
d8f7a68bca728e7c2d96152760155b4695833955.source: Runs once by hand on the first day and once a month after that. On the first run it researches the business from its own public surfaces before asking anything, writes the strategy folder, seeds the launch board, builds the tailored command center, reconciles the schedule table, and registers the recurring jobs. On every monthly run it re-reads the evidence the kit produced, applies what changed, reconciles drift, and rebuilds. It holds every outbound action unless you released the channel, and it never enters a credential.
d8f7a68bca728e7c2d96152760155b4695833955.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b1f949d100f0a26d312a447144a40c832f5d4e0f.description_zh: 工作日处理上市看板的就绪卡片，按需要使用浏览器：整理仪表板文案、填写目录或媒体表单并保留页签、验证配置、打包交接或研究后续目标。确认完成文件后勾选卡片；提交、发送和花费只在已放行渠道进行，不接触凭据。
b1f949d100f0a26d312a447144a40c832f5d4e0f.source: Weekdays, browser only when the card needs one. Takes the next ready cards off the launch board and does the work each one names: stages copy into the dashboard, fills a directory or press form and leaves it open in its tab, verifies a setup, packages a handoff, or researches its own next targets. It ticks its own card the moment it has verified the file that closes it. It submits only where you released the channel, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
b1f949d100f0a26d312a447144a40c832f5d4e0f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

adfedd5456a0dd98f84e2c65324e07407b390d86.description_zh: 工作日依据信号台账中的可联系人员，生成当天首次联系及跟进的日期队列，供用户阅读、编辑并手动发送；可选在用户邮箱创建未发送草稿。外发须先放行，不接触凭据。
adfedd5456a0dd98f84e2c65324e07407b390d86.source: Weekdays. Turns the contactable people in the signal ledger into today's due first touches and follow ups, written into dated queue files the member reads, edits, and sends by hand, and optionally into the member's own mailbox as unsent drafts. It holds every outbound action unless you released the channel, and it never touches a credential.
adfedd5456a0dd98f84e2c65324e07407b390d86.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

18a4c22b64ab1e786b258b3895282250f872a6d0.description_zh: 每周只读审计已有付费投放与衡量配置，将缺失的活动结构、广告文案、否定关键词种子及转化跟踪规格做成可直接粘贴的完整本地文件。未经渠道放行不在账户创建、保存、激活或花费，并承担支出停止控制。
18a4c22b64ab1e786b258b3895282250f872a6d0.source: Weekly. Audits the paid and measurement setup the member already has by reading it, then assembles the parts that are missing as local files: campaign structure, ad copy, negative keyword seeds, and conversion tracking specifications, each one complete and ready to paste. It creates nothing in an account, saves nothing, activates nothing, and spends nothing, unless you released the channel. This is where the spend stop lives.
18a4c22b64ab1e786b258b3895282250f872a6d0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

It sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, never touches a credential, and never writes a number it did not measure.

Reads the member's own signal sources and saved searches, captures dated buying signals together with the contactable people attached to them, and appends both to the ledgers the outreach queue reads. Read only on every people surface, LinkedIn included. It holds every outbound action unless you released the channel, and it never touches a credential.
f5e540793783c5adafb32da4df0f2ab7b52133a4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

24686b32246f9b142d7c12ae619abb3b696ba8ca.description_zh: 首日手动初始化销售工作台，之后每月首个工作日轻量浏览运行：先研究企业公开资料，建立策略、销售管道，核对计划表并注册任务。月度重读套件证据，只更新自身文件，并原样保留用户设置；外发须放行，不输入凭据。
24686b32246f9b142d7c12ae619abb3b696ba8ca.source: Runs once by hand on the first day and once a month after that, on the first weekday, light browser lane. On the first run it researches the business from its own public surfaces before asking anything, writes the strategy folder, seeds the pipeline, reconciles the schedule table, and registers the recurring jobs. On every monthly run it re-reads the evidence the kit produced, applies what changed to the files it owns, and carries every member written setting across verbatim. It holds every outbound action unless you released the channel, and it never enters a credential.
