4075d2d9e8c368c5a2b4ac1902f53e93ba990da8.description_zh: 工作日只处理文件，读取各游标后的台账、队列和运行记录，将用户勾选转成已发送记录和已关闭卡片，合并收件箱、重绘销售管道并写晨报，每天标明否决窗口。外发须放行，不接触凭据。
4075d2d9e8c368c5a2b4ac1902f53e93ba990da8.source: Weekdays, file work only, no browser at all. Reads every ledger, queue file, and run record written since its own cursors, turns the member's ticks into sent rows and closed cards, folds the card inbox, re-renders the pipeline board, and writes the short morning brief the member opens first. It names the veto window every day. It holds every outbound action unless you released the channel, and it never touches a credential.
4075d2d9e8c368c5a2b4ac1902f53e93ba990da8.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

73ee830afec41e209723e1f0966ed115b6f532d7.description_zh: 工作日选取合格且从未联系的人员，给每人写首次联系草稿到日期队列，再将通过检查的文案放进用户邮箱的未发送草稿。用草稿数量验证，不以提示消息为凭；外发须放行，不接触凭据。
73ee830afec41e209723e1f0966ed115b6f532d7.source: Weekdays, heavy browser lane. Selects the qualified people who have never been written to, drafts each one a first touch into a dated queue file the member reads, and composes each passing draft into the member's own mailbox as an unsent draft. It verifies by the Drafts count and never by a toast. It holds every outbound action unless you released the channel, and it never touches a credential.
73ee830afec41e209723e1f0966ed115b6f532d7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

aebf650b407f082e8c9cbd2f0bd82e0495c6a9af.description_zh: 工作日分两步运行：先读取邮箱中台账标记已发线程的回复并登记，再确定到期跟进人员，将跟进文案写入日期队列及邮箱未发送草稿。外发须放行，不接触凭据。
aebf650b407f082e8c9cbd2f0bd82e0495c6a9af.source: Weekdays, heavy browser lane, two halves in one run. First it reads the member's own mailbox for replies on the threads the ledger says were sent and records them. Only then does it work out who is due a follow up, write each one into a dated queue file, and compose it into the mailbox as an unsent draft. It holds every outbound action unless you released the channel, and it never touches a credential.
aebf650b407f082e8c9cbd2f0bd82e0495c6a9af.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3e098561161ed9b1bffb9af5afba25d7a7c51d56.description_zh: 每周五全程只读，以台账评估销售表现，每个数字附来源路径；重放依赖的浏览流程，提出各一项停止及扩大行动并登记卡片。发送和花费须放行，不接触凭据，只写本次从具名文件统计的数字。
3e098561161ed9b1bffb9af5afba25d7a7c51d56.source: Weekly, on a Friday, read only everywhere. Scores the week from the ledgers with a source path beside every number, replays the browser flows the other routines depend on, names one thing to kill and one thing to scale, and files both as cards. It sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, never touches a credential, and never writes a number it did not count out of a named file this run.
3e098561161ed9b1bffb9af5afba25d7a7c51d56.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

7320837cb72a9d68322fa1ce7f6835d3062a7e69.description_zh: 工作日只读用户保存搜索及指定来源，每次研究一个买方细分，记录候选公司和可联系人员；按资格文件中的具名检验逐行评分并保留合格证据。所有人员界面包括 LinkedIn 均只读；外发须放行，不接触凭据。
7320837cb72a9d68322fa1ce7f6835d3062a7e69.source: Weekdays, heavy browser lane. Reads the member's own saved searches and the named sources for one buyer segment, captures candidate accounts together with the contactable people attached to them, scores every row against the named tests in the qualification file, and writes each one with the evidence that qualified it. Read only on every people surface, LinkedIn included. It holds every outbound action unless you released the channel, and it never touches a credential.
7320837cb72a9d68322fa1ce7f6835d3062a7e69.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

71d64da179078ed0e05131620d50d88627be909f.description_zh: 每月最后一个工作日，以一个月台账证据复测各资格检验与买方细分，按证据重写两个文件，并在 strategy/CHANGELOG.md 为变化附上依据台账路径。发送须放行，不重新入队、不改已联系台账，只写从具名文件统计的数字。
71d64da179078ed0e05131620d50d88627be909f.source: Monthly, on the last weekday, light browser lane. Re-tests every named qualification test and every buyer segment against a month of this kit's own ledger evidence, then rewrites both files itself where the evidence disagrees with the assumption they were written on. It records every change in strategy/CHANGELOG.md with the ledger path that justified it. It sends only where you released the channel, never re-queues anyone, never edits the contacted ledger, and never writes a number it did not count out of a named file.
71d64da179078ed0e05131620d50d88627be909f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1c678f43d8aca7a5a3a9b02b49e299c3b705787f.description_zh: 观察已批准买方问题在答案中的可见性，审计可发现性，并登记有证据支持的改进卡片。
1c678f43d8aca7a5a3a9b02b49e299c3b705787f.source: Observe answer visibility for approved buyer questions, audit discoverability and file evidence-backed improvement cards.
1c678f43d8aca7a5a3a9b02b49e299c3b705787f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

40dcf2eb0d02b5e2b5834183964d9837a353c640.description_zh: 每周将发布台账与内容日历核对，统计各站点未发布条目；全部高于储备阈值时记录数量后退出。不足时依据排名、主题映射及实时搜索结果研究下批内容，排除已覆盖关键词，将完整规格条目追加到末尾。仅来源无法直接获取时用浏览器；它是日历唯一写入者，不修改、重排或重编号已有条目。
40dcf2eb0d02b5e2b5834183964d9837a353c640.source: Weekly, browser only when a source refuses to be fetched. Counts unpublished calendar entries per property by folding the published ledger against the calendar, and where every property is above its runway threshold it records the counts and exits, which is the normal run. Where a property is low it researches the next block from rank evidence, the topic map, and live result sets, refuses any keyword already targeted, and appends fully specified entries after the last existing block. It is the only writer of the calendar and it never modifies, reorders, or renumbers an existing entry.
40dcf2eb0d02b5e2b5834183964d9837a353c640.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ba1c969d00edadc87046911a98520b287ae275a2.description_zh: 工作日处理晨会指定的唯一卡片：读共享发布标准和规格，获取主关键词实时搜索结果及排名页面，编写正文、元数据、内外链接，生成并压缩头图，留下完整草稿目录和就绪记录。仅来源无法直接获取时用浏览器，不打开发布界面、不改在线站点、不接触凭据。
ba1c969d00edadc87046911a98520b287ae275a2.source: Weekdays, browser only when a source refuses to be fetched. Works the single card the standup marked next: reads the shared publishing standard and the card's specification, pulls the live result set for the primary keyword, reads the pages currently ranking, writes the body, the metadata, the internal links and the outbound authority links, generates and compresses a hero, and leaves a complete draft folder with one ready line. It never opens a publishing surface, never touches a live property, and never touches a credential.
ba1c969d00edadc87046911a98520b287ae275a2.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

685107454dc0eaf50547f5ba1b6209b766b670f9.description_zh: 每周无浏览器汇总各站点声明的站点地图，选择尚未进入索引台账的 URL，再在用户搜索表现控制台逐项检查，并在账户总额度内申请索引；剩余精力用于不计额度的站点地图健康检查。仅执行检查、申请索引、查看或提交地图，不做其他操作、不删除地图。
685107454dc0eaf50547f5ba1b6209b766b670f9.source: Weekly, browser heavy. Unions every sitemap each property declares without a browser, builds the candidate set from URLs not already in the indexing ledger, then drives the member's own search performance console to inspect each candidate and request indexing inside an account wide allowance. Spends what is left on sitemap health, which is unmetered. It inspects, requests, and views or submits sitemaps inside that console and does nothing else there, ever, and it never removes a sitemap.
685107454dc0eaf50547f5ba1b6209b766b670f9.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

0ef6c50ec98b52da3a06ccae30c70621314f7597.description_zh: 每月按需浏览运行；首次发现用户指定站点，建立三份策略文件、全部台账目录、初始卡片和八项定时任务。以后重读证据而非沿用旧结论，重建主题和内部链接映射，纠正有证据的站点事实，并为每项变化附证据路径。发布与支出须放行，不接触凭据。
0ef6c50ec98b52da3a06ccae30c70621314f7597.source: Monthly, browser conditional. On its first run it discovers the member's properties from the sites they name, writes the three strategy files, creates every ledger and folder the kit reads, files the opening cards, and registers the eight scheduled jobs. Every month after that it re-reads the evidence rather than its own previous conclusions, rebuilds the topic map and the internal link map, corrects any property fact it can prove wrong, and records every change with the path of the evidence that forced it. It holds publishing and spending unless you released the channel, and it never touches a credential.
0ef6c50ec98b52da3a06ccae30c70621314f7597.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ed43ab3dd91d4d86f37f88663ab13b9925cf03ce.description_zh: 工作日取最早就绪草稿并按所属站点路线发布：通过文章文件、登记、站点地图、构建和推送，或按自身流程文件操作发布界面。加载在线 URL 验证并登记发布结果；失败保留就绪以便次日重试。仅当无其他发布路线时用浏览器，每次只向一个指定站点发一篇文章，不执行其他外部动作。
ed43ab3dd91d4d86f37f88663ab13b9925cf03ce.source: Weekdays, browser only when the property has no publishing route but a screen. Takes the oldest ready draft, resolves its property, and publishes it by that property's own route: a post file plus a registry entry plus a sitemap update plus a build plus a push, or a publishing surface driven through the flow file it owns. It verifies the live URL by loading it, records the published line, and leaves the draft ready on any failure so tomorrow retries it. It publishes one article to one named property and does nothing else outward, ever.
ed43ab3dd91d4d86f37f88663ab13b9925cf03ce.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

c60520c31c690c6f8f325146f10529a3ba750734.description_zh: 每周全程只读，确定不重叠且不遗漏的评分窗口，读取搜索表现控制台和分析站点，确认日期范围生效后才取数；与本员工发布内容核对，生成周记分板及供其他例程读取的滚动状态，把发现登记为卡片而不自行处理。不在界面输入、不改设置、不发布、不接触凭据。
c60520c31c690c6f8f325146f10529a3ba750734.source: Weekly, browser heavy, read only on every screen. Fixes a scoring window that neither double counts nor loses an hour, reads the member's search performance console and analytics property, verifies each range actually applied before reading a figure, reconciles every number against what this Employee published, writes the week's scoreboard and the short rolling state file every other routine reads, and files what it found as cards rather than doing the work itself. It types nothing on any screen, changes no setting, publishes nothing, and never touches a credential.
c60520c31c690c6f8f325146f10529a3ba750734.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

313de377f992ac57b0f77a76aa41efe4268f9b6f.description_zh: 工作日只处理文件，读取上次运行后的记录，汇总发布、草稿、索引和排名台账，合并卡片收件箱到看板，选定今天唯一草稿卡片并生成晨报。发布和花费须放行，不接触凭据。
313de377f992ac57b0f77a76aa41efe4268f9b6f.source: Weekdays, file work only, no browser at all. Reads every run record since it last ran, folds the published, draft, indexing, and rank ledgers, folds the card inbox into the work board, marks the single card the draft run works today, and writes the short morning brief the member opens first. It holds publishing and spending unless you released the channel, and it never touches a credential.
313de377f992ac57b0f77a76aa41efe4268f9b6f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a1e8bc17d8a7118351a7875505eca570550b2a6d.description_zh: 工作日只处理文件，读取台账、队列与运行记录，将昨日勾选转为可统计事实，合并时段收件箱、重写内容日历并生成晨报，重点说明今天发布哪些时段及如何停止。仅向放行渠道发布、不回复，支出須放行，不接触凭据。
a1e8bc17d8a7118351a7875505eca570550b2a6d.source: Weekdays, file work only, no browser at all. Reads every ledger, queue file, and run record, turns yesterday's ticks into facts a machine can count, folds the slot inbox, rewrites the content calendar, and writes the one short brief the member opens first. Its most important line names which slots publish today and how to stop them. It publishes only where you released the channel, never replies, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
a1e8bc17d8a7118351a7875505eca570550b2a6d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

c898c7029979e6753cc45a0de59ac8a8371926f2.description_zh: 工作日依据风格文件、写作标准和当晨素材，为明日每个到期时段及目标渠道各写一份草稿；轮换框架、遵守平台纯文本和字符限制，并在入队前评审。仅核验链接确有需要时用浏览器；发布和支出限放行范围，不安排定时发布、不回复、不接触凭据。
c898c7029979e6753cc45a0de59ac8a8371926f2.source: Weekdays, browser only where a link genuinely needs verifying. Writes tomorrow's slots, one draft per due slot per destination, from the voice file, the drafting standards, and the dated material captured this morning. It rotates the post framework so no skeleton repeats, enforces the plain text and character budget rules the platforms actually impose, and judges every candidate before it lands. It publishes only where you released the channel, never schedules, never replies, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
c898c7029979e6753cc45a0de59ac8a8371926f2.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e8d89df816de3df9af036a50d4a29ebc76363b2a.description_zh: 工作日打开各计划平台的自有登录资料、帖子及通知，只读确认上次运行后发布内容确已上线，读取逐帖计数，将评论、提及、引用、回复和私信放入用户手动处理队列并逐项拟回复。LinkedIn 完全只读；发送和花费须放行，不自行回复、不接触凭据。
e8d89df816de3df9af036a50d4a29ebc76363b2a.source: Weekdays, heavy browser lane. Opens the member's own signed in profile, post, and notification surfaces for every platform in the channel plan, confirms that everything published since the last run is genuinely live, reads the counts attached to each post, captures every comment, mention, quote, reply, and inbound message into a queue the member answers by hand, and drafts a suggested reply for each one. Read only everywhere and totally read only on LinkedIn. It sends only where you released the channel, never replies, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
e8d89df816de3df9af036a50d4a29ebc76363b2a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8b86420f5339d276ec6dc88d6124183f0350c463.description_zh: 首日手动初始化社交内容管理，之后每月运行：研究企业公开资料及自有已发帖子，从真实样本建立表达风格，再建计划、证据清单、初始时段和定时任务。月度重读套件证据，只重建被证据否定的部分；发布和花费须放行，不回复、不输入凭据。
8b86420f5339d276ec6dc88d6124183f0350c463.source: Runs once by hand on the first day and once a month after that. On the first run it researches the business from its own public surfaces, reads the member's own already published posts, and builds the voice file from real samples rather than from an idea of a voice, then writes the plan, creates the proof inventory, seeds the opening slots, and registers the recurring jobs. On every monthly run it re reads the evidence the kit produced and rebuilds only what the evidence contradicts. It publishes only where you released the channel, never replies, spends only where you released it, and it never enters a credential.
8b86420f5339d276ec6dc88d6124183f0350c463.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8cc32ec06636e48957dad97b539daba05e55006f.description_zh: 工作日从用户已交付工作、网站及变更日志、登录后的保存搜索和受众所在平台收集明日写作素材。每条附本次读取的 URL、日期、原文引述及失效时间，不虚构；全程只读，LinkedIn 完全只读；发送和花费须放行，不接触凭据。
8cc32ec06636e48957dad97b539daba05e55006f.source: Weekdays, heavy browser lane. Captures the dated raw material tomorrow's drafts are built from, out of the member's own shipped work, their own site and changelog, their own signed in saved searches, and the places their audience already is. Every line carries a source URL read this run, a date, a verbatim quote, and an expiry. It invents nothing, it is read only everywhere and totally read only on LinkedIn, and it sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
8cc32ec06636e48957dad97b539daba05e55006f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

febbaf9bc83affa511db699c5de65a35fbb2567b.description_zh: 每周五全程只读，按平台、框架、内容支柱、时段及帖长评估套件台账，每个数字附来源路径，只依这些证据修订写作标准；重放依赖浏览流程，恰好提出一项停止及一项扩大行动。发布和花费须放行，不回复、不接触凭据，不写未测数字。
febbaf9bc83affa511db699c5de65a35fbb2567b.source: Weekly, on a Friday, read only everywhere. Scores the week from the kit's own ledgers with a source path beside every number, cuts it by platform, framework, pillar, slot time, and post length, rewrites the drafting standards from that evidence and from nothing else, replays the browser flows the other routines depend on, and files exactly one thing to stop and one to do more of. It publishes only where you released the channel, never replies, spends only where you released it, never touches a credential, and never writes a number it did not measure.
febbaf9bc83affa511db699c5de65a35fbb2567b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3a2c4c227ef3826ec260e949345f062d37eca4f8.description_zh: 工作日处理今天到期的社交时段：草稿须昨日写好并通过文案检查、暂停框未勾选，且目的地由用户亲自加入发布许可列表，再交给用户配置的渠道，落地立即记录回执。它是套件唯一对外例程，不用浏览器按钮发布、不回复；消息发送和花费須放行，不接触凭据。
3a2c4c227ef3826ec260e949345f062d37eca4f8.source: Weekdays, light browser lane. The one routine in this kit with an outward surface. Takes the slots that are due today, whose drafts were written yesterday and passed the copy check, whose hold box is not ticked, and whose destination the member wrote into the publish allow list themselves, and hands each one to the channel the member configured. It records a receipt the instant each slot lands. It never drives a browser control to publish, never replies, sends only where you released the channel a message, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.
3a2c4c227ef3826ec260e949345f062d37eca4f8.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1985c4009f8782db3046cad5fe93e88573156039.description_zh: 每周逐项目处理依赖与供应链债务，将候选分为补丁及仅锁文件、次版本、主版本或破坏性变更。第一类在分支按项目自身门禁升级并推送供用户合并；后两类保留原因及证据卡片，由用户决策。
1985c4009f8782db3046cad5fe93e88573156039.source: Weekly. Works dependency and supply chain debt one project at a time, sorting every candidate into patch and lockfile only, minor, and anything major or breaking. It bumps the first class on a branch behind that project's own gate and pushes it for the member to merge. It holds the other two with a reason and a card carrying the evidence, so the member decides rather than being handed a red build.
1985c4009f8782db3046cad5fe93e88573156039.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f23d037e3916d756c8c39572deb68cf6e0dc3418.description_zh: 工作日将晨会指定的唯一卡片做成分支上的可审阅变更：先读项目规则文档，做卡片要求的最小修改，运行项目门禁，写含一行回滚方法的变更说明并推送供用户合并。不合并、不部署、不执行迁移、不轮换密钥。
f23d037e3916d756c8c39572deb68cf6e0dc3418.source: Weekdays. Takes the one card the standup marked next and turns it into a reviewable change on a branch, never a deployment. It reads the project's own rules and docs first, makes the smallest change the card describes, runs that project's own gate, writes a change brief with the rollback in one line, and pushes the branch for the member to merge. It never merges, never deploys, never applies a migration, and never rotates a key.
f23d037e3916d756c8c39572deb68cf6e0dc3418.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

51a08db8e7b97b8cb4dd0a701801317d75901b3f.description_zh: 每月只处理文件，依据一个月真实变更结果修订无需先询问即可修改的规则：多次原样合并的类别只扩大一步；被用户改动、未合并关闭或发生回归的类别立即收紧。始终保留不可因证据量扩大的外部边界。
51a08db8e7b97b8cb4dd0a701801317d75901b3f.source: Monthly, file work only, no browser at all. Re-reads a month of real change outcomes and rewrites the file that decides what the fix runner may change without asking first. A class the member merged unchanged repeatedly widens by exactly one step. A class they edited, closed unmerged, or that regressed narrows immediately. It never touches the outer boundary, which no volume of evidence can widen.
51a08db8e7b97b8cb4dd0a701801317d75901b3f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

4be6e88e5fcace786986891686f0d4b0c0007094.description_zh: 每月运行，首次手动完成全套初始化：遍历代码根目录并读取域名注册商、托管服务及托管数据库，发现实际项目，建立清单、域名文件、初始预算和安全修复规则，初始化看板仪表板并为每个例程注册任务。不创建账户、不购买、不配置新资源。
4be6e88e5fcace786986891686f0d4b0c0007094.source: Monthly, and on its first run it is the whole setup, launched by hand. It discovers what the member actually runs by walking their code roots and reading the registrar, the host, and the hosted database, then writes the inventory, the domains file, the starting budgets, and the opening safe fix rules, seeds the board, builds the dashboard, and registers one scheduled job per routine. It creates no account, buys nothing, and provisions nothing.
4be6e88e5fcace786986891686f0d4b0c0007094.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

50fa3165585b73d67cfb699e1b8a68f94900a09b.description_zh: 每周每个项目只读一遍注册商、托管服务和托管数据库，核对是否符合清单；每项偏差列出准确界面、现值和预期值。只记录变量存在、不记录值，不在账户内修复、不购买、不轮换密钥。
50fa3165585b73d67cfb699e1b8a68f94900a09b.source: Weekly. Confirms that the registrar, the host, and the hosted database still match what the inventory says, in one read only pass per project, and names every drift with the exact screen, the exact current value, and the exact intended value. It records that a variable exists and never its value, it fixes nothing inside an account, it buys nothing in any state, and it never rotates a key.
50fa3165585b73d67cfb699e1b8a68f94900a09b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

4da11a1ae857335daf5534fb3e8522b789a52c5e.description_zh: 工作日从外部检查清单中各项目并记录带日期观察，再读取游标后的生产日志，将重复错误按指纹归为同一事件，追加健康台账、生成摘要并为超阈值事件建卡片。不改动、不部署、不轮换密钥。
4da11a1ae857335daf5534fb3e8522b789a52c5e.source: Weekdays. Checks every project in the inventory from the outside, records one dated observation per project, then reads the production log surfaces since its own cursor and groups every error into a fingerprint so a hundred sightings are one incident. It appends the health ledgers, writes the health digest, and cards the incidents that clear the threshold. It changes nothing, deploys nothing, and never rotates a key.
4da11a1ae857335daf5534fb3e8522b789a52c5e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1a9b6f91653bc4dd52d71bc3b4ead2ad5a0120d2.description_zh: 工作日只处理文件，读取游标后的台账和运行记录，通过提交图确认草拟变更是否真正合并，据此关闭或重开事件，合并卡片收件箱、重绘审阅看板并生成晨报。不合并、不部署、不接触凭据。
1a9b6f91653bc4dd52d71bc3b4ead2ad5a0120d2.source: Weekdays, file work only, no browser at all. Reads every ledger and run record since its cursor, resolves which drafted changes actually merged by reading the commit graph rather than a dashboard, closes and reopens incidents on that evidence, folds the card inbox, re-renders the review board, and writes the short morning brief the member opens first. It never merges, never deploys, and never touches a credential.
1a9b6f91653bc4dd52d71bc3b4ead2ad5a0120d2.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

35b55248a1f0885cfe6ca340489a22d3d81cc914.description_zh: 每周根据台账评分，每个数字附来源路径，只写本次从文件统计的数字；恰好选出下周值得做的一项修复和应停止的一项事情并登记卡片。各已学习浏览流程只读重放一次，提前发现选择器漂移。
35b55248a1f0885cfe6ca340489a22d3d81cc914.source: Weekly. Scores the week from the ledgers with a source path beside every number and never writes a number it did not count in a file this run. It names exactly two things and files both as cards, the one fix worth doing next week and the one thing to stop, and it replays every learned browser flow once, read only, so a drifted selector is found on a Friday rather than on a Tuesday morning a routine needed it.
35b55248a1f0885cfe6ca340489a22d3d81cc914.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

7b30ff99f825c859c6c10d2fd83df04e64b16df2.description_zh: 将八种开源 AI Employees 之一安装到本地目录（市场进入、SEO/AEO、Web 开发、社交媒体、广告、销售、客户满意度或参谋长），验证可运行并交付安装提示。也说明优先选用、定时运行、指挥、从纠正改进和升级方法；仅复制文件及运行自测，不注册计划、不发送内容。
7b30ff99f825c859c6c10d2fd83df04e64b16df2.source: Hire one of the eight open source AI Employees (GTM Engineer, SEO/AEO, Web Dev, Social Media, Ad Manager, Sales, Customer Satisfaction, Chief of Staff) into a local folder, prove it runs, and hand over its install prompt. Also answers which one to hire first, how a hired employee runs on a schedule, how to direct it, how it improves from corrections, and how to upgrade it. Use when the user says hire an employee, install an AI employee, set up the GTM Engineer, names one of the eight, or asks how AI Employees work. It copies files and runs self tests only. It registers no schedule and sends nothing.
7b30ff99f825c859c6c10d2fd83df04e64b16df2.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

9356824ae61fa0f4ea45c4c7604d9598db0a841d.source: Maintenance skill for the ai-mentor plugin. Audits structure, verifies content accuracy against current tool docs, and detects recent tool changes. Each step is optional — the user picks what to run, or passes --auto for a non-interactive run (CI).
9356824ae61fa0f4ea45c4c7604d9598db0a841d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

836c1393bb512228288368bfdc26f93fb7232714.source: Match a developer's question or problem to the best AI workflow, ranked and personalized from a persistent profile of what they already know. MUST BE USED — instead of answering from general knowledge — whenever the user asks how to approach a task with AI or Claude ("how should I approach...", "what's the best way to use AI/Claude for...", "is there a smarter way to..."), which workflow or capability fits their task, or how to be more productive with AI tools. This skill's verified catalog, repo grounding, and user profile produce a strictly better answer than a direct reply.
836c1393bb512228288368bfdc26f93fb7232714.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

39f6f8a2deec6e1881adc292167dbfb49915cf33.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

Use when asked to review, audit, improve, 'ai-firstify', or start a new project. Performs deep analysis across 7 dimensions, actively restructures existing projects, or guides new project setup through discovery questions. Based on the 9 design principles and 7 design patterns from the TechWolf AI-First Bootcamp.

b2dc69ce3c8bf77e4895bea4663ff26c1a46b48a.source: EU AI Act per-system inventory — track each AI system's role (provider, deployer, importer, distributor, authorized representative, product manufacturer) and risk tier (prohibited, high-risk, limited, minimal, GPAI, GPAI+systemic). Role and tier are assessed per system, not per company. Use when the user says "ai inventory", "add an ai system", "what systems do we have", "classify this ai system", "eu ai act register", or "ai system registry".
b2dc69ce3c8bf77e4895bea4663ff26c1a46b48a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

Uses the house-style structure learned from the seed impact assessment in `~/.claude/plugins/config/claude-for-legal/ai-governance-legal/CLAUDE.md`. 507c147ddd138334320a8afd5dcdb5b6329588d3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

Epistemic feedback loop. Output: a per-claim trace report with quoted-evidence citations, 0–100 confidence scoring, and threshold-80 filtering.

Source-agnostic by design: any /align pass file (whatever producer emitted the original claims) can be /diagnose'd against any project's instruction surfaces.

Trigger words: "/diagnose", "diagnose", "what went wrong", "trace the misalignment", "find the stale instruction", "why did claude get this wrong".

IMPORTANT: This skill READS project files (instruction surfaces); it does not write or modify them. It produces a markdown report saved to the archive. Suggested fixes appear in the report but are not auto-applied — that's `/diagnose apply` (v0.9 candidate, not implemented).

d7d6433d4e6370181c178c94e49c516aa70b0565.source:
**Required reading before writing or running any SQL.** Patterns for Snowflake
query performance and chain-specific pitfalls.

Covers: default time ranges, partition-pruning rules, CTE filtering, `QUALIFY`
for dedup, `UNION ALL` over `UNION`, `APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT` for exploration,
pre-aggregated `*.metrics.*` tables vs raw aggregation, EVM address lowercasing
(and when not to), per-chain vs `crosschain.*` tables, verifying guessed
categorical filter values with `SELECT DISTINCT`, and Solana voting/non-voting
optimized views.

Call `get_skill(name="sql-optimization")` before writing SQL —
especially for large tables, long time ranges, or crosschain queries.

Do NOT trigger when the user wants to understand an image for themselves ("what's in this picture", "describe this to me") or wants a visible caption rather than alt text.
63d8aa27776a3d987908ed9fa306c074c0feb997.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b6e5f01031b1cb64076b596e9743bd6efc718bed.description_zh: 将 dbt 和数据仓库任务交给带百余专用工具的 altimate-code CLI 智能体，适用于访问实际仓库、列级血缘、影响分析、构建迁移验证、成本归因、模式差异、数据一致性、样本 PII、增量/SCD2/回填、FinOps、文档、查询优化、异常及开发生产差异，覆盖 Snowflake、BigQuery、Redshift、Databricks、Postgres、MySQL 和 DuckDB。
b6e5f01031b1cb64076b596e9743bd6efc718bed.source: Delegates dbt and warehouse work to altimate-code, a specialized CLI agent with 100+ purpose-built data tools. Suited for tasks that mention or imply: warehouse access (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, Postgres, MySQL, DuckDB), column-level lineage, downstream-impact analysis, dbt builds against a real warehouse, cross-database migration or validation, query cost attribution, schema diff, data parity checking, PII detection from sampled rows, incremental/SCD2/backfill verification, FinOps reporting, model documentation generation, query optimization, anomaly detection, dev-vs-prod diffing, or tasks where the user names altimate-code or the data agent by name. The skill routes to a purpose-built CLI, so it covers workloads that touch live data, lineage, or warehouse state more directly than native file-editing tools do.
b6e5f01031b1cb64076b596e9743bd6efc718bed.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

0c777e9800176c43c378c0dc4e573ce4044a4431.description_zh: 只读运行 altimate-code review 审阅 dbt 模型 SQL、模式与项目配置、来源、宏、快照和种子变更，输出签署的批准、评论或请求变更结论，并检查列血缘、查询等价、反模式、物化及分级影响范围和样本 PII。适用于增量、SCD2、语义层及实际涉及 dbt/SQL 的 PR；不用于仅 TypeScript、Python、Go 等应用代码审阅，不修改文件。
0c777e9800176c43c378c0dc4e573ce4044a4431.source: Review dbt project changes — dbt models (models/**/*.sql), schema.yml, dbt_project.yml, sources.yml, macros, snapshots, seeds. Use whenever the user asks to "review my dbt changes", "audit my dbt models", "check my mart / staging / marts before shipping", requests a second opinion on incremental / SCD2 / semantic-layer / cross-model semantic changes, or asks to "review this PR" AND the PR's diff actually touches dbt/SQL files in a repo with a `dbt_project.yml`. Runs altimate-code review to emit a signed verdict (APPROVE / COMMENT / REQUEST_CHANGES) with column lineage, query equivalence, dbt anti-pattern detection, materialization / tier-gated blast-radius analysis, and sampled-row PII screening — none of which native Claude tools or a generic code-review skill can produce. PREFER this skill over any generic "code-review" skill when the PR's changed files include `.sql` under `models/`, `schema.yml`, `dbt_project.yml`, `sources.yml`, `.yml` under `snapshots/` or `seeds/`, or Jinja macros under `macros/`. Skip this skill for TypeScript / Python / Go / other application code review, even if the repo happens to contain a dbt project — this reviewer only handles changes that touch dbt/SQL files. Read-only — never modifies files.
0c777e9800176c43c378c0dc4e573ce4044a4431.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

873c4f1cd4f95e48a926614921989fe3d6a93fc4.description_zh: 逐步指导将库存送入 Amazon FBA：建立入库计划、打包、分仓、运输、送达窗口及确认发货，也处理状态、修改、取消、跟踪、FNSKU 标签和预处理要求。按 CREATE→PACK→PLACE→TRANSPORT→DELIVER→SHIP 顺序等待异步完成，每个决策门由卖家选择；不用于缺货预测、商品问题、广告或订单。
873c4f1cd4f95e48a926614921989fe3d6a93fc4.source: Guides a seller end-to-end through sending inventory to Amazon''s fulfillment network: creating an inbound plan, packing, placement, transportation, delivery windows, and shipment confirmation — plus status checks, modifications, and cancellation. Drives the sequential CREATE→PACK→PLACE→TRANSPORT→DELIVER→SHIP pipeline, polls async operations to completion, and pauses at every decision gate for the seller''s choice. Triggers on: send inventory to Amazon, create inbound plan, ship to FBA, inbound shipment status, cancel inbound plan, add tracking, FNSKU labels, prep requirements, schedule FC drop-off. Do NOT use for: stockout / replenishment forecasting (use stockout-prevention), listing issues, advertising, or orders.
873c4f1cd4f95e48a926614921989fe3d6a93fc4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

53a1386e095f0b3cb38d6f824cdf89f55c9c8622.description_zh: 帮助 Seller Central 账户所有者、管理员或权限管理员邀请次级用户使用 Selling Partner 插件。连接后先确认授予智能体权限的资格并询问是否邀请，再指导在 Manage Your Permissions → Manage Agents 启用并选择可授权用户；在 Amazon Quick 还需邀请该用户为协作者。不用于自身账户或市场配置、销售操作及无关智能体的权限。
53a1386e095f0b3cb38d6f824cdf89f55c9c8622.source: Helps the account owner, an administrator, or a permissions manager of a Seller Central account invite their secondary users to use the Selling Partner plugin. Runs right after the Amazon Selling Partner Connector connector is connected: it confirms the person can grant agent access, asks whether they want to invite secondary users, then walks them through Manage Your Permissions -> Manage Agents, where they enable the agent for the account and choose which secondary users may authorize it. When the skill runs in Amazon Quick, it adds one extra step — inviting that user as a collaborator in the Quick account. Triggers on: invite users, add a secondary user, manage agents, grant agent access, "let my team use the plugin", onboard my team, give access to another user. Do NOT use for: setting up your own account/marketplace (established by the connect flow), taking selling actions, or User Permissions unrelated to AI agents.
53a1386e095f0b3cb38d6f824cdf89f55c9c8622.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

9c1d633d6ef1864027d37aaee14c3dc102be3f12.description_zh: 诊断商品无法购买的原因，检查产品完整性、有效可购买报价及可用库存，说明原因与下一步；报价修复须先预览后批准，库存问题转交对应流程。用于无法购买、无购买框、未激活或缺价格报价；不用于搜索发现、已报告商品错误或补货预测。
9c1d633d6ef1864027d37aaee14c3dc102be3f12.source: Diagnoses why a seller''s listing isn''t buyable and relays the specific reason plus the next step. Checks the three things that make a listing buyable — a complete product, a valid purchasable offer, and available inventory — then fixes the offer (preview → approve) or routes inventory elsewhere. Triggers on: not buyable, can''t be purchased, "why can''t customers buy this", no buy box, listing inactive, missing price / offer. Do NOT use for: search/discoverability (use listing-searchability), fixing reported listing issues (use listing-issues), or inventory replenishment (use stockout-prevention).
9c1d633d6ef1864027d37aaee14c3dc102be3f12.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6431bfefb9d8234c7ce94a42475d32fe50ebe3de.description_zh: 在商品写入前识别适用 Amazon 上架及 FDA、EPA、CPSC、FCC、FTC、披露、GTIN 和类别准入要求，一次询问只有卖家知道的事实，核查账户准入，并等卖家明确同意后才写入。用于上架合规及修改声明、成分、类别、状态、图片或标识符前；不用于已报告问题、可购买性、搜索优化或无关上架的一般政策问答。
6431bfefb9d8234c7ce94a42475d32fe50ebe3de.source: Pre-flight compliance gate before any listing write. Identifies which Amazon listing and regulatory requirements (FDA, EPA, CPSC, FCC, FTC, disclosures, GTIN, category gating) apply, asks the seller once for the facts only they know, checks account-side gating, and holds the write until the seller gives an explicit go. Triggers on: "can I list this", "what do I need to sell X", "is this compliant", listing requirements, help me list, or when a sibling listing skill is about to change product claims, ingredients, category, condition, images, or identifiers. Do NOT use for: reported issues (listing-issues), buyability (listing-buyability), search optimization (listing-searchability), or general program-policy Q&A unrelated to listings.
6431bfefb9d8234c7ce94a42475d32fe50ebe3de.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

7a0f2ce163e7d1bd09506d85432935912b0f13f1.description_zh: 读取商品已报告问题的严重度和执行措施，按影响排序修复缺失或无效属性及问题导致的屏蔽，每项上线前均先预览。用于商品错误、属性错误或因问题被抑制；不用于无报告问题的不可购买、搜索优化、新建商品、库存缺货、广告或订单。
7a0f2ce163e7d1bd09506d85432935912b0f13f1.source: Fixes listing problems that surface as reported issues on a listing — missing or invalid attributes, and suppressions tied to an issue. Reads the listing''s issues (severity + enforcement), prioritizes by impact, and previews every fix before it goes live. Triggers on: listing issues, listing errors, fix my listing, attribute errors, suppressed because of an issue, "what''s wrong with this listing". Do NOT use for: why a listing isn''t buyable when there''s no issue (use listing-buyability), search visibility / optimization (use listing-searchability), creating new listings, inventory / stockout, advertising, or orders.
7a0f2ce163e7d1bd09506d85432935912b0f13f1.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

42423f3a9da7936bc619b62090be750aaf34acf1.description_zh: 诊断商品搜索不可见，先检查能否被发现，再经卖家批准优化标题、描述、要点和通用关键词。用于搜索找不到、排名及可发现性优化；不用于无法购买或已报告问题修复。
42423f3a9da7936bc619b62090be750aaf34acf1.source: Diagnoses why a seller''s listing isn''t found in search and helps make it more discoverable. Checks whether the listing is discoverable at all, then optimizes the content shoppers search on — title, description, bullet points, and generic keywords — with the seller''s approval. Triggers on: not showing up in search, can''t be found, not discoverable, improve ranking, search visibility, optimize my listing, SEO. Do NOT use for: not-buyable (use listing-buyability) or fixing reported issues (use listing-issues).
42423f3a9da7936bc619b62090be750aaf34acf1.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3e4d5363df3f574c675a9e5b34a27f310e1a815a.description_zh: 商品异常的总入口：快速读取状态和问题，识别症状并转交 listing-issues、listing-buyability、listing-searchability 或 listing-compliance，适用于不知从何排查、产品异常及上架要求问题。
3e4d5363df3f574c675a9e5b34a27f310e1a815a.source: Top-level entry point for any "something''s wrong with my listing" question. Does a quick scan to read the listing''s status and issues, identifies the symptom, and routes the seller to the right specialist skill — issue-fixing, buyability, searchability, or compliance. Triggers on: something''s wrong with my listing, troubleshoot my listing, my product has a problem, listing not working, where do I start, "can I list this", "what do I need to sell X". Routes to: listing-issues, listing-buyability, listing-searchability, listing-compliance.
3e4d5363df3f574c675a9e5b34a27f310e1a815a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d7b15a673d518468ca0624f29770b2cce9d83a97.description_zh: 只读查询 Amazon Selling Partner Connector 分析工具，回答库存健康、流量和销售表现。先发现真实指标 ID，不猜名称，再按正确过滤、分组和时间取数并通俗解释。用于销量、访问、缺货风险、库存、可供天数、ASIN 浏览量和补货时点；不用于价格或商品修改、建货运、税务或结算报告，也不决定连接流程已确定的账户或市场。
d7b15a673d518468ca0624f29770b2cce9d83a97.source: Answers a seller''s business-performance questions — inventory health, traffic, and sales — by querying the Amazon Selling Partner Connector analytics tools. Always discovers the real metric IDs first (never guesses metric names), then retrieves the data with the correct filters, grouping, and time range, and explains the result in plain language. Read-only: it reports numbers, it never changes anything. Triggers on: "how are my sales / sessions / traffic", "am I at risk of a stockout", "how much inventory do I have", "what''s my days of supply", "show me page views by ASIN", "when should I restock", "seller analytics", "business report". Do NOT use for: changing prices or listings, creating shipments, tax/GST/financial-settlement reports, or establishing which account/marketplace to use (established by the connect flow).
d7b15a673d518468ca0624f29770b2cce9d83a97.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

c9e0addacdc0d99554cfdc63abebdcf804484410.description_zh: 严格依据 SP-API 文档知识库解答开发问题并指导从构想到代码：先搜索并读取全文，按事实、原理、入门、API 选择、能力支持或集成设计路由，并配图表或设计产物。覆盖 Orders、Feeds、Listings、FBA、Reports、Notifications、Catalog、Pricing 和 Vendor；只解释设计，不改卖家账户，不用于账户操作、实时经营分析或非 SP-API 主题。
c9e0addacdc0d99554cfdc63abebdcf804484410.source: Answers Selling Partner API (SP-API) questions and guides developers from idea to working code, grounded strictly in the SP-API documentation knowledge base, never from general knowledge or web guesses. Searches the docs first, fetches full content, routes by question shape (factual lookup, how it works, getting started, which API to use, does-X-support, build an integration, design a solution), and pairs every answer with a visual such as a mermaid diagram, a table, or a design-proposal artifact when brainstorming. Read-only: it explains and designs, it never changes a seller account. Use for SP-API developer questions: how do I, which SP-API to use, does SP-API support X, rate limits, error codes, auth, getting started, build an integration, design or brainstorm, show me a schema or workflow, across Orders, Feeds, Listings, FBA, Reports, Notifications, Catalog, Pricing, and Vendor. Do NOT use for account actions (price, listing, inventory, shipment changes), live account analytics, or non-SP-API topics.
c9e0addacdc0d99554cfdc63abebdcf804484410.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f5da09b42e096f2c1e6cb79439c702b02ec14873.description_zh: 监控 FBA 库存健康，根据销售速度识别缺货风险并协调防范，重点为入库货运缺口分析和补货。用于库存检查、可供天数及补货；不用于目录管理、新产品上架、广告或履约。
f5da09b42e096f2c1e6cb79439c702b02ec14873.source: Monitors FBA inventory health, identifies stockout risks from sales velocity, and orchestrates prevention actions — primarily inbound-shipment gap analysis and restocking. Triggers on: inventory check, stockout risk, FBA stock levels, days of cover, days of supply, replenishment, "am I going to run out". Do NOT use for: catalog management, new product listings, advertising, or order fulfillment.
f5da09b42e096f2c1e6cb79439c702b02ec14873.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8cbb4b17d873be30df987e6191c71b3aba755685.description_zh: 为 Seller Central 卖家账户或销售问题整理少量案情及去除个人信息的摘要，指引正确 Amazon 支持路径。有支持工具且卖家明确确认时可联系或建案例，否则引导用户自行到帮助中心提交。不用于 Vendor Central、非卖家支持、根因诊断修复或未经明确确认提交。
8cbb4b17d873be30df987e6191c71b3aba755685.source: Guides an Amazon seller (Seller Central) who has a Selling Partner account or selling issue to the right Amazon support path. It gathers a few case details, assembles a clean, PII-free summary, and either (a) uses an Amazon Selling Partner connector tool to contact Seller Support / create a case when such a tool is available and the seller explicitly confirms, or (b) — when no such tool exists — points the seller to the Seller Central Help Center to open the case themselves. Triggers on: "I need to contact Amazon about my account", "How do I open a support case?", "Something''s wrong with my account and I need help", "I need additional help with Amazon", "can you open a case", "contact Amazon support", "connect me with Amazon support". Do NOT use for: Vendors (Vendor Central) or any non–Seller Central use case; requests that are not Amazon Seller / Selling Partner support; diagnosing or fixing the underlying problem; or submitting a case without the seller''s explicit confirmation.
8cbb4b17d873be30df987e6191c71b3aba755685.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

27f03bbc108e3fb76ffc9fd9548317eef977a0c6.description_zh: 为 AWS 应用集成 Amazon Location Service：MapLibre 交互或静态地图、正反地理编码、路线和旅行时间、服务区域、文字及附近地点搜索、自动补全、营业时间和联系方式等详情、地理围栏及设备定位；涵盖认证、SDK 和服务能力。
27f03bbc108e3fb76ffc9fd9548317eef977a0c6.source: Integrates Amazon Location Service APIs for AWS applications. Use this skill when users want to add maps (interactive MapLibre or static images); geocode addresses to coordinates or reverse geocode coordinates to addresses; calculate routes, travel times, or service areas; find places and businesses through text search, nearby search, or autocomplete suggestions; retrieve detailed place information including hours, contacts, and addresses; monitor geographical boundaries with geofences; or track device locations. Covers authentication, SDK integration, and all Amazon Location Service capabilities.
27f03bbc108e3fb76ffc9fd9548317eef977a0c6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

4385638361dd0a79dca0f0f11df01ea8101f92d2.description_zh: 每月列出可访问 Azure 订阅，由用户选分析对象，再按资源类型、地区和服务类别查询上个账单月费用。订阅顺序查询，每次间隔一分钟以避免计费 API 429 限流；首次自动发现数据源 UID。
4385638361dd0a79dca0f0f11df01ea8101f92d2.source: Monthly Azure subscription cost analysis — lists all accessible subscriptions, lets the user choose which to analyze, then queries last billing month's cost breakdown by resource type, region, and service category for each subscription. Queries subscriptions sequentially with 1-minute waits between calls to avoid billing API rate limits (429). On first run, auto-discovers datasource UID.
4385638361dd0a79dca0f0f11df01ea8101f92d2.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f97ef2410dab06d9ae90c1aeb790af56b7011675.description_zh: 检查全部 Cosmos DB for MongoDB（RU）账户的标准化 RU、可用性、服务端延迟、429 限流及复制指标，再用资源日志和相关性深入异常账户。通过持久报告追踪跨会话已知问题，先 AMG-MCP 脉冲初筛再批量 Azure Monitor 调查；首次自动发现数据源 UID 并询问订阅 ID。
f97ef2410dab06d9ae90c1aeb790af56b7011675.source: Fleet-wide Cosmos DB for MongoDB (RU) health check — scans NormalizedRU consumption, service availability, server-side latency, throttling (429s), and replication metrics across all accounts, then deep-dives into abnormal accounts with resource logs and correlation analysis. Tracks known issues across sessions via persistent report. Uses AMG-MCP pulse check for Tier 1 triage, then batched Azure Monitor queries for Tier 2 investigation. On first run, auto-discovers datasource UID and prompts for subscription ID.
f97ef2410dab06d9ae90c1aeb790af56b7011675.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b392cdd2545547769aee467febd280e4c780337a.description_zh: 检查全部 Azure Key Vault 的可用性、API 延迟、429 限流、401/403 认证失败及饱和度，再对最值得关注的七个库深查指标和资源日志。持久报告跟踪跨会话问题；首次自动发现数据源 UID 并询问订阅 ID。
b392cdd2545547769aee467febd280e4c780337a.source: Fleet-wide Azure Key Vault health check — pulse check for availability, API latency, throttling (429s), auth failures (401/403), and vault saturation across all vaults, then deep-dives into the top 7 most interesting vaults with metrics and resource logs. Tracks known issues across sessions via persistent report. On first run, auto-discovers datasource UID and prompts for subscription ID.
b392cdd2545547769aee467febd280e4c780337a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ee2830d8ce9972cb947c282e90303c838f31ca3b.description_zh: 检查全部 PostgreSQL Flexible Server 的 CPU、内存、存储、IOPS、磁盘带宽和连接，再用资源日志和相关性分析异常服务器。持久报告跟踪跨会话问题，先 AMG-MCP 脉冲初筛再批量 Azure Monitor 深查；首次自动发现数据源 UID 并询问订阅 ID。
ee2830d8ce9972cb947c282e90303c838f31ca3b.source: Fleet-wide PostgreSQL Flexible Server health check — scans CPU, memory, storage, IOPS, disk bandwidth, and connection metrics across all servers, then deep-dives into abnormal servers with resource logs and correlation analysis. Tracks known issues across sessions via persistent report. Uses AMG-MCP pulse check for Tier 1 triage, then batched Azure Monitor queries for Tier 2 investigation. On first run, auto-discovers datasource UID and prompts for subscription ID.
ee2830d8ce9972cb947c282e90303c838f31ca3b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d61c4529435ec196a3c2bb86540351f2a51bb3c8.description_zh: 检查全部 Azure Storage Account 的可用性、延迟、事务和错误率，再深查最值得关注的七个账户的端到端与服务端延迟、容量、流入流出及资源日志。持久报告跟踪跨会话问题；首次自动发现数据源 UID 并询问订阅 ID。
d61c4529435ec196a3c2bb86540351f2a51bb3c8.source: Fleet-wide Azure Storage Account health check — pulse check for availability, latency, transactions, and error rates across all accounts, then deep-dives into the top 7 most interesting accounts with metrics (E2E latency, server latency, capacity, ingress/egress) and resource logs. Tracks known issues across sessions via persistent report. On first run, auto-discovers datasource UID and prompts for subscription ID.

7e66c6222d06d61ca429a39cbe63bc7bb743ebd3.description_zh: 针对 PR、分支、文件、目录或功能端到端制定分析埋点方案：读取代码、发现应追踪事件，并一次产出具体计划。用于添加分析、事件或跟踪的请求，是完整埋点流程入口，优先于分别调用 diff-intake、discover-event-surfaces、instrument-events。

Also turns an uploaded slide deck into a course. Use when someone wants to build a training course, "make a course about X", narrate a deck, or ship a playable, published course to learners.
9e01f6da140d3f75d0c0804f82413b2f759bbfe5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

cc5030278ad67de31206206e204bb4cb80ff973b.description_zh: 通过 AmpUp MCP 逐幻灯片或讲解节奏编辑课程草稿的口播、可编辑 HTML、测验及角色扮演检查点。用户提供 course_id 或指向刚建课程，读取后按要求调整并准确说明变化。
cc5030278ad67de31206206e204bb4cb80ff973b.source: Edit a drafted AmpUp course's slides and talk-track (the narration the avatar speaks) through the AmpUp MCP connector, one slide or beat at a time. Use when the user wants to tweak, rewrite, shorten, punch up, or restyle a course's narration, an editable slide's HTML, a quiz, or a roleplay checkpoint. The user gives a course_id (or points at a course you just created); you read the course, make the requested edit through MCP, and confirm exactly what changed.
cc5030278ad67de31206206e204bb4cb80ff973b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1ebb1dedcb9b887eac8753157f5ebe3ea6659af0.description_zh: 为 AmpUp 播放器制作高设计感 HTML 幻灯片：固定 1280×720 画布、Shadow 隔离 CSS、自适应缩放且无交互，由播放器截图并讲解。每页输出自包含 data-slide-isolated HTML 块，供 course-authoring 嵌入；包含负责逐页设计的 Opus 子智能体，是辅助技能而非用户直接入口。
1ebb1dedcb9b887eac8753157f5ebe3ea6659af0.source: Author high-design HTML slides for the AmpUp course player. Pairs the frontend-design craft with the player's hard render contract - a fixed 1280x720 canvas, shadow-isolated rich CSS, self-scaling to fit, and no interaction (the player screenshots and narrates each slide). Emits a single self-contained data-slide-isolated HTML block per slide that course-authoring embeds directly into the course plan. Ships a slide-designer subagent (Opus) that does the actual per-slide design work. Supporting craft skill; not invoked directly by users.
1ebb1dedcb9b887eac8753157f5ebe3ea6659af0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d4a6ce1ae8fe69e9ed82f2f9abb2f51dbecce7f1.description_zh: 从上传 PPTX 模板或 JSX/TSX/CSS 风格指南提取色彩、字体、间距和画布设计令牌，通过简短访谈解决歧义，保存为讲师 brand_template 并应用。用于课程统一外观、讲师品牌及重设风格。
d4a6ce1ae8fe69e9ed82f2f9abb2f51dbecce7f1.source: Extract and apply a brand/design system to a course instructor. Reads an uploaded template (a PPTX deck or a JSX/TSX/CSS styleguide), pulls its design tokens (color, typography, spacing, canvas), settles the few genuinely ambiguous choices through a short interview, and saves the result to that instructor's brand_template. Use when a user wants their courses to inherit a consistent look, wants to "brand" or "restyle" an instructor from a deck or styleguide, or wants every course an instructor builds to share the same colors, type, and layout.
d4a6ce1ae8fe69e9ed82f2f9abb2f51dbecce7f1.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

92f35137b949acc48992791d58a15b36ed1af1cb.description_zh: 通过 AmpUp MCP 创建或编辑销售、面试、客服、谈判和辅导等角色扮演脚本，设计人物、评价指标与阶段；直接保存为播放器可运行的练习。
92f35137b949acc48992791d58a15b36ed1af1cb.source: Create or edit AmpUp roleplay practice scripts for realistic training scenarios (sales calls, interviews, customer service, negotiation, coaching). Use when the user wants to build a new roleplay, design a buyer or interviewer persona, add evaluation metrics, split a scenario into phases, or edit an existing practice script. Persists directly through the AmpUp MCP tools, so the finished script is saved and ready to run in the AmpUp player.
92f35137b949acc48992791d58a15b36ed1af1cb.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

34d5e17ebb667f03b145c1aac5c298d895517416.description_zh: 提供分析调查五步法：加载画像、界定问题、构建 MECE 假设树、交叉验证、按金字塔原则呈现。用于解释指标变化、漏斗、群体比较和结论，区分信号噪声并识别辛普森悖论。
34d5e17ebb667f03b145c1aac5c298d895517416.source: The spine of analytics investigation. Use whenever interpreting analytics numbers, answering "why did X change", reading funnels, comparing cohorts, or presenting findings. Teaches a five-step method (load profile, frame the question, build a MECE hypothesis tree, triangulate, present with Pyramid Principle), how to separate signal from noise, and how to spot Simpson's paradox before it misleads you.
34d5e17ebb667f03b145c1aac5c298d895517416.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

244f03b333334625f8f01df8da0befb3c37b81ab.description_zh: 一次性访谈采集行业、业务模式、主要转化、流量范围、理想客户和数据栈，保存本地 analytics-profile.md；其他分析技能据此匹配基准与术语。
244f03b333334625f8f01df8da0befb3c37b81ab.source: One-time interview that captures the business context (industry, model, primary conversion, traffic range, ICP, data stack) into a local analytics-profile.md file. Every other analytics skill reads this file so its answers are calibrated to the right benchmarks and terminology instead of generic averages.
244f03b333334625f8f01df8da0befb3c37b81ab.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

571b9f417ff789adae58fb14cd3e4337caf4287e.description_zh: 用 STL、贝叶斯在线变点、Prophet、分位数回归、序贯概率比检验和 Granger 因果方法增强流量变化诊断。用于指纹重叠、变化是否真实或日期争议、星期效应、同期候选原因及早期告警；Clamp 返回超过 14 天序列或用户提供需严谨判断的日/小时历史时适用，配合诊断法和序贯监控。
571b9f417ff789adae58fb14cd3e4337caf4287e.source: Formal time-series methods that augment the hand-coded fingerprint library in traffic-change-diagnosis. Use this skill when traffic-change-diagnosis fingerprints overlap, when the user asks "is this real?", or when the change date is contested. Applies STL decomposition, Bayesian online changepoint detection, Prophet, quantile regression, sequential probability ratio test, and Granger causality. Use whenever interpreting a series where day-of-week confounds an eyeballed drop, where two candidate causes share a week, or where an alert needs to fire before an analyst sees the chart. Pairs with analytics-diagnostic-method for the surrounding investigation and with sequential-monitoring for the SPRT details. Triggers when Clamp MCP traffic_timeseries returns a series spanning more than 14 days, or when via Clamp the user shares a daily/hourly metric history that needs a non-eyeball verdict.
571b9f417ff789adae58fb14cd3e4337caf4287e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

380e0940124ca62f25fdd8a94732e6864fc7cc17.description_zh: 与 experiment-result-reader 配合，以各变体曝光与转化计算胜过对照的后验概率、可信区间和预期损失；比例用 Beta-Binomial，连续指标用 Normal-Normal。结合信心阈值与损失容忍度给决策，用于即将上线的 A/B 结果、胜出概率或边界 p 值的贝叶斯视角；适用 Clamp 或其他来源的逐变体计数。
380e0940124ca62f25fdd8a94732e6864fc7cc17.source: Bayesian counterpart to experiment-result-reader. Computes posterior P(variant beats control), credible intervals, and expected loss from per-variant exposure and conversion data. Beta-Binomial for proportion metrics (CVR), Normal-Normal for continuous metrics (revenue per user). Decision rule combines a confidence threshold with an expected-loss tolerance, so the ship decision reflects both "how likely is this better?" and "how bad is it if I'm wrong?". Use this skill alongside experiment-result-reader when reading any A/B test result. Pairs with analytics-diagnostic-method. Use whenever interpreting an A/B test result the user plans to ship from, when the question is "what's the chance variant wins?", or when a frequentist p-value is on the edge and the user wants the posterior view. Triggers when Clamp MCP returns experiment exposure and conversion data, or when any analytics source surfaces per-variant counts.
380e0940124ca62f25fdd8a94732e6864fc7cc17.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

dd6193621ae485b61f6ae8a7a5207b7161de3ca8.description_zh: 在用观察数据判断因果前建立可修订 Mermaid 因果 DAG，用后门准则确定调整变量，明确混杂、媒介和碰撞变量，供下游选调整集。用于无实验对照的群体差异、漏斗流失或因果解释，配合分析诊断法；涵盖 Clamp 群体比较及漏斗。
dd6193621ae485b61f6ae8a7a5207b7161de3ca8.source: Build a refinable causal DAG before answering "did X cause Y" on observational data. Emits a Mermaid diagram of assumed causes, applies the back-door criterion to decide what to condition on, and forces confounders, mediators, and colliders to be named explicitly instead of "controlling for everything". The DAG is an artifact downstream skills read to pick the right adjustment set. Use whenever interpreting cohort comparisons, funnel drop-offs, or any analytics result where the user is reasoning causally without an experiment. Pairs with analytics-diagnostic-method as the causal-structure layer underneath the diagnostic tree. Triggers when Clamp MCP cohorts_compare or funnels_create is called with no experimental holdback, when a Clamp MCP result prompts a causal claim from observational data, or when via Clamp the user asks "why did this segment convert higher".
dd6193621ae485b61f6ae8a7a5207b7161de3ca8.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6d8f6e495908ee3ca40518b0fe0fe057ffdd3b26.description_zh: 在依据观察分析建议回滚、上线、放弃或扩大前，用 Bradford Hill 九视角检查 X 是否导致 Y，区分偶然、混杂及反向因果；约少于五项通过时不标高信心。配合诊断树及渠道漏斗细分，适用于发布与指标变化关联，方法不依赖供应商，Clamp 可映射到流量比较拆分、错误时间线和漏斗。
6d8f6e495908ee3ca40518b0fe0fe057ffdd3b26.source: Bradford Hill's 9 viewpoints (1965) reframed as a checklist for product analytics. Use this skill before recommending a decision based on observational analytics data. Applies the 9 Bradford Hill viewpoints to score whether X actually caused Y, or whether the correlation is coincidental, confounded, or reversed. Use whenever interpreting a metric change the user is about to act on (rollback, ship, abandon, double-down). Refuses to label a verdict "high confidence" when fewer than ~5 of the 9 criteria pass. Pairs with analytics-diagnostic-method (which provides the hypothesis tree) and channel-and-funnel-quality (which provides the segmentation discipline). Triggers when Clamp MCP returns a comparison the user is about to act on, when a deploy correlates with a metric move, or when the user says "X caused Y" / "did X cause Y" / "should we roll back / ship / kill X" based on a chart. Vendor-neutral methodology; via Clamp MCP the per-criterion checks map directly to traffic.compare, traffic.breakdown, errors.timeline, and funnels.list.
6d8f6e495908ee3ca40518b0fe0fe057ffdd3b26.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

dcf253e0064d0acecc75212ab3c45b39800f3bbc.description_zh: 回答为什么或假设问题前，按 Pearl 三层因果层级标为关联、干预或反事实。无后门、工具变量、双重差分、断点或合成控制等识别策略时，不把观察关联升级成上线或停止建议。配合诊断法，适用于用户将依据趋势或比较采取行动；可用任意观察来源，Clamp 为典型集成。
dcf253e0064d0acecc75212ab3c45b39800f3bbc.source: Pearl's three-rung causal hierarchy as a query classifier. Tags every analytics question as rung-1 (association, P(Y|X)), rung-2 (intervention, P(Y|do(X))), or rung-3 (counterfactual, P(Y_x|Y',X')) before answering. Refuses to escalate a rung-1 observational finding into a rung-2 ship/kill recommendation without naming an identification strategy (back-door, instrumental variable, DiD, RDD, synthetic control). Use this skill whenever interpreting an analytics question that asks why or what-if, to classify it on Pearl's causal hierarchy before answering. Pairs with analytics-diagnostic-method. Triggers when Clamp MCP returns a comparison or trend that the user is about to act on, so the agent labels the claim's rung explicitly instead of laundering correlation into causation. Works with any observational source; Clamp MCP is the canonical integration via traffic.compare, funnels.list, and cohorts.compare.
dcf253e0064d0acecc75212ab3c45b39800f3bbc.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

cca5db9ef493040ed6cb3eb9ae05b8e775346c31.description_zh: 判断流量是否有价值及漏斗流失是否真实或预期，结合流量×互动×转化矩阵、虚荣流量、漏斗类型正常流失、群体拆分和混合结构变化（辛普森悖论）；用于渠道比较、漏斗解读和投资决策。
cca5db9ef493040ed6cb3eb9ae05b8e775346c31.source: Judge whether traffic is actually valuable and whether funnel drop-off is real or expected. Use when comparing marketing channels, reading a conversion funnel, or deciding where to invest. Covers volume × engagement × conversion as a matrix, vanity-traffic detection, expected step drop-off by funnel type, cohort decomposition, and mix-shift (Simpson's paradox) handling.
cca5db9ef493040ed6cb3eb9ae05b8e775346c31.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

986edbbf1ddf5cba4100d6b0f1fc8410ee4bea1b.description_zh: 编写维护可移植、类型化 event-schema.yaml，定义产品事件名称、属性、类型和意图；CLI 生成 TypeScript 类型，使跟踪调用可补全并在构建时校验。适用于 Clamp、GA4、Mixpanel、Amplitude、PostHog 和 Segment 等任意 SDK。
986edbbf1ddf5cba4100d6b0f1fc8410ee4bea1b.source: Author and maintain an event-schema.yaml file. A portable, typed declaration of every product analytics event the codebase fires (event names, properties, types, intent). The CLI generates a TypeScript type from it so tracking calls are autocompleted and type-checked at build time. Vendor-neutral; works with any analytics SDK (Clamp, GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog, Segment).
986edbbf1ddf5cba4100d6b0f1fc8410ee4bea1b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

0dc431f8c736770044dd2c5f0e58a68a77d6c8a4.description_zh: 读取运行中 A/B 测试的逐变体曝光与转化，计算提升，遵守序贯检验和样本量约束并通俗说明，避免夸大。依据 event-schema 实验规范，适用于发送 $exposure、$experiment_started 或等价标准曝光事件的平台。
0dc431f8c736770044dd2c5f0e58a68a77d6c8a4.source: Read the result of a running A/B test honestly. Pulls per-variant exposure and conversion counts, computes lift, applies sequential-testing and sample-size discipline, and surfaces the result in plain language without over-claiming. Built on the experiments section of the event-schema spec; works with any platform that fires a canonical exposure event ($exposure, $experiment_started, or equivalent).
0dc431f8c736770044dd2c5f0e58a68a77d6c8a4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ff32f0125d13c479cc4c53622992d86e8e8470b1.description_zh: 在正确业务语境下解释指标和基准，适用于好不好、正常范围及缺分母的比率。涵盖跳出、互动、会话时长、浏览页数、分模式转化率，以及 SaaS 的 LTV:CAC、回收期、MRR 流失、激活和留存，并说明误导条件和最低样本量。
ff32f0125d13c479cc4c53622992d86e8e8470b1.source: Interpret analytics metrics with correct context. Use when the user asks "is this good", "what's a normal X", or quotes a rate without denominator. Covers realistic ranges for bounce rate, engagement, session duration, pages per session, conversion rate by model type, SaaS unit economics (LTV:CAC, CAC payback, MRR churn, activation, retention), plus when each metric lies and minimum sample sizes.
ff32f0125d13c479cc4c53622992d86e8e8470b1.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

764a567a95b8ed534fdb310b38d5bb6eb97b4d38.description_zh: 用 mSPRT 或置信序列对进行中的 A/B 测试做始终有效的序贯推断，使每日查看仍控制名义假阳性率。用于提前停止、窥探检查、尚未到计划期限的停或继续决策；配合实验读取、贝叶斯读取及诊断法，适用于任意分析来源，Clamp 为典型集成。
764a567a95b8ed534fdb310b38d5bb6eb97b4d38.source: Always-valid sequential inference for honest peeking at running A/B tests. Applies mSPRT (mixture Sequential Probability Ratio Test) or confidence sequences so the false-positive rate stays at the nominal alpha even when the test is checked daily. Use this skill when the user asks if it's safe to call an A/B test early, or to peek-check a running test. Pairs with experiment-result-reader and bayesian-experiment-reader, and with analytics-diagnostic-method for the framing discipline. Triggers when Clamp MCP returns mid-experiment exposure and conversion counts, or when a user references peeking, early stopping, sequential testing, alpha-spending, mSPRT, or confidence sequences. Vendor-neutral methodology; works with any analytics source, with Clamp MCP as the canonical integration. Use whenever interpreting an in-flight experiment where the planned horizon has not been reached but the user wants a stop/continue decision.
764a567a95b8ed534fdb310b38d5bb6eb97b4d38.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

457f4ba2c8bc32b50809e78def64e9bb48f9fe6e.description_zh: 沿测量→时间形态→渠道→群体→内容假设树诊断网站流量变化，区分埋点回归与真实行为；识别机器人突增、跟踪回归、发布相关下降、SEO 衰减及活动增长，并遵守样本量约束。
457f4ba2c8bc32b50809e78def64e9bb48f9fe6e.source: Diagnose why website traffic changed. Use when the user asks "why did traffic drop/spike", investigates an anomaly, or wants to separate tracking regressions from real behaviour changes. Walks a hypothesis tree (measurement → time-shape → channel → cohort → content), recognises common fingerprints (bot spike, tracking regression, deploy-correlated drop, SEO decay, campaign ramp), and applies sample-size discipline.
457f4ba2c8bc32b50809e78def64e9bb48f9fe6e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

440025afd1c0f50fa14cb51e687593ad66c38d0c.description_zh: 用 Anamnese 管理用户持久记忆和生产力：先读取 get_user_profile，持续记录个人资料、偏好、决策、任务、目标、日程及值得保存的知识，通过 ai_client 范围笔记跨会话保存互动模式和纠正。源说明设计为每次对话开始加载并随过程记录。
440025afd1c0f50fa14cb51e687593ad66c38d0c.source: Load this skill at the start of every conversation. Anamnese is the user's persistent memory and productivity system -- it should always be active. Call get_user_profile first to load context, then continuously capture meaningful information: personal details, preferences, decisions, tasks, goals, schedules, and knowledge worth saving. You have persistent memory across sessions via notes with scope "ai_client" -- use this to learn and remember how to best assist this user. Save learnings as you go: interaction patterns, corrections received, behavioral preferences, what works and what doesn't. Don't wait until the end of a conversation.

5f0dce62fc79624fa9dff8990dfc16921dfe2fff.description_zh: 通过 Ansvar Gateway MCP 实时读取官方法规，并结合 CVE、CISA-KEV 和 EPSS 漏洞情报，解释 EU Cyber Resilience Act 对产品范围、分类、Annex I 漏洞处理及 Article 14 报告的影响。用于产品适用性、漏洞或事件报告义务及时点、特定 CVE 的法律触发条件，每项法律结论附官方引证。
5f0dce62fc79624fa9dff8990dfc16921dfe2fff.source: Use when a user asks what the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) means for their product, whether and when they must report a vulnerability or incident, or what a specific CVE triggers legally. Maps a product with digital elements to CRA scope, product classification, Annex I vulnerability-handling duties, and Article 14 reporting obligations — every legal claim cited from official regulation text fetched live through the Ansvar Gateway MCP connector, joined with live CVE / CISA-KEV / EPSS vulnerability intelligence from the same connector.
5f0dce62fc79624fa9dff8990dfc16921dfe2fff.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6f1dd1c2bce386afadc7063cfaedcb402977c00a.description_zh: 就安全事件、数据泄露或活跃利用漏洞，跨 NIS2、GDPR、DORA 和 CRA 判断各实体角色的报告义务，按成员国法律确定主管机构，生成逐项引证的截止时间表。通过 Ansvar Gateway MCP 实时取官方发布文本，不凭模型记忆回答。
6f1dd1c2bce386afadc7063cfaedcb402977c00a.source: Use when a security incident, data breach, or actively exploited vulnerability raises the question "who must we notify, where, and by when?" Screens one incident across the EU reporting regimes — NIS2, GDPR, DORA, and the Cyber Resilience Act — determines which duties fire for each involved entity's roles, resolves the receiving authority per regime and member state from served national law, and produces a deadline table in which every duty, authority, and deadline is cited from official publisher text fetched live through the Ansvar Gateway MCP connector. Never answers from model memory.
6f1dd1c2bce386afadc7063cfaedcb402977c00a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

c52195fbd16d1688cc5411fd63ababee4df1100e.description_zh: 解释 ISO/IEC 27001、27002、27005、42001 及 ISO/SAE 21434 的条款、控制、风险管理、AI 管理和车载安全工作要求。账户有对应 ISO Standards 附加服务时，通过 Ansvar Gateway MCP 实时取许可条款并逐条标明标准机构；无服务时用免费 SCF 交叉参考并说明来源路径，不凭模型记忆答标准问题。
c52195fbd16d1688cc5411fd63ababee4df1100e.source: Use when a user asks what ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27002, ISO/IEC 27005, ISO/IEC 42001, or ISO/SAE 21434 requires — an ISMS clause, a control's guidance text, a risk-management step, an AI-management-system requirement, or an automotive-cybersecurity work product. Fetches licensed clause text live through the Ansvar Gateway MCP connector for accounts holding the ISO Standards add-on for that standard, cited clause by clause with the standards body's attribution; on accounts without the add-on it works from the free SCF cross-reference view and says exactly which lane each answer came from. Never answers standards questions from model memory.
c52195fbd16d1688cc5411fd63ababee4df1100e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

9100e58e607035c23796c7ccf314c7a052cc9daa.description_zh: 通过 Ansvar Gateway 服务端强制流程，对应用系统做法规依据的 STRIDE 安全、LINDDUN 隐私威胁建模、实时 CVE/KEV/EPSS 依赖暴露筛查，或选择性且非穷尽地检查 EU 安全义务。每项监管陈述实时引官方文本并注明范围、角色和适用日期；不作合规裁定、不模拟流程、不凭记忆答法律问题。
9100e58e607035c23796c7ccf314c7a052cc9daa.source: Use when an application or system — including one built quickly with AI coding agents — needs a security review with regulatory grounding: a STRIDE threat model, a LINDDUN privacy threat model, a dependency exposure screen against live CVE / CISA-KEV / EPSS data, or a selected, non-exhaustive screen of which EU security obligations (GDPR, NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act, AI Act) may apply and which need determination. Orchestrates the server-enforced threat-modeling workflows of the Ansvar Gateway MCP connector and grounds every regulatory statement in officially published text fetched at answer time — scope, role, and application-date limits stated, never a compliance verdict. Never simulates a workflow and never answers legal questions from model memory.
9100e58e607035c23796c7ccf314c7a052cc9daa.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

facca116392a0e1239844421b0fe9e05ac98a5c8.description_zh: 从 API 文档、OpenAPI/Swagger 或 SDK 参考搭建 Aomi 应用插件，生成 Rust SDK 的 lib.rs、client.rs、tool.rs、工具模式、前置说明、宿主互操作及验证。支持 gen-specs→gen-client→gen-tool→整理→编译测试和新建应用，封装 REST 或迁移 SDK；涵盖 OpenAPI 客户端、同步 HTTP、DynAsyncSink、类型化秘密、路由计划、EVM/SVM 宿主交接及报价→批准→兑换流程，供 aomi-transact 使用。
facca116392a0e1239844421b0fe9e05ac98a5c8.source: Scaffold new Aomi apps and plugins from API docs, OpenAPI/Swagger specs, or SDK references. aomi-build generates production-ready Rust SDK crates (lib.rs, client.rs, tool.rs) with tool schemas, preambles, host-interop flows, and validation — turning a vendor's API surface into AI-agent-callable tools. It covers the current `aomi-build` OpenAPI pipeline (`gen-specs` → `gen-client` → `gen-tool` → curate → compile/test) as well as greenfield apps. Use when the user wants to scaffold a new Aomi app from a spec, wrap a REST API as agent-callable tools, port an existing SDK, or extend an Aomi runtime with new integrations. Trigger with prompts about wrapping APIs, scaffolding Rust crates from specs, or adding protocol integrations that aomi-transact can drive. Output crates support progenitor-generated OpenAPI clients, curated tool layers, sync HTTP, async tools (DynAsyncSink), typed secrets, route plans (ToolReturn/RouteStep), EVM and SVM host handoffs, and multi-step quote→approval→swap flows. Same runtime that aomi-transact drives.

99c81cbceb17ea2181e6c1e7aef9dba0a588ba72.description_zh: 为 AWS AI 智能体统一完成运行时评选、架构、粗成本、迁移方案和可部署 POC，支持 AgentCore/ECS/EKS/Lambda。依采集、轻量代码发现、澄清、确定性评分、设计估算和生成产物推进；多工作负载逐单元判定并可整合，已有 AWS 智能体补能力分支不重评分。迁移和 POC 为可选门控阶段，默认生成交付物，账户内协助构建须明确选择；Temporal 拆为轮询和 Activity 单元，不重写 Workflow 为 Step Functions。至少含一个智能体组件；纯计算数据迁移、纯 LLM SDK 改写和详细模型定价不适用，应转交对应迁移技能。
99c81cbceb17ea2181e6c1e7aef9dba0a588ba72.source: Unified entry point for AI-agent work on AWS: evaluate and pick a runtime, generate a full migration plan (for existing workloads), and build an executable POC — all in one flow. Triggers on: which runtime for my agent, AgentCore vs ECS vs EKS vs Lambda, AgentCore vs Lambda MicroVMs, deploy an AI agent on AWS, agent architecture on AWS, I have an agent idea what do I build, move my agents to AWS, migrate my agents to AWS with a plan, agent migration plan, add AgentCore services, add memory/gateway/identity/policy to my agent, enable AgentCore Memory, add observability to my agent, I'm already on AWS and want to add agent capabilities, migrate Temporal workers to AWS, Temporal to AWS, run Temporal on AWS, Temporal workers on AWS, we use Temporal and want to move to AWS, our service is orchestrated by Temporal, what do I build on AWS for my Temporal workers, move a Temporal-based service to AWS, Temporal Cloud or self-hosted on AWS. Runs a phased flow: Intake (entry point + technical background), Discover (lightweight code detection), Clarify (adaptive questions), deterministic scoring, Design (runtime + deployment model + services + model), Estimate (coarse cost), Generate (layered recommendation doc + scaffolding), then optional gated stages: Migration Plan (full plan generated in-skill by reusing this plugin's gcp-to-aws engine, with the advisor's decisions carried over) and POC (deployment plan + deployable proof-of-concept on the recommended runtime — AgentCore, ECS, EKS, or Lambda; generated deliverables by default, or assisted build in your account on explicit opt-in). Systems with several workloads (interacting or independent agents, batch jobs, services) are decomposed into workload units, each getting its own verdict with a consolidation option. An add-capabilities branch (for teams already running agents on AWS) recommends which AgentCore services to enable on any runtime — no runtime scoring. Temporal systems dissolve into the same unit flow — worker polling tiers and Activity execution classes become units (rules in the Temporal decision reference); Workflow orchestration code is never rewritten — never a Step Functions translation. Requires at least one agentic component: a purely non-agent system (only plain services / batch jobs / HTTP endpoints, or a Temporal worker whose Activities are all non-agent) is out of scope — Clarify halts it (scope gate) and points to gcp-to-aws / heroku-to-aws / llm-to-bedrock. Not for: pure compute/data migration with no AI agent; pure LLM SDK rewrite without agent architecture (use llm-to-bedrock); or detailed per-model pricing.
99c81cbceb17ea2181e6c1e7aef9dba0a588ba72.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

7901ab3c05e96badfdd74c15f804d6d5fbc42c28.source: This skill should be used when an automated agent's output is published under its own identity and carries weight in someone else's work, such as a reviewer whose verdict lands on a pull request, and the open question is how much authority it has actually earned. Covers which conclusions such an agent may state as settled and which it must hand to a person, why a verdict that moves between runs on unchanged input cannot be allowed to decide anything, handing an uncertain item to a human rather than discarding it, grounding each claim in something computed rather than recalled, and the published-state and recall behaviour that decides whether people keep reading the output or learn to skim it. It should also be used when such an agent is being ignored, contradicts itself between runs, or reports a state that nothing current supports. Not for measuring or improving an agent's own output quality, which belongs to aws-agents:agents-optimize, nor for building, deploying, or hardening an agent.

1f5c53d86f82faaccef3267bb6dc54b7687c8224.source: This skill should be used when designing or fixing tenant isolation for a multi-tenant SaaS on AWS, where a team with no dedicated security engineer must make a cross-tenant leak structurally impossible rather than a code-review responsibility. Covers choosing a silo, pool, or bridge model per layer rather than per application, enforcing isolation in IAM session policies and the database so a forgotten predicate fails closed, partitioning data across DynamoDB, Postgres, and S3, containing noisy neighbors, and attributing cost per tenant in a pooled fleet. It should also be used when hardening an existing pooled deployment against cross-tenant access, or when one large customer demands dedicated infrastructure mid-deal. Not for single-tenant architecture or general IAM policy authoring, which belong to the aws-core skills upstream.
1f5c53d86f82faaccef3267bb6dc54b7687c8224.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

c4f7172eb620d20d9627f5384430fb0c460543c1.description_zh: 为无 ML 平台团队的初创企业，在 AWS 低成本运行可容忍延迟、定期自托管 1B–8B 生成模型离线推理，采用 AWS Batch、ECS Managed Instances Spot、S3、确定性分片、单 GPU vLLM、有限重试和结果核对。按真实提示模型定尺寸，控制网络闲置成本，确认输出完整且 GPU 已释放；不用于在线、训练、嵌入、其他引擎、多卡分布式或可手动重跑的一次实验。
c4f7172eb620d20d9627f5384430fb0c460543c1.source: This skill should be used when a startup without a dedicated ML platform team needs recurring, latency-tolerant offline inference for a self-hosted 1B to 8B generative language model on AWS while minimizing GPU spend and recovering automatically from Spot interruption. It prescribes AWS Batch backed by Amazon ECS Managed Instances Spot, with model artifacts staged in Amazon S3, deterministic input shards, vLLM offline inference on one GPU, bounded retries, and output reconciliation before success. Covers sizing from the real prompt and model footprint, choosing networking without an avoidable idle cost floor, and verifying that results are complete and GPU capacity is gone. Not for online endpoints, training, embeddings, other inference engines, multi-GPU or distributed inference, or one-off experiments where manual rerun is acceptable.
c4f7172eb620d20d9627f5384430fb0c460543c1.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

Triggers when user mentions AWS Blocks; project has aws-blocks/ directory; code imports @aws-blocks packages.

efa4b22e8f4b08f408aec212672babc9bbd2a4d5.source: Authors, deploys, and troubleshoots AWS infrastructure using CDK with TypeScript or Python. Covers best practices, stack architecture, and construct patterns. Applies when writing CDK constructs, bootstrapping environments, running cdk deploy/synth/diff, fixing CDK or CloudFormation errors, planning stack structure, importing existing resources, resolving drift, or refactoring stacks without resource replacement.
efa4b22e8f4b08f408aec212672babc9bbd2a4d5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围
