bf838fa8ca5af4ad7b1b3da31d7a3dbe67f75e3b.description_zh: 为客户或家庭会议准备另类投资简报，从iCapital/Addepar取持仓、NAV认缴已缴未缴、流动和平台IRR/TVPI等，与流动资产及IPS目标并列，标记催缴现金、占比集中和过期数据；逐项注明平台，不推荐基金或预测模拟。
bf838fa8ca5af4ad7b1b3da31d7a3dbe67f75e3b.source: Prepare a meeting-ready alternative-investments brief for a client, household, IRA, trust, or named account before a review — pulls the alts book from iCapital or Addepar (positions, NAV vs. commitment, called and unfunded amounts, contributions/distributions/subscriptions/redemptions, lockups, and the platform's own IRR/TVPI/DPI/RVPI) and sits it beside the liquid book and IPS target from the connected portfolio system (Orion Connect, Addepar, or Envestnet), then flags cash needed for capital calls, alts % vs. target, concentration, unfunded concentration, and stale as-of data. Cites the source platform on every figure and keeps disclosures on the page. Does not recommend funds, forecast NAVs/IRRs, or simulate allocation changes. Triggers on "alts brief", "/alts-brief", "prep the [client]'s alts review", "what's going on with [client]'s PE/private investments", "how's [client] doing on their alts", or any request to review a household's alternative investment positions before a meeting.
bf838fa8ca5af4ad7b1b3da31d7a3dbe67f75e3b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

abc11d536b8daf76da53e2720dc34ba12f2755bc.description_zh: 按SEC投资顾问营销、受托反欺诈、记录保留及适用Reg BI规则审核面向客户的邮件、演示或其他材料，输出通过/提示/失败标注、披露、记录草条和归档交接提醒。
abc11d536b8daf76da53e2720dc34ba12f2755bc.source: Review any client-facing message or material (emails, letters, newsletters, social posts, website copy, presentations, performance reports, proposals) for compliance with SEC rules that govern investment advisers — the Marketing Rule (206(4)-1), fiduciary duty / antifraud provisions (206), Books and Records (204-2), and Reg BI where broker-dealer activity applies. Produces a pass/flag/fail markup, required disclosures, a books-and-records scratch-pad entry, and an archiving handoff reminder. Triggers on "compliance check", "/compliance", "is this compliant", "review this before I send it", "can I say this to a client", "check this email/post/deck". Use it whenever an advisor asks to check, review, or look over anything before it goes to a client or prospect — "check this before I send it", "look this over before it goes out" — even a routine note, because deciding that a message needs no changes is part of the review, not a reason to skip it.
abc11d536b8daf76da53e2720dc34ba12f2755bc.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1b87115700145d4b12e239a7be260e073fb5a72d.description_zh: 为家庭准备遗产与税务会议简报，核对CRM进展、Wealth.com计划签署资产、上年税务及当年参数，与托管和投资账户名义及受益人匹配，排序缺口；仅可经批准建CRM任务，不起草法律条款或更改账户受益人。
1b87115700145d4b12e239a7be260e073fb5a72d.source: Prepare a meeting-ready estate and tax brief for a household — opens with what was discussed and actioned since the last meeting (Wealthbox/Redtail/Salesforce), pulls the estate plan from Wealth.com (structure, key documents and whether each is signed, balance sheet) plus the prior-year tax look-back and that year's tax constants, and cross-checks it against how accounts are titled and beneficiaried at the custodian and portfolio platforms (Schwab, Orion/Addepar, iCapital) — surfacing unfunded trusts, titling mismatches, and beneficiary gaps as a prioritized flags list. The only write is creating advisor-approved follow-up tasks in the CRM (optional, approved first). Never drafts trust language, gives legal advice, retitles an account, or changes a beneficiary. Triggers on "estate brief", "estate meeting brief", "estate and tax brief", "estate plan review for [client]", "check [client]'s trust funding", "are [client]'s beneficiaries up to date", or "does [client]'s estate plan match their accounts".
1b87115700145d4b12e239a7be260e073fb5a72d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

c49ee3e8c259671cba8daad7c76c083f7df9e64a.source: Turn a plain-English data question into a read-only SQL++ query, grounded in the live cluster's schema, sample data, and indexes — then run it and return the results. Covers filtering, grouping, aggregation, joins, and matching stored values by range or location/distance ("near…", "within N miles"). Applies mid-conversation when a schema/setup/modeling session pivots to a data question. Does NOT handle full-text, vector, or semantic similarity search (use the Couchbase Search Service); does NOT analyze, optimize, or speed up queries or design indexes (use couchbase-query-optimizer); does NOT perform writes or run DDL (it may *suggest* a CREATE FUNCTION for the user to run). Requires the Couchbase MCP server.

b8ba77f584637a8d887f5cd3687a4c7388323505.source: Diagnose and tune slow Couchbase SQL++ / N1QL queries. Distinct from couchbase-data-modeling (document shape) and couchbase-natural-language-querying (query authoring) — this skill is about reading plans, designing the right indexes, and reshaping queries that already exist. Use proactively when the user shares an EXPLAIN output or a slow query. Requires the Couchbase MCP server.
b8ba77f584637a8d887f5cd3687a4c7388323505.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

cc9f5a30ba72a320c4c2ce2fd5c6da719e1ae04f.description_zh: 作为需求预测第2至3步，计算量、ADI、CV²与趋势，划分SBC需求象限和层级细分，可比较机器聚类与规则，并按提前期建议预测单元和时域；阈值由用户确定。
cc9f5a30ba72a320c4c2ce2fd5c6da719e1ae04f.source: Use this skill for Steps 2–3 of demand-insight — the core series classification and per-segment spec. Computes the 4 axes (volume/ADI/CV²/trend), assigns SBC quadrants (Smooth/Erratic/Intermittent/Lumpy), builds hierarchical segments (~8–12), optionally runs ML clustering (k-means / shape / PCA) and compares it against the rule-based result, then proposes a per-segment forecast unit & horizon (lead-time aware). Thresholds are presented as starting points; the user decides. Use after EDA, or to re-classify on pattern change / new stores.
cc9f5a30ba72a320c4c2ce2fd5c6da719e1ae04f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a0089cd025e7f28fa8eda6e6cb321219941838ec.source: Use this skill for Step 1 of demand-insight — data understanding, preprocessing, and quality checks. Runs missing-value pattern analysis (time-aware interpolation), outlier detection (3σ residual → is_event flag, not deletion), STL/MSTL decomposition, ACF/PACF, ADF stationarity, and change-point detection. Outputs an EDA report and merges a summary into state.json for downstream classification. Use after the H1–H8 hearing or when data is refreshed.
a0089cd025e7f28fa8eda6e6cb321219941838ec.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

0a48e537ca5e6407b541a0f90847ae59301d4d50.source: Use this skill for Steps 6 & 8 of demand-insight — error analysis, business-KPI translation, and the Excel report. Computes accuracy metrics (MAE/RMSE/MAPE/MASE/WMAPE), fulfillment metrics (stockout/overstock), asymmetric business cost, probabilistic quality (Pinball/CRPS, interval coverage), detects systematic bias (by weekday/period/segment), updates hypotheses, recommends next_action (decision.json), optionally reconciles hierarchies (MinTrace), and emits a function-first Excel (.xlsx) report. Use after each modeling iteration, or to produce the final report.
0a48e537ca5e6407b541a0f90847ae59301d4d50.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6625b545b3ae820350ee058a760d71255d4165e3.description_zh: 为需求预测构建日历、周期、节假日、滞后、滚动与外生特征，严格防泄漏，目标衍生特征shift(1)，遵守预测时域可得性，输出特征计划与前滚安全数据。
6625b545b3ae820350ee058a760d71255d4165e3.source: Use this skill for Step 4 of demand-insight — building forecast features with strict data-leakage prevention. Generates calendar, cyclical (sin/cos), holiday (incl. pre/post), lag, rolling, and exogenous features, enforcing shift(1) on all target-derived features and the horizon-availability constraint (lags < h are future information for Direct forecasting). Outputs feature_plan.json and a Walk-Forward-safe features table. Use after classification, or when error analysis calls for new explanatory power.
6625b545b3ae820350ee058a760d71255d4165e3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

4a21ea4a10bd62166d35d0d164900cea0c48ed6f.description_zh: 按需求细分建立朴素等基线及LightGBM、Croston、SBA或TSB模型，执行带提前期间隔的前滚验证和自助预测区间，解释特征与SHAP，仅采用优于基线的高级模型。
4a21ea4a10bd62166d35d0d164900cea0c48ed6f.source: Use this skill for Steps 5 & 7 of demand-insight — build, backtest, and interpret per-segment models. First builds Naive/Seasonal-Naive/MA/SES baselines via StatsForecast, then applies the segment-appropriate advanced model (LightGBM/Croston/SBA/TSB) with skforecast, runs Walk-Forward Validation with bootstrapped prediction intervals (lead-time gap), and extracts feature importance / SHAP. Adopts an advanced model only if it beats baseline. Use after feature engineering, after a G1 model-family switch, or to measure baselines alone.
4a21ea4a10bd62166d35d0d164900cea0c48ed6f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

dd1e12cffbcae99a55c0c4c3beccd09f789263b5.source: Audits a repository's durable artifacts — design tokens and config files, CLAUDE.md and style docs, hardcoded component defaults, git/PR/session history, and prior design-review or design-planning outputs from other tools (critic-layer notes, design briefs, style critiques, layout reviews) — to surface design decisions that quietly became permanent canon, including ones nobody consciously chose. Use this whenever a designer proposes a visual or UI change and needs to know if it conflicts with an existing standard, whenever someone asks "why does X always look like this," "what's our actual design system," "are we locked into this," "can we change this without breaking something," or before any redesign, rebrand, or style-guide work — even if the user never says "canon," "audit," or "design system" explicitly. dd1e12cffbcae99a55c0c4c3beccd09f789263b5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

19908b622bbbaa6f796f3eacf80c879b57760617.description_zh: 在浏览器实时审查网页设计，可贴元素笔记、绘制标记或预览文字样式编辑，保存精确前后差异并形成编码简报；页面预览变化仍需编码者应用到源码。
19908b622bbbaa6f796f3eacf80c879b57760617.source: Run a real-time, in-browser UX/UI design review on a live web page in three modes — pin sticky NOTES on elements, DRAW freehand markup/arrows/shapes over the page, and make live ELEMENT EDITS (text/style/attributes/HTML) that are captured as exact before→after diffs — then turn all of it into an agent-ready change brief plus a paste-ready Claude Code prompt. Use this whenever the user wants to review, critique, annotate, mark up, draw on, or directly edit a live website or web app — a Framer/Webflow/Shopify/React site, a portfolio, a SaaS landing page, a marketing page — and especially when they say things like "review this site," "mark up the homepage," "leave notes on the hero," "draw on the page," "circle what's wrong," "just change the copy/color/spacing right here," "show me the fix on the page," or "turn my design feedback into instructions for a coding agent." Also trigger when handed an existing Critic Layer / annotation JSON export to synthesize. Trigger even when the user does not say "sticky note" or "annotate" — any request to walk a live page and capture what should change, whether by note, drawing, or a direct edit, or to convert loose visual judgments into precise implementation direction, belongs here. Live edits mutate the page for WYSIWYG feedback but the coding agent still applies the captured change to source; Critic Layer is not an autonomous redesign agent.
19908b622bbbaa6f796f3eacf80c879b57760617.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

bf1c6c9bc786a02e18df109978f28cb73a60fc92.description_zh: 按Critic Layer原问题编号与验收标准核验界面修改，提供前后及响应式证据。
bf1c6c9bc786a02e18df109978f28cb73a60fc92.source: Verify implemented interface changes against the original Critic Layer issue IDs and acceptance criteria, including before/after and responsive evidence.
bf1c6c9bc786a02e18df109978f28cb73a60fc92.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f7553dd11c2475c6eaaa195ebbd6de2886659864.description_zh: 清理仓库和项目过期计划、审计、重复文档、临时产物等开发残留，了解意图、澄清重要歧义、本地归档并修复保留指导；保护运行代码，功能退役另行处理。
f7553dd11c2475c6eaaa195ebbd6de2886659864.source: Sanitize repositories and project folders by removing development residue: superseded plans, completed audits, duplicate docs, plugin output, scratch files, and disposable artifacts. Read project intent, resolve consequential ambiguities through a brief grouped conversation, archive locally, and repair surviving guidance. Use for repository bloat, folder cleanup, or audit-only reviews. Operational code is protected; feature retirement is separate work.

16e74b45248d01d1f848f54138b76c3f5f4eabd7.source: Run a comprehensive, read-only health check on the user's computer and return a scored chat summary with prioritized, plain-English recommendations and safe cleanup suggestions. Use this whenever the user wants to check their computer's health, speed it up, free up / reclaim disk space, find what's eating CPU / memory / storage, check battery health and wear, audit login & startup items, see pending updates, or asks for a "tune-up", "checkup", "system report", "health check", or "is my Mac/PC/laptop healthy". Trigger even on casual phrasing like "my laptop feels slow", "why is my fan so loud", "my computer is laggy", "running out of space", or "clean up my machine". Works on macOS, Windows, and Linux. This is a Desktop Commander skill: it relies on a real local shell (start_process / interact_with_process) and is strictly read-only by default — it never needs sudo and only performs cleanups the user explicitly approves.
16e74b45248d01d1f848f54138b76c3f5f4eabd7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8b63dcd7bd41e524533611d79e78b5216429fe36.source: Use Desktop Commander for terminal and command-line work, especially anything that needs a shell whose state persists across turns: Python/Node REPLs, database shells, dev servers and other long-running processes, SSH into remote machines, and Windows PowerShell. Reach for it on pasted errors like "command not found", "permission denied", "EADDRINUSE", "address already in use", "npm ERR!", "ModuleNotFoundError", or "ENOENT", and on intents like "what's using port 3000", "kill that process", "ssh into my server", or "why won't my dev server start". Works on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Never run destructive commands without explicit confirmation.

The deliverable is data (Markdown + JSON); presentation is left to the client.

66ba8aaff4bd10c023b1abcf48bd34721bf3aa57.source: Make two agents refer to the same object. 77ff287c98a7b32c35aed123f93e5a4bb242ff0c.source: Convert a local file (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, …) to markdown, or answer questions about its content. Use whenever the input is a file path, not a URL.
77ff287c98a7b32c35aed123f93e5a4bb242ff0c.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

40287ec3ea01d20d3cc8f3021afe32f2955976e7.description_zh: 通过 Firecrawl 论文索引的语义搜索、语义/结构扩展和正文验证查找论文，覆盖以生物医学和生命科学为主的 PubMed、bioRxiv、medRxiv，以及 arXiv 计算机、物理和数学预印本；该索引仅由 research MCP/CLI 访问，与普通网页搜索 research 分类不同。
40287ec3ea01d20d3cc8f3021afe32f2955976e7.source: Find the papers that answer a research query in Firecrawl's research paper index — a corpus of paper abstracts whose largest share is biomedical and life-science literature (PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv), alongside arXiv preprints in CS, physics, and math — using semantic search, semantic and structural expansion, and in-body verification. Use this skill for literature-finding and paper-retrieval tasks of any kind, including clinical, biomedical, drug, gene, disease, and other life-science questions, whether the answer is a single paper or a full multi-paper set. The index is reached only through the `firecrawl_research_*` MCP tools or the `firecrawl research` CLI subcommands. Calling `firecrawl_search` with its `categories` option set to `["research"]` is a different feature — it filters ordinary web search to research-affiliated websites (the list includes PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv, and publisher sites) and returns page results from them, without querying the paper records in this index.
40287ec3ea01d20d3cc8f3021afe32f2955976e7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

7f9edf74e731e7fb91bc69ad06c1cc12ca6b6d02.description_zh: 将给定 URL 内容提取为干净 Markdown，包括 JavaScript 渲染页面，原文建议用于用户给出网址并需要正文时。
7f9edf74e731e7fb91bc69ad06c1cc12ca6b6d02.source: Extract a URL's content as clean markdown, including JS-rendered pages. Use whenever the user provides a URL and wants its content; prefer over WebFetch.
7f9edf74e731e7fb91bc69ad06c1cc12ca6b6d02.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

efb27f1395765eac581398ce393507b7ac7acf8b.description_zh: 在未知 URL 时进行带完整页面内容的网页搜索，寻找来源、文章或新闻；论文和库/API/错误/缺陷问题分别交由研究与开发者索引技能。
efb27f1395765eac581398ce393507b7ac7acf8b.source: Web search with full page content. Use when no URL is known: finding sources, articles, or news. For papers use firecrawl-research-index; for library, API, error, or bug questions use firecrawl-developer-index.
efb27f1395765eac581398ce393507b7ac7acf8b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

4c24b0ce1a5df49f0a4a7007fdae126318e24ec3.description_zh: 通过 Firecrawl CLI 执行网页搜索、读取提取、来源整理、URL 发现、批量抓取、站点下载、变更提醒及需要点击登录的网页任务；本地文件、论文和开发者问题分别路由到专用技能。
4c24b0ce1a5df49f0a4a7007fdae126318e24ec3.source: Any live-web task via the Firecrawl CLI — including ordinary web research: searching the web, reading or extracting pages, gathering sources, discovering site URLs, bulk extraction, downloading a site, change alerts, or pages needing clicks/login — web only; local files route to firecrawl-parse. For papers use firecrawl-research-index; for library, API, error, or bug questions use firecrawl-developer-index.
4c24b0ce1a5df49f0a4a7007fdae126318e24ec3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d692a49745ee93a0ad3acbaad346c67599d0a936.description_zh: 创建 Firetiger 监控代理、安装预置代理并配置触发器和日程，用于自动监控、周期或单次分析及事件自动化；保留代理需开启、触发器为独立资源及 scheduled-agent-runs 是单次运行的限制。
d692a49745ee93a0ad3acbaad346c67599d0a936.source: Use when creating a Firetiger monitoring agent, installing a prebuilt catalog agent, or configuring an agent's triggers and schedules — monitoring something automatically, scheduling recurring or one-off analysis, or wiring event-driven automation. Always use this skill to create or automate an agent — it carries the critical gotchas (prefer create_agent_with_goal and answer the planner, agents must be AGENT_STATE_ON to fire, triggers are separate resources with six config types, scheduled-agent-runs are one-shot not cron).
d692a49745ee93a0ad3acbaad346c67599d0a936.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1d05a03874460545c1905c3fdc5b16b7d8378c3a.description_zh: 为 Node.js、Next.js、Python、Go 或 Rust 应用接入 OpenTelemetry 并向 Firetiger 发送遥测，配置追踪和 OTLP 导出；原文强调初始化先于其他导入、接入使用 HTTP Basic 认证且凭据由 MCP 获取。
1d05a03874460545c1905c3fdc5b16b7d8378c3a.source: Use when adding OpenTelemetry instrumentation to an application so it sends telemetry to Firetiger — setting up tracing, configuring the OTLP exporter, or connecting a Node.js, Next.js, Python, Go, or Rust app to Firetiger. Always use this skill when instrumenting for Firetiger — it carries the critical gotchas (init must load before any other import, Firetiger ingest uses HTTP Basic auth not Bearer, credentials come from the get_ingest_credentials MCP tool) that make telemetry actually show up.
1d05a03874460545c1905c3fdc5b16b7d8378c3a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

85df510411a9b22de9a39e922fead87d385422fa.description_zh: 通过 Firetiger 发起或读取调查，以遥测诊断事件并处理调查发现；调查是 AI 代理会话、状态由服务端设定，问题由专家代理管理，需通过引导代理推进。
85df510411a9b22de9a39e922fead87d385422fa.source: Use when diagnosing an issue or incident with Firetiger — launching or reading a Firetiger investigation, troubleshooting with telemetry, or working the issues an investigation surfaces. Always use this skill for incident diagnosis — it carries the critical gotchas (an investigation is an AI agent session, not a findings form; its status is server-set; issues are managed by an expert agent you steer rather than mutate) that keep you working with the product instead of against it.
85df510411a9b22de9a39e922fead87d385422fa.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e09601e1ef2d58085074cc08a8cd2e6434785fb1.description_zh: 使用 Firetiger 监控 PR 或部署并查看结果，涵盖 @firetiger 评论流程、CI/CD 部署登记和监控报告；需完整 PR URL 和已连接 GitHub App，检查点以实际部署后的10分钟、1小时、24小时和72小时为基准。
e09601e1ef2d58085074cc08a8cd2e6434785fb1.source: Use when monitoring a PR or deployment with Firetiger and reviewing what it found — watching a deploy, setting up the @firetiger comment flow, registering deployments from CI/CD, or reading a monitoring agent's results. Always use this skill for deploy monitoring — it carries the critical gotchas (monitor_pr needs the full PR URL, the @firetiger flow needs a connected GitHub App, checks run at 10m/1h/24h/72h anchored to the real deploy, register deploys with Basic auth so checkpoints fire on the right release).
e09601e1ef2d58085074cc08a8cd2e6434785fb1.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3e48a5f8db9acb807527215c2867f67802b738f5.description_zh: 通过 Firetiger MCP query 用 SQL 查询追踪、日志、指标、错误、慢请求和延迟分位数，也访问连接的数据库与监控源；涵盖带斜杠表名引用、计算时长、整数状态码、结构属性及 connections/{name} 完整限定。
3e48a5f8db9acb807527215c2867f67802b738f5.source: Use when querying Firetiger telemetry with SQL — finding traces, searching logs, inspecting metrics, locating errors or slow requests, computing latency percentiles, aggregating observability data, or querying a connected source (Postgres, MySQL, ClickHouse, Datadog, Prometheus, GCP Monitoring) through the Firetiger MCP `query` tool. Always use this skill before writing a Firetiger query — it carries the critical gotchas (slashed table names must be quoted, duration is computed not stored, status codes are integers, attributes are structs not maps, fully-qualify "connections/{name}".table to reach a connected source) that make queries succeed.
3e48a5f8db9acb807527215c2867f67802b738f5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

2d34c2b8523fce9084c62fabe86631d7238484f8.description_zh: 为项目完整接入 Firetiger，涵盖认证订阅、技术栈识别、多源遥测接入、GitHub/Slack/数据库/云集成、部署登记、服务发现和监控代理创建；保留自动提供凭据、Basic 接入及服务发现所需 GitHub 与遥测条件。
2d34c2b8523fce9084c62fabe86631d7238484f8.source: Use when onboarding a project to Firetiger end-to-end — authenticate, subscribe, detect the stack, wire telemetry from any source (OTLP SDK, platform log/trace drains, Datadog Agent, Prometheus, Vector, or a generic HTTP sink), connect integrations (GitHub, Slack, databases, cloud, observability backends), register deployments, let discovery map services, and create a monitoring agent. Always use this skill for first-time setup — it carries the gotchas (credentials auto-provision, Basic-auth ingest, connect GitHub + telemetry to unlock discovery) that finish onboarding in one pass.
2d34c2b8523fce9084c62fabe86631d7238484f8.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1e1b2b4b134503ea2abe9fa93ff6859e5b1868ec.description_zh: 作为 Firetiger 可观测任务入口，将设置、OpenTelemetry 接入、SQL 查询、事件调查、PR/部署监控及代理创建路由到相应技能，涵盖 Basic 接入、按服务表的 DuckDB SQL 和评论流程。
1e1b2b4b134503ea2abe9fa93ff6859e5b1868ec.source: Use when the user mentions Firetiger or wants to work with their observability data — setting up Firetiger, instrumenting an app with OpenTelemetry, querying traces/logs/metrics with SQL, investigating an incident, monitoring a PR or deployment, or creating a monitoring agent. Always use this skill when the user says "Firetiger", even for simple asks — it routes to the specialized skill that carries the critical gotchas (Basic-auth ingest, DuckDB SQL over per-service tables, the @firetiger comment flow) that prevent common mistakes.
1e1b2b4b134503ea2abe9fa93ff6859e5b1868ec.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

c559ac9d9c7d1c9da71b7449e184d6a5d41dce0c.description_zh: 对有实际影响或反复出现的缺陷修复整个错误类别：以失败测试复现、命名类别、搜索相同模式、修复或记录所有命中，并增加规则、不变量、辅助函数或检查防止复发；轻微评审项另行记录。
c559ac9d9c7d1c9da71b7449e184d6a5d41dce0c.source: Bug-fix routine that fixes the whole class of bug, not just the reported instance. Use for any bug report, failing production behaviour, monitoring alert, audit finding or review finding that does real harm (a smaller review finding goes on the item's list, as ship-check says), and whenever the same kind of bug has been seen before. Reproduces it with a failing test, names the failure class, searches the codebase for the same pattern, fixes or records every hit, and adds the rule, invariant, helper or check that stops it coming back.
c559ac9d9c7d1c9da71b7449e184d6a5d41dce0c.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

cc7b985d992a93dd4ba6d098564b3f830cecc672.description_zh: 从用户近期 Claude Code 实际输入中识别可能降低回答质量的习惯提示词，说明影响与后续问题、提出替代表达，并将词语映射到应触发的检查规则；用于学习、刷新或审阅习惯提示。
cc7b985d992a93dd4ba6d098564b3f830cecc672.source: Learns the words a user habitually writes to their coding agent that make its answers worse ("be 100% sure", "don't assume", "full review", "are you sure?", "all fine, right?"), from what they actually typed in their recent Claude Code sessions. Shows what each one does, what went wrong after it, and what to say instead, then writes the habit words block that maps each word to the checks it should trigger, so the checks run without the words. Use when asked to learn, read, refresh or review the user's habit words or prompts, "which of my words make you worse", from setup-first-pass's profile step, or when the start-of-session check says the habit words are due.
cc7b985d992a93dd4ba6d098564b3f830cecc672.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

294725f7b16cd7bfa424c134cca0433d7fb5c513.description_zh: 设置、检查或调整可选 Jev/TypeSafe 判断模型，供 ship-check 评估审查项实际影响、轻微问题是否立即修复及所需证据；显示各仓库状态与所用密钥、切换启停并发送测试请求，仅在用户明确调用时运行。
294725f7b16cd7bfa424c134cca0433d7fb5c513.source: Sets up, checks or changes the optional Jev judge, the TypeSafe decision model that ship-check asks about review findings (is this real harm, is a small one worth fixing now, what proof does a small fix need). Shows whether it is on for each repo, which key it uses, switches it on or off, and sends one test request. Runs only when the user types it.
294725f7b16cd7bfa424c134cca0433d7fb5c513.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b24585c0dfd4647ff971d32fe17e21fb3ba860dd.description_zh: 在涉及数据、作业、资金、外部服务或用户行为的修改前预判故障，按原文列明的重复执行、半途失败、外部调用、失败非空值、相邻影响、结束状态、资金、恶意用户、文案、规模与时间等故障类别检查代码，将答案写入计划。
b24585c0dfd4647ff971d32fe17e21fb3ba860dd.source: Run before writing or changing code for any feature, bug fix or refactor that touches data, jobs, money, outside services or user-facing behaviour. Finds where the change will break before it is built, by walking ten named failure classes (twice, halfway, outside call, failure-is-not-empty, neighbors, endings, money, hostile user, words, scale and time) against the code, and writes the answers into the plan. Use when planning a change, when asked to "think it through", "cover the gaps", "make sure it's bug free", or before any edit to payment, publishing, deletion, auth or background-job code.
b24585c0dfd4647ff971d32fe17e21fb3ba860dd.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

64f2cf991c31dcec38a02f96f369330a108d9eb4.description_zh: 合并前审查当前分支（含未提交修改）或指定 PR/仓库/分支，结合基线、工单、失败 CI 和评论，重新审查并追踪受影响代码，证明或标注未证实发现，列明构建、环境变量、迁移及部署顺序和验证方式；不发 GitHub 评论，报告后才提出修复，仅明确调用时运行。
64f2cf991c31dcec38a02f96f369330a108d9eb4.source: Reviews a change before it is merged, from little or no input. With nothing typed it reviews the branch you are on, uncommitted work included, against its base, its PR and its ticket, so a developer can check their own work before asking for review. With PR links, repo#N or a branch it reviews someone else's change the same way, several repos at once. It judges the failed CI checks and every Bugbot and reviewer comment, gets a fresh breaker review, traces every other piece of code that uses what changed, proves each finding or marks it unproven, says what the merge needs (a build, env vars, migrations, deploy order) and how to check the deploy, never posts to GitHub, and offers fixes only after the report. Runs only when the user types it.
64f2cf991c31dcec38a02f96f369330a108d9eb4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f352643a8d80e95a80db0f4f661da9db1f18b106.description_zh: 为多仓库主目录或单仓库设置 First Pass 工作规则，建立工作区地图、各仓库实际命令、测试限制、不变量与钩子索引；用于首次安装、补充交付规则或漂移后的更新。
f352643a8d80e95a80db0f4f661da9db1f18b106.source: Set up first-pass for a main folder that holds many repos, or for one repo. In a main folder it writes one set of working rules at the root that every session loads, a workspace map, and a section in each repo with that repo's real commands, test limits and invariants, and it lists each repo's own hooks so first-pass can run them from the main folder. In one repo it writes the rules and the section into that repo. Use when asked to set up, install, add, update or re-run first-pass, to "add the shipping rules", or when the start-of-session check says something drifted. Re-run to update.
f352643a8d80e95a80db0f4f661da9db1f18b106.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

73820df4d9c7fc47d4369a5a87ceb863122714a1.description_zh: 在执行前重写命令后的提示，把混合请求拆成编号事项、将笼统保证转为具体检查，保留名称、路径、数字和引文，仅需猜测时提问；只在用户明确调用时运行。
73820df4d9c7fc47d4369a5a87ceb863122714a1.source: Rewrites the prompt typed after the command before any work starts, then works from the rewrite. Splits a mixed-up message into a numbered list of asks, turns words like "be 100% sure", "cover all cases" or "don't break anything" into the checks they stand for, keeps every name, path, number and quote exactly, and stops to ask only where it would have to guess. Runs only when the user types it.
73820df4d9c7fc47d4369a5a87ceb863122714a1.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b8f66c618e18142bbb061bb3de93ec1d3a9957a4.description_zh: 在宣布功能或缺陷修改完成前核对交付条件，检查故障预判、证明测试在旧代码失败、重新审查、干净检出中运行 CI 检查、核对用户文案并生成证据报告。
b8f66c618e18142bbb061bb3de93ec1d3a9957a4.source: The definition of done. Run before calling any change done, fixed, verified, ready or shippable, for features and bug fixes alike. Checks the pre-mortem was answered, proves the tests fail on the old code, gets a fresh breaker review, runs CI's own checks in a clean checkout, checks the user-facing words, and writes the evidence report. Also use when asked "is it done", "is it ready", "did you verify it" or "can we merge".
b8f66c618e18142bbb061bb3de93ec1d3a9957a4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6e2be4ac62e353344ad14e4af235567599560a89.description_zh: 通过 FlightQueue MCP 查询航空公司随身和托运行李规则、费用及遗失行李记录，用于比较行李政策和托运风险。
6e2be4ac62e353344ad14e4af235567599560a89.source: Look up airline baggage rules and lost-bag records with the FlightQueue MCP server. Use when the user asks "what is the carry-on size for Delta", "how much is a checked bag on United", "which airline loses the fewest bags", or "is it safe to check a bag on this airline".
6e2be4ac62e353344ad14e4af235567599560a89.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

aef5f2ff5c4048daf95535c12a95bfef89d33ec8.description_zh: 通过 FlightQueue MCP 比较出发或转机机场，包括安检排队等因素，帮助选择出发机场或中转枢纽。
aef5f2ff5c4048daf95535c12a95bfef89d33ec8.source: Choose which airport to fly from with the FlightQueue MCP server. Use when the user asks "should I fly from JFK or Newark", "which London airport has the shortest security queue", "compare LAX and SFO", or which hub to connect through.
aef5f2ff5c4048daf95535c12a95bfef89d33ec8.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

838069ad75ab084eac037d98bd52b0bd4ff42633.description_zh: 通过 FlightQueue MCP 阅读旅客提交的机场等待报告，并在用户位于机场时提交其实际体验，用于核对安检排队情况。
838069ad75ab084eac037d98bd52b0bd4ff42633.source: Read traveller-submitted airport wait reports, and submit one when the user is at the airport, with the FlightQueue MCP server. Use when the user asks "what are people reporting at security", "is the queue really that long", or says "I just got through security in 20 minutes".
838069ad75ab084eac037d98bd52b0bd4ff42633.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5e8dd95540ac53e91f7c19f313c8575ff9708f7d.description_zh: 通过 FlightQueue MCP 查询欧盟 EES 边检队列和申根90/180天停留额度，用于了解入境等待、剩余停留天数和行程是否超期。
5e8dd95540ac53e91f7c19f313c8575ff9708f7d.source: Check EU Entry/Exit System (EES) border queues and the Schengen 90/180-day allowance with the FlightQueue MCP server. Use when the user asks "how long is passport control at Lisbon", "what is the EES queue", "how many Schengen days do I have left", or "will this trip overstay".
5e8dd95540ac53e91f7c19f313c8575ff9708f7d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a41ff1c8cb6a38a4bf1bcc53e56b18cb786a6d29.description_zh: 通过 FlightQueue MCP 规划航班当天安排，包括何时出发或到机场、当天延误、航站楼与休息室选择。
a41ff1c8cb6a38a4bf1bcc53e56b18cb786a6d29.source: Plan the day of a flight with the FlightQueue MCP server. Use when the user asks "when should I leave for the airport", "what time should I get to JFK", "is my airport delayed today", or which terminal or lounge to use.

73bae6bfc5255e691ecb8ea6509a9619494306b7.source: Connects the Form.io MCP server (`@formio/mcp`) to whatever coding agent is running, so the Form.io skills have tools to call. Use when a Form.io skill''s preflight finds the MCP tools missing, when Form.io tool calls fail because no Form.io tools are available, or when the user asks to install, connect, configure, or fix the Form.io MCP server. Also use when the user has installed the Form.io skills on their own but nothing has wired the server yet. Writes the MCP configuration for the client it is running in — Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, or Codex — behind an approval gate, falling back to all four when the host cannot be established, then asks the server which Form.io project this directory resolves to and captures only whichever URL it reports missing, so the first tool call works, and tells the user how to reload. Not for: authenticating to Form.io (see `formio-auth`); building anything with Form.io — return to the skill that sent you here once the server is connected.
73bae6bfc5255e691ecb8ea6509a9619494306b7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3908d7e10af04cfc756504031c97920aa019cfd2.description_zh: 在明确 React 请求时，用 Vite、React Router 数据路由和 @formio/react 构建新 Form.io 应用、为已有应用增加资源 CRUD 或嵌入表单；未指定框架、纯建模、Angular 和 API 查询使用其他技能。
3908d7e10af04cfc756504031c97920aa019cfd2.source: React framework implementor for the Form.io skill library — a router over three branches: build a greenfield React application around a Form.io project, add Form.io resource CRUD to a React application that already exists, or embed a single form. Targets Vite, React Router data routers, and `@formio/react`. Claims ONLY React-explicit triggers. Use when the user says "build it in React", "React front-end for this Form.io project", "use React", "use `@formio/react`", "the React skill", "add Form.io CRUD to my React app", "wire this Form.io project into my existing React app", or "embed a Form.io form in React". Not for: framework-agnostic app requests (see `formio-application`); planning a data model (see `formio-resource-planner`); framework-agnostic embed/render-a-form requests (see `formio-form`); Angular work (see `formio-angular`); REST endpoint lookups (see `formio-api`).
3908d7e10af04cfc756504031c97920aa019cfd2.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

643f45d049a2306b36929fe1525dc0c2a31d02de.description_zh: 使用 @formio/react 的 Form 组件嵌入表单，处理挂载、事件、实时实例、生命周期、provider、匿名/认证提交以及 Vite/Next.js 要求；字段逻辑、新表单、CRUD 和 SDK 参考交由专用技能。
643f45d049a2306b36929fe1525dc0c2a31d02de.source: Embed a Form.io form in a React application with `@formio/react`''s `Form` component — mounting, the event surface, the live instance, the lifecycle traps, provider configuration, anonymous versus authenticated submission, and the Vite and Next.js requirements. Reached by handoff from `formio-react`''s embed branch. Use when the user says "embed a Form.io form in React", "render a form in my React app", "use `@formio/react`''s `Form` component", or "add a Form.io form to this React page". Not for: framework-agnostic embedding and every field-behaviour question — conditionals, calculated values, validation, cascading selects (see `formio-form`); resource CRUD screens (see `formio-react-resources`); creating a form that does not exist yet (see `formio-form-builder`); the raw SDK reference (see `formio-sdk`).
643f45d049a2306b36929fe1525dc0c2a31d02de.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

adc0ecab638175a1dff05766ea8966d8d10a9221.description_zh: 在已有 React 应用中生成 Form.io 资源 CRUD 页面，组合资源内核、React Router 数据路由和父子层级资源，支持新增或重建路由及双向关联；首次创建或缺少 FormioProvider 的项目交由 React 主技能。
adc0ecab638175a1dff05766ea8966d8d10a9221.source: Nested React sub-skill that generates Form.io resource CRUD screens into a React application — the resource kernel, route composition, and hierarchical parent/child resources through React Router data routers. Reached by handoff from `formio-react` (itself possibly from `formio-application`), or by phrasing that names React or `@formio/react` verbatim. Use when the user says "add a React route for X", "regenerate the React `Participant` resource", "in my React app, wire `X`''s children to `Y`", or "add a bidirectional React join between `Team` and `User`". Not for: initial React app creation or a workspace with no `FormioProvider` — see `formio-react`; extension requests that never name React — see `formio-application`; shaping a data model — see `formio-resource-planner`; embedding one form — see `formio-form`; REST endpoint lookups — see `formio-api`.
adc0ecab638175a1dff05766ea8966d8d10a9221.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6335ed50a00f9d0bd144aa33ff366a6993335ad6.description_zh: 通过访谈规划 Form.io 资源、字段、关系、认证与访问模型，先形成供批准的可读 Resource Map，再生成含角色、资源、表单和动作的可导入 template.json；用于独立数据模型设计，应用创建、单表单和高级认证交由其他技能。
6335ed50a00f9d0bd144aa33ff366a6993335ad6.source: Plan the Resource structure, field configurations, and access/permission model for a Form.io application, then emit a ready-to-import project `template.json` (Phase A: a human-readable Resource Map for approval; Phase B: the full template with roles, resources, forms, and actions). Interview-driven — infers resources and asks about relationships, auth, and access before committing. Use when the user asks to design, architect, model, or plan the resources, schema, data model, or access model — "design the resources for...", "plan the schema for...", "model <domain> in Form.io". Not for: building or standing up the app itself — "build me a task manager / CRM" (see `formio-application`, which invokes this planner internally as its planning step); standalone single-form creation — one survey, contact form, or questionnaire with no data model (see `formio-form-builder`); SSO, Token Swap, Custom JWT, 2FA, or RBAC tuning beyond default roles (see `formio-auth`); endpoint lookups (see `formio-api`).
6335ed50a00f9d0bd144aa33ff366a6993335ad6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

aa36512e5ef8a0f5336f0a935b7d3481ba73f5e6.description_zh: 参考 Form.io 项目、表单/资源和提交的 JSON 文档结构，编写编辑或解释组件、向导、条件、验证、data、行级 access、草稿、metadata、集成、认证提供方、阶段、租户及导入导出模板；不替代 REST、服务端动作或新应用规划。
aa36512e5ef8a0f5336f0a935b7d3481ba73f5e6.source: Form.io JSON schema reference covering the document shapes for projects, forms (and resources), and submissions. Use whenever constructing, editing, or interpreting Form.io JSON — form definitions returned by `form_get` / `form_create` / `form_update`; submission bodies (decoding `data`, row-level `access`, draft state, `metadata`); and project documents (settings, integrations, auth providers (OAuth/LDAP/SAML), stages, tenants, and template envelopes for `project_import` / `project_export`). Trigger for schema-level questions about form components, wizards, resources, submissions, project templates, conditional logic, validation rules, or any component `type` (textfield, select, datagrid, panel) when the work involves Form.io JSON. Not for: calling Form.io REST endpoints (see `formio-api`); configuring server-side actions on a form (see `formio-actions`); planning a new app''s resource model from scratch (see `formio-resource-planner`); orchestrating an entire app build (see `formio-application`).
aa36512e5ef8a0f5336f0a935b7d3481ba73f5e6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e06b0c82b83ebadab5feb01777e563217e8a758a.description_zh: 提供基于源码的 @formio/js、@formio/js/utils 与 @formio/core 参考，覆盖 Formio 静态方法、实例表单/提交/文件方法、createForm、插件生命周期、Evaluator、树遍历、条件、JSONLogic、掩码清洗和 JWT 解码；作为原始 API 参考，完整应用与嵌入流程交由专用技能。
e06b0c82b83ebadab5feb01777e563217e8a758a.source: Source-derived reference for the Form.io JavaScript SDK (`@formio/js`), the Utilities (`@formio/js/utils`), and the `@formio/core`-only helpers — authored from the Form.io source code. Covers static methods (`setBaseUrl`, `setProjectUrl`, `setToken`, `currentUser`, `logout`), instance methods on `new Formio(url)` (forms, submissions, files), the VanillaJS rendering entry point (`Formio.createForm`), the plugin lifecycle, and the `Utils` surface (Evaluator, traversal, conditions, JSONLogic, mask/sanitize). Use when the user asks to call a `Formio.*` static method, work with a `new Formio(...)` instance, invoke a `Utils.*` helper, evaluate JSONLogic, register a plugin, traverse component trees, or decode the JWT. Not for: REST endpoint shapes (see formio-api); orchestrating an app build (see formio-application); planning Resource schemas (see formio-resource-planner); `@formio/angular` wrappers (see formio-angular); embed/render-a-form tasks (see formio-form — this stays the raw API reference).
e06b0c82b83ebadab5feb01777e563217e8a758a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

cee32517d1c5a1c1898d6bf561495f3ef4f17885.source: Check how hiring software (an ATS parser) reads a resume with the FoundRole MCP app, and report what the parser extracted and what it lost. Use when the user is handing off a project (trigger phrases include "generate a handoff", "hand off this project", "create a handoff doc", "I'm going on PTO / leaving / changing teams and need to document", "help someone take over") rather than a quick status read (use project-awareness for that).
611eb8367e5f9914820b8e8a24e92be313120f1b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

64456bc20838d30afef8d0829d6d42d7cd9dc8d5.description_zh: 搜索 Glean 企业知识，返回带新鲜度和权威性提示的已核查结果；涉及多工具综合的广泛问题使用 using-glean。
64456bc20838d30afef8d0829d6d42d7cd9dc8d5.source: Search Glean enterprise knowledge - use for find the doc about, search for, where is, look up, search company knowledge, search Glean for; returns vetted results with freshness and authority indicators. For broader enterprise queries needing synthesis across multiple tools, prefer the using-glean skill instead.
64456bc20838d30afef8d0829d6d42d7cd9dc8d5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ec559721bd18b50fa4597eb3f8539199afdbf83b.description_zh: 跨内部仓库寻找相似实现和代码模式先例，用于确认已有方案或获取参考实现。
ec559721bd18b50fa4597eb3f8539199afdbf83b.source: Find similar implementations and prior art for a code pattern across internal repositories — use when checking whether something already exists internally before building it, or looking for reference implementations to follow.
ec559721bd18b50fa4597eb3f8539199afdbf83b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3df9338de700e3cf7f609401a087fa7fd9e3e64a.description_zh: 指导编写新代理技能，判断创建价值、解释 SKILL.md 与渐进披露、识别常见错误，从工作模式发现机会或由描述生成技能；不用于调用已有技能。
3df9338de700e3cf7f609401a087fa7fd9e3e64a.source: Guide the user through authoring a new agent skill — when a skill is worth creating, the SKILL.md format, progressive disclosure, and common pitfalls. Also covers discovering skill opportunities from the user's work patterns and generating a SKILL.md from a description. Trigger phrases include "create a skill", "write a skill", "make a skill", "new skill", "SKILL.md format", "how do skills work", "skill best practices", "convert this workflow into a skill", "what should I automate", and "find skill opportunities". Don't use it for invoking existing skills — only when authoring a new one or understanding the skill format.
3df9338de700e3cf7f609401a087fa7fd9e3e64a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

45f5e838f6bcd6802cbf5e6551e891934ec11e6d.description_zh: 识别变更或项目需要批准、咨询和知会的人，分析受影响者并形成 RACI，适用于重构、迁移和决策。
45f5e838f6bcd6802cbf5e6551e891934ec11e6d.source: Identify people who need to approve, consult on, or be informed about a change or project — use when someone asks who needs to know about a change, who should be looped in, who needs to approve, who should be consulted, who is affected, or needs a RACI for a change, refactor, migration, or decision.
45f5e838f6bcd6802cbf5e6551e891934ec11e6d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f58d91a61ed3b8901779e81968d9b8a13b8a85f2.description_zh: 跨组织仓库检索分析内部源码，查找系统实现、仓库、作者、相似模式和 API 示例；当前本地代码优先本地检索，设计文档和无代码背景人员查询使用其他 Glean 参考。
f58d91a61ed3b8901779e81968d9b8a13b8a85f2.source: Search and analyze internal source code across the organization's repositories — use when asked how something is implemented, where the code for a system lives, who has been working on a codebase, or to find similar patterns across teams. Trigger phrases include how is X implemented, where is the code for, find the implementation of, what repos contain, who wrote the code for, how do other teams handle, find similar code to, examples of using, prior art for. Do not use for code in the current working directory (prefer local Grep/Glob), for design docs (use the using-glean skill's search reference), or for finding people without code context (use the using-glean skill's employee-search reference).
f58d91a61ed3b8901779e81968d9b8a13b8a85f2.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

09751da6a4ad8abfe6d20cf87593d34f650abf95.description_zh: 通过 Glean 汇总用户自己的工作活动、成果、优先事项、阻塞与近期背景，用于周总结、状态更新、1:1 和晨报；不用于他人活动或非用户主体项目状态。
09751da6a4ad8abfe6d20cf87593d34f650abf95.source: Synthesize the user's own work activity, priorities, and recent context using Glean — use when the user asks about their recent work, what they accomplished, what is urgent, what needs their attention, or wants help with status updates, 1:1 prep, or weekly summaries. Trigger phrases include what have I been working on, what did I do last week, what should I focus on, summarize my week, help me with my status update, what's blocking me, morning briefing, what happened while I was out. Do not use for general enterprise queries (use the using-glean skill), for someone else's activity, or for project-status questions where the user is not the subject (use a project-awareness skill).
09751da6a4ad8abfe6d20cf87593d34f650abf95.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

2259b7da1b06fbd7e736a7d9074d29ba8ea3f18e.description_zh: 使用 Glean MCP 查询企业文档、Wiki、政策、RFC、人员团队、会议决策、行动项、邮件日历、内部源码及个人工作活动；适用于答案在企业系统中的问题，本地代码、公共网页或一般编程知识使用其他来源。
2259b7da1b06fbd7e736a7d9074d29ba8ea3f18e.source: Use Glean MCP tools to answer questions about company documents, internal wikis, policies, RFCs, design docs, people, teams, meetings, decisions, action items, email, calendar events, internal code, and the user's own work activity. Reach for this whenever the answer lives in enterprise systems rather than the local codebase or public web. Trigger phrases include "find the doc about", "what's our policy on", "where is the spec for", "who works on", "who owns", "find someone who knows", "what was decided in the meeting", "action items from", "search my email", "what did I work on last week", and "find the implementation in our repos". Don't use it for questions answerable from the local working directory, the public web, or generic programming knowledge.
2259b7da1b06fbd7e736a7d9074d29ba8ea3f18e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e9c707082ac78a3cfeabe2f67326fde4a8893b77.description_zh: 将 RFC 或设计文档与实际实现比较，核验规格完成情况、漂移、缺失部分和未记录变更。
e9c707082ac78a3cfeabe2f67326fde4a8893b77.source: Verify an RFC or design doc against the actual implementation — find drift, missing pieces, and undocumented changes. Trigger phrases include "verify the RFC", "compare design doc to implementation", "is the spec implemented", "does the code match the design", "what's drifted from the RFC", "audit the doc against", "spec compliance check", "is what we built what we designed".
e9c707082ac78a3cfeabe2f67326fde4a8893b77.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

dfb4de6f7805f279e4577c765de571d4bda6a5b0.description_zh: 检索公开 Glean 开发文档，回答 API、SDK、MCP、认证、索引及集成细节，适用于构建 Glean 集成，不用于内部企业知识。
dfb4de6f7805f279e4577c765de571d4bda6a5b0.source: Search the public Glean developer documentation for API, SDK, MCP, authentication, indexing, and integration details. Use when the user is building with Glean rather than searching internal company knowledge — trigger phrases include Glean API, Glean SDK, integrate with Glean, indexing API, Glean Python or JavaScript SDK, and how to authenticate with Glean. Don't use it for internal company knowledge, which the using-glean skill covers.
dfb4de6f7805f279e4577c765de571d4bda6a5b0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

06e971c0c90de1d27d1e096d3dca36bc1c35e514.description_zh: 开展结构化企业 KYB 或尽职调查，确认实体并汇总官方注册、董事、股东、集团结构和财务信息。
06e971c0c90de1d27d1e096d3dca36bc1c35e514.source: Runs a structured KYB / due-diligence review of a company — resolves the entity, then pulls official-registry details, directors, shareholders, corporate group structure and financials into one report. Use when the user asks to run due diligence, a KYB check, a compliance review, or to "check out" / "vet" a company.
06e971c0c90de1d27d1e096d3dca36bc1c35e514.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1f5f416c4d7408b0ba01f2b15993be59a3ade377.description_zh: 为单个企业生成简短档案，包含身份、规模、财务要点和数字足迹，适用于名称、官网或 LinkedIn URL 查询，不制作完整 KYB 档案。
1f5f416c4d7408b0ba01f2b15993be59a3ade377.source: Produces a short profile of one company — identity, size, financial headline and digital footprint — without the full KYB dossier. Use when the user asks "what is this company", "tell me about", "look up" or "profile" a company, or pastes a company website or LinkedIn URL and asks who they are.
1f5f416c4d7408b0ba01f2b15993be59a3ade377.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

30cf9c4e3f7342d23c093be067f8806b7d42f37f.description_zh: 按国家、行业、规模和收入等企业特征筛选目标账户名单，并可查找补全各公司联系人，用于企业潜客与账户获取。
30cf9c4e3f7342d23c093be067f8806b7d42f37f.source: Builds a target account list from firmographic filters — country, industry, size, revenue — then optionally finds and enriches contacts at each company. Use when the user asks to find, search or build a list of companies matching criteria, to source leads or accounts, or to get contacts at a set of companies.
30cf9c4e3f7342d23c093be067f8806b7d42f37f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1a7a634716d292f1831288fa1f34467d6c11f2fd.description_zh: 读取采购送货单或供应商发票的照片、扫描或 PDF，通过已连接的 Glop MCP 匹配供应商和商品，展示 POS 计算预览，经用户明确确认后登记；需订购相应扩展，不用于客户销售送货单或供应商采购订单。
1a7a634716d292f1831288fa1f34467d6c11f2fd.source: Usa esta skill SIEMPRE que el usuario adjunte una foto, escaneo o PDF de un albarán de compra o de una factura de proveedor y quiera registrarlo en Glop: "registra este albarán", "mete esta factura de compra", "lee este albarán del proveedor", o simplemente adjunte la imagen y pida procesarla. Lee el documento, resuelve proveedor y artículos con las tools del MCP de Glop, enseña la previsualización que calcula el TPV y, tras confirmación explícita del usuario, registra el documento. Requiere el MCP de Glop conectado y el complemento contratado. No sirve para albaranes de venta a clientes ni para pedidos a proveedor.
1a7a634716d292f1831288fa1f34467d6c11f2fd.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

58d42c49633fe22f3459dda3139f1fb9109b6ba3.description_zh: 分析 Glop 供应商采购支出、供应商分布、常购商品、采购价变化及采购占销售额比例，查询已登记采购文档与库存；选用相应采购或库存工具并说明数据限制，不登记送货单。
58d42c49633fe22f3459dda3139f1fb9109b6ba3.source: Usa esta skill cuando el usuario pregunte por sus compras a proveedores en Glop: cuánto ha gastado y en qué proveedores, qué productos compra más, cómo ha evolucionado el precio de compra de un artículo ("¿me han subido la Coca-Cola?"), o qué proporción de lo que factura se le va en compras. También para buscar documentos de compra ya registrados y consultar existencias. Elige la tool glop_compras_* o de stock adecuada y traslada siempre las limitaciones de los datos. No registra albaranes: para eso está alta-albaran-compra.
58d42c49633fe22f3459dda3139f1fb9109b6ba3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8a0d57e02555a31e077dcd1099d8514c047d08f5.description_zh: 分析 Glop 销售额、收款、商品数量、热销品、现金与卡、时段/班次、同比及其他期间比较、门店/终端/员工/品类/星期细分、客单价、就餐人数、取消和赠送；明确期间并使用 POS 实数，不编造外推，不用于采购库存。
8a0d57e02555a31e077dcd1099d8514c047d08f5.source: Usa esta skill cuando el usuario pregunte por las ventas de su negocio en Glop: cuánto ha facturado o cuánto hizo de caja (hoy, ayer, el mes), cuántas unidades ha vendido de un artículo ("¿cuántas croquetas vendimos ayer?"), los productos más vendidos, efectivo contra tarjeta, ventas por franja horaria o por turno, comparar con el año pasado u otro periodo, ventas por local, terminal, empleado, familia o día de la semana, medias, ticket medio y comensales, anulaciones e invitaciones, o el último ticket. Elige la tool glop_ventas_* adecuada, fija bien el periodo y presenta las cifras del TPV sin inventar ni extrapolar. No sirve para compras ni stock.
8a0d57e02555a31e077dcd1099d8514c047d08f5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

2cc188cb72b776171e154a2d94940b03ad7ed3a0.description_zh: 汇总 Glop 单日或周末经营结果，一次列明含税/不含税金额、现金与卡、票据数量与客单价、热销品、取消赠送及上周同星期比较；不等同现金盘点，无法看到钱箱实际现金，长期间分析交由销售技能。
2cc188cb72b776171e154a2d94940b03ad7ed3a0.source: Usa esta skill cuando el usuario quiera el resumen de un día de su negocio en Glop: "¿cómo ha ido hoy?", "hazme el cierre de ayer", "¿qué caja hicimos el sábado?", "resumen del día con efectivo y tarjeta", "¿cómo va el día?" a mitad de servicio. Da de una vez el total con y sin IVA, efectivo contra tarjeta, tickets y ticket medio, los productos más vendidos, las anulaciones e invitaciones y la comparación con el mismo día de la semana anterior, todo con las tools glop_ventas_*. Sirve para un día o para un fin de semana; para periodos más largos o preguntas sueltas está analisis-ventas. No es un arqueo de caja: no ve el efectivo del cajón.
2cc188cb72b776171e154a2d94940b03ad7ed3a0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

366499cf133c2111328acd0cd030e0b2e7c1d610.description_zh: 使用 Glop 采购数据生成面向会计顾问的 PDF，包括摘要、供应商支出税基与 IVA、主要商品及数据限制，并准备邮件；有邮件工具也需确认后发送，不替代供应商发票或登记账。
366499cf133c2111328acd0cd030e0b2e7c1d610.source: Usa esta skill cuando el usuario quiera preparar un informe de sus compras a proveedores en Glop para enviárselo a su asesor, gestor o contable: "prepárame el informe de compras del mes para mi asesor", "necesito mandar a la gestoría lo que he comprado este trimestre", "haz un PDF con las compras para el contable". Reúne las cifras con las tools glop_compras_*, compone un informe en PDF pensado para quien lleva la contabilidad (resumen, gasto por proveedor con base e IVA, artículos principales y limitaciones de los datos) y prepara el correo de envío. Si el asistente dispone de una herramienta de correo, ofrece enviarlo desde ahí tras confirmación; si no, entrega el PDF y el texto del correo listos para pegar. No sustituye a las facturas de proveedor ni a los libros registro.
366499cf133c2111328acd0cd030e0b2e7c1d610.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

49dd8ad317526b508602eca429eec62b53ad445d.description_zh: 使用 Glop 会计销售报告汇总按日/序列的简化发票、逐张客户发票、更正发票和 IVA 税率拆分，按用户选择生成 PDF、CSV 或两者并备邮件；发送需确认，不替代登记账或 Glop 会计导出。
49dd8ad317526b508602eca429eec62b53ad445d.source: Usa esta skill cuando el usuario quiera preparar las ventas de su negocio en Glop para su gestor, asesor o contable: "prepárame las ventas del mes para el gestor", "necesito el IVA desglosado del trimestre para la gestoría", "haz un PDF con las ventas de agosto para el contable", "pásame las ventas del trimestre en CSV para la gestoría", "¿dónde saco los números del mes para mi asesor?". Reúne el informe con glop_informe_ventas_gestor (simplificadas por día y serie, facturas una a una con los datos del cliente, rectificativas y desglose por tipo de IVA), pregunta al usuario si lo quiere en PDF (para leer), en CSV (para importar en una hoja de cálculo o en el programa del gestor) o en los dos, lo genera y prepara el correo de envío. Si el asistente dispone de una herramienta de correo, ofrece enviarlo tras confirmación; si no, entrega los ficheros y el texto del correo listos para pegar. No sustituye a los libros registro ni a la exportación contable de Glop.
49dd8ad317526b508602eca429eec62b53ad445d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d89009b76452421a0902f9941830f7095a2f3a1a.description_zh: 根据 Glop 热销和品类数据审视菜单或商品组合，识别明星和低销量品、比较两期增长下降及调价前后情况，始终区分数据与意见；不计算单菜利润率。
d89009b76452421a0902f9941830f7095a2f3a1a.source: Usa esta skill cuando el usuario quiera revisar su carta o su surtido con los datos de venta de Glop: "¿qué platos tiran y cuáles sobran?", "¿qué debería quitar de la carta?", "¿cómo se ha vendido cada producto este año contra el pasado?", "¿cómo me ha afectado subir el precio del menú?", "¿qué hamburguesa se vende más?", "ranking de la familia postres". Monta un análisis guiado con glop_ventas_get_top_products y glop_ventas_get_sales_by_category: productos estrella, productos que casi no salen, qué sube y qué baja entre dos periodos y el antes y el después de un cambio de precio. Separa siempre el dato de la opinión. Para una pregunta suelta sobre un producto está analisis-ventas. No calcula márgenes por plato.
d89009b76452421a0902f9941830f7095a2f3a1a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1d32468b3a8d8abb89f3fd20c06bec9e5c592d32.description_zh: 提供 glyph Go 终端界面框架的惯用模式，用于编写、调试或扩展导入 github.com/kungfusheep/glyph 的应用，以及 Go TUI 构建。
1d32468b3a8d8abb89f3fd20c06bec9e5c592d32.source: Idiomatic patterns for the glyph Go TUI framework. Use when the user is writing, debugging, or extending a glyph application, when code imports github.com/kungfusheep/glyph, or when asked to build a terminal UI in Go.
1d32468b3a8d8abb89f3fd20c06bec9e5c592d32.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

bdea3f80435a9d75f413fcfb32c5dcd22cfb10cb.description_zh: 作为 Go2Rev 第四步选择需求生成引擎并转为渠道组合，用于设计 GTM 需求计划和决定渠道投入。
bdea3f80435a9d75f413fcfb32c5dcd22cfb10cb.source: This skill should be used when the user asks to "design my demand plan", "how do we generate demand", "which channels should we invest in", "build our demand engines", "/gtm-planner:demand-plan", or needs the demand generation layer of a go-to-market plan. Fourth step of the Go2Rev methodology — selects demand engines and translates them into a channel mix.
bdea3f80435a9d75f413fcfb32c5dcd22cfb10cb.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

2bf90e7a2dc122d0f1934b6ab5dd4f8ed07c5f4f.description_zh: 作为 Go2Rev 第一步整理企业背景并生成 Business Snapshot，作为后续 GTM 规划基础。
2bf90e7a2dc122d0f1934b6ab5dd4f8ed07c5f4f.source: This skill should be used when the user wants to start a go-to-market plan, says "start my GTM plan", "build a business snapshot", "run intake", "/gtm-planner:intake", or describes their company and asks where to begin. First step of the Go2Rev methodology — produces the Business Snapshot that every later step builds on.
2bf90e7a2dc122d0f1934b6ab5dd4f8ed07c5f4f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

40089c095da81a9d33455f682481e652890e25fe.description_zh: 作为 Go2Rev 第二步分析市场、竞争者与品类，找定位空白，为后续定位决策提供市场依据。
40089c095da81a9d33455f682481e652890e25fe.source: This skill should be used when the user asks to "map my market", "analyze my competitors", "who do we really compete with", "find positioning gaps", "/gtm-planner:market-map", or needs competitive and category intelligence for a go-to-market plan. Second step of the Go2Rev methodology — reads the market so positioning can be decided against it.
40089c095da81a9d33455f682481e652890e25fe.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d6a5bbbf54a4206d01fb2f714dbaaee2e365768e.description_zh: 作为 Go2Rev 第三步决定品类、核心承诺、支柱和消息架构，形成 GTM 战略定位。

56b03caea320244aaee0d19b013ff1cb5da622c0.description_zh: 为产品、公司或项目构思适合品牌的名称，同时通过 Instant MCP 检查对应域名的索引注册状态，让名称建议附有查询结果。
56b03caea320244aaee0d19b013ff1cb5da622c0.source: Brainstorm brandable names for a product, company, or project and check each one's indexed domain registration status in the same pass. Use when the user asks for name ideas, business names, startup names, app names, or "what should I call this", and a domain is part of what makes a name usable. Pairs generated ideas with the instant MCP tools so suggestions include checked registration status rather than guesses about availability.
56b03caea320244aaee0d19b013ff1cb5da622c0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

25759a01d043867df24c964880b810297e99a02d.description_zh: 通过 Instant MCP 查询域名是否已注册、检查多种后缀并寻找替代名称，支持项目命名时同步查域名，以及搜索 USPTO 商标记录与申请详情。
25759a01d043867df24c964880b810297e99a02d.source: Check whether domain names are registered and find alternatives using the Instant MCP server. Use whenever the user asks if a domain is available, taken, or free; wants to check a name across extensions (.com, .io, .ai, .dev, and hundreds more); needs alternatives because a name is taken; or is picking a domain for a project, product, startup, or side project. Also use when naming a new app or repository and the user wants domain registration status checked alongside name ideas. Also use when the user asks to search USPTO trademark records or inspect a filing.
25759a01d043867df24c964880b810297e99a02d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

53277604776e66e4a0102ea880541ad2d153228f.description_zh: 仅在用户明确要求时，针对 Claude Code 指令或上下文的单个改动，用相同提示分别重复运行HEAD与HEAD加未提交差异，生成HTML并排比较报告，验证规则或引用文档是否影响行为；不用于应用代码或已由自动测试覆盖的检查。
53277604776e66e4a0102ea880541ad2d153228f.source: Check whether one change to Claude Code's instructions or context (CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules, referenced docs, skills) actually changes behavior. Runs the same prompts against HEAD and HEAD + the uncommitted diff, N times each, and builds an HTML report for a person to compare the runs side by side. Use it to test adding, deleting, rewording, or moving a rule, or to check whether an @import or a referenced doc is loaded and followed. Not for checking application code or anything automated tests already cover. Only run it when the user explicitly asks for it; never start an experiment on your own.
53277604776e66e4a0102ea880541ad2d153228f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

35e52ecff1b0f72da77a38f54215f6df53d6d725.description_zh: 只读比较 Intelligo 背调报告的变化与重合，支持同档案同等级跨时间刷新、同档案不同报告等级，以及多个档案或整项目之间的对比，不回写系统。
35e52ecff1b0f72da77a38f54215f6df53d6d725.source: Compare Intelligo background-check reports and report what changed or what overlaps. Use this skill whenever the user wants to compare, diff, or cross-reference Intelligo reports or profiles — including "what changed since the last report", "refresh comparison", "compare this profile''s new and old report", "what''s common between these two profiles", "do these subjects share anything", or comparing every profile in an Intelligo project against each other. Trigger on phrases like "compare reports", "what''s new in this refresh", "diff these profiles", "shared connections between profiles", "what did the upgrade add", "compare the two report levels", and on any request that names two or more Intelligo profiles/reports and asks how they relate. Three modes: REFRESH (same profile over time, same level), LEVEL CHANGE (same profile, two different report levels — upgrade or interim), and CROSS-PROFILE (two or more distinct profiles, including a whole project). Read-only — never writes back to Intelligo.
35e52ecff1b0f72da77a38f54215f6df53d6d725.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

9ddf1e3a622ae6edbd0c43ee618cea957b5935f9.description_zh: 引导选择 Intelligo 报告或项目的 PDF 导出范围与内容，再调用 exportPdf，支持单份报告、整项目及全部档案下载。
9ddf1e3a622ae6edbd0c43ee618cea957b5935f9.source: Guided PDF export from Intelligo — walks the user through scope and content options before calling exportPdf.  Trigger whenever the user wants to download, export, or get a PDF of a report or project in Intelligo,  or says things like "download this report", "export to PDF", "get me the PDF for this project",  "download all profiles", "export the report for [name]", or anything implying they want a PDF out of Intelligo. Always use this skill instead of calling exportPdf directly — it ensures the right scope and options are chosen first.
9ddf1e3a622ae6edbd0c43ee618cea957b5935f9.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

4d18ee11ce7e3bcc3bf178183092508cbeef0962.description_zh: 按定义、司法辖区与发布机构背景、模式评估及互联网研究四层解释 Intelligo 个人或公司报告中的诉讼、留置权、破产、制裁、观察名单、PEP和执法发现；不自动触发，并区分报告数据与网络资料。
4d18ee11ce7e3bcc3bf178183092508cbeef0962.source: Explains legal and regulatory findings from Intelligo reports — individuals and companies. Four layers: definition, jurisdiction/issuing body context, pattern assessment, internet research. Trigger on: "explain this finding", "what does this mean", "is this serious", "is this common in [country]", "what does the internet say", "is this a red flag", "explain this lawsuit", "what is a lien", "what is a bankruptcy filing", "explain this sanction", "what does this watchlist mean", "is this PEP significant", "what does SECO mean", "what is OFAC", "what does CAATSA listing mean", "what is OFSI", "explain this enforcement action", "what does sanctions list mean", "I want to know more on the regulatory findings", "how significant is this watchlist hit", "what does this designation mean". Do NOT auto-trigger. Do NOT mix Intelligo data with internet data.
4d18ee11ce7e3bcc3bf178183092508cbeef0962.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

44b096da7a2f5e56b9405b15d862e40f81553893.description_zh: 先简短确认投委会风格与需求，再将 Intelligo 背调发现整理为叙事摘要、幻灯片片段、PDF或PPTX，支持单一对象、整交易项目或整体概览加重点对象的混合范围。
44b096da7a2f5e56b9405b15d862e40f81553893.source: Convert Intelligo background-check findings into Investment Committee (IC) ready materials — narrative summaries, slide-ready snippets, polished PDFs, or PPTX decks. Works at any scope — single subject report, full deal/project rollup, or hybrid (project overview with one subject in depth). Use whenever an analyst asks to "prepare for IC", "summarize the deal for committee", "roll up findings for project X", "build IC slides", "make an IC summary", "format Intelligo findings", "create a project one-pager", "write the IC memo section", or wants to share Intelligo output with partners, board, GC, or risk committee. Different funds have very different IC styles, so this skill always conducts a short intake before generating output. Trigger generously — analysts often describe the destination (their IC, their deal, their project) rather than naming the format.
44b096da7a2f5e56b9405b15d862e40f81553893.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

0e318d7a3a38e325a84441b732a04258509830a8.description_zh: 总结 Intelligo 单个人或公司的背景、信用及社交媒体分析，提供执行摘要、风险标记数量、标记与发现或分标签页视图；项目转交项目摘要，不用于网络研究、监控或行动项。
0e318d7a3a38e325a84441b732a04258509830a8.source: High-level factual summary of one Intelligo profile — background check, credit check, and social media analysis, with executive summary, red/yellow flags, and key findings. Summarizes one profile (person or company), not a project; if the query is ambiguous it searches profiles and projects, and hands a project off to the project-summary skill. Use whenever the user wants a summary, recap, key takeaways, risk read, red flags, or major risks on a person or company in due diligence — even without saying "Intelligo." Offers four selectable views (executive summary, flag count, flags + findings, per-tab breakdown) and asks which when unspecified. Triggers: "summarize X", "red flags on X", "what did we find on X", "how many flags on X", "exec summary on X", "break X down by tab". Do NOT use for web research, monitoring, action items, or project-level summaries.
0e318d7a3a38e325a84441b732a04258509830a8.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b4dfdb8df0754cc79775ab867a11ecc60d5c4a0a.description_zh: 汇总 Intelligo 投资或交易项目全部档案，生成项目执行摘要与各对象简短风险及红黄标记，可单独输出对象清单、概览或对象风险；单档案交由档案摘要，不用于比较、网络研究或监控。
b4dfdb8df0754cc79775ab867a11ecc60d5c4a0a.source: Deal/project-level summary across every profile in an Intelligo project — a synthesized project executive summary plus a short risk summary per subject (mini exec summary + red/yellow flags). Summarizes a whole investment (a project with multiple profiles), not a single subject; if the query is ambiguous it searches projects and profiles and hands a single profile off to the profile-summary skill. Can return the whole summary or just one part on request — the subject roster, the project overview, or the per-subject risk summaries. Triggers: "summarize the X project/investment/deal", "roll up X", "risk across the X deal", "red flags across X", "what did we find on the X investment", "what should I know about the X deal", "who''s in the X deal", "list the subjects/companies in X", "the gist of the X deal", "break the X deal down by subject". Do NOT use for a single person/company (that''s profile-summary), web research, monitoring, action items, or comparisons.
b4dfdb8df0754cc79775ab867a11ecc60d5c4a0a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

9386f9f6e76d4a35829f815ea907eabdbb97ddde.description_zh: 在客户自有 Intelligo 多份背调报告中分析红黄信息标记的时间趋势、主题、突增风险及跨档案关键词，依据实际发现内容推导类别，输出聊天摘要、表、图表或仪表盘。
9386f9f6e76d4a35829f815ea907eabdbb97ddde.source: Search and surface RISK TRENDS across an Intelligo client''s own background-check reports — patterns across many reports, not one. Use when the user wants: flags trending over time by level (Red/Yellow/Info); flags broken down by theme or finding; newly emerging or spiking risks vs a prior period; comparisons across reports, subjects, or products; or a CROSS-PROFILE search for any entity/keyword (e.g. "which profiles mention China"). Flag categories are NOT a stored field — derive meaning from each flag''s finding content, not its config name. Trigger on "risk trends", "flag trends", "what risks are increasing", "break our flags down", "which reports mention X", "search across profiles for…", even when Intelligo isn''t named. Pulls flags and finding content via capabilities, not fixed tool names (see below); returns a chat summary + table, charts, or a dashboard.
9386f9f6e76d4a35829f815ea907eabdbb97ddde.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

0b64b8d34acfb4856ec4410404d9983d5e8edd6e.description_zh: 规划建立新的 Intelligo 尽调项目，确定调查范围及应纳入实体，客户端组织来自已认证会话；不用于项目后跟踪、库查询或一般尽调问题。
0b64b8d34acfb4856ec4410404d9983d5e8edd6e.source: This skill should be used when the user wants to start, scope, or set up a new Intelligo due-diligence project. Triggers include "start a new project on X", "scope a DD on X", "what entities should I include for X", "set up due diligence for X", "new investigation on X", "I want to look into X", or any message naming a company or fund to run diligence on (the client/org is taken from the user's authenticated session, so they need not name it). Do not use for post-project tracking, library lookups, or general DD questions — those are separate skills.
0b64b8d34acfb4856ec4410404d9983d5e8edd6e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

10fb882ca60fe35acad172e32681bdadff9613ba.description_zh: 结合 Intercom 对话历史、账号背景和互动时间线建立完整客户画像，支持邮箱、公司或客户名称的360度背景查询。
10fb882ca60fe35acad172e32681bdadff9613ba.source: Build a comprehensive customer profile from Intercom data, including conversation history, account context, and interaction timeline. Use when the user asks to "look up a customer", "customer profile", "customer 360", "tell me about this customer", "summarize a customer's history", or provides a customer email or company name and wants a full picture.
10fb882ca60fe35acad172e32681bdadff9613ba.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

52dd9541d48f23e1b9035e594b99cc85e4c9b3ac.description_zh: 安装并认证 @intercom/cli，让人工或AI代理通过命令行管理 Intercom 工作区。
52dd9541d48f23e1b9035e594b99cc85e4c9b3ac.source: Install and authenticate the Intercom CLI (`@intercom/cli`) — a command-line tool for managing Intercom workspaces, designed for both human operators and AI agents. Use when the user asks to "install the Intercom CLI", "set up the intercom command", "install @intercom/cli", or wants shell access to their Intercom workspace.
52dd9541d48f23e1b9035e594b99cc85e4c9b3ac.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f5ce4b2305a20e9af00c56625219f1fdbe149207.description_zh: 在网站或网页应用接入带JWT身份验证的 Intercom Messenger，生成 React、Next.js、Vue、Angular、Ember或普通JS前端，以及Node.js、Python、PHP或Ruby后端代码。
f5ce4b2305a20e9af00c56625219f1fdbe149207.source: Install the Intercom Messenger on a website or web application with secure JWT-based identity verification. Generates backend and frontend code for React, Next.js, Vue.js, Angular, Ember, and plain JavaScript. Supports Node.js, Python (Flask/Django), PHP, and Ruby backends. Use when the user asks to "install Intercom", "add the Intercom Messenger", "set up Intercom chat widget", "add customer chat to my website", or "integrate Intercom".
f5ce4b2305a20e9af00c56625219f1fdbe149207.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

03e85d16539d4e62e263a45bd5faa0f2ae1d2fae.description_zh: 分析 Intercom 对话以发现支持模式、调查客户问题，并查询联系人与公司资料。
03e85d16539d4e62e263a45bd5faa0f2ae1d2fae.source: Analyze Intercom conversations to identify support patterns, investigate customer issues, and look up contacts and companies. Use when the user asks to "analyze conversations", "find support patterns", "search Intercom", "look up a customer", "investigate a customer issue", "check contact info", or asks questions about their Intercom data.
03e85d16539d4e62e263a45bd5faa0f2ae1d2fae.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a93ad4f4c9b9cd4501f27a276c555be34a00e17a.description_zh: 探查 InternetData 数据库的字段、行粒度和样例，在 Claude Code 中下载副本后做计数查询，分析供应商分布、网络覆盖及地址或地址段是否存在。
a93ad4f4c9b9cd4501f27a276c555be34a00e17a.source: Explore what is inside an InternetData database and analyze it - its columns and what a row means, a first look from its sample rows, and in Claude Code, counts and lookups over a downloaded copy. Use when someone asks what a database contains, wants example rows, or wants numbers from the data such as counts by provider, how much of a network is covered, or whether an address or range is in it.
a93ad4f4c9b9cd4501f27a276c555be34a00e17a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e0334520bd8bb090626f4803604819640df5b3c9.description_zh: 查看组织获许可的 InternetData IP数据库清单、内容、规模、构建日期、CSV/MMDB格式、校验和、授权状态及下载历史，验证副本完整性并排查下载失败。
e0334520bd8bb090626f4803604819640df5b3c9.source: Look into the InternetData IP databases an organization is licensed for - what exists, what is inside one, how big it is, whether a downloaded copy is intact, and why a download failed. Use when someone asks about the downloadable databases, their columns, sample rows, sizes, build dates, formats (CSV or MMDB), checksums, license standing or download history.
e0334520bd8bb090626f4803604819640df5b3c9.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

9ffc48e0f574a4dd9a634bee13bb86247394c880.description_zh: 只读结合 QuickBooks 薪资运行、员工、工资单、付款与公司数据分析薪资费用变化、最高薪人员和成本驱动，考察加班、人数、税费、福利、补贴奖金等因素，并提出成本控制思路，不编造薪资事实。
9ffc48e0f574a4dd9a634bee13bb86247394c880.source: Analyze QuickBooks Payroll cost, payroll spend changes, top-paid employees, pay item drivers, and practical payroll cost-control ideas using connected payroll run, employee, payslip, paycheck, and company context data. Use when the user asks why payroll expense increased or decreased, who was paid the most, what drove payroll spend, how to reduce payroll spend, how current payroll compares with a prior period, or whether overtime, headcount, pay rates, employer taxes such as SUI, benefits, employer contributions, reimbursements, bonuses, commissions, allowances, or pay-item mix affected payroll cost. Read only; use available payroll tools and do not invent payroll facts.
9ffc48e0f574a4dd9a634bee13bb86247394c880.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

261edecf88c9d439d483ded4bb8caabd5c0a7b61.description_zh: 综合 QuickBooks 多份报告生成经营健康简报，将损益、现金流、资产负债、应收账龄及销售表现整合为一个对话视图，识别当月异常与需关注事项。
261edecf88c9d439d483ded4bb8caabd5c0a7b61.source: synthesize a QuickBooks business health briefing from multiple Intuit QuickBooks app reports. Use when the user asks broad questions such as "how's my business doing?", "give me the big picture", "what should I be worried about?", "summarize my financials", "anything unusual this month?", or wants one conversational view of profit and loss, cash flow, balance sheet, receivables aging, and sales performance without opening separate reports.
261edecf88c9d439d483ded4bb8caabd5c0a7b61.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ec48cb5693cf5432511afb6e7a68492bd793fd52.description_zh: 查看 QuickBooks 逾期或未付发票并发送匹配账龄的付款提醒，在发送前确认内容和语气，适用于欠款查询及催收跟进。
ec48cb5693cf5432511afb6e7a68492bd793fd52.source: Send payment reminders for invoices with tone matched to aging. ALWAYS use this skill when the user asks to "send a reminder", "send reminder to invoice", "remind about invoice", "send a reminder to invoice 1234", "remind them about 4574", "send a firmer reminder for invoice 1042", "who owes me money", "show me overdue invoices", "chase down overdue invoices", "follow up on unpaid invoices", or "nudge customers who haven't paid". This skill MUST be loaded before calling qbo_sales_send_invoice_reminder to ensure confirmation and tone-matching.
ec48cb5693cf5432511afb6e7a68492bd793fd52.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e6d9438888a758fd2f2527e55d2226cb4437f310.description_zh: 把客户邮件线程中的报价与工作内容转为可发送的 QuickBooks 估价单或发票，减少销售单据逐项重复录入。
e6d9438888a758fd2f2527e55d2226cb4437f310.source: Turn a customer email thread into a ready-to-send QuickBooks estimate or invoice. Use when the user asks to "create an invoice from my email thread", "draft an estimate based on what I quoted this customer over email", "bill this customer for the work we discussed and send it to them", "turn this email into an invoice", "make an estimate from this thread", or wants to go from an email conversation to a QuickBooks sales document without re-keying line items.
e6d9438888a758fd2f2527e55d2226cb4437f310.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

176a6f6b532684ddfa25b617e76a8f5b4a028ba4.description_zh: 仅使用已连接 QuickBooks 公司的财务数据与同行对标，评估利润率及费用水平；不用于一般行业研究、某地盈利行业、业务类型预期利润或用户自行提供数字的场景。
176a6f6b532684ddfa25b617e76a8f5b4a028ba4.source: benchmark the user's CONNECTED QuickBooks company against industry peers using their QuickBooks financial data. Use only when the numbers come from the user's connected QuickBooks account — "how does my business compare to similar businesses", "are my margins healthy", "am I spending too much", "benchmark my QuickBooks company". Do NOT use for industry research, for questions about which industries are most profitable in a location, for expected profit for a business type, or when the user supplies their own figures — those are answered by the Intuit QuickBooks benchmarking tools directly.
176a6f6b532684ddfa25b617e76a8f5b4a028ba4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5ca7b002bdad02b4bff1936679db80f25023144e.description_zh: 只读解释比较 QuickBooks Capital 定期贷款、信用额度、WebBank发行的商业信用卡和贷款市场，估算还款利息并查询本人余额APR计划及可用额度；不执行支付提款或变更，不作报价审批，也不覆盖申请状态或其他融资产品。
5ca7b002bdad02b4bff1936679db80f25023144e.source: QuickBooks Capital small-business financing: QuickBooks Term Loan, Line of Credit, Intuit Business Credit Card (issued by WebBank), and the QuickBooks Business Loan Marketplace. Use to explain how these products work (eligibility, rates, fees, terms), compare or choose between them, estimate loan payments (weekly/monthly payment, total interest, total repayment), and answer questions about the signed-in user''s own QuickBooks Capital loans and lines of credit (balance, APR, repayment schedule, payoff, available credit), plus what similar businesses have borrowed. Use proactively when a funding need surfaces from payroll, cash-flow, or invoicing work to check for a drawable line of credit and, with consent, peer offers. Read-only guidance only: never makes payments, draws, or loan changes, and never gives a loan offer, rate, credit limit, or approval decision. Not for loan application status or non-QuickBooks-Capital products (SBA, invoice factoring, merchant cash advances, consumer loans).
5ca7b002bdad02b4bff1936679db80f25023144e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

c4ed5ddaac74efe92a1c0164c6ac833569cef3f4.description_zh: 依据用户资料、录用通知或员工名单把新员工加入 QuickBooks Payroll，创建前去重、分配现有工作地点并设初始合同薪资，写入前确认并报告剩余配置；不用于既有员工调薪、发薪、税务、直存、福利或合规建议。

For actually building IAG5 services, use /iag.

6db0df8fdc0bb23af33363fba94b12dec9aafd19.source: Use this skill when a build is complete and needs to be verified before customer sign-off. On any test failure, it reports the failure with evidence and hands back to /builder-agent for a fix; it never edits workflows itself. Invoke after /builder-agent completes a build. This is the last technical stage before customer delivery.

8528b2cedab549e2b1f4e6aadd49a5d51998e701.source: Use this skill when someone has approved requirements (a customer-spec.md) and needs to assess platform feasibility or produce a solution design. Hands off to /builder-agent after design approval.

Use it whenever someone is at the beginning of building something new and hasn't yet defined what they're building. For ad-hoc platform exploration, use /explore instead. Hands off to /solution-arch-agent after approval.

b850b61547fabe5e74b21ea283529fe1b5ff17bd.source: Structured workflow for analyzing a Jam bug report end-to-end — pulls diagnostics from the Jam MCP server (console, network, user events, screenshots, video frames, transcript) and produces a root-cause hypothesis.
