e2d0b390087f22994db8d67fb9cded9518f6fcee.description_zh: 按阶段、诉讼地位和风险汇总刑事案件组合，依据原说明提醒侦查与追诉时效、上诉期限、临时羁押、72小时拘留、辩护文书及庭审排期。
e2d0b390087f22994db8d67fb9cded9518f6fcee.source: Rollup de la cartera de asuntos penales. Distribucion por fase, posicion y riesgo; alertas de plazo de instruccion del art. 324 LECrim, prescripcion, plazos de recurso, prision provisional, detenido en 72 h, escrito de defensa y juicios señalados. Usar con donde estoy, estado cartera o cuantos asuntos abiertos.
e2d0b390087f22994db8d67fb9cded9518f6fcee.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

83be92f3e859536afda6b98de67443d98d2fdb0c.description_zh: 为刑事审判准备被告、证人、专家及受害人询问提纲，依据原说明保留被告沉默权和非证人身份，并以卷宗页码关联先前证言，组织证人及专家质疑。
83be92f3e859536afda6b98de67443d98d2fdb0c.source: Preparacion del interrogatorio en el juicio oral penal. El acusado NO es testigo — tiene derecho a guardar silencio y no hay ficta confessio (arts. 24.2 CE, 118 y 520.2 LECrim). Interrogatorio del acusado o su silencio estrategico, contradiccion de testigos con la declaracion sumarial (art. 714 LECrim) anclada al folio, contradiccion del perito, y victima como testigo con su estatuto (Ley 4/2015). Usar con preparar interrogatorio, guion para el juicio oral penal.
83be92f3e859536afda6b98de67443d98d2fdb0c.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

99761b950148b524775983b39aab9fa8f0e6cfc3.description_zh: 分析侵犯基本权利取得的证据和程序无效，准备简易刑事程序预备庭审意见，覆盖非法搜查、通信与手机监控、定位、卧底、保管链、无律师陈述及超期调查。
99761b950148b524775983b39aab9fa8f0e6cfc3.source: Analiza y ataca la prueba obtenida con vulneración de derechos fundamentales (art. 11.1 LOPJ) y la nulidad de actuaciones (arts. 238 y 240 LOPJ), y prepara la alegación para la AUDIENCIA PRELIMINAR del art. 785 LECrim. Actívala ante "prueba ilícita", "nulidad de la prueba", "nulidad de actuaciones", "el registro fue ilegal", "entraron sin orden", "entrada y registro nula", "pinchazo telefónico", "intervención de comunicaciones sin motivación", "me miraron el móvil", "registro del móvil", "geolocalización", "agente encubierto", "cadena de custodia rota", "declaró sin abogado", "sin información de derechos", "efecto reflejo", "conexión de antijuridicidad", "frutos del árbol envenenado", "diligencias fuera de plazo del 324", "cuestiones previas".
99761b950148b524775983b39aab9fa8f0e6cfc3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

dc534cbdaee319a9dc52df1acdbd639af4de0310.description_zh: 目录型技能，未含模板；起草启动刑事案件的正式控告，依据原说明处理公众控诉、特别授权、保证金、受理与不受理上诉；案件已存在且受害人只需参加时转用私人控方加入技能。
dc534cbdaee319a9dc52df1acdbd639af4de0310.source: Catálogo (sin plantilla). Redacta querellas conforme a los arts. 270-281 LECrim ante la Sección de Instrucción del Tribunal de Instancia. Actívala ante "presentar querella", "querella criminal", "interponer querella", "querellarse contra", "acusación popular", "ejercer la acción popular", "poder especial para querellarse", "fianza del querellante", "diferencia entre querella y denuncia", "me han admitido/inadmitido la querella", "recurso contra la inadmisión de la querella". Requisito previo: la causa penal NO está iniciada y hay que incoarla con este escrito. Si ya existe un procedimiento en marcha (denuncia, atestado o querella de otro) y la víctima solo quiere mostrarse parte en él, usar /personacion-acusacion-particular-catalogo.
dc534cbdaee319a9dc52df1acdbd639af4de0310.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

c0fe564c17fd9da47953502683d2b46cfdff0fa9.description_zh: 目录型技能，未含模板；起草针对初审法院刑事部门或省级法院一审刑事判决的上诉，涵盖证据评价错误、刑法适用、审判无效及附带加入上诉。
c0fe564c17fd9da47953502683d2b46cfdff0fa9.source: Catálogo (sin plantilla). Redacta recurso de apelación penal contra sentencia de la Sección de lo Penal del Tribunal de Instancia (antes Juzgado de lo Penal) o de la Audiencia Provincial en primera instancia. Actívala ante "recurrir la sentencia penal", "recurso de apelación contra sentencia condenatoria/absolutoria", "sentencia del juzgado de lo penal", "error en la valoración de la prueba", "infracción de precepto penal", "apelar ante la Audiencia Provincial", "nulidad del juicio", o "adherirse a la apelación".
c0fe564c17fd9da47953502683d2b46cfdff0fa9.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

111ca96afdef5392e5652aef5a276b2453178396.description_zh: 目录型技能，未含模板；准备并向西班牙最高法院第二庭提出刑事上诉，先依据原说明按被挑战裁判类型确定可受理理由，包括法律违反与程序瑕疵。
111ca96afdef5392e5652aef5a276b2453178396.source: Catálogo (sin plantilla). Prepara e interpone recurso de casación penal ante la Sala Segunda del Tribunal Supremo, determinando primero qué motivos son admisibles según la resolución recurrida (art. 847 LECrim). Actívala ante "recurso de casación penal", "casación por infracción de ley art. 849", "quebrantamiento de forma art. 850/851", "preparar casación", "casación contra sentencia de apelación de la Audiencia Provincial", "recurrir ante el Tribunal Supremo en lo penal", o "¿cabe casación contra esta sentencia?".
111ca96afdef5392e5652aef5a276b2453178396.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ac807e3301e18762b73985ccc3eb03685e6cff9d.description_zh: 依据原说明分析开启刑事审判裁定的可上诉范围，并起草可行请求或分流；通常仅人身状态部分可上诉，实体指控应通过辩护书反驳，亦涵盖亲属间免责事由。
ac807e3301e18762b73985ccc3eb03685e6cff9d.source: Analiza la recurribilidad del auto de apertura de juicio oral (art. 783.3 LECrim — IRRECURRIBLE salvo en lo relativo a la situación personal del acusado) y redacta el recurso procedente o redirige a la vía útil. Cubre la excusa absolutoria del art. 268 CP entre parientes. Actívala ante "recurrir la situación personal acordada en el auto de apertura", "¿es recurrible el auto de apertura de juicio oral?", "solicitar sobreseimiento pese a la apertura", "excusa absolutoria entre parientes", "art. 268 CP", "acusación infundada". Aviso: en la inmensa mayoría de los casos el auto NO es recurrible, de modo que si lo que se quiere es combatir la acusación de fondo, el cauce correcto es el escrito de defensa → /escrito-defensa-calificacion.
ac807e3301e18762b73985ccc3eb03685e6cff9d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

fe04e839e069ab22f6bab7ae401613d428a0185d.description_zh: 为私人控方或受害人起草针对侦查阶段已作出、已通知的终止和归档裁定的复议及备位上诉；尚未作出裁定时使用事前反对终止的意见技能。
fe04e839e069ab22f6bab7ae401613d428a0185d.source: Redacta recurso de reforma y subsidiario de apelación contra el auto de sobreseimiento y archivo YA DICTADO en instrucción, para la acusación particular o el perjudicado. Actívala ante "recurrir el archivo de la causa", "recurso contra el auto de sobreseimiento ya notificado", "reforma y subsidiaria apelación", "han archivado mis diligencias", "auto de sobreseimiento inmotivado", "quiero reabrir la causa", "el juez ha archivado sin practicar mis diligencias" o cuando la acusación quiera revocar un archivo ya acordado. Requisito previo: existe auto de archivo notificado y corre el plazo de recurso. Si todavía no hay auto y solo se ha dado traslado a la acusación para alegar sobre el archivo propuesto, lo que procede es oponerse antes → /alegaciones-oposicion-sobreseimiento.
fe04e839e069ab22f6bab7ae401613d428a0185d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a7afacdba0852c376910a7d54603a68e94268474.description_zh: 起草刑事文书指定章节，包括法院抬头、LECrim第650条编号结论中的事实、定性、参与、修正情节、刑罚与民事责任，以及程序背景、上诉理由、请求和附加申请，并定位卷宗页码。
a7afacdba0852c376910a7d54603a68e94268474.source: Redactar una seccion concreta de un escrito penal — encabezamiento a la Seccion de Instruccion del Tribunal de Instancia, Audiencia Provincial o Sala Segunda del TS; conclusiones numeradas del escrito de calificacion (art. 650 LECrim: hechos, calificacion, participacion, circunstancias modificativas, pena y responsabilidad civil); antecedentes procesales, motivos de recurso, suplico y otrosies. Anclaje al folio de las actuaciones. Usar con redacta las conclusiones, saca el suplico penal, redacta el motivo del recurso.
a7afacdba0852c376910a7d54603a68e94268474.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

da48884e7011c6d1464460da4ec5adb4aec81f06.description_zh: 分流刑事裁判和传票，识别客户是被调查人还是证人，依据原说明确定期限和动作，覆盖拘留、立案、转简易程序、辩护、开启审判、预备庭审、判决及执行。
da48884e7011c6d1464460da4ec5adb4aec81f06.source: Triage de resoluciones y citaciones penales. Identifica si el cliente es investigado o testigo, que plazo arranca y que hay que hacer. Cubre citacion como investigado art 118 LECrim, citacion de testigo, detencion, auto de incoacion, transformacion en abreviado, traslado para escrito de defensa, apertura de juicio oral, audiencia preliminar art 785, notificacion de sentencia y ejecutoria. Usar con hemos recibido una citacion, nos citan del juzgado, han detenido a un cliente o requerimiento judicial.
da48884e7011c6d1464460da4ec5adb4aec81f06.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d8ec95c1dc404a860ad0e38945d6d4ba01e4efde.description_zh: 为受刑事调查或指控的法人准备辩护，覆盖与自然人的利益冲突、合规预防模型、减轻事由、法人刑罚、特别指定代表及内部调查。
d8ec95c1dc404a860ad0e38945d6d4ba01e4efde.source: Defensa de personas juridicas investigadas o acusadas penalmente (art. 31 bis CP). Conflicto de interes con la persona fisica, modelo de compliance como eje de defensa, atenuantes del 31 quater, penas del 33.7, representante especialmente designado e investigaciones internas. Usar con "responsabilidad penal de la empresa", "compliance", "modelo de prevencion", "han imputado a la sociedad", "31 bis", "canal de denuncias", "compliance officer", "defender a la empresa y al administrador", "penas para la persona juridica", "representante especialmente designado".
d8ec95c1dc404a860ad0e38945d6d4ba01e4efde.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e0d066ca474397f6bca548900e24b945b8270f90.description_zh: 初步分类刑事案件通信和文件的律师职业保密属性，依据原说明处理律师客户通信、拘留者保密会见、第三方数据与犯罪记录。
e0d066ca474397f6bca548900e24b945b8270f90.source: Primera pasada de clasificacion de comunicaciones y documentos bajo el secreto profesional del abogado (art. 542.3 LOPJ), con las especialidades del penal: confidencialidad abogado-cliente de los arts. 118.4 y 520.7 LECrim, entrevista reservada con el detenido del art. 520.6.d, datos de terceros y antecedentes penales (art. 10 RGPD). Usar con revisar secreto profesional o clasificar comunicaciones.
e0d066ca474397f6bca548900e24b945b8270f90.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a35ced61178ef2fe22b1cfae8af1de7687c65d15.description_zh: 目录型技能，未含模板；起草侦查调查措施申请，涵盖银行或运营商调取、证人、对质、专家鉴定、补充调查、搜查、通信监控及拒绝调查上诉，并依据原说明检查侦查期限和延长。
a35ced61178ef2fe22b1cfae8af1de7687c65d15.source: Catálogo (sin plantilla). Redacta escritos solicitando la práctica de diligencias de investigación en instrucción. Actívala ante "pedir diligencias", "solicitar diligencias de investigación", "solicitar prueba en instrucción", "oficio a entidad bancaria", "oficio a la operadora", "declaración testifical", "careo", "pericial en instrucción", "solicitar diligencias complementarias", "entrada y registro", "intervención de comunicaciones", "pinchar el teléfono", "me han denegado las diligencias", "recurso contra la denegación de diligencias", "plazo de instrucción", "prórroga de la instrucción", "art. 324", o cuando una parte quiera impulsar o completar la investigación.
a35ced61178ef2fe22b1cfae8af1de7687c65d15.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d0147b3780c2447ab2f6e9ed1f275422d8db0cc4.description_zh: 将犯罪构成、判例与事实相连接，依据原说明检查行为发生时刑法、后续较有利法律、罪刑法定、不利类推禁止、疑罪从无及无罪推定；判例须经jurisprudenciator MCP获取。
d0147b3780c2447ab2f6e9ed1f275422d8db0cc4.source: Silogismo de subsuncion sobre el tipo penal. Impone identificar la redaccion del CP vigente a la fecha de los hechos (art. 2 CP) y comprobar si la posterior es mas favorable (art. 2.2 CP) — con la LO 1/2025 y la LO 1/2026 esto ya no es teorico. Principio de legalidad y prohibicion de analogia in malam partem (art. 4.1 CP). In dubio pro reo y presuncion de inocencia (art. 24.2 CE). Jurisprudencia SIEMPRE con el conector MCP jurisprudenciator. Usar con subsumir, pulir escrito penal, conectar jurisprudencia con los hechos.
d0147b3780c2447ab2f6e9ed1f275422d8db0cc4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8c8c80a30d3bfd9e8ff9466db6885169eb375552.description_zh: 依据原说明为控辩双方指导陪审团刑事程序，覆盖管辖、侦查、LOTJ第30条预备庭审、可审事实、裁决问题、异议、表决、退回裁决书与高级法院上诉；与简易程序预备庭审区分。
8c8c80a30d3bfd9e8ff9466db6885169eb375552.source: Guia practica del procedimiento ante el Tribunal del Jurado (LO 5/1995) para la defensa y la acusacion. Competencia del art. 1, instruccion propia, audiencia preliminar del art. 30, auto de hechos justiciables, objeto del veredicto y protesta, mayorias, devolucion del acta y apelacion ante el TSJ. Usar con "tribunal del jurado", "objeto del veredicto", "jurado popular", "me toca un jurado", "audiencia preliminar del jurado (art. 30 LOTJ)", "hechos justiciables", "veredicto", "recusacion de jurados", "apelacion del jurado", "LOTJ". Requisito previo: el delito es de los del art. 1 LOTJ y el procedimiento se sigue por los tramites del jurado. Ojo: su audiencia preliminar es la del art. 30 LOTJ y NO tiene nada que ver con la audiencia preliminar del art. 785 LECrim del procedimiento abreviado → /audiencia-preliminar-abreviado.
8c8c80a30d3bfd9e8ff9466db6885169eb375552.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

57b541db98131a3f1e0351cdb352ea0aa463ef72.description_zh: 依据原说明处理性别、家庭及儿童暴力的专门保护程序，覆盖女性暴力部门管辖、紧急保护令、人身与民事措施、违反限制及免作证规则，支持控辩双方；无该关系背景时使用一般刑事临时措施技能。
57b541db98131a3f1e0351cdb352ea0aa463ef72.source: Violencia de género y doméstica — competencia de las Secciones de Violencia sobre la Mujer (art. 89 LOPJ y art. 14.5 LECrim; el 87 ter LOPJ está SUPRIMIDO), orden de protección del art. 544 ter (audiencia urgente, 72 horas, estatuto integral, medidas civiles 30+30), medidas cautelares del art. 544 bis reescrito por la LO 1/2026, quebrantamiento del art. 468 CP y dispensa del art. 416 LECrim. Sirve a la defensa y a la acusación. Actívala ante "orden de protección", "alejamiento", "violencia de género", "violencia doméstica", "juzgado de violencia sobre la mujer", "quebrantamiento", "544 ter", "544 bis", "dispensa de declarar", "LO 1/2004", "pulsera telemática", "violencia contra la infancia". Es el régimen ESPECIALIZADO: úsala siempre que la relación entre las partes sea de pareja o expareja, familiar o de violencia contra la infancia. Si no concurre ese contexto, la prohibición de aproximación genérica del art. 544 bis y las demás cautelares se tramitan con /medidas-cautelares-penales-catalogo.
57b541db98131a3f1e0351cdb352ea0aa463ef72.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1850d83bab3f106adcef5cd1655feede7056c20b.description_zh: 按律所文风及案件论证路线起草法律书状指定章节，逐项引用事实、核查判例，并将论点关联整体案件主张。
1850d83bab3f106adcef5cd1655feede7056c20b.source: Draft a brief section in house style, consistent with the case theory — every fact cited, every case checked, every argument tied to the theory. Use when the user says "draft the [section]", "write the statement of facts", "argument section on [issue]", or needs a first draft of a brief section.
1850d83bab3f106adcef5cd1655feede7056c20b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

72cbe7f9268e927a32fbc68cad968853871c7bf0.description_zh: 从指定文档和上传材料构建或更新案件时间线，提取带日期事件、去重并按案件主张标记重要性，支持工作、事实陈述及特定证人时间线。
72cbe7f9268e927a32fbc68cad968853871c7bf0.source: Build or update a chronology from declared document sources and uploads — dated events extracted, de-duped, and tagged by significance per the matter theory. Use when the user asks to build a chronology or timeline from a production or matter file, says "chron from the production" or "what happened when", or needs a working, statement-of-facts, or witness-specific timeline.
72cbe7f9268e927a32fbc68cad968853871c7bf0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5cf4e48ef380c0fb271c8f919cff90918df31e80.description_zh: 制作或审查专利侵权、无效或其他民事诉因和抗辩的要素表，每个单元格提供精确引文，重点识别逐项证明缺口。
5cf4e48ef380c0fb271c8f919cff90918df31e80.source: Build or review an element chart — a patent claim chart (infringement, invalidity, or review) or a civil element chart for any cause of action or defense — with every cell pin-cited and gap detection as the priority output. Use when the user asks for a claim chart, element chart, proof chart, infringement or invalidity contention, element-by-element mapping, or asks "what are we missing to prove [claim]".
5cf4e48ef380c0fb271c8f919cff90918df31e80.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3e28e45eebf47645eafe5c6413fad98efbf28d4a.description_zh: 初次设置诉讼插件档案，按公司法务、律所律师或独立执业及原被告立场分支采集风险、业务环境和文风，写入CLAUDE.md并检查可用集成。
3e28e45eebf47645eafe5c6413fad98efbf28d4a.source: House cold-start for the litigation plugin — branches by role (in-house, firm associate, solo) and side (plaintiff, defense, both), captures risk calibration, landscape, and house style, and writes the practice profile CLAUDE.md. Use on a fresh install, when the user wants to set up or redo the practice profile, or to re-check available integrations.
3e28e45eebf47645eafe5c6413fad98efbf28d4a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

2a79dbbfa9889b8fb29826ad08c67c7bcc4226dd.description_zh: 逐项定制诉讼执业档案，无需重做全部初始访谈，支持角色、诉讼立场、风险尺度、业务环境、文风、升级联系人、严重程度词汇及案件工作区路径。
2a79dbbfa9889b8fb29826ad08c67c7bcc4226dd.source: Guided customization of your litigation practice profile — change one thing without re-running the whole cold-start interview. Adjust practice role, side (plaintiff / defense / mixed), risk calibration, landscape, house style, escalation contacts, severity vocabulary, or matter workspace paths. Use when the user says "change my [thing]", "update my profile", "edit my config", or "customize".
2a79dbbfa9889b8fb29826ad08c67c7bcc4226dd.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

45f0335d775df692d4936fca5c4f030aef996775.description_zh: 根据已完成的资料采集起草要求函，先检查保密特权、FRE 408、权利放弃和承认事项，输出DOCX、发送后清单及案件创建选项。
45f0335d775df692d4936fca5c4f030aef996775.source: Draft a demand letter from a completed intake, gated on a privilege / FRE 408 / waiver / admission checklist, with a .docx output, post-send checklist, and an offer to create a matter. a10f5ab4e1f6fc084a4ba8a440dcec59021712ca.source: Pre-drafting context gathering for a demand letter — parties, facts, basis, leverage, BATNA, and privilege filters — written to a structured intake.md the demand-draft skill reads. Use when the user wants to prep a demand letter, run intake before drafting, or capture context for a payment demand, breach/cure notice, cease-and-desist, employment separation, or preservation demand.
a10f5ab4e1f6fc084a4ba8a440dcec59021712ca.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ff4c41040250dd8a7197ae8998af6457d3c813a8.description_zh: 评估收到的要求函，提取字段、对照案件组合、分析依据并提出应对选项与建议，需要升级时移交案件登记或要求函资料采集技能。
ff4c41040250dd8a7197ae8998af6457d3c813a8.source: Triage an inbound demand letter — extract fields, cross-check the portfolio, assess merit, present response options with a recommendation, and hand off to matter-intake or demand-intake if escalation is warranted. Use when the user says "we got a demand letter", "triage this demand", or shares an incoming demand to evaluate.

d21af217cf59f54811a4f26a1a77e4c348f24b22.source: Extracts reusable collaboration patterns from a working session. Invoke with "arm" at the START of any session likely to involve iteration, correction, or unfamiliar ground — capture then runs as you work. Invoke with "distill" at session end to mine. Use when a session produced — or is expected to produce — surprise: corrections, rework, near-misses, an invented procedure, wasted effort. Do NOT use as a session summarizer or changelog — answer that directly, or hand it to a summarizing skill if one is installed; this extracts the way of working, never the work's content. Do NOT use to evaluate people — feedback on a person is theirs to ask for directly; this mines the collaboration only.

Also triggers on "what should I post about", "new content ideas", "my posts feel repetitive", "add a topic".
63c93f6d5e05a6b9ca0efa07a20eeec3c00d9ed0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

bdac50a23d1b6aaa31faa211bff44d4d7b68f082.description_zh: 编写适合间隔重复记忆的闪卡并保存至MasterKi，支持词汇学习及将笔记、文章或会话转成MasterKi或Anki卡片。
bdac50a23d1b6aaa31faa211bff44d4d7b68f082.source: Write good spaced-repetition flashcards and save them to the user's MasterKi app. Use when the user asks to make flashcards, memorise something, study vocabulary, or turn notes, an article or a conversation into cards for MasterKi or Anki.
bdac50a23d1b6aaa31faa211bff44d4d7b68f082.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a3e152135d2456d9e11a8675d925a57877145d7b.description_zh: 依据Masthead资产评分评审BigQuery表与BI资产监控等级，解释优先、关键或常规建议，逐资产确认后才通过MCP应用。
a3e152135d2456d9e11a8675d925a57877145d7b.source: Review monitoring tiers for BigQuery tables and BI assets against Masthead asset scores — propose PRIORITY or CRITICAL for assets that matter and REGULAR for prioritized assets that no longer do — explain each suggestion from the score metrics, and apply changes through the Masthead MCP server only on per-asset confirmation.
a3e152135d2456d9e11a8675d925a57877145d7b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d2d9b3997d138ce20f2644d866173e57bd80b949.description_zh: 识别并暂停或停用未使用、无下游用途或低效的流水线，以优化BigQuery计算成本。
d2d9b3997d138ce20f2644d866173e57bd80b949.source: Optimize BigQuery compute costs by identifying and pausing/disabling unused, dead-end, or inefficient pipelines that consume compute resources.
d2d9b3997d138ce20f2644d866173e57bd80b949.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

247e9560eadbf27c70a9dae12449de55aa57bdb3.description_zh: 依据Masthead建议将Dataform、dbt、Airflow模型或服务账号用户重新分配至槽位预留或按需计算，以不影响性能为目标优化BigQuery计算成本。
247e9560eadbf27c70a9dae12449de55aa57bdb3.source: Optimize BigQuery compute costs by reassigning data models (Dataform, dbt, Airflow) or principals (service accounts, users) to slot reservations or on-demand compute based on Masthead recommendations without impacting performance.
247e9560eadbf27c70a9dae12449de55aa57bdb3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

0da42adfc73cb872ccc590e0a0ef0b6224d0205d.description_zh: 通过Masthead MCP分流数据质量与流水线事故，分析下游影响并实施缓解。
0da42adfc73cb872ccc590e0a0ef0b6224d0205d.source: Triage, analyze downstream impact, and mitigate data quality and pipeline incidents using the Masthead MCP server.
0da42adfc73cb872ccc590e0a0ef0b6224d0205d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d9c1f77b046814933c4a1ab0a1c28788a5bbb810.description_zh: 对表、数据集、流水线和数据模型开展完整Masthead FinOps审计，与Claude Code的/savings流程相同，Codex可调用masthead-savings。
d9c1f77b046814933c4a1ab0a1c28788a5bbb810.source: Run the full Masthead FinOps audit across tables, datasets, pipelines, and data models. Same workflow as the Claude Code `/savings` command, invocable as `$masthead-savings` in Codex.
d9c1f77b046814933c4a1ab0a1c28788a5bbb810.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

32ccc2761962ed53356d177075631336ee72eb16.description_zh: 在BigQuery数据集层面切换存储计费模式并设置过期策略，以优化存储成本。
32ccc2761962ed53356d177075631336ee72eb16.source: Optimize BigQuery storage costs at the dataset level by switching storage billing models and setting expiration policies.
32ccc2761962ed53356d177075631336ee72eb16.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6088a367ecc58ad8047132dfc5d141a584eb2507.description_zh: 识别并移除无下游用途或未使用的BigQuery表，以优化存储成本。
6088a367ecc58ad8047132dfc5d141a584eb2507.source: Optimize BigQuery storage costs by identifying and removing dead-end and unused tables.
6088a367ecc58ad8047132dfc5d141a584eb2507.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

34119e384811c1b077ff752a1145850f60c93daf.description_zh: 以血缘与影响范围分析分流活跃Masthead事故，与Claude Code的/triage流程相同，Codex可调用masthead-triage。
34119e384811c1b077ff752a1145850f60c93daf.source: Triage active Masthead incidents with lineage and blast-radius analysis. Same workflow as the Claude Code `/triage` command, invocable as `$masthead-triage` in Codex.
34119e384811c1b077ff752a1145850f60c93daf.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

36524c83c41e8162c3c9fe9f7d556cce76277ae0.description_zh: 以纯推理解答IMO、Putnam、USAMO和AIME等竞赛数学问题，再由新上下文对抗验证者按具体失误模式攻击证明，报告校准信心；原说明要求无把握时明确说明，验证通过且有LaTeX时生成PDF。
36524c83c41e8162c3c9fe9f7d556cce76277ae0.source: Solve competition math problems (IMO, Putnam, USAMO, AIME) with adversarial verification that catches the errors self-verification misses. Activates when asked to 'solve this IMO problem', 'prove this olympiad inequality', 'verify this competition proof', 'find a counterexample', 'is this proof correct', or for any problem with 'IMO', 'Putnam', 'USAMO', 'olympiad', or 'competition math' in it. Uses pure reasoning (no tools) — then a fresh-context adversarial verifier attacks the proof using specific failure patterns, not generic 'check logic'. Outputs calibrated confidence — will say 'no confident solution' rather than bluff. If LaTeX is available, produces a clean PDF after verification passes.
36524c83c41e8162c3c9fe9f7d556cce76277ae0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d0baef9b129df75d5d0f4c60bbed443a4e1fb7aa.description_zh: 设计、运行或审查支持数学研究主张的符号、精确、有限域、表示论、同调或数值计算，检查正确性、来源、范围、复现及解释，保留有界实验不能证明普遍结论的限制。
d0baef9b129df75d5d0f4c60bbed443a4e1fb7aa.source: Design, run, or audit a mathematical computation that supports a research claim, including symbolic, exact, finite-field, representation-theoretic, homological, or numerical experiments. Use when correctness, provenance, tested range, reproducibility, or interpretation matters. Do not present bounded output as a universal proof.
d0baef9b129df75d5d0f4c60bbed443a4e1fb7aa.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b974be7a79c864dfba6b6726acbb50bbb0eb09d9.description_zh: 核验外部数学定理、引文、符号转换、来源依赖推论及限定范围的新颖性，优先原始来源并记录检索范围，复用获授权本地资料；不把片段或检索失败当证明。
b974be7a79c864dfba6b6726acbb50bbb0eb09d9.source: Verify an external mathematical theorem, citation, notation translation, source-dependent implication, or bounded novelty claim, reusing authorized project-local source copies when available. Use when a proof relies on a named paper/result, when exact hypotheses or versions matter, when the user asks whether a claim is known, or when an authenticated mathematical source should be cached for later checks. Prefer primary sources and record the search scope. Do not treat snippets or failed searches as proof or global novelty.
b974be7a79c864dfba6b6726acbb50bbb0eb09d9.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d1f01814f009485f1b210df9aa999e067fd2e5f2.description_zh: 仅在明确要求时，将已验证数学结果、修正、引文或审稿回复整合至权威LaTeX手稿，保留假设、证据状态、符号与依赖；不用于发明证明或常规文字校对。
d1f01814f009485f1b210df9aa999e067fd2e5f2.source: Integrate an already validated mathematical result, correction, citation, or referee response into an authoritative LaTeX manuscript while preserving hypotheses, evidence status, notation, and dependencies. Use only when the user explicitly requests manuscript integration. Do not use to invent a proof or to perform routine copyediting.
d1f01814f009485f1b210df9aa999e067fd2e5f2.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

23e31c64358e6f1eca6164bb349bff331b5e27a8.description_zh: 以默认只读方式对抗审查既有数学主张、证明、推导、图表或定理依赖，核验正确性并定位缺口及剩余推论；不用于创造新证明路线。
23e31c64358e6f1eca6164bb349bff331b5e27a8.source: Adversarially audit an existing mathematical claim, proof, derivation, diagram, or theorem dependency for correctness. Use for requests to verify, referee, stress-test, type-check, find gaps, or isolate the exact remaining implication. Default to read-only. Do not use to invent a substantially new proof route or merely copyedit prose.
23e31c64358e6f1eca6164bb349bff331b5e27a8.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

60592afdb8d254066f7e594b6da0e7db6395d9b6.description_zh: 保守校对数学文字与LaTeX语法、排版、符号一致性、交叉引用及明确局部笔误，适用于显式校对和最终自查，不实质替换或修复证明。
60592afdb8d254066f7e594b6da0e7db6395d9b6.source: Conservatively proofread mathematical prose and LaTeX for grammar, typography, syntax, notation consistency, cross-references, and uniquely forced local mathematical typos. Use for explicit math-proofreading requests and final self-review of theorem-, proof-, or equation-heavy edits. Do not invent, replace, shorten, or substantively repair proofs.
60592afdb8d254066f7e594b6da0e7db6395d9b6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5879aa27fce8acdd0dc80995b8fd791067e7407d.description_zh: 在明确研究请求下运行一次有边界、可审计的数学证明尝试、化简、反例搜索、来源推论或计算；不用于失败后持续多路线调查或常规解释。
5879aa27fce8acdd0dc80995b8fd791067e7407d.source: Run one bounded, auditable mathematical research route: a proof attempt, reduction, counterexample search, source-dependent implication, or claim-supporting computation. Use when the user explicitly asks to attack a research question or invokes this skill. Do not use for a sustained multi-route investigation that continues after failed approaches, routine editing, explanation, or an unchanged verification rerun.
5879aa27fce8acdd0dc80995b8fd791067e7407d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1771b8ef7beb29382944b9ea1f0f6968a9873707.description_zh: 在明确要求时初始化或迁移AI数学研究仓库的智能体架构、指令、状态历史和工作流，先检查并提出可评审文件计划，默认不建仓库本地技能。
1771b8ef7beb29382944b9ea1f0f6968a9873707.source: Initialize or migrate an AI-assisted mathematical research repository's agent architecture. Use only when the user explicitly asks to set up, plan a retrofit, or substantially revise AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, live research status/history, workflow files, or their authority structure, including migrating a flat research log across programs into program indexes. Inspect first, propose a reviewable file plan, and default to no repository-local skills. Do not use for an ordinary research attempt, a closeout of one named program or phase, or a read-only project retrospective.
1771b8ef7beb29382944b9ea1f0f6968a9873707.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

4881cc6fb56b540e1f876e8f785e8e88ba194a95.description_zh: 跨证明、反例、文献和计算路线持续推进大型数学研究或获授权的指定阶段收尾，协调连续尝试并保留证据；单次引理、普通解释和仓库指令迁移使用其他流程。
4881cc6fb56b540e1f876e8f785e8e88ba194a95.source: Pursue or close out a substantial mathematical research program across multiple proof, counterexample, literature, and computational routes. Use when the user asks for sustained investigation, several approaches, continuation until a goal is reached, or an authorized closeout of one named program or phase that compacts its live status and history. Coordinate successive attempts and preserve their evidence. Do not use for a single bounded lemma attempt, ordinary explanation, proofreading, a read-only project retrospective, or a repository-wide migration of instructions or a flat research log into program indexes.
4881cc6fb56b540e1f876e8f785e8e88ba194a95.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3f061894d44ccffe1b468aa8bad13b645d173a56.description_zh: 默认只读复盘数学研究仓库的当前主张、证明、计算、状态、文献依赖与失败路线，推荐下一项有界研究行动，支持周月复盘、优先级及文字交接。
3f061894d44ccffe1b468aa8bad13b645d173a56.source: Reconcile a mathematical research repository's current claims, proofs, computations, status, literature dependencies, and failed routes, then recommend the next bounded research moves. Use only when the user asks for a project review, weekly/monthly retrospective, prioritization, a prose project handoff, or “what should I do next?”. Do not use to write a program closeout, migrate research history, operate a .mathbox ledger, or generate its dependency-aware handoff. Default to read-only.
3f061894d44ccffe1b468aa8bad13b645d173a56.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

dffc8627bac09d6224f8ad3aacd0dc1b92a9d3a7.description_zh: 在本地追加式.mathbox账本记录精确数学主张、证据版本、依赖影响、审查来源、研究路线及并行延迟执行，支持陈旧证据检查、运行核对和依赖交接，不以元数据替代证明审查。
dffc8627bac09d6224f8ad3aacd0dc1b92a9d3a7.source: Track exact mathematical claims, evidence revisions, dependency impact, audit provenance, research routes, and parallel or delayed executions in a local append-only ledger. Use when a project has a .mathbox ledger or the user asks for executable research-state tracking, stale-evidence detection, run reconciliation, or a dependency-aware handoff generated from recorded events. Do not initialize state for a casual math question, replace proof auditing with metadata validation, or write a prose project retrospective from status files.
dffc8627bac09d6224f8ad3aacd0dc1b92a9d3a7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

182107f59f9550c27282e4d82b1fb75e828b51fc.description_zh: 为单个药物或研发资产制作深度情报包，覆盖开发状态、试验证据、竞争定位、催化事件和风险；只需结构化事实表时使用profile-entity。
182107f59f9550c27282e4d82b1fb75e828b51fc.source: Build a full intelligence packet on one named drug or asset: development status, trial evidence, competitive position, catalysts, and risks. Use when someone names a single asset and wants depth, for example 'tell me everything about X', 'profile this drug', 'is X differentiated'. Use profile-entity instead when only a single structured fact sheet is wanted.
182107f59f9550c27282e4d82b1fb75e828b51fc.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f272cffd39747554e6838e3c7f86bc2278703d24.description_zh: 按共同维度并列对标指定药物资产，输出明确证据强度的结构化比较；需寻找可借鉴先例时使用identify-analogs。
f272cffd39747554e6838e3c7f86bc2278703d24.source: Compare named assets side by side on a common set of dimensions and return a structured benchmark with explicit evidence strength. Use for direct comparisons, for example 'how does X compare to the other IL-23s', 'benchmark these four programs'. Use identify-analogs when precedents to reason from are wanted rather than a head-to-head table.
f272cffd39747554e6838e3c7f86bc2278703d24.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

48060d6c95115453e5159b8b8dbcdad35822ff53.description_zh: 为单家公司制作深度情报包，覆盖研发管线、近期事件、资本状况与战略立场；仅需单份事实表时使用profile-entity。
48060d6c95115453e5159b8b8dbcdad35822ff53.source: Build a full intelligence package on one company: pipeline, recent events, capital position, and strategic posture. Use when someone names a company and wants depth, for example 'profile Vertex', 'what is going on at X', 'walk me through their pipeline'. Use profile-entity instead when only a single structured fact sheet is wanted.
48060d6c95115453e5159b8b8dbcdad35822ff53.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8518a77033e765d41af97c1c07cf6a9f7d2dc43a.description_zh: 按适应症、作用机制或靶点绘制药物竞争管线，以阶段、公司或机制分组；疾病本身研究与资本流向分别使用indication-research和funding-landscape。
8518a77033e765d41af97c1c07cf6a9f7d2dc43a.source: Map who is developing what for an indication, mechanism, or target, grouped by phase, company, or mechanism. Use for competitive questions, for example 'map the NSCLC landscape', 'who else is working on TL1A', 'what is the competition for X'. This is drug-program-centric: use indication-research when the question is about the disease itself, and funding-landscape when it is about capital flow.
8518a77033e765d41af97c1c07cf6a9f7d2dc43a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

782e935eef3ba517d366c6f658a205281e4c04b6.description_zh: 追踪公司、资产、适应症或指定类型的许可、并购、研发合作及合资交易，返回带来源的结构化逐笔交易证据。
782e935eef3ba517d366c6f658a205281e4c04b6.source: Trace BD deals (licensing, M&A, R&D collaborations, joint ventures) for a company, asset, indication, or deal type, and return structured deal-level evidence with provenance. Use for transaction questions, for example 'who has licensed X', 'what deals have been done in obesity'.
782e935eef3ba517d366c6f658a205281e4c04b6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b27565f69c17be37494db32a43080cc14984e9c8.description_zh: 按标准建立药物、公司、试验、机制或靶点的限定名单，先确定集合而不逐项分析；需要竞争格局分析时使用competitive-pipeline。
b27565f69c17be37494db32a43080cc14984e9c8.source: Build the scoped list of drugs, companies, trials, mechanisms, or targets matching a set of criteria, without analyzing each one. Use when the job is to define the right set first, for example 'list every Phase 3 KRAS G12C program'. This is a building block: use competitive-pipeline when the landscape should be analyzed rather than listed.
b27565f69c17be37494db32a43080cc14984e9c8.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5f2346d951496eca2a4d7701089054baa8fc4f27.description_zh: 为药品收入或估值预测汇集患者人群、渗透率、定价、时点和竞争侵蚀等假设及各自证据，输出假设而非成品表格或叙述；仅需市场规模时用size-market。
5f2346d951496eca2a4d7701089054baa8fc4f27.source: Assemble the assumptions behind a revenue or valuation forecast: population, penetration, pricing, timing, and competitive erosion, each with its evidence. Use when someone is building a model, for example 'what assumptions should I use for X', 'help me forecast peak sales'. Returns assumptions, not a finished spreadsheet or narrative. Use size-market when only sizing is wanted.
5f2346d951496eca2a4d7701089054baa8fc4f27.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a7c1fbb1c5e957fd019cc56d4ad23336139c9b6f.description_zh: 按适应症、机制、靶点或投资者集合绘制资金流向、金额和时间变化，形成市场级资本图景；单家公司逐轮融资与药物竞争管线另用对应技能。
a7c1fbb1c5e957fd019cc56d4ad23336139c9b6f.source: Map capital flow across a space: who is funding an indication, mechanism, target, or investor set, how much, and how it has moved over time. Use for market-level money questions, for example 'who is funding TL1A', 'how much has gone into obesity'. Use trace-financings when someone wants the round-by-round record for one company, and competitive-pipeline for drug programs rather than capital.
a7c1fbb1c5e957fd019cc56d4ad23336139c9b6f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ede1caaabc27f3c830ca6ca4b3cd7dec8cfcc5ea.description_zh: 寻找可支持药品资产、公司或市场判断的历史及竞争先例，解释可比性，用于发布或定价类比；指定资产直接并列比较用benchmark-assets。
ede1caaabc27f3c830ca6ca4b3cd7dec8cfcc5ea.source: Find historical or competitive precedents that inform an asset, company, or market question, and explain why each is a fair comparison. Use for precedent reasoning, for example 'what is the closest analog to this launch', 'what should we price off'. Use benchmark-assets for a direct side-by-side comparison of named assets instead.
ede1caaabc27f3c830ca6ca4b3cd7dec8cfcc5ea.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

cd96e286945dc38143eeff6eab9cb2fa175adb57.description_zh: 以证据构建疾病概况，覆盖临床背景、流行病学、未满足需求、标准治疗和研发管线应对；竞争药物及纯市场规模另用专门技能。
cd96e286945dc38143eeff6eab9cb2fa175adb57.source: Build an evidence-backed picture of a disease: clinical context, epidemiology, unmet need, standard of care, and how the pipeline addresses it. Use for disease-first questions, for example 'tell me about ulcerative colitis', 'what is the unmet need in NASH'. Use competitive-pipeline when the question is really about competing drug programs, and size-market when only sizing is wanted.
cd96e286945dc38143eeff6eab9cb2fa175adb57.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d5c043cf1df8431816ded957332010d30b714a78.description_zh: 为单一已知药物、公司、试验、机制或靶点返回结构化证据事实表，作为工作流基础组件；完整药物与公司情报使用asset-profile或company-portfolio。
d5c043cf1df8431816ded957332010d30b714a78.source: Return one structured, evidence-backed fact sheet for a single known drug, company, trial, mechanism, or target. 2f7654ff251b3c9053d9666bac8b55959422e12a.description_zh: 按可衡量标准优化已有技能篇幅、格式、措辞及已诊断的触发不足，支持自动说明优化循环；行为变更或超篇幅重构分别用其他技能。
2f7654ff251b3c9053d9666bac8b55959422e12a.source: Raise an existing skill's quality against a measurable criterion WITHOUT changing its intended behavior. Use when the user asks to debloat, tighten, shorten, or clean up a skill, fix its formatting or wording, rewrite a description already diagnosed as under-triggering (diagnosing why belongs to review-skill), or run the automated description-optimization loop. Behavior changes belong to update-skill; skills over their size budget belong to restructure-skill.
2f7654ff251b3c9053d9666bac8b55959422e12a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

19a40ee0696bb5c06d6895b46ff2632b71afb813.description_zh: 重组技能架构，拆分、合并重叠技能或在SKILL.md、参考和脚本间移动内容，处理篇幅超限、触发碰撞及加载层次不当。
19a40ee0696bb5c06d6895b46ff2632b71afb813.source: Reorganize skill architecture — split one skill into several, merge overlapping skills, or move content between SKILL.md, references, and scripts. Use when a skill exceeds its size budgets, when skills overlap or their descriptions collide, when content sits at the wrong loading level, or when the user asks to split, merge, rename, or reorganize skills. Content edits within one healthy skill belong to update-skill or improve-skill.
19a40ee0696bb5c06d6895b46ff2632b71afb813.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d8ead54c751231db0747561e00921abbe2c811d3.description_zh: 安全删除、弃用或归档已有Claude Code子智能体；仅存在于插件缓存的随包智能体，原说明要求报告后停止。
d8ead54c751231db0747561e00921abbe2c811d3.source: Safely delete, deprecate, or archive an existing Claude Code subagent. Use when the user asks to remove, delete, retire, or uninstall an agent, says an agent is superseded or unused, or wants to clean up unused agents. Not for plugin-shipped agents living only in the plugin cache — this reports and stops for those.
d8ead54c751231db0747561e00921abbe2c811d3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

eb5a3a3c236c99c7b5d94c1e867314fa7e689c52.description_zh: 删除、弃用或归档已有智能体技能，用于被替代、过时、废弃或未使用技能清理。
eb5a3a3c236c99c7b5d94c1e867314fa7e689c52.source: Safely delete, deprecate, or archive an existing Agent Skill. Use when the user asks to remove, delete, retire, uninstall, or archive a skill, when a skill is superseded, obsolete, or abandoned, or when cleaning up unused skills.
eb5a3a3c236c99c7b5d94c1e867314fa7e689c52.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

58afd746361c865e1e01643bb12bef099d1061bc.description_zh: 只读审计已有Claude Code子智能体，诊断未被选中委派、工具列表及交付质量，不直接修改；修复交由更新或优化技能。
58afd746361c865e1e01643bb12bef099d1061bc.source: Read-only audit of an existing Claude Code subagent — never modifies it. Use when the user asks to review, check, or audit an agent, asks why an agent isn't getting picked or delegated to, wants its tool list checked, or wants a second opinion on an agent before shipping it. Not for applying fixes — route those to update-agent or improve-agent.
58afd746361c865e1e01643bb12bef099d1061bc.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

aca5dca5e66796dec06fc7d80914cf5d1f070503.description_zh: 只读审计Claude Code Hook配置和脚本，诊断未触发、未阻止调用及安全正确性，不负责编写修复。
aca5dca5e66796dec06fc7d80914cf5d1f070503.source: Read-only audit of Claude Code hook configuration and scripts — never modifies them. Use when the user asks to review or audit hooks, asks why a hook didn't fire or didn't block a tool call, or asks whether a hook is safe or correct. Not for authoring or fixing a hook.
aca5dca5e66796dec06fc7d80914cf5d1f070503.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a064dbcfba59f29ddb9f56bf697e72158256aaac.description_zh: 只读审查AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md和规则，逐项对照实际代码核验事实，发现过时错误、跨文件矛盾和冗余，修复及初始化使用对应技能。
a064dbcfba59f29ddb9f56bf697e72158256aaac.source: Read-only audit of a project's instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules) — never edits them. Use to review, check, audit, or diagnose instruction files, verify every documented claim against the actual codebase, find stale or wrong facts, spot cross-file contradictions or bloat, or get a quality report before deciding what to change. Not for applying fixes (update-instructions / improve-instructions) or first-time bootstrap (setup-instructions).
a064dbcfba59f29ddb9f56bf697e72158256aaac.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

70d612e94c89bd5117b86695bdf6b8e92415560a.description_zh: 只读评审、评分或诊断已有技能，检查未触发和行为异常，形成发布或共享前质量报告，不直接修改受审技能。
70d612e94c89bd5117b86695bdf6b8e92415560a.source: Read-only audit of an existing Agent Skill — it never modifies the skill under review. Use when the user asks to review, check, grade, audit, or diagnose a skill, asks why a skill isn't triggering or is misbehaving, wants a quality report before deciding what to do, or wants a second opinion on a skill before shipping or sharing it.
70d612e94c89bd5117b86695bdf6b8e92415560a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3e45fc11bb28e7c65be818939e932ad61af75e76.description_zh: 按用户调用，依据全部已安装技能与真实代码重新生成顶层AGENTS.md及路径规则布局，连接适用技能、移除不适用项并核验主张；用户路线图和随手笔记仅报告候选，不改写。
3e45fc11bb28e7c65be818939e932ad61af75e76.source: User-invoked pass that re-derives a project's Claude-native instruction layout — a surface AGENTS.md plus path-scoped .claude/rules/ — as a projection of the installed skill set and the actual codebase. Enumerates every available skill, maps which applies to which path (wiring unwired-but-needed ones, dropping inapplicable ones), grounds every claim against the code, discloses only non-code-recoverable info per path, and drops the inert references/ layer. Read-only toward user-owned notes (roadmaps, scratchpads) — it reports promotion candidates, never rewrites them. Invoke as /meta-dev:revise-agents-md.
3e45fc11bb28e7c65be818939e932ad61af75e76.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

843a4b1b346640e5a164b2961bbe419059b67813.description_zh: 搭建新的Claude Code插件并连接技能、智能体或Hook，使工作流可安装共享；已有插件审计使用validate-plugin。
843a4b1b346640e5a164b2961bbe419059b67813.source: Scaffold a new Claude Code plugin and wire its components. Use when the user asks to create or scaffold a plugin, package skills, agents, or hooks as a plugin, or make a workflow installable/shareable. Not for auditing an existing plugin — route that to validate-plugin.
843a4b1b346640e5a164b2961bbe419059b67813.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

9a150b1a2d13d1905bbf73b93a8169ab871900b0.description_zh: 从已安装技能与实际代码首次建立项目顶层AGENTS.md及路径规则；已有内容修改、精简或整布局重建分别使用其他技能。
9a150b1a2d13d1905bbf73b93a8169ab871900b0.source: Bootstrap a project's instruction files from scratch — a surface AGENTS.md plus path-scoped .claude/rules/ derived from the installed skills and the actual code. Use when the user asks to set up CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, bootstrap instruction files or project memory, or initialize the layout for a repo that has none. Not for editing an existing layout's content (update-instructions), tightening one already in place (improve-instructions), or re-deriving the whole layout of a repo that already has one (revise-agents-md).
9a150b1a2d13d1905bbf73b93a8169ab871900b0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6430a334d5b8197cd544e337c48cc3ffb182d3fd.description_zh: 作为全部技能工作的入口，路由创建、编辑、扩展、精简、重构、审计和移除，适用于操作不清、混合或跨多项技能的请求。
6430a334d5b8197cd544e337c48cc3ffb182d3fd.source: Entry point and router for ALL work on Agent Skills. Use whenever the user wants anything done to a skill — make, build, edit, extend, tighten, reorganize, audit, or remove one — especially when the operation is unclear, mixed, or spans several, or when the user invokes skill-creation by name.
6430a334d5b8197cd544e337c48cc3ffb182d3fd.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5c641c987d9be91f4ef5fe4bd51e98f9ecd702c9.description_zh: 按需对照当前官方Claude Code文档核查meta-dev标准与生命周期变化，并通过更新流程处理偏差。
5c641c987d9be91f4ef5fe4bd51e98f9ecd702c9.source: On-demand currency check: diffs meta-dev''s standards and lifecycles against current official Claude Code docs and routes drift through the update lifecycles.
5c641c987d9be91f4ef5fe4bd51e98f9ecd702c9.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

74bacdee7662ce0c41580dbdcd650d7fb198c687.description_zh: 按新需求修改已有智能体行为，包括提示、工具、模型和预载技能；仅质量清理、只读审计及删除分别使用其他技能。
74bacdee7662ce0c41580dbdcd650d7fb198c687.source: Change an existing agent's behavior — its prompt, tools, model, or preloaded skills — for new requirements. Use for "update/extend agent X", "give the agent tool Y", "change what the reviewer agent does". Not for quality-only cleanup with unchanged behavior (improve-agent), read-only auditing (review-agent), or deleting/deprecating an agent (retire-agent).
74bacdee7662ce0c41580dbdcd650d7fb198c687.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

78ce4fe599a06e8f17287b531c46ee5f23089f27.description_zh: 修改AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md和路径规则中的事实、技能或内容，并在作用范围扩张时拆分或重定规则；初始化、仅精简和整布局重建另行处理。
78ce4fe599a06e8f17287b531c46ee5f23089f27.source: Change a project's instruction-file content — AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and .claude/rules/ — and re-scope a rule when its area outgrows it. Use for "add/change X in AGENTS.md", "update a rule's skills or facts", "the stack table is out of date", "split the app rule". Not for quality-only cleanup with unchanged facts (improve-instructions), a fresh repo with no layout yet (setup-instructions), or a full re-derivation of the whole layout (revise-agents-md).
78ce4fe599a06e8f17287b531c46ee5f23089f27.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

23e60be77cff30ffe7c4cc89076639e7bf719a42.description_zh: 扩展或改变已有技能行为以涵盖新功能、用例或知识；行为不变的优化及跨技能文件重组分别使用其他技能。
23e60be77cff30ffe7c4cc89076639e7bf719a42.source: Extend or change an EXISTING skill's behavior to meet new requirements. Use when the user asks to add functionality, cover a new case, change what a skill does, or fold new knowledge into a skill — any behavioral edit. Not for quality-only cleanups with unchanged behavior (improve-skill) and not for reorganizing files across skills (restructure-skill).
23e60be77cff30ffe7c4cc89076639e7bf719a42.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

efe9726a213621fa2d4ce6a4f8b3a3b7fe776d47.description_zh: 只读验证审计Claude Code插件或市场，检查加载失败、清单和发布就绪状态，不修改检查对象。
efe9726a213621fa2d4ce6a4f8b3a3b7fe776d47.source: Read-only validation and audit of a Claude Code plugin or marketplace — never modifies what it inspects. Use when the user asks to validate a plugin or marketplace, wonders why a plugin won't load, wants the manifest checked, or asks if a plugin is ready to publish.
efe9726a213621fa2d4ce6a4f8b3a3b7fe776d47.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

98fea26ef9e4762c2d39e17b4f981390027796f3.description_zh: 检查订单行ATP或CTP可承诺性，以现存库存扣除占用并加在途量对照需求，查看下个可生产时段，计算最早交期；在承诺权限内确认同步报价或升级例外。
98fea26ef9e4762c2d39e17b4f981390027796f3.source: Available- / capable-to-promise (ATP / CTP) feasibility check (uc-deliver-atp-ctp) - nets available inventory (on-hand minus all claims) plus in-transit against an order line, checks the next capable build slot (CTP) in planning, computes the honest earliest date, and within promise limits confirms and syncs it to the quote or escalates the exception. Use when an inbound order or quote line needs a promise date, a configure-to-order / CTO line is short on stock, sales wants a delivery date inside a live quote, on-hand covers only part of the ask, the words ATP / available-to-promise / ATC / available-to-commit, capable-to-promise / CTP against a build slot, split-ship vs push the full date, over-promise, promise-vs-actual, or order promising against Kinaxis / o9 / IBP planning and a Manhattan OMS.
98fea26ef9e4762c2d39e17b4f981390027796f3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6f1e88b3a1b82aac292f698e14643768eee232d3.description_zh: 将单项供应商EDI 855交期延误经MRP追踪至生产工单和客户承诺，按周与客户量化影响，比较重排、加急、双来源、拆分或吸收成本供采购批准。
6f1e88b3a1b82aac292f698e14643768eee232d3.source: Take a single supplier confirmation slip (an EDI 855 order acknowledgment) on a PO, peg it forward through MRP to the affected production / work orders and customer commitments, size the downstream impact by week and by customer, and price the reschedule options (accept the slip and re-time the build, expedite or dual-source an alternate, split, escalate a pull-in, or hold and absorb) for a buyer to approve. Use when an EDI 855 or supplier-portal acknowledgment confirms a PO date later than promised (a lead-time slip), when a confirmed date lands past its committed need date, when someone asks which work orders or customer commits move, whether to dual-source or re-time or absorb, or mentions uc-resched-slip, confirmation slip, PO date change, schedule-line confirmation, MRP pegging, reschedule-in / reschedule-out, expedite spend, over-expediting, penalty commit, or a slipped critical component.
6f1e88b3a1b82aac292f698e14643768eee232d3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

cd4609f4e53944d44d0d3862f9aa8049caba1fd5.description_zh: 分析同商品多家独立供应商集中延迟与涨价是否构成市场挤压，衡量全部开放PO和生产敞口，比较提前采购、替代资格与重排方案，准备多PO采购行动；单项延误用对应技能。
cd4609f4e53944d44d0d3862f9aa8049caba1fd5.source: Correlated multi-supplier slip and market-squeeze response (uc-resched-correlated) - two or more independent suppliers confirm later dates on the SAME commodity within days during an industry-wide uptick; read together it is a squeeze building, not two isolated blips. Size the category exposure across every open PO and build, decide squeeze vs coincidence, and price a forward-buy vs qualifying an alternate or re-timing builds, then stage the multi-PO action for sourcing. Use when several confirmation slips cluster on one commodity, a commodity price is climbing, someone asks whether to forward-buy or lock coverage, whether two slips are a pattern or coincidence, which SKUs to protect first, or mentions market squeeze, correlated slip, commodity inflation, forward buy, category exposure, panel or component shortage, allocation, or working-capital lock-up. For a single slip on one PO, use confirmation-slip-reschedule.
cd4609f4e53944d44d0d3862f9aa8049caba1fd5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b5b9b07e27a08349284d1a48427b38e93e48769d.description_zh: 对当日出库订单做HS或ECCN分类与拒绝交易方、制裁筛查，区分权限内常规放行与命中、受控或低置信行，将异常交指定贸易合规人员逐行决定放行、扣留或升级。
b5b9b07e27a08349284d1a48427b38e93e48769d.source: Export-control classification (HS/ECCN) and denied-party/sanctions screening of the day's outbound order lines, separating the routine bulk that auto-clears within limits from the hits, controlled parts, and low-confidence lines a named trade-compliance officer must adjudicate (uc-strat-customs-screening). Use when the day's outbound orders need HS/ECCN classification and denied-party/sanctions screening before release, a fuzzy name match hits an SDN/OFAC or BIS Entity/Denied-Persons list, a low-confidence ECCN sits on a controlled assembly, alert fatigue could bury the one real hit, someone must decide clear/hold/escalate per line, or the user mentions denied-party screening, SPL/RPS/DPS, sanctioned party list, SDN match, HS/ECCN classification, ITAR/EAR/USML controlled part, export license, deemed export, or a customs release hold across SAP GTS, Descartes, e2open, or ONESOURCE.
b5b9b07e27a08349284d1a48427b38e93e48769d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

4817b2cd774ce079b5372daebf560c01eaf40d75.description_zh: 对日常循环盘点和系统库存差异分流，区分容差噪声与实质偏差、追踪原因并量化ATP影响，在设定限额内自动调整或安排复点、升级及冻结可用量。
4817b2cd774ce079b5372daebf560c01eaf40d75.source: Triage a day's cycle-count discrepancies against system on-hand - split tolerance noise from real variance, trace each material gap to a likely cause, size it by available-to-promise impact, then auto-post within a set limit, recount, or escalate and hold availability. Use when daily cycle counts or a physical inventory disagree with WMS or ERP on-hand, when a count discrepancy list needs triage, when deciding auto-adjust vs recount vs escalate, or on mention of cycle count variance, inventory adjustment, tolerance calibration, on-hand mismatch, short-pick or mis-put, phantom inventory, ATP corruption, a Manhattan cycle count, or an SAP physical-inventory count difference (use case uc-inv-health-cyclecount).
4817b2cd774ce079b5372daebf560c01eaf40d75.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

276e4ceef8886cbf42b23eb7a3644378df7ebf4f.description_zh: 在出库波次截止前将紧缺配送中心库存分配给门店和直接客户，按库存天数、促销陈列、失销与SLA风险排序，比价三种分配，经批准写入WMS并更新部署计划。
276e4ceef8886cbf42b23eb7a3644378df7ebf4f.source: Split scarce DC stock across stores and direct-customer orders under an outbound wave clock - size the shortfall against available-to-deploy, rank nodes by days-of-supply, promo/planogram priority, lost-sale risk and SLA exposure, price three deployment splits, and on approval write the allocation to the WMS wave and update the deployment plan (use-case uc-inv-deploy-allocation). Use when overnight replenishment shows DC on-hand covering less than the network pull for a fast-mover, stores plus open customer orders exceed available-to-deploy, a promo or planogram store risks going short on a flat fair-share split, or the user mentions scarce stock allocation, deployment split, DC-to-store allocation, days-of-supply, protect the promo node, demand-weighted vs fair-share, outbound wave cut-off, or which stores get the units before the trucks load.
276e4ceef8886cbf42b23eb7a3644378df7ebf4f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

af85247a2330b9b31a58c18a127cff33b1a548db.description_zh: 共享组件或产线无法覆盖SKU家族总需求时，追踪MRP关联并按收入、服务和罚款影响排序，比较重分配、提前延后、加急与安全库存消耗，形成可解释供给分配。
af85247a2330b9b31a58c18a127cff33b1a548db.source: Demand-supply rebalance across a SKU family when a shared constraint (a component or a line) cannot cover total demand - trace the peg per SKU across the horizon, rank the gaps by revenue / service / penalty impact, and price the rebalancing moves (reallocate, pull-in, push-out, expedite, safety-stock draw-down) into a defensible split. Use when the weekly supply plan flags a shared constraint pegged across many SKUs, a single- or limited-source component starves a whole family, high-margin and strategic-customer SKUs compete for the same short supply, or someone asks how to split constrained supply, avoid a naive pro-rata / fair-share, decide which customer commits hold vs slip, or whether to expedite vs reallocate. Covers allocation, constrained master plan, MRP peg, coverage, penalty clause, air-freight premium; plan lives in Kinaxis / SAP IBP / o9 / Blue Yonder. Use-case uc-plan-ds-rebalance.
af85247a2330b9b31a58c18a127cff33b1a548db.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

84641d27c04c844e233a63e742e6d792d0c9a3f8.description_zh: 对比加急运费与交付延误的OTIF罚款、零售扣款和失销敞口，结合TMS、合同条款、ETA、客户优先级及费率，建议加急、部分加急或吸收延误。
84641d27c04c844e233a63e742e6d792d0c9a3f8.source: Expedite-or-absorb - price the transport expedite premium against the OTIF penalty, retailer chargeback, and lost-sale exposure of letting a committed shipment slip, then recommend expedite, partial-expedite, or absorb. Use when a shipment is tracking late against its committed OTIF / delivery window, a carrier ETA breaches the OTIF buffer, a top account risks a late delivery, someone asks whether to pay premium freight / air / team-drive / expedited mode or eat the miss, or the words expedite vs absorb, premium freight, OTIF penalty, chargeback, TONU, service-level miss, late shipment, at-risk load, or should we expedite come up. Covers uc-deliver-expedite - the high-frequency expedite-vs-absorb call across TMS (Oracle OTM, SAP TM), CLM (Icertis) penalty terms, carrier ETA feeds, CRM account priority, and premium-mode rates.
84641d27c04c844e233a63e742e6d792d0c9a3f8.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3fb9be1a31473012edab0f6af50c3f5f9e16905d.description_zh: 对照客户EDI 830或门户预测、内部统计预测与共识计划，量化增幅并分解偏差、证据支持的新需求和一次性噪声，给信号加权，在承诺供给前建议接受、减弱或暂缓。

a02f577f805170f6602d6859c11a310aa29e9a27.description_zh: 为AWS智能体评估AgentCore、ECS、EKS或Lambda，按工作负载澄清评分、设计部署服务、粗估成本并生成推荐、迁移计划和可部署PoC；账户实际构建须明确选择，Temporal编排不改写为Step Functions，纯非智能体迁移另用其他技能。
a02f577f805170f6602d6859c11a310aa29e9a27.source: Unified entry point for AI-agent work on AWS: evaluate and pick a runtime, generate a full migration plan (for existing workloads), and build an executable POC — all in one flow. Triggers on: which runtime for my agent, AgentCore vs ECS vs EKS vs Lambda, AgentCore vs Lambda MicroVMs, deploy an AI agent on AWS, agent architecture on AWS, I have an agent idea what do I build, move my agents to AWS, migrate my agents to AWS with a plan, agent migration plan, add AgentCore services, add memory/gateway/identity/policy to my agent, enable AgentCore Memory, add observability to my agent, I'm already on AWS and want to add agent capabilities, migrate Temporal workers to AWS, Temporal to AWS, run Temporal on AWS, Temporal workers on AWS, we use Temporal and want to move to AWS, our service is orchestrated by Temporal, what do I build on AWS for my Temporal workers, move a Temporal-based service to AWS, Temporal Cloud or self-hosted on AWS. Runs a phased flow: Intake (entry point + technical background), Discover (lightweight code detection), Clarify (adaptive questions), deterministic scoring, Design (runtime + deployment model + services + model), Estimate (coarse cost), Generate (layered recommendation doc + scaffolding), then optional gated stages: Migration Plan (full plan generated in-skill by reusing this plugin's gcp-to-aws engine, with the advisor's decisions carried over) and POC (deployment plan + deployable proof-of-concept on the recommended runtime — AgentCore, ECS, EKS, or Lambda; generated deliverables by default, or assisted build in your account on explicit opt-in). Systems with several workloads (interacting or independent agents, batch jobs, services) are decomposed into workload units, each getting its own verdict with a consolidation option. An add-capabilities branch (for teams already running agents on AWS) recommends which AgentCore services to enable on any runtime — no runtime scoring. Temporal systems dissolve into the same unit flow — worker polling tiers and Activity execution classes become units (rules in the Temporal decision reference); Workflow orchestration code is never rewritten — never a Step Functions translation. Requires at least one agentic component: a purely non-agent system (only plain services / batch jobs / HTTP endpoints, or a Temporal worker whose Activities are all non-agent) is out of scope — Clarify halts it (scope gate) and points to migration-to-aws / heroku-to-aws / llm-to-bedrock. Not for: pure compute/data migration with no AI agent; pure LLM SDK rewrite without agent architecture (use llm-to-bedrock); or detailed per-model pricing.
a02f577f805170f6602d6859c11a310aa29e9a27.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

488ea026b8493ab9358719b7d2573a3b95447dc6.source: Opt-in only. e3d694e12ff4da19bb3b330c932a5095d7d01ce0.description_zh: 解读现有 Mixpanel 图表、报告或保存查询，说明展示内容、显著模式及值得进一步查看之处；默认不追查根因，不用于新建图表或整份看板审查，需已有 Mixpanel 引擎。
e3d694e12ff4da19bb3b330c932a5095d7d01ce0.source: Read and explain a Mixpanel report or chart — what it shows, what's notable, and what's worth a closer look. Use whenever the user asks to interpret, explain, summarize, review, or break down an existing chart, report, or saved query in Mixpanel. Trigger phrases: "what does this chart show", "explain this report", "interpret this chart", "summarize this for me", "what's notable here", "anything weird in this chart", "tell me what's happening", "review this insight", "walk me through this report", "what's the takeaway from this". Also trigger when the user pastes a Mixpanel chart or report URL and asks anything about it. Lean by default — surfaces what the report shows and flags notable patterns, but does not chase root causes. Do NOT trigger for building new charts, reviewing entire dashboards, or full root-cause diagnostic workflows (for "why did this change" questions, use monitor-metrics). Requires a Mixpanel engine — run /mixpanel:install if not set up.
e3d694e12ff4da19bb3b330c932a5095d7d01ce0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

dc260175d055e1bfcfbf73f2e31549722e2c7405.description_zh: 创建 Mixpanel 看板，组织布局、文本卡片、报告验证和叙事结构，也可把调查结果整理成实时看板。
dc260175d055e1bfcfbf73f2e31549722e2c7405.source: Creates a well-designed Mixpanel dashboard. Use when the user asks you to build, create, or design a dashboard, or when you need to present findings from an investigation as a live dashboard. Handles layout, text cards, report validation, and narrative structure.
dc260175d055e1bfcfbf73f2e31549722e2c7405.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

62570ca280d1bcdf5e80e5c217b8c2e2acdd0ba7.description_zh: 在 Mixpanel 开展结构化指标调查，先确定项目、事件和属性范围及调查计划，再循环查询、解释和提出假设，分析趋势驱动因素与指标变化原因。
62570ca280d1bcdf5e80e5c217b8c2e2acdd0ba7.source: Conducts a structured metric investigation in Mixpanel. Use when the user asks why a metric changed, what's driving a trend, requests a "deep dive" or "root cause," or wants to understand a phenomenon in their data. Walks through project / event / property scoping, plan confirmation, and an iterative query → interpret → hypothesise loop.
62570ca280d1bcdf5e80e5c217b8c2e2acdd0ba7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

610cf80d07466b7f56d5d9927ad474fddf2b95c6.description_zh: 为项目选择并配置 Mixpanel 引擎，可使用 MCP server、mixpanel-headless Python SDK 或用户集成，并切换引擎或区域；需交互式选择，不用于应用埋点代码或直接查询分析。
610cf80d07466b7f56d5d9927ad474fddf2b95c6.source: Set up Mixpanel for this project — set up an engine for the other Mixpanel skills to use (Mixpanel MCP server, mixpanel-headless Python SDK, or the user's own integration). Use whenever the user asks to set up, install, configure, or connect Mixpanel, switch Mixpanel engine or region, or when any Mixpanel skill finds no engine set up. Trigger phrases: "set up mixpanel", "configure mixpanel", "connect mixpanel", "install mixpanel", "switch mixpanel region", "use mixpanel headless", "change mixpanel engine", "add another engine". Do NOT use for adding Mixpanel tracking code to an application (use tracking-implementation) or for running analytics queries. Interactive — asks the user to choose; do not run in non-interactive sessions.
610cf80d07466b7f56d5d9927ad474fddf2b95c6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

41d1270d93b192597767b9189fd75b56ad9f57bb.description_zh: 通过交互式模块引导用户了解 Mixpanel MCP 能力、可提问题和起步方式；具体报表、看板、查询、埋点、实验与 Lexicon 管理交由对应技能。
41d1270d93b192597767b9189fd75b56ad9f57bb.source: Onboard users to the Mixpanel MCP server through guided, interactive modules. Use when the user asks "how do I use MCP", "what can I ask", "what should I try first", "show me what MCP can do", or is figuring out where to start (e.g. "what now?"). Always invoke this skill when the user asks about MCP capabilities, even if the question seems simple. Do NOT use for: creating reports or dashboards, running queries, tracking setup, experiment analysis, or Lexicon management — use the dedicated skills for those tasks.
41d1270d93b192597767b9189fd75b56ad9f57bb.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

73c7e26ad94ed7e3ac7308a7ec127c937a6639dd.description_zh: 管理 Mixpanel 看板全生命周期，包括创建、模板化、复制、盘点、更新重命名、删除及清理过时看板，支持跨项目团队标准化；需已有引擎，不用于实验、功能开关或事件属性元数据治理。
73c7e26ad94ed7e3ac7308a7ec127c937a6639dd.source: Full lifecycle dashboard management for Mixpanel — create, template, clone, clean up, inventory, and update dashboards across projects and teams. ALWAYS use when a user asks to: create a dashboard, build a board, template or clone a dashboard, clean up stale dashboards, audit dashboards, list all dashboards, inventory boards, update or rename a dashboard, delete a dashboard, or standardize boards across projects. Also trigger on "duplicate board", "stale dashboards", "empty boards", "board management", or when dashboards are mentioned with "governance", "cleanup", "template", "onboarding", or "standardize". Do NOT use for A/B experiments (use `manage-experiment`), feature-flag rollouts (use `manage-feature-flags`), or Lexicon/event-and-property metadata cleanup (use `manage-lexicon`). Requires a Mixpanel engine — run /mixpanel:install if not set up.
73c7e26ad94ed7e3ac7308a7ec127c937a6639dd.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8fa94817e25cea100da5363293f24ee09da9a9e3.description_zh: 辅导 Mixpanel 实验的设计、上线、监控和结果解释，涵盖假设、指标、样本量、统计模型、CUPED、缩尾及多重检验、SRM、护栏、提前终止和分群分析；保留原说明中上线不可逆的限制，不用于无衡量目标的纯功能开关发布。
8fa94817e25cea100da5363293f24ee09da9a9e3.source: Coach the user through any phase of a Mixpanel experiment — design (hypothesis framing, metric selection, sizing, statistical-model choice, advanced features like CUPED / Winsorization / multiple-testing correction), launch (pre-launch readiness check and the irreversible launch), monitor (mid-flight safety: SRM, sample pace, guardrail peeks, terminate-early calls), and interpret (read results, decide ship / iterate / kill / wait, read health checks like SRM and Retro A/A, break down by segment, use session replays). Use when the user mentions an experiment or A/B test, a ship/kill decision, MDE, sample ratio mismatch, CUPED, or statistical significance, or asks things like "set up an experiment", "is my experiment SRM-ing", "should we ship", "what's my MDE", or "audit my experiment". Do NOT use for plain feature-flag rollouts with no measurement criterion — that belongs to the `manage-feature-flags` skill.
8fa94817e25cea100da5363293f24ee09da9a9e3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

0f4248531a22106fc55d076bc39c9c125fef498d.description_zh: 管理 Mixpanel 功能开关，选择 Feature Gate、Dynamic Config 或 Experiment，配置名称与键、分阶段放量、紧急关闭、曝光排查及归档恢复；实验样本量、统计监控和结果决策使用实验技能。
0f4248531a22106fc55d076bc39c9c125fef498d.source: Coach the user through Mixpanel feature-flag work — picking the right flag-shaped product (Feature Gate vs Dynamic Config vs Experiment), naming and keying, staged rollouts, the kill switch, exposure debugging, and archive/restore. Use when the user wants to create, configure, ramp, kill, archive, restore, debug, or clean up a Mixpanel feature flag, or asks why exposures are zero, why a rollout-percentage change had no effect, whether to use a flag or an experiment, or how to clean up stale flags. Trigger on phrasings like 'create a feature flag', 'roll out X to 10%', 'kill the flag', 'why doesn't my flag work', 'archive these stale flags', or 'is this a feature flag or an experiment'. Do NOT use for experiment design ('how should I size this A/B test?', 'what MDE can I detect?'), launch, mid-flight monitoring, or results interpretation ('should we ship?', 'what does this SRM failure mean?') — those belong to the `manage-experiment` skill.
0f4248531a22106fc55d076bc39c9c125fef498d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d036452e70e927dfed58f19e8fb131042bb15b8c.description_zh: 审计和评分 Mixpanel Lexicon 事件及属性元数据，批量补充说明、显示名与标签，处理类型漂移、空值、量异常、重置及标签更名删除；需已有引擎，不用于删除事件数据或用户档案。
d036452e70e927dfed58f19e8fb131042bb15b8c.source: Audit, score, enrich, or clean up the Lexicon (events and properties metadata) for a Mixpanel project. Use whenever the user wants to score Lexicon health, bulk-fill missing descriptions / display names / tags, reset metadata, triage data quality issues (type drift, null values, volume anomalies), or rename and delete tags. Also use when the user describes the problem in their own words — "score lexicon", "enrich lexicon", "bulk enrich", "auto-tag events", "reset lexicon", "wipe tags", "review data quality issues", "rename/delete Lexicon tags", "event names are a mess", "half my events have no descriptions", "tracking plan audit", "clean up the schema", "score our instrumentation" — as long as Mixpanel is the context. Do NOT use for: deleting event data or user profiles; dashboard cleanup; cohort tagging; customer health scoring. Requires a Mixpanel engine — run /mixpanel:install if not set up.
d036452e70e927dfed58f19e8fb131042bb15b8c.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

68217283f5508fa1c062a845218d26f4bccff1fc.description_zh: 监控和诊断 Mixpanel 指标的异常、漂移与变化根因，覆盖 KPI、转化、留存、事件量、漏斗及已保存报告或看板指标；需已有引擎，组合健康检查和采用率报告使用对应技能。
68217283f5508fa1c062a845218d26f4bccff1fc.source: Monitor and diagnose a Mixpanel metric for anomalies, drift, and root cause. Use whenever the user asks to investigate, debug, monitor, or explain a change in a metric tracked in Mixpanel — a saved Metric, KPI, conversion rate, retention, event count, funnel step, or anything tracked in a saved report or dashboard. Trigger phrases: "monitor [metric]", "what's going on with [metric]", "why did [metric] drop/spike", "diagnose this metric", "check for anomalies", "has [metric] drifted", "what's driving the drop", "where is the movement coming from", "run RCA on this metric". Also trigger when the user shares a Mixpanel report/dashboard/metric link and asks what's happening, or describes a metric in prose and wants to know if the movement is real. Do NOT trigger for portfolio health checks (use `weekly-pulse`) or adoption reports (use `gtm-customer-intelligence`). Requires a Mixpanel engine — run /mixpanel:install if not set up.
68217283f5508fa1c062a845218d26f4bccff1fc.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

9058b804c45e55ecc41a59649cb463aaf883f23b.description_zh: 为 Mixpanel 组织或项目的 AI 助手整理业务上下文与 Lexicon 元数据，导入信息、填补缺口并检查 AI 准备程度；需已有引擎，不用于看板或指标分析。
9058b804c45e55ecc41a59649cb463aaf883f23b.source: Gets a Mixpanel org or project ready for its AI assistants — business context and Lexicon metadata. Use to set up or import context, fill gaps, or check AI-readiness: "set us up for Mixpanel AI", "how ready are we for the agent". Not for dashboards or metrics. Requires a Mixpanel engine — run /mixpanel:install if not set up.
9058b804c45e55ecc41a59649cb463aaf883f23b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

315833eac2f347a8222b226d48449ad92e422001.description_zh: 指导编码智能体实施 Mixpanel 分析埋点，支持首次事件快速接入、完整生产实施、扩展已有埋点及实施审计。
315833eac2f347a8222b226d48449ad92e422001.source: Guides a coding agent through helping a Mixpanel customer implement analytics correctly. Covers Quick Start (first events in one session), Full Implementation (complete production-ready setup), Add Tracking (extend existing implementation), and Implementation Audit. Use when a user wants to implement Mixpanel, set up Mixpanel, add Mixpanel tracking, configure a new Mixpanel project, or is a Mixpanel customer starting or extending their implementation.
315833eac2f347a8222b226d48449ad92e422001.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

210f776a7cc040369b7708217c195cba2582a96a.description_zh: 对表格、时间序列、文本或图像等机器学习训练、微调、调参和评估采用 16 步流程，从检查原始数据开始，按原说明逐阶段取得用户明确许可，并生成带 matplotlib 图表的 marimo 笔记本。
210f776a7cc040369b7708217c195cba2582a96a.source: MANDATORY whenever a task involves training, fine-tuning, tuning, or evaluating a machine-learning model on data (tabular, time series, text, images — any modality). Enforces a strict 16-step pipeline that starts with inspecting the raw data, gates each phase behind the user's explicit permission, and produces marimo notebooks with matplotlib visuals so the user can see and understand every step. Never jump straight to model training.
210f776a7cc040369b7708217c195cba2582a96a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d2f1273ca1946f5286cf18eaac8cb58522831169.description_zh: 用 MLflow 的数据集、评分器和追踪系统评估改进现有 LLM 智能体的工具选择、答案质量、成本及错误响应；覆盖追踪配置、数据集、评分定义和执行，原说明要求同时使用 instrumenting-with-mlflow-tracing。
d2f1273ca1946f5286cf18eaac8cb58522831169.source: Use this when you need to EVALUATE OR IMPROVE or OPTIMIZE an existing LLM agent's output quality - including improving tool selection accuracy, answer quality, reducing costs, or fixing issues where the agent gives wrong/incomplete responses. Evaluates agents systematically using MLflow evaluation with datasets, scorers, and tracing. IMPORTANT - Always also load the instrumenting-with-mlflow-tracing skill before starting any work. Covers end-to-end evaluation workflow or individual components (tracing setup, dataset creation, scorer definition, evaluation execution).
d2f1273ca1946f5286cf18eaac8cb58522831169.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

fdf3c7d598c58a404fb870cc7ffca4afb44820e3.source: Analyzes an MLflow session — a sequence of traces from a multi-turn chat conversation or interaction. Use when the user asks to debug a chat conversation, review session or chat history, find where a multi-turn chat went wrong, or analyze patterns across turns. Triggers on "analyze this session", "what happened in this conversation", "debug session", "review chat history", "where did this chat go wrong", "session traces", "analyze chat", "debug this chat".

c9a98d11f0a0de15ed3a916be5b2d644bf636b28.source: Analyzes a single MLflow trace to answer a user query about it. Use when the user provides a trace ID and asks to debug, investigate, find issues, root-cause errors, understand behavior, or analyze quality. c9a98d11f0a0de15ed3a916be5b2d644bf636b28.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

9dc3dfc6e3f87974b0aadaccb2a48d6b2be66082.description_zh: 理解智能体、RAG、LLM 应用或生成式 AI 流程，从少量原子质量标准建立 MLflow 评估原型，并为每项标准选择成本最低且可靠的评分器，支持评判器选择、创建与迭代。
9dc3dfc6e3f87974b0aadaccb2a48d6b2be66082.source: Help the user go from zero to a shipped MLflow evaluation prototype by understanding their app, generalizing a small set of atomic quality criteria, and implementing each criterion with the cheapest reliable scorer. Use when the user wants help choosing, creating, or iterating MLflow judges/scorers for an agent, RAG app, LLM app, or GenAI workflow.
9dc3dfc6e3f87974b0aadaccb2a48d6b2be66082.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

bb342552b237772ba94ce92f583d74f7140daa1a.description_zh: 以 MLflow 追踪为证据，按探索、计划、实现和验证循环修复或改变智能体行为；用 @mlflow.test 的 pytest 与 mlflow.genai.evaluate 建立回归标准，迭代智能体直到通过，并检查工具、检索来源或能力缺口而非只改提示词。
bb342552b237772ba94ce92f583d74f7140daa1a.source: Drives a disciplined explore → plan → implement → verify loop for changing an AI agent''s behavior with confidence — whether fixing a reported failure or introducing a new requirement, business rule, or policy. Grounds the diagnosis in MLflow traces, codifies the desired behavior as a regression test suite (`mlflow.genai.evaluate` assertions in `@mlflow.test` pytest tests), and iterates the agent — not the test — until green, resisting quick system-prompt patches when the real fix is upstream (missing tool, retrieval source, or capability). Use whenever the user wants to fix or change how an agent behaves — e.g. "fix this issue in my agent", "this answer is wrong", "the agent is hallucinating", "improve my agent based on this trace", "make the agent do X instead of Y", "I want the agent to lead with/prioritize/recommend X", "new business rule: the agent should X", "always/never do X", "change the agent''s default behavior" — or when you are debugging an agent''s behavior mid-loop and reaching for source code and output files — "debug this agent", "figure out why the agent did X", "the agent''s output is wrong", "why did the agent produce this" — where the trace is the evidence to read first — or shares a trace they want addressed.
bb342552b237772ba94ce92f583d74f7140daa1a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

7743c9166176a0adf61165e766a385d95a218290.source: Instruments Python and TypeScript code with MLflow Tracing for observability. 7743c9166176a0adf61165e766a385d95a218290.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b0b205c410c8a9f0b2b859a878a34ea0063341ab.description_zh: 作为 MLflow 工作流总入口，将追踪、评估、调试、改进智能体或项目接入请求路由到相应 MLflow 子技能。
