41cd50829e6162a7d1fc14eae4fed9c7147365fb.description_zh: 对新功能、端点、服务方法和关键流程采用严格的测试失败、实现通过、重构循环，要求测试先于实现失败；原说明排除简单缺陷修复、配置文档、单行修改及无逻辑 UI 调整。
41cd50829e6162a7d1fc14eae4fed9c7147365fb.source: Use when implementing any new feature, endpoint, service method, or critical flow. Enforces strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycles where tests must fail before implementation exists. Does NOT trigger for quick bug fixes, config changes, documentation, single-line patches, or UI tweaks with no logic.
41cd50829e6162a7d1fc14eae4fed9c7147365fb.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b200d265470faba73555c7e5e15a62e641f4a97b.description_zh: 比较 N|Solid 基线和峰值堆证据，定位保留构造器、闭包及引用路径，调查持续或阶梯式内存增长和常规分析未能定位的泄漏；优先使用已有材料，必要时才采集。
b200d265470faba73555c7e5e15a62e641f4a97b.source: Performs an advanced N|Solid memory leak hunt comparing baseline vs peak heap evidence to isolate retained constructors, closures, and retainer paths. Use when the user reports recurring/staircase memory growth, elusive leaks, retained objects, closures holding references, or a standard heap sample/snapshot analysis was inconclusive. Prefer supplied baseline/peak assets; capture new samples only when needed.
b200d265470faba73555c7e5e15a62e641f4a97b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

0762bf656199256f8ad96e0d19b839e6ea0756b5.description_zh: 按资源 ID 或本地路径，用 asset-summary 分析已有 N|Solid CPU profile、堆 profile、采样或快照，包括刚生成的资源；不用于采集新资源。
0762bf656199256f8ad96e0d19b839e6ea0756b5.source: Analyzes an existing N|Solid diagnostic asset by asset ID or local asset path using asset-summary. Use when the user asks to inspect, review, summarize, or interpret an already-captured CPU profile, heap profile, heap sample, or heap snapshot, including assets just produced by ns-generate-asset. Do not use to capture new profiles/snapshots.
0762bf656199256f8ad96e0d19b839e6ea0756b5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8fd372dce381eeadc78d19965756b50f7184826d.description_zh: 调查已有 N|Solid 事件及相关 MCP 证据，如进程阻塞、新漏洞、agent 退出、未捕获异常、调用栈和 span，必要时转入 CPU、内存、漏洞或追踪流程。
8fd372dce381eeadc78d19965756b50f7184826d.source: Investigates an existing N|Solid event payload and correlates relevant MCP evidence. Use when the user provides or references an event such as process-blocked, new-vulnerability-found, agent-exit, uncaught exception, stack trace, span data. Routes follow-up to CPU, memory, vulnerability, or tracing workflows when needed.
8fd372dce381eeadc78d19965756b50f7184826d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d62c0a7c02e0032d75669772eee79d9fcdff48d9.description_zh: 分析 N|Solid/OpenTelemetry 追踪中的请求延迟、HTTP 错误和服务依赖，排查慢端点、超时、N+1、await 链及级联故障；仅在未提供追踪时查询 N|Solid，不假定缺失的完整瀑布信息。
d62c0a7c02e0032d75669772eee79d9fcdff48d9.source: Analyzes N|Solid/OpenTelemetry tracing evidence for request latency, HTTP errors, and service dependencies. Use when the user asks about slow endpoints, API timeouts, distributed traces/spans, N+1 queries, await chains, microservice latency, cascading failures, or trace IDs. Query N|Solid only when no trace data was provided. Do not assume full waterfall details unless supplied.
d62c0a7c02e0032d75669772eee79d9fcdff48d9.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

180c999f175ba53b2e534402e63ffbcac47ac03b.description_zh: 分析已连接 N|Solid Node.js 进程实际加载的运行时漏洞，识别活跃应用中的 CVE、零日敞口和生产供应链风险；静态项目依赖检查使用 ns-audit-dependencies。
180c999f175ba53b2e534402e63ffbcac47ac03b.source: Analyzes live runtime vulnerabilities loaded by connected N|Solid Node.js processes. Use when the user wants to know which CVEs are actually present in running apps, active exploitable/live vulnerabilities, zero-day exposure, supply-chain risk in production, or production package risk. For static npm-audit-style project dependency scans, use ns-audit-dependencies instead.
180c999f175ba53b2e534402e63ffbcac47ac03b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3751abc8113e71c350b4f7620ecebb9c89e4bec0.description_zh: 利用 NCM 漏洞数据审计本地 Node.js 依赖树，检查直接及传递依赖 CVE、风险与升级前修复计划；实际运行时加载漏洞使用 ns-analyze-vulnerabilities。
3751abc8113e71c350b4f7620ecebb9c89e4bec0.source: Audits a local Node.js project dependency tree with NCM vulnerability data. Use when the user asks for an npm audit-style security review, package CVEs, direct/transitive vulnerability report, dependency risk assessment, or remediation plan before upgrading. For vulnerabilities actually loaded in running N|Solid processes, use ns-analyze-vulnerabilities instead.
3751abc8113e71c350b4f7620ecebb9c89e4bec0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1291694ae4d73bba9a4161229fa140c6f9eea4a6.description_zh: 基准测试单个 Node.js 函数的耗时、吞吐量和统计，比较输入规模或每秒操作数；原版与优化版的 A/B 证明使用 ns-validate-optimization。
1291694ae4d73bba9a4161229fa140c6f9eea4a6.source: Benchmarks one Node.js function and reports throughput/statistics. Use when the user asks to benchmark or time a single function, measure ops/sec, compare input sizes, or answer "how fast is this code?" Use ns-validate-optimization instead when original and optimized versions need an A/B proof.
1291694ae4d73bba9a4161229fa140c6f9eea4a6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d2b2c006247fe509babde82161d6dadfba1bbebd.description_zh: 依据已有证据或 N|Solid CPU 指标与 profile，诊断 Node.js 高 CPU、慢端点或函数、事件循环阻塞、热点循环及火焰图；优先已有资源、摘要、追踪或本地 profile。
d2b2c006247fe509babde82161d6dadfba1bbebd.source: Diagnoses high CPU or slow execution in a Node.js app using supplied evidence or N|Solid CPU metrics/profiles. Use when the user reports CPU spike, high CPU percent, slow endpoint/function, event loop blocking, flamegraph/profile analysis, hot loop, or asks why an app is slow. Prefer existing asset IDs, summaries, trace data, or local profiles before capturing a new profile.
d2b2c006247fe509babde82161d6dadfba1bbebd.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

7cfc2d3d6305e629e35f1cabefdcf7607dade429.description_zh: 按 ID 将 N|Solid 原始堆快照、CPU 或堆 profile 下载到本地，供 snapshot-parser、Chrome DevTools 或差异工具使用；分析资源使用 ns-analyze-asset。
7cfc2d3d6305e629e35f1cabefdcf7607dade429.source: Downloads a raw N|Solid diagnostic asset (heap snapshot, CPU profile, or heap profile) to local disk by asset ID. Use when the user asks to download, save, export, or pull an asset file locally, or needs the raw file for external tools such as snapshot-parser, Chrome DevTools, or diffing. Do not use for analyzing assets — ns-analyze-asset covers that.
7cfc2d3d6305e629e35f1cabefdcf7607dade429.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6711ac835504e803e7bb57c7058612d00c50e0c5.description_zh: 在用户明确要求时，为已连接 Node.js 应用采集新的 N|Solid CPU profile、火焰图、堆采样、快照或跟踪资源，并保存或交接分析；已有资源使用分析技能。
6711ac835504e803e7bb57c7058612d00c50e0c5.source: Captures a new N|Solid diagnostic asset for a connected Node.js app. Use when the user explicitly asks to collect, capture, or generate a CPU profile, flamegraph, heap sample, heap snapshot, or heap tracking asset and wants it saved or handed off for analysis. For existing assets, use ns-analyze-asset instead.
6711ac835504e803e7bb57c7058612d00c50e0c5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a62639ea0a18a221edc90943142b6b778a06c151.description_zh: 为已连接或登记的 N|Solid Node.js 应用生成软件物料清单 SBOM，提供合规、SOC2/供应商审查、许可证、依赖及传递包盘点证据。
a62639ea0a18a221edc90943142b6b778a06c151.source: Generates a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for a connected or registered N|Solid Node.js app. Use when the user asks for SBOM, software bill of materials, compliance evidence, SOC2/vendor review, license inventory, dependency inventory, or transitive package report for a running application.
a62639ea0a18a221edc90943142b6b778a06c151.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6c12233fae45e31b0fa09c08eaf3240b6f5852ec.description_zh: 根据堆证据或 N|Solid 采样快照，诊断 Node.js 内存增长、堆峰值、RSS 上升、OOM 和疑似泄漏，开展内存根因分流。
6c12233fae45e31b0fa09c08eaf3240b6f5852ec.source: Diagnoses memory growth, heap spikes, RSS increases, OOMs, and suspected leaks in Node.js apps using supplied heap evidence or N|Solid heap sampling/snapshots. Use when the user reports memory leak, heap growing, high RSS, out-of-memory, heap snapshot/profile analysis, or wants memory root-cause triage.
6c12233fae45e31b0fa09c08eaf3240b6f5852ec.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

421abbeb1f9c93e0fc77756bf4a7ff6517717874.description_zh: 规划项目 Node.js 运行时升级，检测当前版本，说明 LTS/EOL 依据、依赖兼容性、升级步骤和回退指引，支持更新 .nvmrc 或 engines。
421abbeb1f9c93e0fc77756bf4a7ff6517717874.source: Plans a Node.js runtime upgrade for a project. Use when the user asks which Node version to use, upgrade/migrate Node.js, address LTS/EOL, update .nvmrc or engines, or move between Node versions. Produces version detection, LTS/EOL rationale, dependency compatibility checks, upgrade steps, and rollback guidance.
421abbeb1f9c93e0fc77756bf4a7ff6517717874.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5c114e867af68de19da91ecfaf3a6e28dbbf7ae7.description_zh: 优化用户指定的本地 Node.js 函数以提升吞吐、降低 CPU/内存消耗；要求工作区源码，评估影响范围、提出保持行为的改写并交由基准验证，不只做线上诊断。
5c114e867af68de19da91ecfaf3a6e28dbbf7ae7.source: Optimizes a specific local Node.js function selected by the user. Use when the user points to code and asks to make it faster, improve throughput, reduce CPU/memory cost, or fix a slow function. Requires workspace source; analyzes blast radius, proposes a behavior-preserving rewrite, and hands off to benchmark validation. Not for live N|Solid diagnostics alone.
5c114e867af68de19da91ecfaf3a6e28dbbf7ae7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8a8cad4d6404b0b87cc37d104508ee6255c6271f.description_zh: 利用 NCM 数据比较 npm 包替代方案，为弃用、废弃或高风险依赖提供迁移和 API 差异指引；继续使用同一包的版本升级交由 ns-upgrade-package。
8a8cad4d6404b0b87cc37d104508ee6255c6271f.source: Finds and evaluates alternatives to an npm package. Use when the user wants to replace, drop, or swap a dependency, migrate away from a deprecated/abandoned/risky package, or asks "what can I use instead of X?" Compares candidates with NCM data and provides migration/API-diff guidance. Use ns-upgrade-package for staying on the same package.
8a8cad4d6404b0b87cc37d104508ee6255c6271f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

afc435780f88393d75d2eb1df6735188157981fc.description_zh: 切换 nsolid-plugin 认证对应的 NodeSource 组织，适用于多组织成员或 MCP 显示错误组织的情况。
afc435780f88393d75d2eb1df6735188157981fc.source: Switches which NodeSource organization nsolid-plugin is authenticated against. Use when the user is a member of multiple NodeSource orgs and wants to switch orgs, sign in to a different org, or asks why MCP data is showing the wrong organization.
afc435780f88393d75d2eb1df6735188157981fc.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5ec6b4f0d6ba2a6d5f0b2ddfb8911e8aeda95fac.description_zh: 规划项目中单个 npm 依赖的版本升级，评估 semver、破坏性变化和 peer 依赖风险，提供目标版本及包管理器命令；换库使用 ns-replace-package。
5ec6b4f0d6ba2a6d5f0b2ddfb8911e8aeda95fac.source: Plans an upgrade for a specific npm package already used by a Node.js project. Use when the user wants to bump/update one dependency, assess semver or breaking changes, resolve peer dependency risk, move to a target version, or get exact package-manager commands. Use ns-replace-package when switching to a different library.
5ec6b4f0d6ba2a6d5f0b2ddfb8911e8aeda95fac.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

05d007f1fc7a4f26d4e820e8287110e87c1cbf10.description_zh: 以受控 A/B 基准测试验证同一 Node.js 函数原版与优化版，比较每秒操作数、p 值和显著性并检查性能回归；单版本计时使用 ns-benchmark-run。
05d007f1fc7a4f26d4e820e8287110e87c1cbf10.source: Validates a proposed optimization with controlled A/B benchmarks. Use when original and optimized versions of the same Node.js function need statistical proof, ops/sec comparison, p-value/significance, or a performance regression check. Also fits after ns-optimize-function or diagnostics produce a candidate fix. Use ns-benchmark-run for single-version timing only.
05d007f1fc7a4f26d4e820e8287110e87c1cbf10.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f4d5c8ceecc2c7c215688a6ef51691edd519ac24.description_zh: 用 namespace-guard npm 包检查用户选择的名字及输入 LLM 的不可信文本，处理 Unicode 同形字、混合文字、不可见字符、冒充和规避式粗俗词，支持并发安全占名及文本归一化；原说明基于 TR39 和测量数据，并称混淆文本可能放大 token 消耗至 5.7 倍。
f4d5c8ceecc2c7c215688a6ef51691edd519ac24.source: Stops confusables (lookalike letters, also called homoglyphs) in names people choose and in text sent to an LLM, using the namespace-guard npm package. Use when building sign-up, usernames, handles, organisation or workspace slugs, or any name users pick; when reviewing code that stores or compares such names; or when documents, emails, web pages or other untrusted text go into a model. Covers impersonation and Unicode spoofing (a Cyrillic а for a, rn for m, paypa1), mixed-script and homograph tricks, invisible characters, profanity with evasions, race-safe claiming, and turning confusables back into plain letters before a model reads them, which prevents Denial of Spend (flooded text can take up to 5.7x the tokens). Built on Unicode TR39 confusables.txt plus measured data.
f4d5c8ceecc2c7c215688a6ef51691edd519ac24.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

bdf0909880b695dfaaa7a7cb0200573565841484.description_zh: 对数量、成本、时长或规模做费米式粗略估算，明确假设并给出范围，适用于快速数量级判断。
bdf0909880b695dfaaa7a7cb0200573565841484.source: Make a back-of-the-envelope estimate with stated assumptions and a range. Use when the user asks roughly how much, how many, how long or how big something is, asks for a Fermi estimate, a ballpark, or napkin math, or runs /napkin-math:estimate <question>.
bdf0909880b695dfaaa7a7cb0200573565841484.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ef2883c40df5ed666a544ca9b0558a82361b1af5.description_zh: 通过独立快速估算检查引用数字是否合理，评估包含数字的说法能否成立。
ef2883c40df5ed666a544ca9b0558a82361b1af5.source: Check whether a number someone quoted is plausible, using a quick independent estimate. Use when the user asks "does this number make sense", "is this plausible", "sanity check this figure", pastes a claim with a number in it and asks if it holds up, or runs /napkin-math:sanity-check <claim>.
ef2883c40df5ed666a544ca9b0558a82361b1af5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

92855fbc113a4e0da256e085261d7bdf1fc3ab1e.description_zh: 针对用户计划、提案或决策，提出有事实依据的最强反对论点，帮助找出遗漏和薄弱处。
92855fbc113a4e0da256e085261d7bdf1fc3ab1e.source: Argue the strongest honest case against the user's plan, proposal or decision. Use when the user asks for a devil's advocate, asks "what am I missing", asks you to poke holes in something, or runs /naysayer:devils-advocate.
92855fbc113a4e0da256e085261d7bdf1fc3ab1e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b3d2c4fa9f97d85883d375ec495babb79d54f794.description_zh: 对计划或项目开展事前失败分析，推演可能出错的方式与原因。
b3d2c4fa9f97d85883d375ec495babb79d54f794.source: Run a premortem on a plan or project. Use when the user asks for a premortem, asks how something could fail, asks what could go wrong before starting, or runs /naysayer:premortem.
b3d2c4fa9f97d85883d375ec495babb79d54f794.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

bd4cfc84835dcbe9cb6075e9568cf1ab3a20cb30.description_zh: 依据真实 Linear 项目工单开展事前失败分析，识别可能导致项目失败或影响发布的票据。
bd4cfc84835dcbe9cb6075e9568cf1ab3a20cb30.source: Run a premortem on a real Linear project, grounded in its actual tickets. Use when the user asks for a premortem on a Linear project, asks what could sink a project they track in Linear, asks which tickets put a launch at risk, or runs /naysayer:project-premortem <project name or URL>.
bd4cfc84835dcbe9cb6075e9568cf1ab3a20cb30.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

377e297ac80d799dcf22b96f399a86cd697953bc.description_zh: 通过集成在 Neon 分支、由 Databricks 支持的 AI Gateway，以一个 API 和凭据调用多厂商前沿或开源 LLM，支持模型路由、日志与限流；原说明称可通过更换 base URL 适配 OpenAI、Anthropic、google-genai、Vercel AI SDK 和 Mastra。
377e297ac80d799dcf22b96f399a86cd697953bc.source: One API and one credential for frontier and open-source LLMs, built into your Neon branch and powered by Databricks. Use when a user wants to call an LLM, add AI/chat/an agent to their app, route between model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google/Gemini, Meta, Alibaba, and more), or avoid juggling separate provider API keys and accounts — especially when they already use Neon and want AI requests to branch with their project. Works with the OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, google-genai, the Vercel AI SDK, and Mastra by changing only the base URL. Triggers include "call an LLM", "add AI to my app", "chat completion", "model routing", "LLM proxy/gateway", "one API for all models", "use Claude/GPT/Gemini", "AI SDK", "Mastra agent", "Neon AI Gateway", and "log/rate-limit AI calls".
377e297ac80d799dcf22b96f399a86cd697953bc.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

dab28094f7011666242e50c61b084d9f7aed476b.description_zh: 为应用配置 Neon Auth 的登录、注册、密码重置、OTP、magic link、组织、OAuth、passkey 和 MFA；原说明无已有身份服务时默认 Managed Better Auth，保留正常工作的已有 IdP，超出托管插件支持时用自管理方案。
dab28094f7011666242e50c61b084d9f7aed476b.source: Add authentication to a new app. Use for "add auth", "add login", Neon Auth (Managed Better Auth), identity routing, sign-up, sign-in, password reset, email OTP, magic links, organizations, phone OTP, OAuth, passkeys, MFA, trusted domains, invalid domain, and @neondatabase/auth. No existing identity: default to Managed Better Auth. Keep working Better Auth, Clerk, Supabase Auth, or another IdP. User asked to migrate from Supabase Auth: Managed Better Auth. A required plugin outside Managed support: self-managed Better Auth on a Neon Function or the existing app host. Also use for auth APIs in @neondatabase/neon-js.
dab28094f7011666242e50c61b084d9f7aed476b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

7f66c121f9594975f4a8d24582a0484bce551439.description_zh: 在 Neon 分支部署长运行 serverless Node.js HTTP 函数，自动注入 DATABASE_URL，支持长流式智能体、WebSocket/SSE、webhook、机器人和 MCP server，以及 cron 或对象存储事件触发、日志及生产加固。
7f66c121f9594975f4a8d24582a0484bce551439.source: Long-running, serverless Node.js HTTP functions deployed onto your Neon branch, with DATABASE_URL injected automatically and compute that runs next to your data. Use when a user wants to host an API, an AI agent with long streaming responses, a WebSocket or server-sent-events (SSE) server, a webhook handler, a Discord bot, an MCP server, or any request/response workload that risks timing out on short, lambda-style serverless functions — and wants it to branch with their database. Also use for Function Triggers: a cron or an object-storage event that POSTs to a function. '통합 설계', '큰 설계와 작은 설계 둘 다', '웹소설 기획 부탁해', '소설 설계' 등 범위가 불분명한 요청에 이 스킬을 사용할 것. 큰 설계만 명확히 요청하면 design-big을, 작은 설계만 명확히 요청하면 design-small을 직접 사용하라. 단일 영역만 필요하면 bootstrap/character/plot-hook을 직접 사용하라. 11e5c2aef79f0b96f0efc4d28626dde82f3ec275.description_zh: 把 package.json/lockfile 前后快照或指定依赖升级转成确定的 PASS/WARN/FAIL，供 CI 检查或 PR 状态机器人使用，判断是否阻止合并；不用于普通差异解释或单包信任调查。
11e5c2aef79f0b96f0efc4d28626dde82f3ec275.source: Turn a dependency change — a before/after package.json/lockfile snapshot, or one or more named "bump X from A to B" upgrades — into one deterministic PASS/WARN/FAIL verdict formatted for a CI check or PR-comment bot, not a conversational report. Use when the user explicitly wants a mergeable/blocking verdict, a "CI gate," a PR status comment, or asks "should this PR be blocked," "is this safe to merge," "gate this dependency bump." Not for a plain explanation of what changed in a diff (dependency-audit's own snapshot-diff flow already covers that conversationally) and not for a single already-installed package's trust investigation (package-trust-check).
11e5c2aef79f0b96f0efc4d28626dde82f3ec275.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8341e41785b87c34d5897da552865f0ee7fd7bc9.description_zh: 在安装、升级或交付前审计项目 npm 依赖的已知漏洞、危险安装脚本及许可证合规，支持 package.json、lockfile、依赖名单和两份快照对比。
8341e41785b87c34d5897da552865f0ee7fd7bc9.source: Audit a project's npm dependencies for known vulnerabilities and risky install scripts before installing, upgrading, or shipping. Use when the user pastes or attaches a package.json/lockfile, lists dependencies, or asks to check/audit/scan their packages for security issues — including comparing two snapshots (a PR diff) or checking license compliance.
8341e41785b87c34d5897da552865f0ee7fd7bc9.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

74d57277ad212405c06b76b7081018c8a942b58c.description_zh: 把 npm 供应链可疑或已标记问题转成具体修复处置步骤，支持非技术性的异常描述；初始信任和漏洞调查使用对应技能。
74d57277ad212405c06b76b7081018c8a942b58c.source: Turn a flagged npm supply-chain finding — or just a vague, non-technical description of one ("this package looks sketchy," "someone said we got hacked," "npm install did something weird") — into concrete remediation steps. Use whenever the user wants to know what to actually do about a suspicious/compromised/flagged package, however precisely or vaguely they describe it — not for the initial trust/vulnerability investigation itself (see package-trust-check/dependency-audit for that).
74d57277ad212405c06b76b7081018c8a942b58c.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e58f3e74ae1482fd87e15c6357871db051bcde44.description_zh: 在安装新 npm 依赖前比较 2 至 5 个候选，或按需求及真实同类库评估单个候选并形成清单；不用于已用依赖审计或单包被攻陷调查。
e58f3e74ae1482fd87e15c6357871db051bcde44.source: Help decide what to add as a NEW npm dependency — comparing 2-5 named candidates for the same job, evaluating one named candidate against its real peers, or shortlisting candidates from a described need, before anything is installed. Use for "which should we use for X," "axios vs got vs node-fetch," "is X a good pick for Y," "what should we use to do Z," "should we add X or is there something better." Not for auditing packages already in the project (see dependency-audit), not for a deep single-package compromise/trust investigation (see package-trust-check), and not for a plain factual question with no choice being made ("what does X do").
e58f3e74ae1482fd87e15c6357871db051bcde44.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

939b93d2504640251217feb2229f27f03261668f.description_zh: 调查单个 npm 包的可信度，包括维护者或所有权接管、发布来源不一致和危险安装脚本；不用于整个依赖文件审计或仅解释包用途。
939b93d2504640251217feb2229f27f03261668f.source: Investigate whether one specific npm package is trustworthy — maintainer/ownership takeover signals, publish-provenance mismatches, and risky install scripts. Use when the user asks if a single named package is safe, compromised, hijacked, suspicious, or "can I trust this" — not for auditing a full package.json/lockfile (see dependency-audit) and not for a plain factual question like "what does X do.
939b93d2504640251217feb2229f27f03261668f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

2f3ed56e8e88577181ac1685d48c5246b0968c93.source: Register a bring-your-own-data (BYO-data) connector on a user''s NuBerea account so their own data becomes queryable through the NuBerea MCP server. Use this when a user asks to "connect my data", "add a data source", "register a connector", "expose my Hugging Face dataset / AWS data catalog to NuBerea", or to create the tenant → trust → connector → tool chain. This skill drives the NuBerea SDK CLI (`@nuberea/sdk`), which handles OAuth sign-in and the catalog control plane. Supports two connector kinds: hf_dataset (Hugging Face Parquet datasets, public or gated) and glue_athena (AWS Glue Data Catalog + Athena over the user''s own S3, via secretless OIDC trust).
2f3ed56e8e88577181ac1685d48c5246b0968c93.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5b8b1ea9ec4cd1956cdd21cf13cfaa7453a561fd.source: Configure OpenTelemetry context propagation (OTEL_PROPAGATORS) for services running in Kubernetes, especially when using mirrord to intercept or steal traffic. Use this skill whenever the user mentions OTEL_PROPAGATORS, OpenTelemetry propagators, trace context headers, W3C tracecontext, B3 headers, distributed tracing setup, OTel auto-instrumentation configuration, or configuring header propagation for mirrord sessions. Also trigger when someone asks about traceparent headers, baggage propagation, connecting local dev tracing to a cluster, or ensuring downstream services see the correct trace context when traffic is intercepted by mirrord. This skill covers env vars, Kubernetes Instrumentation CRDs, docker-compose, Spring Boot properties, and local dev config for mirrord users.

4624ab75e31a0de2b9fb334153f69914bd0d212a.source: Entry-point OneSignal onboarding skill. Use when a developer wants to add, install, integrate, initialize, or "set up" the OneSignal SDK in their own codebase (web, iOS, Android, React Native, Expo, Flutter, Cordova/Ionic/Capacitor, Unity) — triggers on "set up OneSignal", "add push notifications", "install the OneSignal SDK", "integrate OneSignal", "onboard onto OneSignal", or a fresh project with no OneSignal present. Supports one-command invocation with arguments, e.g. "/onesignal:setup app=<APP_ID>". Detects the platform/framework from project manifests, gates on push credentials FIRST (uploading them via the provisioning endpoint before any SDK code is written), installs and initializes the SDK, adds a debug-only verification helper, and hands off to the verify skill.
4624ab75e31a0de2b9fb334153f69914bd0d212a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

04fbc69f048e58fb3930561080b7ec306c1c37a9.description_zh: 端到端验证 OneSignal：构建运行应用，等待真实设备订阅、检查身份、发送真实测试推送并确认服务端投递；不安装 SDK 或上传凭据，缺失时转入对应技能。
04fbc69f048e58fb3930561080b7ec306c1c37a9.source: Closed-loop verification that a OneSignal integration actually works end to end — builds/runs the app, waits for the first real device subscription to register, checks identity, sends a real test push, and confirms server-side delivery. Use after the SDK-install or credentials skills have run, or whenever the user asks to "verify OneSignal works", "test push delivery", "prove the integration works", "why isn't my notification arriving", "confirm the device registered", "send myself a test notification", or is debugging an install that appears complete but delivers nothing. This is the "prove it works" step — it does NOT install the SDK or upload credentials; if those are missing it routes to the appropriate skill.
04fbc69f048e58fb3930561080b7ec306c1c37a9.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8db6802c838aae76ce1ac7c770411f6fba8db989.description_zh: 从英德文文章、零散想法、转录或笔记提取德文写作简报，供 schreibe-entwurf 规划长文；原说明强调这是信息提炼而非全文翻译。
8db6802c838aae76ce1ac7c770411f6fba8db989.source: Use when the user has raw material (English article, German article, brain dump in either language, transcript, mixed notes) and wants a German brief extracted from it as the planning artefact for a German article. Trigger on "analysiere quelle", "deutsche zusammenfassung", "brief auf deutsch", "extrahiere kern", or any explicit ask to prepare raw material for German long-form writing. Produces a German brief that schreibe-entwurf reads. Not for translation (the brief is in German but it is not a translation — it is an extraction).
8db6802c838aae76ce1ac7c770411f6fba8db989.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3363e5a8037adbf894da26af3053321a5420fb6d.description_zh: 将笔记、研究和要点组织成约 2,500 至 3,000 词的长博客、文章、随笔或专题；短文、微帖及已有结构的草稿分别使用对应技能。
3363e5a8037adbf894da26af3053321a5420fb6d.source: Use when the user has raw material (brain dump, notes, research, bullet points) and wants it shaped into a publishable long-form piece in the 2,500–3,000 word range — full blog post, article, essay, deep dive, or feature. For short-form posts (800–1,200 words, social/LinkedIn-length), use create-post. For platform-specific micro-posts, use distill. For existing long-form drafts that already have structure and need refinement, use improve-writing.
3363e5a8037adbf894da26af3053321a5420fb6d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

76571ccd732078496baa2e3430518aa867f8786a.description_zh: 把素材、提纲、转录或想法写成适合 Medium 的 800 至 1,200 词文章，并直接保存 Markdown，重视开场、章节流、读者留存、标题副标题及发布备注。
76571ccd732078496baa2e3430518aa867f8786a.source: Use when the user has raw material, notes, a brain dump, outline, transcript, or loose ideas and wants a Medium-ready 800-1,200 word article or essay saved directly as a Markdown file. Use for Medium-specific drafting with a stronger opening hook, compact sectioned flow, reader retention, title/subtitle treatment, and publication notes when needed. For generic 800-1,200 word short-form posts use create-post; for generic 2,500-3,000 word blog drafts use create-draft.
76571ccd732078496baa2e3430518aa867f8786a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

cdb263df0226c82f0965fd37f9ec2b08444b94fd.description_zh: 把无结构素材组织成约 800 至 1,200 词的社交、LinkedIn 或短博客文章；长文、已有草稿润色及平台微帖使用对应技能。
cdb263df0226c82f0965fd37f9ec2b08444b94fd.source: Use when the user has raw, unstructured material (brain dump, notes, bullet points, stream-of-consciousness) and wants it shaped into a publishable short-form post in the 800–1,200 word range (social, LinkedIn-length, short blog). For long-form pieces (2,500–3,000 words, full blog/article), use create-draft. For existing drafts that already have structure and need refinement, use improve-writing. For platform-specific micro-posts (X, Threads, Bluesky 280-char), use distill.
cdb263df0226c82f0965fd37f9ec2b08444b94fd.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1660fb701192f101ef18aeabf5ebf17bf1afa46d.description_zh: 按文章结构手册诊断慢开场、主旨模糊、信息揭示慢、生硬结尾、标题开场不符及节奏问题，只标记并建议修复，不做整体评分或重写。
1660fb701192f101ef18aeabf5ebf17bf1afa46d.source: Use when the user has a written piece (their own or someone else's) and wants structural issues flagged against the post-structure playbook — slow intros, blurring main points, low Rate of Revelation, forced conclusions, headline/intro mismatch, rhythm problems, and similar craft issues. Typically run after create-post, create-draft, or improve-writing produce a draft, or standalone when the user asks "what's wrong with this" / "where is this weak" / "run the checklist on this". Not for overall quality scoring (see rate) or for rewriting (see improve-writing) — diagnose only flags issues and suggests fixes.
1660fb701192f101ef18aeabf5ebf17bf1afa46d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

84d9dfd8edd486b7d6480dd3e907cb55d402aa60.description_zh: 帮助明确内容主题分类和专业领域，解决已有写作目的但不知道擅长主题或候选方向过多的问题；单次创意和受众动机使用对应技能。
84d9dfd8edd486b7d6480dd3e907cb55d402aa60.source: Use when the user has a sense of purpose but doesn't know which topics they actually own — or is stuck between too many possible topics and can't name their genius zone, content territory, or audience-level categories. Also use when the user asks to define, revisit, or refine their content buckets or expert zones. Not for one-off idea generation (see ideate) or for clarifying motivation and audience (see discover-purpose).
84d9dfd8edd486b7d6480dd3e907cb55d402aa60.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

9f7f55d88cc30ad4adb67293cbdd298f4212309e.description_zh: 明确在线写作目的、受众、观点和希望建立的认可，解决方向不清阻碍写作决策的问题；不用于主题发散或专业内容分类。
9f7f55d88cc30ad4adb67293cbdd298f4212309e.source: Use when the user can't articulate in one sentence why they write online, who it's for, or what they want to be known for — or when purpose-level confusion (no clear audience, POV, or direction) is blocking writing decisions. Also use when the user explicitly asks to define, revisit, or sharpen their writing purpose. Not for topic brainstorming (see ideate) or for mapping expertise into content categories (see discover-buckets).
9f7f55d88cc30ad4adb67293cbdd298f4212309e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

10834df5e9ead2e61a2d71d5eee06784833343de.description_zh: 确定调整用户写作语气，使输出贴近自然声音并匹配案例、记录、教程或清单等文章类型，减少通用机械表达；主题与目的使用对应技能。
10834df5e9ead2e61a2d71d5eee06784833343de.source: Use when the user's writing output sounds generic, AI-generated, or misaligned with their natural voice — or when they explicitly ask to define, revisit, or sharpen their writing tonality. Also use when content- producing skills (create-post, create-draft, distill, etc.) consistently produce output that "doesn't sound like me." Also use when output register mismatches the piece type — for example, a case study reading as an opinion piece, a descriptive build log drilling a thesis, instructional content meandering into essay, or a curated list turning into an argument for the favourite item. Not for defining what to write about (see discover-purpose) or which topics to own (see discover-buckets).
10834df5e9ead2e61a2d71d5eee06784833343de.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

930d87747de97fbda4e2da4f431f39987cccf700.description_zh: 将已有长文拆成独立社交内容，支持不超过 280 字符的微帖和 800 至 1,200 字符的 LinkedIn 短帖，可生成一种或两种；不用于从零构思或把原始素材写成完整文章。
930d87747de97fbda4e2da4f431f39987cccf700.source: Use when the user has a long-form piece (article, blog post, essay, draft) and wants it broken into shorter standalone posts in one of two modes: **Micros** (≤280 chars, for X / Bluesky / Threads / Mastodon) or **LinkedIn shorts** (800–1,200 chars). Produces one mode or both depending on the request. Also use for cross-posting or repurposing a single long piece into distributable social content. Not for generating new post ideas from scratch (see ideate) or for shaping raw material into a full post (see create-post for 800–1,200 *word* posts, create-draft for 2,500–3,000 *word* articles).
930d87747de97fbda4e2da4f431f39987cccf700.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d2fec7ec01b66f495eba8b00209f228a15e28591.description_zh: 在起草前深入展开一个写作想法，补充角度、论点、证据、案例、受众意义、故事、矛盾及商业关联；不用于同时生成多个独立点子。
d2fec7ec01b66f495eba8b00209f228a15e28591.source: Use when the user has one writing idea and wants to think it through before drafting, especially when the idea is still thin on angles, claims, evidence, examples, audience stakes, stories, contradictions, or business relevance. Also use when the user picked an idea from ideate and wants to go deeper before create-post / create-draft. Not for generating many separate ideas or turning finished material into a structured draft.
d2fec7ec01b66f495eba8b00209f228a15e28591.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e55ba0432b593ed0d9bfe8557e11aac9a2d4dab2.description_zh: 从零定义用户德文写作声音并生成德文 stil.md，调整不贴近本人语气的德文输出；原说明独立于 discover-tonality，不读取 tonality.md。
e55ba0432b593ed0d9bfe8557e11aac9a2d4dab2.source: Use when the user wants to define, revisit, or sharpen their German writing voice — or when German content-producing skills (schreibe-entwurf, future German skills) consistently produce output that doesn't sound like the user's German. Trigger on "finde meinen stil", "deutsche tonalität", "deutscher schreibstil", or any explicit ask to define how the user's German prose should sound. Independent of discover-tonality — this skill does not read tonality.md and produces stil.md from scratch in German.
e55ba0432b593ed0d9bfe8557e11aac9a2d4dab2.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

cf0ca888c52e63bc6d750f3f36aa439a94806f47.description_zh: 为已有草稿、主题简报或已发布文章生成和迭代标题，提供更鲜明备选；不用于整篇写作或质量诊断。
cf0ca888c52e63bc6d750f3f36aa439a94806f47.source: Use when the user wants headlines generated, workshopped, or iterated on — either for an existing draft, a topic brief without a draft yet, or a published piece that needs sharper options. Triggers include "give me headlines", "headline variants", "rework this title", "write headlines for", "titles for this post", "help me with the headline". Also use when a user shows a draft and asks what to call it, or when an existing headline underperforms and they want alternatives. Not for full-post generation (see create-post / create-draft) or for diagnosing a finished piece's quality (see rate / diagnose).
cf0ca888c52e63bc6d750f3f36aa439a94806f47.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ac5f07095fbe8f6e2306515297e42169f867a123.description_zh: 从主题、笔记、转录和文章中挖掘可发表的差异化内容概念，解决下一篇写什么的问题；单个想法展开和成稿使用对应技能。
ac5f07095fbe8f6e2306515297e42169f867a123.source: Use when the user has a topic but no specific posts to write about it, or hands over raw material (notes, transcripts, articles) and wants publishable post concepts mined out. Also use when the user is stuck on what to write next and needs sharp, differentiated angles. Not for expanding a single idea into drafting material (see explore-idea) or for writing the post itself (see create-post / create-draft).
ac5f07095fbe8f6e2306515297e42169f867a123.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

313d164f0b57b0c3455f04e01c325b494e1da537.description_zh: 为已写成文章配套横幅、页首、主图、章节插图或社交分享图，生成 Midjourney 提示词，可后接 article-image-flow 自动化；不用于其他生成器、图库搜索或图像编辑。
313d164f0b57b0c3455f04e01c325b494e1da537.source: Use when the user has a written piece that's missing accompanying imagery and needs visual assets to pair with it — banner, header, hero image, section illustration, social share graphic. Signals: the piece is publish-ready in words but has no imagery; the user mentions visuals, banners, or images to go with an article; the user is preparing a post for a platform that favours a hero image. This skill produces Midjourney prompts and may be followed by the `article-image-flow` automation for Midjourney submission, asset capture, and website wiring. Not for non-Midjourney generators, stock-photo search, or image editing. If the piece isn't written yet, use create-post or create-draft first.
313d164f0b57b0c3455f04e01c325b494e1da537.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f86ef90f40d08a7537cc3dbc0023d8d0c8d7d8fc.description_zh: 精修已有结构、章节或明确方向的草稿，收紧、重组、完善或完成表达；不用于无结构原始素材或成稿评分。
f86ef90f40d08a7537cc3dbc0023d8d0c8d7d8fc.source: Use when the user has an existing draft with some structure already in place — headers, partial sections, framework annotations, or a clear direction — and wants it refined, tightened, restructured, or finished. Signals include: draft feels flat or rough, sections trail off mid-thought, the writer can't name what's wrong but knows it's not ready. Not for raw unstructured input (see create-post / create-draft) or for rating a finished piece (see rate).
f86ef90f40d08a7537cc3dbc0023d8d0c8d7d8fc.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3d67eeeb809f083d5fad82852fc1f5b9706bbbd7.description_zh: 结构化评估文章或转录的质量与每分钟价值，判断是否值得阅读、是否可发布或比较版本；仅评估，不重写，也不替代结构问题诊断。
3d67eeeb809f083d5fad82852fc1f5b9706bbbd7.source: Use when the user needs a structured quality assessment of a written or transcribed piece — their own draft before publishing, someone else's article before reading/watching, or two versions of the same piece being compared. Signals include: "is this worth my time", "is this ready to ship", "how does this score", or any ask for VPM (value per minute) / quality dimensions. Not for rewriting or improving the piece (see improve-writing) and not for flagging structural craft issues against the checklist (see diagnose) — rate only evaluates.
3d67eeeb809f083d5fad82852fc1f5b9706bbbd7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a74e10264c9ad67a4e83f4b5bb5961a9899a65c8.description_zh: 把英文文章改写成自然德文版本，保留论证而重建句子；适用于博客、随笔和观点文章，不用于逐字翻译或德文转英文。
a74e10264c9ad67a4e83f4b5bb5961a9899a65c8.source: Use when the user wants an English article turned into a German version that reads as if it were originally written in German — not a word-for-word translation. Trigger on "übersetzen", "deutsche Version", "auf Deutsch", "German version", or any EN→DE language transfer for articles, blog posts, essays, or thought-leadership content. Also trigger when the user pastes or links an English markdown article and asks for it in German. Not for DE→EN (reverse direction) or for word-for-word translation — this skill produces native German prose that preserves the argument but rebuilds the sentences.
a74e10264c9ad67a4e83f4b5bb5961a9899a65c8.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8767d157cd58be7436ca844da40121c80c49f0d5.description_zh: 依据已有德文简报撰写约 2,500 至 3,000 词长文；原始素材先询问是否做 analysiere-quelle，原说明中的德文短文和微帖技能尚属未来计划。
8767d157cd58be7436ca844da40121c80c49f0d5.source: Use when the user has a German brief (produced by analysiere-quelle, or hand-written) and wants a long-form German article in the 2,500–3,000 word range — full Blog-Beitrag, Fachartikel, Essay, or Tiefenbeitrag. Trigger on "schreibe entwurf", "deutscher entwurf", "langform auf deutsch", or any explicit ask to draft a long-form German piece from a brief. Requires a German brief as input — if the user hands raw material instead, ask whether to run analysiere-quelle first. For short-form posts (800–1,200 words) use the (future) schreibe-post skill. For platform micro-posts use destilliere (future).
8767d157cd58be7436ca844da40121c80c49f0d5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

14e92d51a69f0f25d7bbe143ff7456b4bc936aa2.description_zh: 为已有长文生成约 100 至 150 词的单段摘要，保持作者语气与原文语域，帮助读者判断是否阅读全文；不用于营销预告、SEO 简介或拆分社交帖子。
14e92d51a69f0f25d7bbe143ff7456b4bc936aa2.source: Use when the user has a long-form article (their own draft, typically 2,500–3,000 words) and wants a single-paragraph abstract for the top of the piece. Triggers: "tldr", "abstract this", "write an abstract for", "synopsis of this draft", "summarize this article". Produces ~100–150 words, neutral synthesis register, in the user's voice and the source's register — functions as a hybrid academic abstract / synopsis that lets a reader decide whether to commit to the full piece. Not for: distilling into multiple shorter posts (see distill), rating quality (see rate), generating headlines (see headlines), structural diagnostics (see diagnose), or marketing teasers / meta descriptions / SEO blurbs (different register, out of scope).
14e92d51a69f0f25d7bbe143ff7456b4bc936aa2.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

37ee551e77d64c607336a0e519f6e0f0075041fe.description_zh: 用 Open Voice Shield 检查路线来电号码传递，查询国家覆盖并拨打测试号码，判断匹配、改写、隐藏或缺失，也可登记托管号码按测试获取收益。
37ee551e77d64c607336a0e519f6e0f0075041fe.source: Verify caller ID delivery on a route with Open Voice Shield - check which countries are covered, run a CLI check that dials a number in the target country with a chosen caller ID and reports what arrived (match, modified, withheld, missing), and host a number to earn per check. Use when someone asks whether their caller ID is delivered intact, whether a vendor strips or rewrites CLI, or wants to enrol a number.
37ee551e77d64c607336a0e519f6e0f0075041fe.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b5b74e528bb21023cd54c41e6f608b3104423a9e.description_zh: 审阅 Open Voice Shield 已分析的拦截或待审通话，读取判定、风险标记、转录及 PDF，并处理来电者；用于夜间异常、拦截原因和投诉证据。
b5b74e528bb21023cd54c41e6f608b3104423a9e.source: Review analysed calls on Open Voice Shield - list calls scored block or review, read a call's verdict, red flags, transcript and PDF report, and act on the caller. Use when someone asks what was flagged overnight, why a call was blocked, what a caller said, or wants evidence for a complaint or a TCPA case.
b5b74e528bb21023cd54c41e6f608b3104423a9e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

565adfdc4739669fd5a822ea6c551f92a1f0fae4.description_zh: 通过 MCP 完成 Open Voice Shield 账号连接、呼叫目的地、路由、IP 白名单、webhook 和告警，最后以人员确认的测试电话验证返回判定。
565adfdc4739669fd5a822ea6c551f92a1f0fae4.source: Set up an Open Voice Shield account end to end with the MCP tools - sign in, the destination calls go on to, routing, IP whitelist, webhook, alerts, then a test call the person confirms that proves a verdict comes back. Use when someone wants to connect their switch, carrier or PBX to Open Voice Shield, or asks how to get started with call fraud analysis on a SIP trunk.
565adfdc4739669fd5a822ea6c551f92a1f0fae4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

0de0133511c58ab4f6dbf69a0a9d2bf38f92a528.description_zh: 通过人员确认的测试电话检查 Open Voice Shield 供应商路线或 SIP 目的地，读取拨号与应答延迟、估算 MOS、抖动、丢包和虚假应答告警。
0de0133511c58ab4f6dbf69a0a9d2bf38f92a528.source: Test a vendor route or a destination through Open Voice Shield - request a test call the person confirms, read post-dial delay, answer delay, estimated MOS, jitter and packet loss per leg, and any false answer supervision (FAS) alert. Use when someone asks whether a route is good, whether a carrier is cheating with fake answer, or wants to check call quality on a SIP destination.
0de0133511c58ab4f6dbf69a0a9d2bf38f92a528.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e62bca7fe3647abd10f8e55a8570545998bd5497.description_zh: 用 OpenClip 为已有不超过三分钟的短视频烧录动态字幕，返回带字幕 MP4，支持指定样式；需要先剪辑的长视频使用 clip-video。
e62bca7fe3647abd10f8e55a8570545998bd5497.source: Add animated captions to a short video the user already has, with OpenClip, and get back a captioned MP4. Use when the user wants captions or subtitles burned into a finished short video (up to 3 minutes), such as a talking-head clip, a Reel, a TikTok, or a UGC clip, especially a local file, or asks to caption it in a specific style like Chase, Sweep, Stamp, or Glass. For a long video that should be cut into clips first, use the clip-video skill instead.

075f7a588619fb77cd73fc93e9e629a63933c55d.description_zh: 将 YouTube、Vimeo、云盘或直接链接的长视频剪成竖屏短片，选择精彩片段并渲染字幕，支持查看之前处理视频的进度。
075f7a588619fb77cd73fc93e9e629a63933c55d.source: Turn a long video into short vertical clips with OpenClip, then render the chosen ones with captions. Use when the user shares a YouTube, Vimeo, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Rumble, or direct video link and asks to clip it, find the best or viral moments, make shorts, TikToks, Reels, or YouTube Shorts from it, or render a clip with captions. Also use when they ask how an earlier OpenClip video is doing.
075f7a588619fb77cd73fc93e9e629a63933c55d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

cb76979dd67f537de7e71278cce4f81bbb35d2a1.description_zh: 依据已处理 OpenClip 视频的转录和片段撰写帖子、配文、引语、摘要、长串帖或 newsletter 简介，并查找某话题出现的位置。
cb76979dd67f537de7e71278cce4f81bbb35d2a1.source: Write posts, captions, quotes, and summaries from a processed OpenClip video's transcript and clips. Use when the user asks what was said at a point in a video, wants a quote or pull-quote, a caption or social post for a clip, a thread or newsletter blurb from a video, or asks to find where a topic comes up in something OpenClip has processed.
cb76979dd67f537de7e71278cce4f81bbb35d2a1.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

24e67a2ac33231dea03cf6762ef6c43af7fdc4b3.description_zh: 在渲染前设计广告开场、时长匹配的节奏脚本、镜头语言故事板及单变量测试，并以具体发现审阅草稿；不调用工具或服务器，不直接生成媒体。
24e67a2ac33231dea03cf6762ef6c43af7fdc4b3.source: Teaches how to make ads that work, before anything is rendered: hooks for the opening moment, beat maps and scripts timed to the film''s length, storyboards in plain shot language, what makes a creator video read as real, how to test one change at a time, and how to review a draft as findings rather than a score. Names no model, calls no tool, and never needs the server. Use when: "write a hook", "five hooks for", "UGC script", "storyboard this ad", "shot list", "what makes a good video ad", "improve my brief", "what should I test next", "ad copy ideas", "review this ad". NOT for: generating an image or video (openclips-image-ads, openclips-video-ads, openclips-clips), copy written onto an existing creative by the server (openclips-edit), a listing or a software demo brief that is ready to render (openclips-real-estate, openclips-saas-explainer), anything about credits, models or endpoints (openclips, openclips-api).
24e67a2ac33231dea03cf6762ef6c43af7fdc4b3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

be99f9beec79c2f047da08b2a5de55e20271a123.description_zh: 通过 OpenClips list_endpoints/call_api 或带个人令牌的用户代码访问其他技能未覆盖的端点，如文件夹、删除、时间线、环境和工作流；不用于广告投放或营销表现查询。
be99f9beec79c2f047da08b2a5de55e20271a123.source: Reaches any OpenClips endpoint: through the connected server''s list_endpoints and call_api for what no other skill covers (folders, deleting, video projects and the timeline editor, environments, voices, workflow runs, any route in the OpenAPI catalogue), and from the user''s own code with a personal access token sent as X-Auth-Token against api.openclips.ai. Use when: "OpenClips API", "X-Auth-Token", "integrate OpenClips into my app", "call it from Python", "api.openclips.ai", "openapi.json", "put these in a folder", "delete this creative", "edit the video timeline", "which endpoint does that". NOT for: anything a spoke already covers, which stays with that spoke and its gate (openclips-image-ads, openclips-video-ads, openclips-clips, openclips-edit, openclips-brand-intel, openclips-real-estate, openclips-saas-explainer, openclips-ecommerce), running ads or reading campaign performance (not offered: OpenClips makes creative and does not deliver it).
be99f9beec79c2f047da08b2a5de55e20271a123.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

597559914fba5c2a43dceb5fe8ab763ca470bd19.description_zh: 从 URL 或手工在 OpenClips 导入产品，更新名称、价格、说明与图片；品牌随产品生成且不能直接创建编辑，整店、房产和媒体修改使用对应技能。
597559914fba5c2a43dceb5fe8ab763ca470bd19.source: Gets products into an OpenClips workspace and keeps them current: imports a product from its URL, creates one by hand when there is no page, and updates name, price, description or images. Use when: "add my product", "import this product URL", "set up my brand", "add this product to OpenClips", "create a product from these photos", "update the product image", "change the price of my product", "is this product already in my workspace". NOT for: generating anything from a product that is already there (openclips-image-ads, openclips-video-ads, openclips-clips), a property listing (openclips-real-estate), a whole store''s catalogue (openclips-ecommerce), deleting a product (openclips-api), editing a creative rather than a product (openclips-edit).
597559914fba5c2a43dceb5fe8ab763ca470bd19.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

76fa5d95d267aee0ab7da4a5251052cdfbebc72b.description_zh: 通过 OpenClips clips 通道生成创作者讲解、证言、开箱、前后对比、多语言同片、双人对话、电影或纸拼贴营销视频；软件演示、房产和无人物普通视频使用对应技能。
76fa5d95d267aee0ab7da4a5251052cdfbebc72b.source: Makes specialised marketing films with OpenClips on the clips lanes: a talking creator, a testimonial, an unboxing or before-and-after, the same film per language, two people talking, a cinematic commercial, or a paper-collage film. Use when: "UGC video", "a creator talking about my product", "testimonial video", "unboxing video", "before and after video", "the same ad in Spanish and German", "two people talking", "cinematic commercial", "paper collage video", "use this avatar". NOT for: a bare video ad with no person or named style (openclips-video-ads), an explainer or app demo for software, including a presenter over app screens (openclips-saas-explainer), a property tour (openclips-real-estate), a still image (openclips-image-ads), creator videos across many products (openclips-ecommerce), changing a film that exists (openclips-edit), a product not yet in the workspace (openclips-brand-intel), a script or storyboard with nothing to shoot (openclips-ad-craft).

Catches silent data loss, content corrupted in transit, stale re-shipped output, and journal entries that claim a delivery that never happened. Use when someone asks whether a load, sync, ETL run, or migration actually worked.
2150c639b8dc5b9e50baca5aecc2c72eb936814e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ce7de289681b797f071ceae57ff4ce71ee2b1467.description_zh: 首次为 Rails 应用建立 docs/primitives/，生成 SCHEMA.md、index.md、capabilities/，通过只读代码调查和结构化访谈起草由人负责的 compilation.md。适用于建立长期意图、编译、评估和来源记录；后续维护和补填由 maintaining-primitives 处理。
ce7de289681b797f071ceae57ff4ce71ee2b1467.source: One-time adoption of the primitives tree in a Rails app: scaffold docs/primitives/ (SCHEMA.md, index.md, capabilities/) and draft the human-owned compilation.md via a read-only codebase survey followed by a structured interview. Use when a repo has no docs/primitives/ tree and the team wants durable intent/compilation/evaluations/provenance, or when the user says set up primitives, adopt primitives, or generate compilation. Recurring maintenance and backfill belong to maintaining-primitives, not here.
ce7de289681b797f071ceae57ff4ce71ee2b1467.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

18bfcc4fe92d8685149ebc5f12a231db725cb12c.description_zh: 在计划或编码前梳理 Rails 功能和行为设计，解决范围不明、多种方向、HTML/JSON、状态归属、REST/RPC、过早引入服务对象或 SPA，以及前端重复业务规则等问题。适用于希望遵循 DHH/37signals 默认架构的应用。
18bfcc4fe92d8685149ebc5f12a231db725cb12c.source: Use when shaping Rails features or behavior changes before planning or code — unclear scope, multiple valid directions, HTML vs JSON, client-owned vs server-owned truth, REST vs RPC-shaped endpoints, premature service objects or SPA layers, or duplication of business rules in JavaScript. Symptoms include reaching for new gems or microservices first, CRUD flows dressed as bespoke protocols, or designs that would fight omakase defaults in a 37signals-shaped app.
18bfcc4fe92d8685149ebc5f12a231db725cb12c.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

981ff7ccff20077a3dbda79d0afe495a71c7d7f3.description_zh: 按 DHH/37signals 风格编排书面 Rails 方案，委派实现及评审并循环到 Approved，本技能自身不写应用代码。逐步模式每项通过后暂停供用户检查提交；执行后的修改也采用相同实现与评审循环。
981ff7ccff20077a3dbda79d0afe495a71c7d7f3.source: Orchestrates execution of a written Rails implementation plan in a DHH / 37signals omakase style without writing application code: delegates each task to pitchd-rails-implementor, reviews via pitchd-rails-reviewer, and loops on feedback until Approved. In step-by-step mode it then stops after each Approved task so the user can review and commit it before the next one starts, keeping the reviewable unit small. Use when the user says execute the plan, run the plan, implement the plan, ship planned tasks, or wants a subset of plan tasks done in full with Pitchd conventions. Also handles post-execution revision requests — when the user says something needs changing, isn''t right, or requests a fix after the skill has run, treat it as a self-contained revision task and run the same implement → review loop.
981ff7ccff20077a3dbda79d0afe495a71c7d7f3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b7d213c7701ad380a0db8fc638a95a98a30fdf94.description_zh: 按 Pitchd 插件约定实现 Rails 方案中的单项任务、纵向切片或限定功能，先采用 rails-omakase-compass，再按相应 writing-* 技能和 rules/*.mdc 落地。原说明将隔离委派交给 pitchd-rails-implementor 子智能体。
b7d213c7701ad380a0db8fc638a95a98a30fdf94.source: Implement a plan task in a Rails app using Pitchd plugin conventions: first rails-omakase-compass (DHH / 37signals-shaped omakase), then applicable writing-* skills and rules/*.mdc for tactics. Use when executing a single task from an implementation plan, a vertical slice, or a scoped feature. For isolated delegation, use the pitchd-rails-implementor subagent (see agents/pitchd-rails-implementor.md).
b7d213c7701ad380a0db8fc638a95a98a30fdf94.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1c5098d44a2d14ff7dd2670069d9296973620401.description_zh: 维护 docs/primitives/ 中长期保留的能力文档，记录意图条款、形态约束、评估映射及只追加来源，同时维护由人负责的 compilation.md。支持从代码和规范补录能力、带引用追溯原因、同步状态及检查覆盖与孤立项；不用于写应用代码或方案，首次初始化使用 bootstrapping-primitives。
1c5098d44a2d14ff7dd2670069d9296973620401.source: Maintain the durable primitives tree under docs/primitives/ — capability docs holding intent clauses, shape constraints, evaluation maps, and append-only provenance, plus the human-owned compilation.md. Operations: capture (backfill a capability doc from existing code and specs), trace (answer "why is X like this" with citations), update (sync status, evaluations, provenance), lint (size limits, clause/eval coverage, orphans). Use when backfilling historical features, answering provenance questions, or running a health pass — not for writing app code or plans. For one-time adoption setup use bootstrapping-primitives; for delegation use pitchd-rails-primitives-maintainer.
1c5098d44a2d14ff7dd2670069d9296973620401.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

679017789d1248a00e359c9c6709c50736e7b2f0.description_zh: 为 Pitchd 风格 Rails 架构选择提供高层判断，关注默认约定、服务器状态归属、REST、单体结构及简化或拆分时机。适用于架构讨论、HTML/API 取舍或偏离 Rails 的设计；具体实现交由 writing-*，不负责语法、方案模板或文件布局。
679017789d1248a00e359c9c6709c50736e7b2f0.source: High-level decision lens for Rails work in the Pitchd plugin tradition — omakase defaults, server-owned truth, REST gravity, majestic monolith, and when to simplify vs extract. Use before debating architecture, when choosing HTML vs API, or when a change feels "off-Rails"; defers HOW to writing-* skills and rules/*.mdc. Not for Stimulus/Turbo syntax, plan templates, or file layout.
679017789d1248a00e359c9c6709c50736e7b2f0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d8d1c76b165906b7063d872bf765d67c285788a2.description_zh: 按 Rails 测试分层约定重构已有 RSpec 套件，发现相关测试、按 Five Gates 和层级职责审计，再移动、合并、删除或重写，使每个行为只有一处归属，并保留覆盖和通过状态。适用于过重系统测试、浏览器测试过多或运行缓慢；新增未测代码测试和无关失败排查使用 writing-tests。
d8d1c76b165906b7063d872bf765d67c285788a2.source: Refactor an existing RSpec suite — typically a batch of bloated system specs and their related request, model, policy, job, mailer, concern, and factory specs — into a Rails best-practice test suite per writing-tests and rules/testing.mdc. Discover related specs, audit each test against the Five Gates and per-layer ownership, then move, merge, delete, or rewrite tests so each behaviour has exactly one home. Verify the suite is green and coverage is preserved. Use when the user mentions refactoring tests, rebalancing specs, "the system specs are too heavy", "we have too many browser tests", reducing test runtime, cleaning up a drifting test suite, or porting an older suite to current plugin conventions. Not for writing new specs for untested code (use writing-tests) or for fixing failing specs unrelated to layering (debug them in writing-tests).
d8d1c76b165906b7063d872bf765d67c285788a2.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

09e4b8df2b10a6b06e04d3ed48aba65983299474.description_zh: 审计并重构 Rails 现有 Stimulus 控制器，按单一职责、DOM 派生状态、生命周期清理和耦合规则决定合并或拆分。结构调整后为每种行为在最简单页面保留一项规范系统测试；新控制器使用 writing-javascript，服务器测试重构使用 refactoring-rails-specs。
09e4b8df2b10a6b06e04d3ed48aba65983299474.source: Audit and refactor an existing fleet of Stimulus controllers in a Rails app — discover every controller, score each against single-responsibility, DOM-derived state, lifecycle cleanup, and cross-controller coupling rules, then merge or split as appropriate. After the structural refactor, ensure each Stimulus behaviour has exactly one canonical system spec on the simplest page that exercises it, per writing-tests. Use when the user mentions refactoring Stimulus, "the Stimulus controllers are a mess", consolidating duplicate JS behaviour, splitting a god controller, or filling in Stimulus spec coverage. Not for writing brand-new controllers from scratch (use writing-javascript) or refactoring server-side specs (use refactoring-rails-specs).
09e4b8df2b10a6b06e04d3ed48aba65983299474.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6932a1161c47b95a5cd75cdb13f6c187b5cc0500.description_zh: 先从 GitHub API 获取官方 Rails 指南目录，再读取匹配主题的原始 Markdown，以获得可靠 API 或功能说明。适用于插件规则不足时查官方文档，原说明禁止把编造内容当作官方材料。
6932a1161c47b95a5cd75cdb13f6c187b5cc0500.source: Load specific topics from the official Rails guides (rails/rails on GitHub) via two fetches: first the GitHub API directory index to discover available filenames, then the raw markdown for the matched guide. Never invent or paraphrase content as if it came from the official docs. Use when you need authoritative Rails API or feature documentation beyond this plugin''s rules.
6932a1161c47b95a5cd75cdb13f6c187b5cc0500.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

990fb7198b3ca141c987cd404668909417ee1e26.description_zh: 根据 marckohlbrugge/37signals-skills 的 README 目录选择主题，仅获取所需 GitHub 原始 Markdown。适用于补充插件之外的 Fizzy 风格实践；读取失败须报告，不以记忆内容冒充指南。
990fb7198b3ca141c987cd404668909417ee1e26.source: Load specific topics from marckohlbrugge/37signals-skills (formerly unofficial-37signals-coding-style-guide) via HTTP fetch of raw GitHub markdown only — use the README table of contents to choose paths (guide topics live under guide/, agent skills under skills/); fetch the minimum needed; if a fetch fails, stop and report (never invent or paraphrase from memory as if it were the guide). Use when you need external Fizzy-derived patterns beyond this plugin’s rules and skills.
990fb7198b3ca141c987cd404668909417ee1e26.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

bcabe8c866afb47ec19eb0e2abfd5b151dffc845.description_zh: 在读取 Pitchd 插件内部 rules、相邻技能或智能体文件前，解析正确路径前缀，兼容 Cursor 与 Claude Code 不同的相对路径规则。同一轮首次读取时处理一次，之后无需重复检查。
bcabe8c866afb47ec19eb0e2abfd5b151dffc845.source: Resolves the correct path prefix for reading this plugin's own files — rules/*.mdc, sibling skills/*/SKILL.md, agents/*.md — before a Read call on one of them. Needed because this plugin runs both as a Cursor plugin and as a Claude Code plugin, and the two resolve plain relative paths differently. Use once, right before the first Read of a plugin-internal file in a given turn; no need to re-check for later reads in the same turn.
bcabe8c866afb47ec19eb0e2abfd5b151dffc845.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b03d84a8fb542ce4d123595526f842a9f5f6beb0.description_zh: 按 Pitchd 插件约定评审 Rails 方案或实现，先检查 rails-omakase-compass 的方案形态，再检查相关 writing-* 技能和规则。适用于代码、方案、PR 或合并前评审；隔离委派可用 pitchd-rails-reviewer。
b03d84a8fb542ce4d123595526f842a9f5f6beb0.source: Review Rails plans and/or implementation against the Pitchd plugin: first rails-omakase-compass (solution shape), then applicable writing-* skills and rules (tactics). Use when requesting a code review, plan review, PR review, or sign-off before merge. For isolated delegation with a clean context, use the pitchd-rails-reviewer subagent (see `agents/pitchd-rails-reviewer.md`).
b03d84a8fb542ce4d123595526f842a9f5f6beb0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

113b3e5f6e36a0fe69fd8a4efd814e07b31bec07.description_zh: 运行 RuboCop 并通过修改代码消除全部违规，不使用内联或配置禁用。适用于 Ruby/Rake lint 或评审前核验；罕见无法修复的问题需阻止并升级处理。
113b3e5f6e36a0fe69fd8a4efd814e07b31bec07.source: Run RuboCop until zero offences: bin/rubocop green, fix code only (no inline or config disables). Block and escalate rare unfixable cases. Use when linting Ruby/Rake, verifying before review, or the user mentions RuboCop.
113b3e5f6e36a0fe69fd8a4efd814e07b31bec07.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a79594bec095f21477e73b67491aab861da885a7.description_zh: 按 DHH/37signals 约定编写 Rails 控制器，采用轻量 CRUD、REST 资源、优先重定向的 Hotwire 响应、共享行为 concern 及 params.expect 强参数。适用于新增控制器、action、Turbo 响应或 REST 路由。
a79594bec095f21477e73b67491aab861da885a7.source: Write Rails controllers following DHH/37signals conventions — thin CRUD controllers, REST-mapped resources, redirect-first Hotwire responses, concerns for shared behaviour, and strong parameters with params.expect. Use when creating new controllers, adding actions, extracting concerns, handling Turbo responses, or when the user mentions controllers, actions, strong parameters, or REST routing.
a79594bec095f21477e73b67491aab861da885a7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

55d8e0ea2b3d14e1197953732744e56e16f8cf6b.description_zh: 按 Rails 方式使用 Tailwind，覆盖 tailwindcss-rails、CSS 入口、v3/v4 配置、@apply、主题、响应式、深色模式、无障碍及 Stimulus 类切换。采用 ERB 工具类和 partial，Hotwire 优先界面不使用 CSS-in-JS；模板和 JS 管线由对应技能处理。
55d8e0ea2b3d14e1197953732744e56e16f8cf6b.source: Style Rails apps with Tailwind the Rails way — tailwindcss-rails, CSS entrypoints, v3 vs v4 config shapes, @apply policy, theme extension, responsive/dark conventions, accessibility, Stimulus class toggles. DHH/37signals: utility-first markup in ERB (see writing-views), partials over parallel design systems, no CSS-in-JS for Hotwire-first UIs. Use when editing Tailwind config, application stylesheets, global CSS, or clarifying styling vs views (templates) and javascript (asset pipeline).
55d8e0ea2b3d14e1197953732744e56e16f8cf6b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

cde524cf44ca664f6540fd74e35a328b0f87f58b.description_zh: 以服务器渲染 HTML 为状态依据构建 Hotwire 界面，使用 Turbo Drive、Frames、Streams、morphing、广播及小型 Stimulus 控制器。按重定向、frame、stream 的优先次序设计，适用于实时更新、弹窗和行内编辑，并避免意外形成 SPA。
cde524cf44ca664f6540fd74e35a328b0f87f58b.source: Build Hotwire-first UIs — Turbo Drive, Frames, Streams, morphing, broadcasts, and Stimulus — with server-rendered HTML as the source of truth. DHH/37signals style: redirect before frames before streams; small Stimulus controllers; no accidental SPA. Use when adding Turbo frames or streams, Stimulus behaviour, real-time updates, modal/inline-edit flows, or when front-end work drifts toward client-side routing or JSON-first CRUD for same-origin pages.
cde524cf44ca664f6540fd74e35a328b0f87f58b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

730f22ddf717cb875a5249843c8124cc0c8b7f9d.description_zh: 组织 Rails I18n 的 YAML、视图延迟查找、helper/控制器绝对键、插值、复数、日期数字格式及 Active Record 错误信息。适用于语言包、ERB 文案、flash 和验证消息，避免模板字符串拼接；不负责翻译供应商工具或 SPA i18n-js。
730f22ddf717cb875a5249843c8124cc0c8b7f9d.source: Organize Rails I18n — YAML structure, lazy lookup in views, absolute keys in helpers and controllers, interpolation and pluralization, datetime/number formats, and Active Record error messages. DHH/37signals style: boring keys, framework-first, no string concatenation in templates. Use when adding or changing locales, extracting user-facing copy from ERB, flash messages, or validation messages; not for translation vendor tooling or SPA i18n-js. Triggers: locales, config/locales YAML, t(), I18n.t, missing translations, flash copy, human_attribute_name.
730f22ddf717cb875a5249843c8124cc0c8b7f9d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8da54a0851ad872349845deeb02e57b3ad92235a.description_zh: 按 Rails 默认方式编写 JavaScript，优先 importmap，必要时采用 esbuild/Vite，使用聚焦的 Stimulus 控制器、ES 模块、无障碍 DOM 更新及带 CSRF 的安全请求。适用于 JS 交付与模块；模板 Hotwire 行为、CSS 和 ERB 分别由对应技能处理，既有控制器重构另有专门技能。
8da54a0851ad872349845deeb02e57b3ad92235a.source: Write JavaScript in a Rails app the omakase way — importmap-first delivery, optional bundling (esbuild, Vite) when justified, focused Stimulus controllers under app/javascript/controllers, modern ES module hygiene, accessible DOM updates, safe fetching with CSRF, and a clear boundary with Turbo/HTML. DHH / 37signals style. Use when editing importmap, package.json, application.js, Stimulus controllers, shared JS modules, or choosing bundling; not for Hotwire/Turbo *behaviour in templates* (see writing-hotwire), Tailwind/config/global CSS (see writing-css-tailwind), or ERB markup (see writing-views). For rebalancing an existing Stimulus fleet (merging, splitting, spec coverage), see refactoring-stimulus-controllers.
8da54a0851ad872349845deeb02e57b3ad92235a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

493c6424920fe8b303e63d7cac7c31b32f431ff7.description_zh: 按 DHH/37signals 约定编写 Rails 后台作业，采用委派模型方法的轻量 job、幂等执行、after_commit 时点及明确重试规则。适用于 ActiveJob、排期、异步处理和队列。
493c6424920fe8b303e63d7cac7c31b32f431ff7.source: Write Rails background jobs following DHH/37signals conventions — thin jobs that delegate to model methods, idempotent execution, after_commit timing, and retry discipline. Use when writing ActiveJob subclasses, scheduling background work, handling async processing, or when the user mentions jobs, queues, background processing, perform_later, or ActiveJob.
493c6424920fe8b303e63d7cac7c31b32f431ff7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5623c4e1c7bf00465164f74ca0d8eace79da7a02.description_zh: 编写 ActionMailer、邮件模板及预览，采用轻量类、Mailer.with 参数化、deliver_later、HTML/文本多格式、主题 I18n 和开发预览。适用于邮件代码、文案或测试；不负责 SMTP 提供方设置和 Action Mailbox 入站邮件。
5623c4e1c7bf00465164f74ca0d8eace79da7a02.source: Write ActionMailer classes, mailer templates, and previews following DHH/37signals conventions — thin mailers, parameterized Mailer.with, deliver_later, multipart HTML/text, I18n for subjects, and previews for development. Use when creating or changing mailers, mailer views, email copy, or mailer specs; not for SMTP provider setup or Action Mailbox inbound mail.
5623c4e1c7bf00465164f74ca0d8eace79da7a02.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

952c47130aa46915cc5bc3aa304ac2777b6f101d.description_zh: 编写可逆的 Rails 数据库迁移，用数据库约束保障完整性并安全操作在线表，原说明要求不修改历史迁移。适用于列、索引、约束和模式变更。
952c47130aa46915cc5bc3aa304ac2777b6f101d.source: Write Rails database migrations following DHH/37signals conventions — reversible changes, database constraints as the source of integrity, safe operations on live tables, and never editing past migrations. Use when creating or modifying migrations, adding columns or indexes, changing constraints, or when the user mentions migrations, schema changes, or database columns.
952c47130aa46915cc5bc3aa304ac2777b6f101d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

654ec8d5ad0e95c2dfb21cd9eaf0f1fbd9e5c0eb.description_zh: 按 DHH/37signals 约定编写 Rails 模型，采用丰富领域模型、横向 concern、以记录表示状态、scope、数据库约束及原生 Rails 模式。适用于模型方法、回调、领域逻辑及重构。
654ec8d5ad0e95c2dfb21cd9eaf0f1fbd9e5c0eb.source: Write Rails models following DHH/37signals conventions — rich domain models, concerns for horizontal behaviour, state-as-records, scopes, database constraints, and vanilla Rails patterns. Use when creating new models, adding model methods, extracting concerns, refactoring model logic, or when the user mentions models, concerns, scopes, callbacks, or domain logic.
654ec8d5ad0e95c2dfb21cd9eaf0f1fbd9e5c0eb.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8eaa817c0a41da01a027187ba455b4414016bde9.description_zh: 按 Rails 和 DHH/37signals 领域语言为文件、类、方法、列、路由及变量命名。覆盖模型、concern、控制器、job、mailer、策略、数据库和测试等层次，适用于新建、重命名和命名评审。
8eaa817c0a41da01a027187ba455b4414016bde9.source: Name files, classes, methods, columns, routes, and variables following Rails conventions and DHH/37signals domain language. Covers how to write the action prompt, how to generate composition-locked end frames with add_slide_image (reference params, consistent-frames mode), the journey overridePrompt template for bridged renders, and a failure-modes table.
1224a6eff634a966c3de05113f12984104903b9e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ba094e1726abc55c0f53c4fa3c06a02a7f0d9e11.description_zh: 在 Poppify 返回成片 videoUrl 后，下载 MP4、用 ffprobe 检查并抽取样帧，生成 Markdown 判定表。适用于核验音轨、字幕、文本颜色、时长及具体幻灯片输出。
ba094e1726abc55c0f53c4fa3c06a02a7f0d9e11.source: Verify a rendered Poppify reel by downloading the MP4, running ffprobe, and extracting sample frames. Use after confirm() returns videoUrl, OR when the user says: "check the video", "verify the reel", "is the render OK", "the video looks wrong", "missing audio", "no music", "no sound", "captions missing", "captions wrong color", "text is wrong color", "wrong duration", "video is too short", "video is too long", "no captions on slide N", or any similar verification / debugging request on a finished Poppify render. Produces a Markdown verdict table.
ba094e1726abc55c0f53c4fa3c06a02a7f0d9e11.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a7ca20448600634825dc9d3e7d778b0d4f3834d5.description_zh: 通过 Poppify MCP 按互动或触达目标发布和排期成片，解读基于真实历史或平台常规的推荐时段、best 排期、时段评价、最佳内容类型及多帖间隔。需要已关联钱包并在 Poppify 应用连接发布渠道。
a7ca20448600634825dc9d3e7d778b0d4f3834d5.source: Engagement/reach-optimized publishing via the Poppify MCP. Use whenever the user wants to POST or SCHEDULE a rendered reel and cares about performance — "post this", "schedule it", "when should I post", "best time to post", "maximize engagement", "maximize reach", "post at the best time", "optimize my posting schedule", "when does my audience engage". Covers publish_post recommendedSlots (real engagement history vs platform norms), scheduledAt:"best", slotAssessment interpretation, per-slot bestPostType, and multi-post spacing. Requires a linked wallet (wallet({action:"link"})) with channels connected in the Poppify app.
a7ca20448600634825dc9d3e7d778b0d4f3834d5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e17924721ac6e9ee8785df06b06dfa1a5d984741.description_zh: 检查已部署 Poppify MCP 工具模式，核对真实接受的参数并比较文档差异。适用于参数被忽略、patch 未生效、覆盖项未使用或建议未确认参数前。
e17924721ac6e9ee8785df06b06dfa1a5d984741.source: Inspect the deployed Poppify MCP tool schemas to verify what parameters are actually accepted. Use when: a parameter you passed seems to have been silently dropped, an apply_session_patch field didn't take effect, the render came out using defaults instead of your overrides, OR before recommending a parameter you're not 100% sure is in the current deployed build. Diffs schema-vs-docs and helps file precise feedback when drift is found.
e17924721ac6e9ee8785df06b06dfa1a5d984741.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

851db84fb31857e5c65c6ee75912e9fbd78b4a66.description_zh: 为 Poppify 幻灯片制作精确文字图卡，优先尝试无需 shell 的服务端 add_text_card；不能表达的终端框或多行代码再用本地 HTML/CSS 和无头浏览器渲染。适用于必须保留字面文本的画面，原说明称两条路径均不耗 seed。
851db84fb31857e5c65c6ee75912e9fbd78b4a66.source: Render a pixel-perfect text card (terminal frame, install command, code snippet, stat callout, title/end card, any exact literal string) as an image for a Poppify slide — locally via HTML/CSS + a headless browser, cross-platform (macOS/Linux/Windows). Use when a slide's content is the user's LITERAL words and must be crisp, because Gemini Imagen garbles typography. Try the free server-side add_text_card tool first — it needs no shell and works in every client. This local HTML/CSS + headless-browser path is for designs add_text_card cannot express (terminal frames, multi-line code). Zero seeds either way.
851db84fb31857e5c65c6ee75912e9fbd78b4a66.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ce5317b94f46b5c359d4d1814bef5133ad8a205b.description_zh: 按症状、根因和行动决策树排查 Poppify 短视频异常，包括渲染失败、音频字幕缺失、颜色或时长错误、链接失效、扣 seed 无视频、渲染卡住、图像内嵌文字或素材搜索无结果。
ce5317b94f46b5c359d4d1814bef5133ad8a205b.source: Diagnose a Poppify reel that came out wrong. Use when the user says: "the reel came out wrong", "render failed", "no audio in the video", "no music", "captions are missing", "wrong color text", "text is green/blue/etc instead of white", "video URL doesn't open", "video URL expired", "seeds were charged but no video", "render is stuck", "render still loading after 5 minutes", "duration is wrong", "video too short / too long", "image has text baked in", "library search returned nothing", or any deviation from what they asked for. Walks the symptom → root cause → action decision tree.
ce5317b94f46b5c359d4d1814bef5133ad8a205b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

df78a0099a35266e49cdfb48317d4a47c4328096.description_zh: 通过简短引导访谈收集领域、目标、身份、作品、头像和社交账号，生成响应式、支持双语的个人作品集网站。按职业调整内容和视觉，准备 SEO/GEO 的 JSON-LD、hreflang、llms.txt、爬虫规则、站点地图及分享图。
df78a0099a35266e49cdfb48317d4a47c4328096.source: Interview the user through a short guided interview rounds, using popups when the host provides them (field, goals, identity, work, avatar photo, social accounts), then generate a responsive, bilingual-ready personal portfolio website modelled on the imMamdouhaboammar portfolio, fully prepared for SEO and GEO (Person/ProfilePage/FAQPage JSON-LD, hreflang, llms.txt, AI-crawler robots, sitemap, share image). Use when someone asks to build, make or generate a portfolio, personal website, profile page, CV site, "about me" page or link-in-bio site, or says "اعملي بورتفوليو", "عايز موقع شخصي", "صفحة بروفايل", "موقع CV". Adapts sections, schema types, tone and visual style to the person's field (developer, designer, marketer, writer, creator, photographer, product, consultant, academic, educator, law/medicine/finance).
df78a0099a35266e49cdfb48317d4a47c4328096.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b7120261271d79ff3d87c8c4d40dd8f72d937356.description_zh: 在文案定位获批后设计作品集信息架构、章节层级、响应式方向、令牌、双语/RTL、无障碍和 UX 修复。为已有生成器输出布局决策记录，识别需要真正改模板能力的地方。
b7120261271d79ff3d87c8c4d40dd8f72d937356.source: Use for portfolio information architecture, section hierarchy, responsive visual direction, design tokens, bilingual/RTL behavior, accessibility and UX repair once messaging is approved. d999a581231e71ef5b4f73e18937ca3bc4bd1cb6.source: Use when the portfolio workflow needs direct user input that cannot be recovered safely from approved sources: missing facts, target reader, positioning, language/register, visual preferences, confidentiality, public contact choices, or explicit approval gates. d999a581231e71ef5b4f73e18937ca3bc4bd1cb6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

4964f097804b76e7d174b05305d47afaaec56348.source: Use only when the user explicitly requests publishing or deploying a reviewed portfolio to an approved destination. Requires verified QA plus separate publication and public-contact approvals, protects credentials, records deployment evidence and post-release verification, and stops when host access is unavailable.
4964f097804b76e7d174b05305d47afaaec56348.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

60f83b545618e511aed9345bd13b375570669b70.source: Use as the entry skill for ambiguous, multi-step, repair-heavy or approval-gated portfolio requests. Classifies intent, reads shared state, resolves prerequisites, selects the smallest valid specialist chain, enforces verification/approval boundaries, validates handoffs and reroutes after failures without performing specialist work itself.
60f83b545618e511aed9345bd13b375570669b70.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5faec758222b4cb0a3f34307a986058fedc775d5.source: Organic growth coach for B2C apps and products on TikTok and Instagram, with no ad spend. Covers account creation, the 7-day warmup before posting, finding content-market fit, hook and caption formulas, CTA placement, riding trends, converting views into downloads, and when to scale to multiple accounts and automate with Post Bridge.

e4853f5742238104d4f99a31a59b8a660254f2fe.description_zh: 为已运营大量社交账号的人员提供批量管理方法，原说明覆盖15至400余账号。涵盖数量与渠道经济性、排期间隔、文案变化、逐账号结果、平台限制识别，以及失效令牌和垃圾内容限制恢复；不用于首个账号入门。
e4853f5742238104d4f99a31a59b8a660254f2fe.source: Run 15 to 400+ social accounts without burning them. Covers account-count vs per-channel economics, bulk scheduling and spacing, per-account caption variation, reading per-account results instead of one vague error, telling a platform restriction apart from a real failure, and the recovery playbook for dead tokens and spam limits. For operators already running many accounts, not for someone starting their first.
e4853f5742238104d4f99a31a59b8a660254f2fe.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

2b13c14d0ff3db84125f655bdd9dd2379b398d0b.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ff04a99a452e32335f3ee7e34626cb1521328056.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

aeddb2c5f0b14fdcf69b106d58b41005ad24769f.source: Analyze session replay patterns across experiment variants to understand user behavior differences.
