aeddb2c5f0b14fdcf69b106d58b41005ad24769f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b60178503ee19c72e92c60a577b8e7c1a281ac9d.description_zh: 将已完成的 PostHog 任务运行拆为活动记录，核验智能体尝试、结果和阻塞证据，并通过 report_activity 逐项记录。使用有界 jq 查询原始 JSONL，支持两种日志模式；只记事实，不提出修复。
b60178503ee19c72e92c60a577b8e7c1a281ac9d.source: Split a completed PostHog task run into activity records — what the agent tried, whether it worked, what blocked it — and record each one through the report_activity tool. Use when a task asks to analyze a run, produce a task analysis, or review a run from an attached run log. Covers the log query protocol (bounded jq queries over the raw JSONL), both log schemas, the activity schema, and evidence verification. Records facts only; it does not suggest fixes.
b60178503ee19c72e92c60a577b8e7c1a281ac9d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

864bace6de50d9617a813d69abb2e071853e10bf.description_zh: 分析页面点击、愤怒点击和滚动深度热图，与自动采集事件关联识别热点元素，可创建保存热图并提出具体改进。仅保存截图使用直接工具，通用回放问题使用 investigating-replay。
864bace6de50d9617a813d69abb2e071853e10bf.source:
Assesses what a page's heatmap is telling you and recommends concrete changes. Pulls click / rageclick / scroll-depth data for a URL, names the hot elements by cross-referencing autocapture events on the same page, and can create a saved heatmap the user opens in PostHog, then summarizes the behavior and proposes improvements.
TRIGGER when: user asks what a heatmap shows, why people aren't clicking something, where users rage-click, how far they scroll, what to change on a page based on heatmap/click data, or to 'analyze/assess/review the heatmap' for a URL.
DO NOT TRIGGER when: the user only wants to create a saved heatmap screenshot with no analysis (use heatmaps-saved-create directly), or is asking about session replay in general (use investigating-replay).
864bace6de50d9617a813d69abb2e071853e10bf.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

afee376e4ee1e3327c0016cf699b48006a6ad851.description_zh: 审计 PostHog 项目全部端点的过时、物化失败和无用物化版本，按问题类型生成优先建议报告。未经明确确认不修改任何内容。
afee376e4ee1e3327c0016cf699b48006a6ad851.source: Audit every endpoint in a PostHog project for staleness, failed materialisations, and unused materialised versions. Use when the user asks "what endpoints can I clean up?", "are any of my endpoints broken?", "which materialised versions are still being called?", or wants a one-shot cleanup pass over the Endpoints product. Produces a prioritised report grouped by issue type, with recommended actions but does not modify anything without explicit confirmation.
afee376e4ee1e3327c0016cf699b48006a6ad851.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

644b06e160df549f623204329f66aca6ef866fd6.description_zh: 审计 PostHog 实验和功能开关的配置、过时状态及实践违规。适用于健康检查、开关清理和实验设置核验。
644b06e160df549f623204329f66aca6ef866fd6.source: Audit PostHog experiments and feature flags for configuration issues, staleness, and best-practice violations. Read when the user asks to audit, health-check, or review experiments or feature flags, check flag hygiene, or verify experiment setup.
644b06e160df549f623204329f66aca6ef866fd6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

61858e341ce69a732baed447f0acdb6d0c0ef7f4.description_zh: 审计 PostHog 数仓来源、连接、同步模式及 webhook 通道的故障和退化，按严重度排序并建议下一步。物化视图使用专门视图审计，单个失败同步使用专门诊断技能。
61858e341ce69a732baed447f0acdb6d0c0ef7f4.source: Audit the health of a PostHog project's data warehouse sources and syncs — find every broken or degraded source connection, sync schema, and webhook channel. Use when the user asks "why are my imports failing?", "what's broken with my sources?", "why is my warehouse data stale?", or wants a one-shot triage of source/sync health before deciding where to dig in. Produces a prioritized report grouped by severity, with recommended next steps. For materialized-view health use `auditing-warehouse-view-health`; for a single failing sync use `diagnosing-failed-warehouse-syncs`.
61858e341ce69a732baed447f0acdb6d0c0ef7f4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

35695d6bf5524a1415b19ea0c372e96600170ace.description_zh: 审计 PostHog 物化视图和保存查询，定位物化失败并识别闲置或过时且耗费存储计算的视图。来源和同步健康交由 auditing-warehouse-source-health。
35695d6bf5524a1415b19ea0c372e96600170ace.source: Audit the health of a PostHog project's materialized views (saved queries) — find every failed materialization and flag unused or stale materialized views that cost storage and compute. Use when the user asks "which of my views are broken?", "why is this materialized view failing?", "are any of my views wasting compute?", or wants a one-shot triage of view health. For source/sync health use `auditing-warehouse-source-health`.
35695d6bf5524a1415b19ea0c372e96600170ace.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

bbe8ea4a44607480a6ed71ab7d8d19fd2ec60bfa.description_zh: 为 PostHog 数仓表及保存查询视图添加并执行类似 dbt test 的质量断言，涵盖非空、唯一、允许值、引用完整性、行数范围、新鲜度和自定义 HogQL。适用于验证可信度或异常数字；指标语义、认证和关联定义另用数据目录技能。
bbe8ea4a44607480a6ed71ab7d8d19fd2ec60bfa.source: Adds and runs data quality checks (dbt-test style assertions) on a project's warehouse tables and saved-query views: not-null, uniqueness, accepted values, referential integrity, row-count bounds, freshness, and custom HogQL. Use when asked to test a model, validate a view, check for nulls or duplicates, add data quality checks, find out why a number looks wrong, or judge whether a warehouse table is trustworthy before using it in an analysis. To describe what data *means* (metrics, certifications, joins), see setting-up-data-catalog instead. Trigger terms: data quality, data test, dbt test, not null check, uniqueness check, freshness check, referential integrity, row count check, validate model, is this table trustworthy.
bbe8ea4a44607480a6ed71ab7d8d19fd2ec60bfa.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5ac325f7ee90eaa5827ec24b282d6ab450f3c650.description_zh: 创建 PostHog 错误跟踪告警，在问题新建、重开或激增时通知。涵盖触发选择、Slack/webhook/Linear 集成、既有告警去重及规范消息体。
5ac325f7ee90eaa5827ec24b282d6ab450f3c650.source: Author error tracking alerts that fire when an issue is created, reopened, or starts spiking. Use when the user asks to set up error notifications, route exceptions to Slack/webhook/Linear, or evaluate which error events are worth alerting on. Covers trigger-event selection, integration choice, dedup against existing alerts, and shipping with the canonical message body shape.
5ac325f7ee90eaa5827ec24b282d6ab450f3c650.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5458d92c9c2f2987052c0e4bad42232830837d00.description_zh: 为 PostHog 服务编写低噪声日志告警，涵盖服务分诊、基线、阈值草拟、simulate 回测及通知目标。适用于增加日志告警或评估监控价值。
5458d92c9c2f2987052c0e4bad42232830837d00.source: Author useful, low-noise log alerts on services in a PostHog project. Use when the user asks to set up alerts for their logs, suggest alerts they should add, or evaluate whether a service is worth monitoring. Covers service triage, baseline characterisation, threshold drafting, back-testing via simulate, and shipping with a notification destination.
5458d92c9c2f2987052c0e4bad42232830837d00.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

397ba6b59e8de216441ca5829ddbe9070bab40b0.description_zh: 创建、编辑或调整 PostHog Signals 定时 scout，包括范围、阈值、排除条件、排期、预演、结构化测量及留言反馈。覆盖 SKILL.md、报告契约、结构化输出、去重和临时记忆、团队存储路径及测试循环。
397ba6b59e8de216441ca5829ddbe9070bab40b0.source: How to author, edit, and adapt PostHog Signals scouts — the scheduled agents that scan a project and write reports into the Signals inbox. Use to customize a canonical scout (narrow its scope, retune thresholds, add disqualifiers), tweak a scout's schedule or dry-run posture, write a new scout for a surface the fleet doesn't cover, build a measurement scout that records structured output (an LLM-judge scoring a sample on a schedule — a custom metric no query can compute), or steer a scout without editing it by leaving it a note. Covers the scout SKILL.md anatomy, the report contract, the structured-output channel, the dedupe + scratchpad-memory conventions, scout notes, the per-team skills-store path vs the canonical in-repo path, and the test loop. Trigger on "write/edit/customize a signals scout", "new scout for X", "tune my scout schedule", "make a scout that watches <event>", "score/judge/measure X with a scout", "structured output from a scout", "leave a note for / give feedback to a scout".
397ba6b59e8de216441ca5829ddbe9070bab40b0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1bfd2276e581d6a4125c484e5ecdd2f9d6eef10e.description_zh: 通过 MCP 根据分析 insight 新建或更新 PostHog 看板，决定创建或更新、复用或新建 insight，参考已审核模板组合产品、留存、收入和激活等主题。适用于增删替换看板指标图表。
1bfd2276e581d6a4125c484e5ecdd2f9d6eef10e.source: Build a new dashboard, or update an existing one, from a set of insights — the same job the in-app assistant does with its upsert-dashboard tool, but over MCP. Use when a user asks to create a dashboard, put several metrics/charts together on one page, assemble a dashboard for a topic (product analytics, retention, revenue, activation, etc.), or add/remove/replace insights on a dashboard they already have. Covers deciding create vs update, reusing existing insights vs creating new ones, and using PostHog's vetted dashboard templates as reference for what a strong dashboard on a topic looks like.
1bfd2276e581d6a4125c484e5ecdd2f9d6eef10e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e710461b5960e286d3f7270bf101a53599b195d2.description_zh: 创建或编辑存储并渲染在 PostHog 的自由画布浏览器应用，例如数据板、文档、表单、工具或图形试验。覆盖定位目标、React/Quill或原生HTML实现，以及读取、编辑、验证、发布和构建流程；网格画布、组件及布局另用 composing-grid-canvases。
e710461b5960e286d3f7270bf101a53599b195d2.source: Create or edit a PostHog freeform canvas — a sandboxed browser application (data board, document, form, small tool, graphics experiment) stored in PostHog and rendered by the desktop/web app. Use when a task asks to build, generate, update, or fix a standalone canvas app, or when a freeform canvas id is given as the publish target. For grid/home canvases, widget placements, or reusable components, use composing-grid-canvases instead. Covers resolving or creating the target canvas, choosing an implementation approach (React + Quill vs plain HTML/browser APIs), the read → edit → validate → publish → build loop, and which companion canvas skills to load for the details.
e710461b5960e286d3f7270bf101a53599b195d2.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

fabc3d801683375ecd1f48e0862c083e9ed26d88.description_zh: 在 PostHog 画布中用语义 HTML、CSS 和直接浏览器 API 编写文档、文章、生成图形、2D Canvas 或 WebGL 体验。用于 building-canvases 已选择原生 HTML 路径的任务，涵盖运行时薄包装、无 Quill 主题及动画清理。
fabc3d801683375ecd1f48e0862c083e9ed26d88.source: Author a PostHog canvas with semantic HTML, CSS, and direct browser APIs — documents, articles, generative graphics, 2D canvas and WebGL experiences, and focused experiments where React components add no useful structure. Use after building-canvases has routed a canvas request to a plain-HTML/browser-API implementation. Covers the thin component wrapper the current runtime requires, styling and theming without Quill, drawing surfaces, and animation/cleanup patterns.
fabc3d801683375ecd1f48e0862c083e9ed26d88.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

292cd80418f2dab5381cbfe0f61e1528441c356d.description_zh: 按 PostHog 单组件契约实现 React/Quill 画布，采用允许导入、设计系统组件和组合规则、主题令牌、加载骨架及日期选择器。适用于路由到 React 的看板、数据板、表单或原生风格工具。
292cd80418f2dab5381cbfe0f61e1528441c356d.source: Author the React + Quill implementation of a PostHog canvas: the single-component contract, the allowed imports, Quill (PostHog's design system) component and composition rules, theme-aware design tokens, loading skeletons, and the in-canvas date picker. Use after building-canvases has routed a canvas request to a React implementation — dashboards, data boards, forms, tools, or any canvas that should look native to PostHog.
292cd80418f2dab5381cbfe0f61e1528441c356d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

382b25e826b8d00db9b80ab0ee9d611e0b05c6a0.description_zh: 通过 MCP 构建、编辑、测试、启用和监控 PostHog 工作流，编写可在视觉编辑器正常打开的动作及边图，并用 patch 定向修改草稿。适用于活动、广播、滴灌序列及事件触发自动化。
382b25e826b8d00db9b80ab0ee9d611e0b05c6a0.source: Build, edit, test, enable, and monitor PostHog workflows over MCP. Author the action/edge graph so it runs and opens cleanly in the visual editor, then change drafts surgically with patch operations. Use when asked to build, set up, automate, change, fix, or debug a workflow, campaign, broadcast, drip sequence, or event-triggered automation in the workflows product.
382b25e826b8d00db9b80ab0ee9d611e0b05c6a0.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f0a5be7109c303c3e3ce7e8f2421cf518e720431.description_zh: 读取项目隐藏 GIT 部署注释并关联 GitHub 合并提交，确定 PostHog 变更何时进入指定环境或区域。面向员工部署问题，不能仅凭事件量判断代码上线时点。
f0a5be7109c303c3e3ce7e8f2421cf518e720431.source: Determine when a PostHog code change reached a given environment by reading the hidden GIT deploy annotations in the project and correlating them with the merge commit on GitHub. Use when PostHog staff ask "when was X deployed", "is my change live in the US/EU yet", "has my PR shipped", "did the fix roll out to prod-us", or otherwise want to know whether/when a commit, PR, or feature went out to a region. Do not answer deploy-timing questions from event/data volume alone — that only shows when data changed, not when code shipped.
f0a5be7109c303c3e3ce7e8f2421cf518e720431.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

4732a6a37dd9e743f0ccd62e3133f5fd584ec264.description_zh: 构建变化图前确认用户要完整时间趋势还是仅起终点差异，分别采用折线或斜率图。适用于前后、环比和增长下降比较；不负责 insight 编辑器中的保存图表类型选择。
4732a6a37dd9e743f0ccd62e3133f5fd584ec264.source: Clarify how to visualize change over a time range before building a trend. Use whenever the user asks how much something changed, grew, dropped, improved, or regressed between two points or periods — "how much did X change from A to B", "before vs after", "start vs end", "week over week", "compare this month to last", "change over time" — or mentions a "slope chart" / "slopegraph". Two readings of "change" need different charts: the whole trend (a line, every interval) versus just the two endpoints (a slope, start vs end). Ask which they want, then render it. Not for choosing a saved insight ChartDisplayType in the insight editor.
4732a6a37dd9e743f0ccd62e3133f5fd584ec264.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

da8b872a14e07c81012af08d3f049bf7e88156f7.description_zh: 识别未使用、已全量发布或放弃的 PostHog 功能开关，检查依赖和移除安全后停用或删除，适用于过期开关清理。
da8b872a14e07c81012af08d3f049bf7e88156f7.source: Identify and clean up stale feature flags in a PostHog project. Use when the user wants to find unused, fully rolled out, or abandoned feature flags, review them for safety, and then disable or delete them. Covers staleness detection, dependency checking, and safe removal workflows.
da8b872a14e07c81012af08d3f049bf7e88156f7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8a8cf1db7f414d9f32b8e0b405573fb8384baf45.description_zh: 组合 PostHog 网格或首页画布中的可复用组件，支持添加、填充、移动、调整大小和移除 widget。覆盖组件库搜索、配置、派生、构建、尺寸与配置契约、生成生命周期、布局补丁和评论读取。
8a8cf1db7f414d9f32b8e0b405573fb8384baf45.source: Compose PostHog grid canvases — widget grids (including the user's home canvas) built from reusable component canvases. Use when a task asks to add, fill, move, resize, or remove a widget on a grid or home canvas, to compose a whole canvas of widgets from one ask, to build a reusable widget/component, or when a placement id or grid canvas id is the target. Covers the component store search → configure → fork → build ladder, the component placement contract (size, configSchema), the placement lifecycle (pending/generating/live/failed), the guarded layout patch loop, and reading the canvas's comment threads.
8a8cf1db7f414d9f32b8e0b405573fb8384baf45.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

914133a78f02f7c481f0b9573ec55d88c1285b49.description_zh: 配置 PostHog 实验分析，包括默认或自定义曝光事件、主次指标、计数求和比率留存类型、多变体用户排除或首次变体处理，以及上线后结果解读。适用于影响、置信度和分析人群问题。
914133a78f02f7c481f0b9573ec55d88c1285b49.source: Configures the analytics side of a PostHog experiment — exposure criteria (server-resolved default exposure event vs custom exposure events), primary and secondary metrics, the supported metric types (count, sum, ratio with `math` and `math_property`, retention with `retention_window_start` and `start_handling`), multivariate user handling ("Exclude" vs "First seen variant"), and how to read results once the experiment is live. Use when the user adds or edits a primary or secondary metric (e.g. "add a secondary metric tracking 'downloaded_file' per user"), sets up a ratio metric (e.g. "revenue from purchase_completed / pageviews"), sets up a retention metric (e.g. "$pageview → uploaded_file, 7-day window"), configures custom exposure (e.g. "only count users who hit /checkout"), changes multivariate handling, or asks "who is in the analysis?", "how do I measure impact?", "is this winning?", "what's the confidence level?", or "should I ship?".
914133a78f02f7c481f0b9573ec55d88c1285b49.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a2e584bff6216b46f515b868154bbd677a8aec3c.description_zh: 配置 PostHog 实验变体分配比例及控制总体入组人数的发布比例，澄清两者歧义。适用于调整草稿或运行实验的流量；中途改分配可能需要重置或结束后重启。
a2e584bff6216b46f515b868154bbd677a8aec3c.source: Configures the rollout shape of a PostHog experiment — the variant split (50/50, 80/20, A/B/C ratios), the overall rollout percentage that gates how many users enter the experiment, and the disambiguation when a percentage like "roll out to 25%" could mean either. Use when the user mentions a rollout percentage, variant split, or traffic distribution; gives a ratio like 60/40, 70/30, or 80/20; asks "who sees the test variant?"; wants to increase, decrease, or change the rollout or split on a draft or running experiment; weighs equal vs uneven splits; or proposes a mid-experiment split change (often an anti-pattern that needs reset or end-and-restart).
a2e584bff6216b46f515b868154bbd677a8aec3c.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e35738bd13eff1cdfacc6d9b33b55a4e967fff4a.description_zh: 将 PostHog 端点接入客户端或 SDK，获取 OpenAPI、生成类型客户端、设置认证头和变量，并处理限流及物化端点错误。区分 HogQL code_name 与 insight 拆分属性。
e35738bd13eff1cdfacc6d9b33b55a4e967fff4a.source: Wire a PostHog endpoint into a client app or SDK. Covers fetching the OpenAPI spec, generating a typed client with openapi-generator or @hey-api/openapi-ts, sending the right auth header, shaping the variables payload (HogQL code_name vs insight breakdown property), handling rate-limit and materialised-endpoint error responses. Use when the user says "how do I call my endpoint", "generate a client for this", or "what auth header do I use".
e35738bd13eff1cdfacc6d9b33b55a4e967fff4a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

cba347df1c117716e905c1a6b1bd749cb76f4488.description_zh: 依据确定性 lint 报告队列整理上下文 wiki，保持知识结构一致。
cba347df1c117716e905c1a6b1bd749cb76f4488.source: Keep the context wiki coherent using the deterministic lint report queue
cba347df1c117716e905c1a6b1bd749cb76f4488.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e26ee8c8aaf63ffea2a3415bf397baff73938b61.description_zh: 将近期组织活动综合为持久上下文 wiki。适用于夜间或增量整理，或依据已完成工作更新带来源的组织上下文。
e26ee8c8aaf63ffea2a3415bf397baff73938b61.source: Synthesizes recent organizational activity into a durable context wiki. Use when running a nightly or incremental context-layer dream, or when updating sourced organizational context from completed work.
e26ee8c8aaf63ffea2a3415bf397baff73938b61.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

65d57c5990954c87e71fc73418cc17f6760f21af.description_zh: 在确定性整理之后，对上下文 wiki 质量进行语义评审。
65d57c5990954c87e71fc73418cc17f6760f21af.source: Semantic review of context wiki quality after deterministic consolidation
65d57c5990954c87e71fc73418cc17f6760f21af.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3993edae417e146be921c83de41d1e00f42d5fb2.description_zh: 将 PostHog 端点复制到同组织其他项目，或在当前项目换名克隆。原说明没有原生跨项目复制工具，需读取后重建、切换项目和检查重名，目标默认不物化并以 endpoint-run 验证；不负责版本编辑或从零创作。
3993edae417e146be921c83de41d1e00f42d5fb2.source: Copy a PostHog endpoint (a saved HogQL/insight query exposed as an API route) to another project in the same organization, or duplicate it under a new name in the same project. Use when the user wants to duplicate an endpoint, promote an endpoint from staging to production, replicate an endpoint's query/variables/freshness config in another workspace, or clone an endpoint to iterate on it. Unlike feature flags and experiments, endpoints have NO native cross-project copy tool — this skill covers the read-then-recreate flow (endpoint-get then endpoint-create), the active-project switching it requires, name-collision checks, and the safe defaults (land unmaterialised in the target, verify with endpoint-run). Does not cover editing endpoint versions (see managing-endpoint-versions) or authoring a brand-new endpoint from scratch (see creating-an-endpoint).
3993edae417e146be921c83de41d1e00f42d5fb2.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

8c08440feffafa2ad9d7a46febc4eccfda28a259.description_zh: 将 PostHog 功能开关复制到同组织目标项目，处理群组重映射、计划变更及加密载荷。默认目标开关停用且不带计划变更，适用于环境提升和跨项目同步。
8c08440feffafa2ad9d7a46febc4eccfda28a259.source: Copy a feature flag from one PostHog project to one or more target projects in the same organization. Use when the user wants to duplicate a flag, promote a flag from staging to production, sync flags across projects, or replicate a flag configuration in a different workspace. Covers cohort remapping, scheduled-change handling, encrypted payloads, and the safe defaults (disabled in target, no scheduled changes).
8c08440feffafa2ad9d7a46febc4eccfda28a259.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

0ac89aa6443780ca26b6ab8fdf1fa559eec7fdf7.description_zh: 创建按 cron 周期运行自由文本提示的 PostHog AI 报告，将生成的 Markdown 发送到邮件或 Slack。适用于周期摘要；给已有分析或看板订阅附加摘要时使用 managing-subscriptions 的 summary_enabled。
0ac89aa6443780ca26b6ab8fdf1fa559eec7fdf7.source: Create a recurring AI-generated PostHog report — schedule a free-text prompt to run on a cron, with the LLM-synthesized markdown delivered to email or Slack on each tick. Use when the user wants a recurring AI summary of X on any cadence (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly) rather than a one-off report. (To attach an AI summary to an existing insight/dashboard subscription instead of a free-text prompt, see `managing-subscriptions` and its `summary_enabled` option.)
0ac89aa6443780ca26b6ab8fdf1fa559eec7fdf7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

80bf283abaa7dc88037a54b305a77d6b2e034cae.description_zh: 创建 PostHog 查询 API 端点，选择查询类型、名称、变量、新鲜度及是否物化。避免群组拆分或比较模式物化、物化端点仅内联变量、无界日期和模糊名称。
80bf283abaa7dc88037a54b305a77d6b2e034cae.source: Create a PostHog endpoint with the right shape on the first try — covers query kind choice, name conventions, what to expose as variables (HogQL code_name vs insight breakdown), data_freshness_seconds, and whether to materialise on day one. Use when the user says "create an endpoint", "expose this query as an API", "turn this insight into an endpoint", or asks for help structuring a new endpoint. Steers away from common mistakes: materialising a query with cohort breakdowns or compare mode, inline-only variables on a materialised endpoint, unbounded date ranges, ambiguous names.
80bf283abaa7dc88037a54b305a77d6b2e034cae.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e50750b6fdee90b9b21391f7a72803d592f2593a.description_zh: 创建基于产品分析或 SQL 的 PostHog 箱线图，选择标准 Trends 或 SQL insight，核验分布数据、保存并验证。适用于数值分布、跨日期或群组中位数及四分位比较。
e50750b6fdee90b9b21391f7a72803d592f2593a.source: Creates product analytics or SQL-backed box plot insights in PostHog. Use when a user asks to create, build, or save a box plot, visualize a numeric distribution, compare quartiles or medians across dates or groups, or turn SQL results into a box plot. Chooses between a standard Trends box plot and a SQL insight, validates the distribution data, saves the insight, and verifies it.
e50750b6fdee90b9b21391f7a72803d592f2593a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

24700a146fe4db894c2143cd11673cf5742c9e31.description_zh: 按定义假设、配置流量和设置分析三步创建 PostHog 实验，分别复用实验发布及分析配置技能。不用于已有实验更新、生命周期管理或单纯浏览。
24700a146fe4db894c2143cd11673cf5742c9e31.source:
Guides agents through the 3-step experiment creation flow: defining the hypothesis, configuring rollout, and setting up analytics. Delegates rollout decisions to configuring-experiment-rollout and metric setup to configuring-experiment-analytics.
TRIGGER when: user asks to create a new experiment or A/B test, OR when you are about to call experiment-create.
DO NOT TRIGGER when: user is updating an existing experiment, managing lifecycle, or only browsing experiments.
24700a146fe4db894c2143cd11673cf5742c9e31.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1e2568bca08900e25a73ec16d4f5c941b023e027.description_zh: 依据已识别真实失败模式创建持续运行的 PostHog AI 在线评估，先提出可选集合、选择目标及 hog/LLM裁判/情绪类型，配置提供方模型和触发条件，停用创建、验证范围后启用。密钥限制启用而非创建；失败探索及已有评估管理由其他技能处理。
1e2568bca08900e25a73ec16d4f5c941b023e027.source: Author continuously-running online evaluations in PostHog AI observability, grounded in real failure modes you've identified. Use when the user wants evaluations that automatically score new generations or whole traces going forward — "create an eval to catch X", "continuously check that responses do Y", "turn these failures into evals". Covers letting the explored data decide how many evals to create, proposing that set for the user to pick, choosing the target and eval type (hog / llm_judge / sentiment), configuring a provider and model for an llm_judge eval (a provider key gates enabling, not creation), scoping which generations trigger it via conditions, creating disabled, verifying scope, and enabling. Proposes a sentiment eval when no failure mode is worth catching. Finding and ranking the failure modes worth evaluating is its own job — use exploring-ai-failures first. To debug or manage evaluations that already exist, use exploring-llm-evaluations.
1e2568bca08900e25a73ec16d4f5c941b023e027.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

222a965d6e7322931923dfb3bd8beaf6d3fad6df.description_zh: 创建或扩大 Replay Vision scanner 前选择监控、分类、评分或摘要类型及会话查询，估算 credits 并核对组织余额，避免首轮耗尽预算。适用于扩大采样和改高价模型；单次已有会话问题优先使用内联扫描。
222a965d6e7322931923dfb3bd8beaf6d3fad6df.source:
Guides agents through creating and safely sizing a Replay Vision scanner: choosing the scanner type (monitor/classifier/scorer/summarizer), shaping the RecordingsQuery that selects sessions, and — crucially — estimating the credits it will spend and checking the org's remaining budget before creating, so a broad scanner doesn't exhaust the budget on its first scheduled sweep.
TRIGGER when: user asks to create, set up, or configure a Replay Vision scanner, OR when you are about to call vision-scanners-create, OR when widening an existing scanner's query, sampling_rate, or sampling_mode (or moving it to a pricier model) via vision-scanners-update.
DO NOT TRIGGER when: only reading scanners or observations, deleting a scanner, or running an existing scanner against a single session on demand (vision-scanners-scan-session). For a one-off question about sessions you already have, use vision-scanners-inline-scan-create rather than creating a scanner — the skill's first section covers when that applies.
222a965d6e7322931923dfb3bd8beaf6d3fad6df.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

13485a294c1f87e4fb7171085097c4a7ff1f91c2.description_zh: 只读调查客户 PostHog 实验的真实结果，按已知原因解释曝光不均、变体无流量、偏差警示及与 SQL 数字不一致，提供客户说明、修复建议和数字复查。新建、发布、指标、生命周期及开关本身问题使用对应技能。
13485a294c1f87e4fb7171085097c4a7ff1f91c2.source: Debug and support PostHog Experiments (A/B tests) for a customer looking at their own results. Use whenever an experiment support ticket is pasted or a customer asks a results question, most commonly "why aren''t my exposures even?", "why is one variant getting no traffic?", "why am I missing / seeing too few exposures?", "why does the bias banner show?", or "why don''t PostHog''s numbers match my SQL?". Pulls the experiment''s real data read-only, matches it to a known-cause catalog, and produces a customer-facing explanation, fix, and review of the pertinent numbers. Loads diagnosing-experiment-results as its deep diagnostic library. DO NOT TRIGGER when: creating an experiment (use creating-experiments), only configuring rollout (configuring-experiment-rollout) or metrics (configuring-experiment-analytics), asking lifecycle questions (managing-experiment-lifecycle), or the underlying feature flag is what''s misbehaving rather than the results (use debugging-feature-flags).
13485a294c1f87e4fb7171085097c4a7ff1f91c2.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d44975df07963e1659160318da8a4a7fae0f95a8.description_zh: 排查本地开发中回放摄取或显示失败，覆盖 SDK、Caddy、Rust capture-replay、Kafka、Node 摄取与 recording-api 及 SeaweedFS。适用于 hogli start 后故障、孤立进程、卡住 worker 和触发配置问题。
d44975df07963e1659160318da8a4a7fae0f95a8.source: Debugs why session recordings aren't appearing in the local dev environment. Use when a developer reports that local replay ingestion isn't working, recordings aren't showing up despite /s calls, or the replay pipeline seems broken after hogli start. Covers the full local pipeline: SDK capture, Caddy proxy, capture-replay (Rust), Kafka, ingestion-sessionreplay (Node), recording-api (Node), SeaweedFS, and common failure modes like orphaned processes, stuck phrocs workers, and trigger misconfiguration.
d44975df07963e1659160318da8a4a7fae0f95a8.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

17ccf6e5c3f7854723383aae6ea7dc90290dafa4.description_zh: 开发或排查 PostHog MCP Analytics，覆盖 JS/Python SDK、$mcp_* 事件与属性、指标规则、端到端管线、看板查询和安装向导。适用于缺失或错误数据及功能开发；单纯读数优先使用 exploring-mcp-*。
17ccf6e5c3f7854723383aae6ea7dc90290dafa4.source: Debug, support, and build PostHog MCP Analytics — product analytics for MCP servers (the `@posthog/mcp` and `posthog.mcp` SDKs plus the mcp_analytics product). Use when MCP analytics data looks wrong or missing ("events aren't showing", "intent clusters are empty", "sessions are missing", "per-tool numbers look wrong"), when writing queries over `$mcp_*` events by hand, or when doing feature work on the SDKs, the dashboard and its query runners, the self-instrumented MCP server, the `wizard mcp-analytics` install command, or the in-app onboarding. Covers the repo map, the `$mcp_*` vocabulary and where each property comes from, the rules that silently corrupt metrics when ignored, the end-to-end pipeline and where each stage breaks, and which repo to change. For reading the data rather than fixing it, prefer the `exploring-mcp-*` and `improving-mcp-tools` skills.
17ccf6e5c3f7854723383aae6ea7dc90290dafa4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d85628112cd8708e481148ec586352b424814212.description_zh: 端到端排查本地 PostHog Signals 管线，用 fixture 发测试信号、检查 Temporal REST 状态、对象存储日志及 Docker 沙箱。适用于信号未入收件箱、摘要失败或运行超时，覆盖嵌入过时、网络拒绝和闲置超时。
d85628112cd8708e481148ec586352b424814212.source: Debug the signals pipeline locally end-to-end. Covers emitting test signals from fixtures, monitoring Temporal workflows via the REST API, reading sandbox agent logs from object storage, inspecting Docker sandbox containers, and diagnosing common failures (stale ClickHouse embeddings, agentsh network denials, inactivity timeouts). Use when a signal isn't reaching the inbox, a signal-report-summary workflow fails, or a sandbox task run times out.
d85628112cd8708e481148ec586352b424814212.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1bcd2a07ca65c5c67a6047b018a240dcbd65d1b4.description_zh: 排查或开发 PostHog Surveys 后端及 Web、iOS、Android、Flutter、React Native SDK，覆盖显示资格、部分响应、分支、可选题、自动提交和功能一致性。提供只读诊断及客户回复依据。
1bcd2a07ca65c5c67a6047b018a240dcbd65d1b4.source: Debug, support, and build PostHog Surveys across the backend and all five SDKs (web/posthog-js, iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native). Use whenever a Surveys support ticket is pasted ("survey not showing", "fewer responses than expected", "responses disappeared", "responses are incomplete", "only the first question was answered", "the user says they didn't mean to submit", "survey shows on wrong platform"), when diagnosing why a survey does or doesn't display, or when doing survey feature work that must ship across SDKs. Covers the eligibility pipeline, how a response actually gets stored (partial responses, branching, optional questions, auto-submit), cross-SDK feature parity, the known-cause catalog, read-only diagnostic queries, staff access, and the customer-reply style guide.
1bcd2a07ca65c5c67a6047b018a240dcbd65d1b4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a89a5f78b483484876c0a964da30264a6935efa7.description_zh: 在 PostHog 工作流库中设计、保存和编辑邮件模板，使用带 Liquid 个性化的设计 JSON，并通过 MCP 创建及往返修改。适用于工作流、广播和活动邮件。
a89a5f78b483484876c0a964da30264a6935efa7.source: Author, save, and edit email templates in the PostHog workflows library — compose email design JSON with Liquid personalization and create and round-trip-edit templates over MCP. Use when asked to design, build, update, or fix an email template for workflows, broadcasts, or campaigns.
a89a5f78b483484876c0a964da30264a6935efa7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6d540ed4d8c26bc372f38030eb3237e91f1a3475.description_zh: 用工程分析 MCP 诊断 GitHub CI 和 PR 管线，比较 workflow 趋势、失败或等待检查、开到合并耗时和单 PR 时间线。具体 CI 失败归因使用 investigating-ci-failures，保存分析另用对应技能。
6d540ed4d8c26bc372f38030eb3237e91f1a3475.source: Diagnoses CI and pull-request pipeline health for a GitHub repo using the engineering analytics MCP tools — pull-requests (PR list with CI status), workflow-health (per-workflow CI trends), and pr-lifecycle (a single PR's timeline). Use when asked whether CI is getting faster or slower, which GitHub Actions workflow is the slow or flaky long-pole, how long PRs take from open to merge, how an author's merge time compares to the cohort, which open PRs have failing or pending CI, or where a specific pull request is stuck. Triggers on "engineering analytics", "is CI getting slower", "slow workflow", "flaky CI", "time to merge", "cycle time", "PR throughput", "failing checks", "where is PR <n> stuck", "CI long pole", "what's holding up this PR". For a verdict on one specific CI failure (whose fault, which commit) use investigating-ci-failures; to save these numbers as insights use turning-engineering-analytics-into-insights.
6d540ed4d8c26bc372f38030eb3237e91f1a3475.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

2a2e1bc7c07cc33d7a5736047ab033d0de9aba52.description_zh: 针对单个 PostHog 端点诊断慢、超时或昂贵原因，提出缓存 TTL、物化、变量重组或查询重写等具体方案。不用于全项目审计。
2a2e1bc7c07cc33d7a5736047ab033d0de9aba52.source: Diagnose why a PostHog endpoint is slow or expensive and propose a concrete fix — bump the cache TTL, enable materialisation, restructure variables, or rewrite the query. Use when the user says "this endpoint is slow", "my endpoint times out", "we're hitting the cost cap on this one", or asks "should I materialise this?". Focuses on a single named endpoint, not a project-wide audit.
2a2e1bc7c07cc33d7a5736047ab033d0de9aba52.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

4979c575518e01a71f820d361f95b8dce7aceb4e.description_zh: 诊断 PostHog 实验零曝光、样本比例失配、身份碎片、多变体曝光、非均匀分配排除偏差、显著性误区、SQL 差异及中途修改异常，并可用按变体调查补充定性反馈。实验新建、流量、指标和生命周期分别使用对应技能。
4979c575518e01a71f820d361f95b8dce7aceb4e.source:
Diagnoses bias, anomalies, and strange results on a PostHog experiment. Covers 0-exposure experiments, sample ratio mismatch, identity fragmentation, multi-variant exposure, uneven-split exclusion bias, significance traps (peeking, A/A, Bayesian vs Frequentist), PostHog-vs-SQL discrepancies, surprises after mid-run edits, and qualitative follow-up via a variant-split survey.
TRIGGER when: user asks 'is my experiment biased?' or 'why 0 exposures?', references the bias banner, says a variant looks strange / wrong / off, sees significance flipping or A/A significance, finds PostHog numbers disagreeing with their SQL, reports surprises after mid-run edits, or wants qualitative feedback or a survey for an experiment.
DO NOT TRIGGER when: creating an experiment (use creating-experiments), only configuring rollout (use configuring-experiment-rollout) or metrics (use configuring-experiment-analytics), or only asking lifecycle questions (use managing-experiment-lifecycle).
4979c575518e01a71f820d361f95b8dce7aceb4e.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1fd4b737b63908d3d6ecea280b32004ada09ffc6.description_zh: 诊断指定 PostHog 数仓来源或表同步失败并建议恢复措施，区分来源与模式级问题，覆盖卡住运行、凭据、结构漂移、增量字段和 CDC 前提错误，以及取消、重载、重新同步或删除数据等恢复动作。
1fd4b737b63908d3d6ecea280b32004ada09ffc6.source: Diagnose why a data warehouse sync is failing and recommend the right recovery action. Use when the user asks "why isn't my Stripe/Postgres/Hubspot sync working?", "this table has been stuck for hours", "the data in the warehouse looks wrong", or wants to troubleshoot a specific source or schema. Covers source-level vs schema-level failures, stuck Running states, credential and schema-drift errors, incremental-field misconfig, CDC prerequisite failures, and the cancel / reload / resync / delete-data recovery actions.
1fd4b737b63908d3d6ecea280b32004ada09ffc6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d8ac4f916ab41f557f921139c693e72aaf2997c4.description_zh: 诊断 PostHog 会话录制缺失或未采集原因，检查 SDK 信号、项目设置、采样、触发器、广告拦截及配额计费。适用于特定会话或项目范围问题。
d8ac4f916ab41f557f921139c693e72aaf2997c4.source: Diagnoses why a session recording is missing or was not captured. Use when a user asks why a session has no replay, why recordings aren't appearing, or wants to troubleshoot session replay capture issues for a specific session ID or across their project. Covers SDK diagnostic signals, project settings, sampling, triggers, ad blockers, and quota/billing scenarios.
d8ac4f916ab41f557f921139c693e72aaf2997c4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

88289dc78165a1ac9439adccd0067d20037fb4e9.description_zh: 检查 PostHog SDK 集成健康和版本，识别过时 SDK 并提供升级建议。适用于事件或功能异常可能与旧版本有关的场景。
88289dc78165a1ac9439adccd0067d20037fb4e9.source: Diagnoses the health of a project's PostHog SDK integrations — which SDKs are out of date and how to fix them. Use when a user asks about PostHog SDK versions, outdated SDKs, upgrade recommendations, "SDK health", "SDK doctor" (the former name), or when events or features seem off and it might be due to an old SDK.
88289dc78165a1ac9439adccd0067d20037fb4e9.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

017e40dcc3ffb56b719a73874eb1509153d915a4.description_zh: 排查 PostHog 错误堆栈符号化，覆盖 Web JS/TS、React Native Hermes、Android Proguard/R8 和 iOS/macOS dSYM。检查符号集、映射、chunk ID、UUID 和上传配置；原说明 JS 平台参考较完整，其他平台资料仍逐步补充。
017e40dcc3ffb56b719a73874eb1509153d915a4.source: Help users debug PostHog Error Tracking stack-trace symbolication for any supported platform — JavaScript/TypeScript web, React Native (Hermes), Android (Proguard / R8), or iOS / macOS (dSYM). The PostHog symbol-set lookup flow is universal across platforms; build-tool and artifact details live in per-platform references (JavaScript is fleshed out, others come as we encounter them). Use when stack frames stay minified or obfuscated after symbols are uploaded, PostHog symbol sets show last_used but frames are not readable, chunk IDs or dSYM UUIDs do not match, "Token not found" appears, uploaded source maps / dSYMs / Proguard mappings look empty, or bundler / symbol-upload configuration needs troubleshooting.
017e40dcc3ffb56b719a73874eb1509153d915a4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

3ec58601a6564b19ab259fbbf8dc3a5f7d740589.description_zh: 按需导出 PostHog 事件、人员、会话或 HogQL 结果并下载 Parquet/JSONLines 等文件。通过 MCP 启动并轮询完成，再经既有 REST 重定向端点下载。
3ec58601a6564b19ab259fbbf8dc3a5f7d740589.source: Export PostHog events, persons, sessions, or the results of a HogQL query on demand and download the resulting files. Use when the user asks to download/export raw PostHog data, export HogQL query results, create a one-off file export, fetch a Parquet or JSONLines export, or use the file_download_batch_exports API. Covers starting the export with MCP, polling completion, and downloading via the existing REST redirect endpoint.
3ec58601a6564b19ab259fbbf8dc3a5f7d740589.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d7927a082560896739f06a14cb956d6599040f16.description_zh: 依据真实生产轨迹识别 AI/LLM 失败模式，限定用例后结合代码错误、指标异常、人工检查、评估激增或聚类定位问题，形成按优先级排列的失败分类。适用于错误答案、幻觉、忽略指令及工具误用。
d7927a082560896739f06a14cb956d6599040f16.source: Find where an AI/LLM application is failing in production and surface the failure patterns, working from real traces. Use when someone wants to understand what's going wrong with an AI feature, find and categorize failure modes, triage errors, or investigate quality issues (wrong answers, ignored instructions, hallucinations, tool misuse) — "what's failing in my agent", "surface error patterns", "why are the responses bad", "find the common failure modes", "what should I fix next". Covers scoping to one use case, finding failing traces by whichever signal fits the context (code errors, metric outliers, trace-type slices, manual review, existing-eval spikes, clustering), and reading them into a ranked failure taxonomy.
d7927a082560896739f06a14cb956d6599040f16.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

53f525e7cb751e638fc7f4772d29035fce8bc5c5.description_zh: 通过 MCP 调查 PostHog APM 的 OpenTelemetry span，分析慢 HTTP/数据库调用、错误、延迟、trace ID 和属性。适用于分布式应用性能，不用于 AI 可观测轨迹或产品日志。
53f525e7cb751e638fc7f4772d29035fce8bc5c5.source: Investigates distributed application performance using PostHog APM (OpenTelemetry span) data via MCP. Use when the user asks about service traces, slow HTTP/database spans, error spans, error-rate trends or spikes, latency distributions, trace IDs, or span attributes — not AI observability traces or product logs. Uses posthog:query-apm-spans, posthog:apm-trace-get, posthog:apm-spans-sparkline, posthog:apm-services-list, posthog:apm-attributes-list, and posthog:apm-attribute-values-list.
53f525e7cb751e638fc7f4772d29035fce8bc5c5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

d5e64c65005084c02578a595aa40cda4f1859ba4.description_zh: 探索 posthog-js 的 $autocapture 交互，定位 CSS/data-attr 选择器、核验唯一性、查询点击并创建 action。适用于点击筛选的趋势或漏斗及 elements_chain，只用于启用该自动采集的项目。
d5e64c65005084c02578a595aa40cda4f1859ba4.source: Guides exploration of $autocapture events captured by posthog-js to understand user interactions, find CSS selectors (especially data-attr attributes), evaluate selector uniqueness, query matching clicks ad-hoc, and create actions. Use when the user asks about autocapture data, wants to find what users are clicking, needs to build actions from click events, asks about elements_chain, wants to build a trend or funnel filtered by clicks or other autocapture interactions, asks which properties autocapture sends, or asks how to filter $autocapture events. Only applies to projects using posthog-js autocapture.
d5e64c65005084c02578a595aa40cda4f1859ba4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

6314c53cf0ab61232f6d2c48a2ef14d7045b58e3.description_zh: 查看单个 PostHog 端点执行日志，诊断错误、失败、缓存未命中、慢运行及异常行数。适用于指定端点近期调用，不用于全项目审计或查询性能剖析。
6314c53cf0ab61232f6d2c48a2ef14d7045b58e3.source: Explore and diagnose a PostHog endpoint's execution logs — error messages, failed runs, cache misses, slow runs, or unexpected row counts during endpoint invocations. Use when the user says "my endpoint is failing", "show me the logs for endpoint X", "what error did endpoint Y produce", "why did endpoint Z return no rows", "is this endpoint hitting cache", or "check the last N runs". Focused on a single named endpoint's runtime log entries, not project-wide auditing or query performance profiling.
6314c53cf0ab61232f6d2c48a2ef14d7045b58e3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

28bab5b92095a58aa0a95aec8b1836d48611c6a9.description_zh: 查看 PostHog Web analytics Live 数据，包括在线用户、近30分钟页面浏览、热门页面、来源、设备、浏览器、国家及机器人每分钟趋势。支持筛选下钻并构建对应产品分析。
28bab5b92095a58aa0a95aec8b1836d48611c6a9.source: Inspects PostHog Web analytics Live tab data — current users online, last-30-minutes pageviews, top pages, referrers, devices, browsers, countries, bot traffic, and the per-minute bot/users charts. Use when the user asks "who is on my site right now?", "what is happening live?", "what bots are crawling me?", asks about the "live tab" / "live dashboard", wants live numbers (last 30 min), or wants help filtering or drilling into the live view. Also covers building product-analytics insights that mirror what the tiles show.
28bab5b92095a58aa0a95aec8b1836d48611c6a9.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

1b11592eebddd2ae01e75b5bc3e4b7eb4364e11d.description_zh: 调查 AI 可观测聚类中的使用模式、群组行为、成本和延迟，并深入查看组内具体轨迹。
1b11592eebddd2ae01e75b5bc3e4b7eb4364e11d.source: Investigate AI observability clusters — understand usage patterns in AI/LLM traffic, compare cluster behavior, compute cost/latency metrics, and drill into individual traces within clusters.
1b11592eebddd2ae01e75b5bc3e4b7eb4364e11d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

0475196bc8b56c459657cf0009c4936420896151.description_zh: 分析 PostHog LLM 支出，按时间、模型、提供方、用户、轨迹或自定义维度拆分，核查 token、缓存经济性及成本回归。适用于费用激增、成本看板或告警。
0475196bc8b56c459657cf0009c4936420896151.source: Investigate LLM spend in PostHog — total cost over time, cost by model, provider, user, trace, or custom dimension, token and cache-hit economics, and cost regressions. Use when the user asks "how much are we spending on LLMs?", "which model / user / feature is most expensive?", "why did cost spike?", wants to build a cost dashboard or alert, or pastes a trace URL and asks about its cost.
0475196bc8b56c459657cf0009c4936420896151.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5f9dd708ab1fa016c980a0f3c2ae6f63080582fe.description_zh: 检查 PostHog AI 的 hog、LLM裁判和情绪评估，查看配置、对特定生成执行、查询结果并设置周期报告。适用于失败排查、过滤比较、预演、裁判提示试验和评估生命周期。
5f9dd708ab1fa016c980a0f3c2ae6f63080582fe.source: Investigate AI observability evaluations — `hog` (deterministic code-based), `llm_judge` (LLM-prompt-based), and `sentiment` (user-message sentiment). Find existing evaluations, inspect their configuration, run them against specific generations, query individual results, and set up scheduled reports on an evaluation. Use when the user asks to debug why an evaluation is failing, surface common failure modes, compare results across filters, dry-run a Hog evaluator, prototype a new LLM-judge prompt, inspect sentiment classifications, or manage the evaluation lifecycle.
5f9dd708ab1fa016c980a0f3c2ae6f63080582fe.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

21255a47ed5b61b40ab5a1ce4af8cfb732c10a36.description_zh: 通过 PostHog MCP 查看 LLM 或智能体轨迹，检查失败、工具使用、上下文文件、子智能体决策及 token 成本。原说明强调消息内容仅在专用 posthog.ai_events 表，普通 events 属性查询可能为空。
21255a47ed5b61b40ab5a1ce4af8cfb732c10a36.source: Debug and inspect LLM/AI agent traces using PostHog's MCP tools. Use when the user pastes a trace or session URL (e.g. /ai-observability/traces/<id> or /ai-observability/sessions/<id>), asks to debug a trace, figure out what went wrong, check if an agent used a tool correctly, verify context/files were surfaced, inspect subagent behavior, investigate LLM decisions, or analyze token usage and costs. Also use when raw SQL/HogQL against `events.properties.$ai_input` / `$ai_output_choices` returns empty — message content lives only on the dedicated `posthog.ai_events` table.
21255a47ed5b61b40ab5a1ce4af8cfb732c10a36.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a4d1c10a95fa3b4c7455890a22e9e97bfe123a53.description_zh: 探索 MCP 意图语义聚类及工具分布、错误率，分析各意图工具发现和捕获率、描述匹配及重叠。适用于目标分组、混淆工具或重新聚类。
a4d1c10a95fa3b4c7455890a22e9e97bfe123a53.source: Explore PostHog MCP intent clusters — agent goals grouped by semantic similarity, with each cluster's tool distribution and error rates, plus the tool-centric pivot (capture rate per intent, discovery rate against the advertised catalog, description fit, tool overlaps). Use when the user asks "what are agents trying to do with the MCP?", "group the intents", "which goals fail most?", "what does each cluster route to?", "when agents have this intent do they find my tool?", "which tools get mixed up?", wants to recompute the clustering, or pastes an MCP analytics intent-clustering URL.
a4d1c10a95fa3b4c7455890a22e9e97bfe123a53.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

db4f6996682938fc17f72c8500904f9ac19d6db6.description_zh: 调查单次 PostHog MCP 会话的工具调用顺序、智能体目标及失败位置。适用于查询具体会话、错误会话或连接用户。
db4f6996682938fc17f72c8500904f9ac19d6db6.source: Investigate individual PostHog MCP sessions — the sequence of tool calls a single agent made in one run, what it was trying to do, and where it went wrong. Use when the user asks "what did this MCP session do?", "show me the tool calls for session X", "what was the agent's goal?", "which sessions had errors?", "who is connecting to my MCP?", or pastes an MCP analytics sessions URL.
db4f6996682938fc17f72c8500904f9ac19d6db6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

7ca295fd7537652287a7bda8fd285976a5cfee11.description_zh: 重建 MCP 会话起始时的用户目标，按目标分类并统计规模、占比和特征，在 PostHog 笔记本发布。逐会话阅读并自行写目标标签；原说明不将目标字段交给仅处理机械特征的脚本。
7ca295fd7537652287a7bda8fd285976a5cfee11.source: Build a starting-point taxonomy for an MCP tool — what users were trying to accomplish before they reached the tool — and publish it as a PostHog notebook. Reconstructs each session's goal from its opening tool calls, then clusters those goals into named categories with size, share, and facet mix. Use when the user asks "why do people use this tool?", "what are users actually trying to do?", "what problem brings people here?", "where do these sessions start?", "segment usage of <tool> by goal", or wants a Clio-style taxonomy of MCP usage. Complements exploring-mcp-intent-clusters, which groups what agents did per call rather than why the session began. The agent running this skill writes the goal labels itself, reading the corpus query output session by session — the bundled scripts cover the mechanical facets but measurably lose the goal's altitude, so do not delegate that field to them.
7ca295fd7537652287a7bda8fd285976a5cfee11.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

94aa472ba41d787c7d578457403a7e2c4aa0abe4.description_zh: 分析 PostHog MCP 工具调用质量，包括错误率、延迟、触达和慢或失败工具。适用于可靠性比较和工具质量矩阵。
94aa472ba41d787c7d578457403a7e2c4aa0abe4.source: Investigate the quality of PostHog MCP tool calls — error rates, latency, reach, and which tools are failing or slow. Use when the user asks "which MCP tool has the highest error rate?", "what's the slowest tool?", "which tools fail most often?", "how reliable is tool X?", wants a tool-quality matrix, or pastes an MCP analytics tool-quality / dashboard URL and asks what it shows.
94aa472ba41d787c7d578457403a7e2c4aa0abe4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

947c552b8ddded4946899b9f8e708d089892ccf7.description_zh: 作为 PostHog MCP 使用分析入口，把宽泛问题路由到可回答的查询工具及聚焦技能。适用于整体表现、用户或智能体行为探索以及无明确问题的分析链接。
947c552b8ddded4946899b9f8e708d089892ccf7.source: Starting point for exploring how a PostHog MCP server's tools are used — routes a broad question to the typed tool that answers it. Use when the user asks "how is my MCP doing?", "what should I look at?", "explore my tool calls", "who uses my MCP tools?", "what are agents doing with the MCP?", or pastes an MCP analytics URL without a specific question. Offers a menu of questions, each backed by a query tool, then hands off to the focused skill.
947c552b8ddded4946899b9f8e708d089892ccf7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

ab7793ca1e2770d122ab8178afb2614b66282887.description_zh: 读取 Replay Vision 扫描观察，跨会话总结模式、深入回放，将真实且交叉核实的问题转为任务、insight 或回放调查。扫描器创建、单次不分析的扫描及 scout 编写由其他技能处理。
ab7793ca1e2770d122ab8178afb2614b66282887.source:
Guides agents through pulling a Replay Vision scanner's observations, reading the findings, and acting on them — summarizing patterns across sessions, drilling into individual recordings, and turning real, corroborated issues into PostHog tasks, insights, or an investigating-replay hand-off.
TRIGGER when: user wants to pull/read/triage Replay Vision observations, asks "what has my scanner found", wants to act on or summarize scanner findings, turn observations into tasks/work, or points at a /replay-vision/<scanner-id> URL.
DO NOT TRIGGER when: creating or sizing a scanner (use creating-replay-vision-scanners), running a one-off scan you don't then analyse, or authoring a signals scout.
ab7793ca1e2770d122ab8178afb2614b66282887.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

96cde12ca58bda6fffd6aabce8d4cf2cf37fcfd1.description_zh: 只读探索 PostHog Signals scouts 的清单、排期、近期运行、推理、持久临时记忆及所写报告，按成功率、报告率和信噪比评估健康。修改或调整 scout 使用 authoring-scouts。
96cde12ca58bda6fffd6aabce8d4cf2cf37fcfd1.source: How to explore and make sense of PostHog Signals scouts — the scheduled agents that scan a project and write reports into the Signals inbox. Use when a user wants to understand what scouts they have, how each one is behaving, and whether the fleet is actually working. Covers surveying the fleet and its schedules, reading recent scout runs and drilling into a single run's reasoning, inspecting the durable scratchpad memory the fleet has built up, tracing a run to the reports it wrote or edited, and assessing a scout's health and performance over time (cadence, success rate, report rate, signal-to-noise). Read-only and exploratory — to write or tune a scout, use `authoring-scouts` instead. Trigger on "what are my scouts doing", "how is my <x> scout performing", "show me recent scout runs", "why did this scout find/report nothing", "what has the fleet learned", "explore scout run <id>", "is my scout working".
96cde12ca58bda6fffd6aabce8d4cf2cf37fcfd1.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

9a9607703a5b6635375b2f46a25ee573d215c1b6.description_zh: 设置 LLM 裁判评估批量提取 AI 功能实际用例，并将结果作为实时信息流发往 Slack。需要 $ai_generation/$ai_evaluation 事件通过 $session_id 关联触发用户录制，适用于免逐条阅读大量轨迹。
9a9607703a5b6635375b2f46a25ee573d215c1b6.source: Set up an LLM-judge evaluation that extracts canonical use cases for a PostHog feature at scale and streams the results to a Slack channel as a live feed. Use when someone wants to understand how users are actually using a specific AI/LLM-powered feature in production — what they're investigating, what questions they're trying to answer, and what patterns surface — without manually reading hundreds of traces. Assumes the feature emits `$ai_generation` and `$ai_evaluation` events with `$session_id` linkage to the trigger user's recording (the standard setup post the session-summary linkage PRs).
9a9607703a5b6635375b2f46a25ee573d215c1b6.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

a3f1b982bee404f7a44954b994c916f381791936.description_zh: 用 isLikelyBot/getTrafficType HogQL 函数和 $virt_* 属性识别、统计并排除机器人、爬虫或 AI 智能体流量，生成纯人类分析。实时 Live 机器人数据另用 exploring-live-traffic。
a3f1b982bee404f7a44954b994c916f381791936.source: Identify, measure, and exclude bot / crawler / AI-agent traffic in PostHog web and product analytics using the traffic classification surface (the isLikelyBot / getTrafficType HogQL functions and the $virt_* virtual properties). Use when the user asks to "exclude bots", "filter out crawlers", "remove bot traffic from my numbers", "how much of my traffic is bots / AI crawlers", "is GPTBot / ChatGPT / Claude hitting my site", "break down traffic by human vs bot", or wants clean human-only counts in an insight or dashboard. For the real-time Live tab bot tiles, use exploring-live-traffic instead.
a3f1b982bee404f7a44954b994c916f381791936.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b9a99c180a81b1690991bea1bc256985fa45fc07.description_zh: 查找当前项目近期软删除的功能开关，并追查删除时间或操作者。原说明 system.feature_flags 有 deleted 标记但无删除时点，须关联逐开关活动日志。
b9a99c180a81b1690991bea1bc256985fa45fc07.source: Find feature flags that were soft-deleted in the active project within a recent time window. Use when the user asks "what flags were deleted in the last N days", "show me recently deleted feature flags", "who deleted flag X", "audit recent flag deletions", or anything similar. Handles the non-obvious gotcha that system.feature_flags exposes the deleted boolean but does not expose a deletion timestamp — the actual deleted-at time lives in the per-flag activity log and must be cross-referenced.
b9a99c180a81b1690991bea1bc256985fa45fc07.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

fd08496d12dcfe7b759350697a31f5d98f974f19.description_zh: 通过 experiment-list 将自然语言实验名称、描述、最近时间或状态解析为具体 ID，多项匹配时消歧。原说明不使用功能开关工具代替实验列表。
fd08496d12dcfe7b759350697a31f5d98f974f19.source: Resolves a PostHog experiment reference from natural language to a concrete experiment ID by browsing `experiment-list` (not feature-flag tools), with disambiguation when multiple experiments match. Use when the user names or quotes an experiment ("split test demo", "the File engagement boost experiment", "onboarding retention test", "landing page hero experiment", "pricing experiment"), describes it loosely ("the signup experiment", "my pricing test", "the one with the new checkout"), uses a relative reference ("latest", "most recent", "the one I created yesterday"), filters by status (running, draft, paused, exposure frozen, stopped, archived), or otherwise refers to an experiment by anything other than its concrete ID.
fd08496d12dcfe7b759350697a31f5d98f974f19.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

76381f58662bafa5204732bb6ac84c38c646f8a7.description_zh: 从错误问题关联录制中按新鲜度、活动和旅程完整性选择最有信息的回放，并总结错误前上下文。适用于已知错误问题 ID。
76381f58662bafa5204732bb6ac84c38c646f8a7.source: Finds the most informative session recording linked to an error tracking issue. Use when a user has an error tracking issue ID and wants to watch a replay showing what the user was doing when the error occurred. Ranks linked sessions by recency, activity score, and journey completeness, then summarizes the pre-error context. Replaces blind session picking from potentially hundreds of linked recordings.
76381f58662bafa5204732bb6ac84c38c646f8a7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

0b50e7a2aab6b8c6abb501110e5b203a0cf35113.description_zh: 把模糊回放观看目标转为聚焦的 RecordingsQuery，筛出少量高信息会话并交给 investigating-replay。已有会话 ID 或已知错误问题分别使用专门技能。
0b50e7a2aab6b8c6abb501110e5b203a0cf35113.source: Guides a user from "I want to watch recordings but don't know which ones" to a short, high-signal list of sessions worth watching. Use when the user asks which sessions or replays to watch, wants help finding interesting / useful recordings, says they don't know where to start in session replay, or wants to watch sessions about a goal (signup, pricing, onboarding, checkout, a feature, rageclicks, errors, mobile, a specific person) without naming exact filters. Turns a vague intent into a focused RecordingsQuery via `query-session-recordings-list`, then deep-links the best few and hands off to `investigating-replay`. Do NOT use when the user already has a recording/session ID (use investigating-replay) or wants the replay for a known error issue (use finding-replay-for-issue).
0b50e7a2aab6b8c6abb501110e5b203a0cf35113.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

bb22aa7a5a382e1435d0224f3e5e322084b63301.description_zh: 为 PostHog Trends 或 SQL insight 选择正确纵轴格式，涵盖时间、币种、比率、大数、小数和标签。适用于避免仅为显示单位而新增计算公式。
bb22aa7a5a382e1435d0224f3e5e322084b63301.source: Pick the right y-axis unit when creating or updating an insight via `posthog:insight-create` or `posthog:insight-update` — both TrendsQuery (`trendsFilter.aggregationAxisFormat`) and SQL insights (`DataVisualizationNode`, `chartSettings.yAxis[].settings.formatting`). Use when the agent is about to add a `formula` purely to convert units (e.g. dividing seconds by 60 to display minutes), when a `math_property` or SQL column is a duration, currency, ratio, or large count, or whenever the user mentions "format the y-axis", "duration", "seconds", "minutes", "hours", "milliseconds", "ms", "percentage", "%%", "currency", "decimals", "axis label", or "axis unit" in the context of a graph insight.
bb22aa7a5a382e1435d0224f3e5e322084b63301.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

c0364abcfd39e8aaec13aab7481dce8c8438d949.description_zh: 合并同一实际错误以不同指纹报告的 PostHog 问题，选择一次性合并或长期分组规则。原说明不跨运行环境、SDK 或调用点把仅概念相似的缺陷合并。
c0364abcfd39e8aaec13aab7481dce8c8438d949.source: Consolidate PostHog error tracking issues that are the same actual error reported under different fingerprints. Use when the user asks "why do I have so many TypeError issues that look the same?", "merge these duplicates", "stop splitting this error into new issues", or wants to clean up fingerprint sprawl. Decides between a one-shot merge of existing issues and a durable grouping rule that keeps future events from creating new fingerprints. Does NOT group conceptually similar bugs across different runtimes, SDKs, or call sites.
c0364abcfd39e8aaec13aab7481dce8c8438d949.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

c65b950e74136c2d8689170ab17c5e844f0ed27d.description_zh: 通过评估闭环改进 MCP 智能体体验，从生产证据选择最重要工具问题、做一次限定修复，仅在前后评分改善时保留。适用于工具发现、描述改进或有评估证据的 PR，每个交付变更须带评估依据。
c65b950e74136c2d8689170ab17c5e844f0ed27d.source: Run an improve-my-MCP campaign: an autoresearch-style loop that measures the MCP agent experience with the eval harness, picks the highest-impact tool problem from production data, makes one bounded fix, and keeps it only if before/after scores improve. Use when asked to "improve my MCP", run an MCP improvement campaign, fix tool discoverability or descriptions based on evidence, or prepare an eval-backed PR for a tool change. Every shipped change must carry eval evidence; guardrails below are hard rules.
c65b950e74136c2d8689170ab17c5e844f0ed27d.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

0643b7472fe2db119f2b19dad4f1261c741ad17f.description_zh: 探索 PostHog Inbox 中由信号报告聚合的可行动问题和趋势，列举、筛选、下钻并处理报告。适用于转为 PR、解决、忽略、延后或查看信号来源，原始信号及语义搜索参见 signals。
0643b7472fe2db119f2b19dad4f1261c741ad17f.source: Explore PostHog's Inbox and act on what it surfaces — the place where signal reports cluster into actionable issues and trends. Use when the user asks "what's in my inbox?", "what should I look at?", "which reports are actionable?", "what's PostHog flagged recently?", asks about a specific report by ID or title, wants to act on / fix / implement a report (turn it into a PR), wants to resolve, dismiss, or snooze a report, or wants to see which signal sources are configured. Covers listing, filtering, drilling into, and acting on reports, plus pointers to the deeper `signals` skill when raw signals or semantic search are needed.
0643b7472fe2db119f2b19dad4f1261c741ad17f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

af9de88d2e7b0f8c2fb75a8435dfed67d325a604.description_zh: 为应用接入 PostHog 错误跟踪，采集异常、堆栈和 source map。适用于功能实现后或 PR 评审，也可初始化尚未安装的 SDK。
af9de88d2e7b0f8c2fb75a8435dfed67d325a604.source: Add PostHog error tracking to capture and monitor exceptions. Use after implementing features or reviewing PRs to ensure errors are tracked with stack traces and source maps. Also handles initial PostHog SDK setup if not yet installed.
af9de88d2e7b0f8c2fb75a8435dfed67d325a604.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

872da002f2b1f6d6a8fc470a5c27da50307dfd59.description_zh: 为新功能添加 PostHog 功能开关，支持安全发布控制。适用于实现后或 PR 评审，也处理首次 SDK 配置。
872da002f2b1f6d6a8fc470a5c27da50307dfd59.source: Add PostHog feature flags to gate new functionality. Use after implementing features or reviewing PRs to ensure safe rollouts with feature flag controls. Also handles initial PostHog SDK setup if not yet installed.

1daccd46f1a54333c7f4c7df44c27b9b617b4902.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

Also handles mirroring existing Prometheus/StatsD/OpenTelemetry metrics into PostHog and initial OTLP exporter setup.

12c088c33711e1533f72b46a68fefb421b3de752.source: Add PostHog product analytics events to track user behavior. Use after implementing new features or reviewing PRs to ensure meaningful user actions are captured. Also handles initial PostHog SDK setup if not yet installed.
12c088c33711e1533f72b46a68fefb421b3de752.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f5430fc60fc6edc34edccd77c20bb8fbeac2b5f4.description_zh: 组合维度拆分、参与者、路径、生命周期、留存和注释查询，诊断产品指标下降、激增或停滞。适用于趋势、漏斗、留存和粘性异常原因分析。
f5430fc60fc6edc34edccd77c20bb8fbeac2b5f4.source: Diagnose why a product metric changed (dropped, spiked, or plateaued) by orchestrating breakdowns, actors, paths, lifecycle, retention, and annotations queries. Use when the user reports an anomaly, asks "why did X change?", or needs root-cause analysis for a trend, funnel, retention, stickiness, or lifecycle metric.
f5430fc60fc6edc34edccd77c20bb8fbeac2b5f4.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

b35fb8bef15ac4519a9f25f2917a091032b06f7f.description_zh: 依据工程分析数仓视图和 CI 失败日志调查具体失败，判断来源提交、作者、是否已修复及是否随机不稳。整体 CI 健康和合并瓶颈、保存 insight 使用其他技能。
b35fb8bef15ac4519a9f25f2917a091032b06f7f.source: Investigates a specific CI failure to a verdict: whose fault, which commit, who wrote it, and whether it's fixed. Use for "who broke master", "why did this test fail in CI", "is this failure my PR's fault or everyone's", "is this test flaky or actually broken", "when did this failure start". Works from the engineering_analytics warehouse views (engineering_analytics_ci_failures, engineering_analytics_ci_job_history) plus the CI failure logs. Not for aggregate CI health, cost, or merge bottlenecks (use diagnosing-ci-and-merge-bottlenecks) and not for building saved insights (use turning-engineering-analytics-into-insights).
b35fb8bef15ac4519a9f25f2917a091032b06f7f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

2e063d228ed41cac01f7e85fcb4201b16aa1bbeb.description_zh: 端到端调查单个 PostHog 错误问题，读取聚合指标、异常样本、群组拆分及关联回放，解释影响、触发、开始时间和发布等相关性，形成明确为假设程度的摘要。
2e063d228ed41cac01f7e85fcb4201b16aa1bbeb.source: Investigates a single PostHog error tracking issue end-to-end. Use when the user provides an issue ID or pastes an issue URL (`/error_tracking/<id>`) and wants to understand the error — who it affects, what triggers it, when it started, whether it correlates with a release, browser, OS, or feature flag, and what the next step should be. Pulls aggregated metrics, sample exception events, segment breakdowns, linked replays, and synthesizes a hypothesis-grade summary in one pass.
2e063d228ed41cac01f7e85fcb4201b16aa1bbeb.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

10de6781a5519b9daf969f76b9c5284b6fd11bd1.description_zh: 通过 PostHog 日志调查服务或部署健康、错误激增和故障，先读取服务概览、模式、前后差异、分桶计数和特征，再深入原始行。适用于事件分诊和日志根因调查。
10de6781a5519b9daf969f76b9c5284b6fd11bd1.source: Investigate logs in a PostHog project: verify a service or deployment is healthy, explain an error spike, triage an incident, or understand what a log stream is saying. Use when the user asks to "check the logs", asks whether a service, deploy, release, or change is working or broke anything, asks why errors are up or what changed, or wants the root cause of failures visible in logs. Routes the logs MCP tools (services overview, pattern mining, before/after pattern diffing, bucketed counts, facets, raw rows) so investigations start from summaries instead of raw rows or hand-written SQL over the logs table.
10de6781a5519b9daf969f76b9c5284b6fd11bd1.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

891e998ac549c7722196af237d041e198c10a620.description_zh: 调查 PostHog 服务器和基础设施指标异常，结合异常刻画、指标查询、日志及 APM 轨迹寻找有证据的可能原因。适用于摄取延迟、错误率、队列、吞吐和指标告警。
891e998ac549c7722196af237d041e198c10a620.source: Investigates server/infrastructure metric anomalies in PostHog Metrics — from "this metric is rising/dropping/spiking" or a fired alert to a probable cause with evidence. Use when asked why a metric looks wrong (ingestion lag rising, error rate spiking, latency degrading, queue depth growing, throughput dropping), when an alert fires on an OTel/Prometheus metric, or for any incident triage that starts from a metric symptom. Composes characterize-metric-anomaly, query-metrics, and metric-names-list with logs (query-logs) and traces (APM span tools) for cross-signal root-cause correlation.
891e998ac549c7722196af237d041e198c10a620.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

48909822021dc36d54437a0ff6cfd52dd358fb06.description_zh: 按录制或会话 ID 一次性收集元数据、人员档案、同会话事件及关联错误，解释用户行为和故障，替代多工具手工串联。
48909822021dc36d54437a0ff6cfd52dd358fb06.source: Investigates a session recording by gathering metadata, person profile, same-session events, and linked error tracking issues in one pass. Use when a user provides a recording or session ID and wants to understand what happened — who the user was, what they did, what errors occurred, and whether there are related error tracking issues. Replaces the manual chain of session-recording-get, persons-retrieve, execute-sql, and query-error-tracking-issues-list.
48909822021dc36d54437a0ff6cfd52dd358fb06.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f206efc4c4a2e31ffb7f368c0bd389523ecfd992.description_zh: 管理 PostHog 端点版本，支持预览草稿、修改指定版本设置、停用和恢复旧查询。原说明明确回滚不是切换指针，而是把旧查询派生为新的顶层版本。
f206efc4c4a2e31ffb7f368c0bd389523ecfd992.source: Work safely with endpoint versions — preview a draft in the playground, roll back to an older version, update settings on one version without bumping query history, deactivate a specific version. Use when the user asks "how do I roll back my endpoint", "preview my changes before publishing", "I want to fix v5 without bumping the version", or anything involving the version history. Calls out today's limitations honestly: there is no pointer flip; "rollback" means forking the old query into a new top version.
f206efc4c4a2e31ffb7f368c0bd389523ecfd992.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

2157aa2cf31085c40b7642c53ac2c6a8d1b1ff7a.description_zh: 管理实验发布、暂停恢复、冻结或重开曝光、结束、发布变体、归档、重置、复制及跨项目迁移，说明前提及分配分析影响。新建、流量和指标配置分别由对应技能处理。
2157aa2cf31085c40b7642c53ac2c6a8d1b1ff7a.source:
Guides experiment state transitions: launching, pausing, resuming, freezing/unfreezing exposure, ending, shipping variants, archiving, resetting, duplicating, and copying to another project. Covers preconditions, implications for variant assignment and analysis, and the decision framework for when to use each action.
TRIGGER when: user asks to launch, pause, resume, end, ship, archive, reset, duplicate, or copy an experiment to another project, or to freeze/unfreeze exposure (stop enrolling new users while metrics keep flowing, or reopen enrollment).
DO NOT TRIGGER when: user is creating an experiment (use creating-experiments), configuring rollout (use configuring-experiment-rollout), or setting up metrics (use configuring-experiment-analytics).
2157aa2cf31085c40b7642c53ac2c6a8d1b1ff7a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

f8ac0e7cf9ae272cff873ef01c63d79cfa37d93f.description_zh: 检查并提出、测试、排序和应用 PostHog 路径清理规则，将数字 ID、UUID、slug 和日期等动态段归为可读别名。涵盖 re2、别名占位、顺序及 MCP 更新。
f8ac0e7cf9ae272cff873ef01c63d79cfa37d93f.source: Inspects URL paths and proposes, tests, orders, and applies project-level path cleaning rules so dynamic segments (numeric IDs, UUIDs, slugs, dates) collapse into readable aliases. Use when the user says "clean the paths", "normalize URLs", "group similar pages", "too many distinct paths", "/users/123 and /users/456 are the same page", "set up path cleaning", or asks why a Web analytics or Paths breakdown is fragmented across thousands of nearly-identical URLs. Covers regex syntax (re2), alias placeholder convention, rule ordering, the test workflow, and applying rules via the path-cleaning-rules-update MCP tool.
f8ac0e7cf9ae272cff873ef01c63d79cfa37d93f.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

4fe80548d613e449b6813d49056e13f1f714a9ef.description_zh: 创建和管理 PostHog 私人应用内提醒，支持一次、周期或 cron、时区及关联看板、实验等资源。适用于日程提示，并说明与告警和订阅的选择区别。
4fe80548d613e449b6813d49056e13f1f714a9ef.source: Create and manage PostHog reminders — private, human-paced nudges that fire as in-app notifications on a schedule, optionally linked to a PostHog resource. Use when the user says "remind me to…", wants a one-off or recurring nudge (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly, a cron schedule, or a specific date/time), wants to be reminded to look at a dashboard, insight, experiment, feature flag, survey, notebook, replay, or error, or wants to list, change, or cancel their reminders. Covers when to pick a reminder over an alert or subscription, the one-off vs recurring vs cron schedule field mappings, timezones, and attaching a resource.
4fe80548d613e449b6813d49056e13f1f714a9ef.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

cd0531fb57ab766b4011887f8636eb4138bee7cf.description_zh: 通过 PostHog MCP 创建、部署和管理 Streamlit 应用，设置源码、启停沙箱、轮询状态、列举版本、删除并分享 PostHog 应用链接。
cd0531fb57ab766b4011887f8636eb4138bee7cf.source: Create, deploy, and operate Streamlit apps in PostHog via the streamlit-apps MCP tools — create an app, set its source, start and stop its sandbox, poll status, list versions, delete, and share the app with humans via its PostHog URL. Use when asked to "create a streamlit app", "deploy a data app", "ship a dashboard app", "restart/stop my app", "why is my app not running", or "give me a link to the app".
cd0531fb57ab766b4011887f8636eb4138bee7cf.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

602e44cb217faebf009e8678cb45df3eeaf9b093.description_zh: 管理 PostHog insight 或看板快照订阅，按期通过邮件、Slack 或 webhook 发送，可附 AI 摘要。支持频率、接收人和停止更新。
602e44cb217faebf009e8678cb45df3eeaf9b093.source: Manage PostHog subscriptions — scheduled email, Slack, or webhook deliveries of insight or dashboard snapshots, optionally with an AI-written summary attached to each delivery. Use when the user wants to subscribe to an insight or dashboard, get an AI summary attached to those deliveries, check existing subscriptions, change delivery frequency, add or remove recipients, or stop receiving updates.
602e44cb217faebf009e8678cb45df3eeaf9b093.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

0e89501a30a8b75c079bfb0c05951cabc21f7bd5.description_zh: 在 PostHog HogQL 视图或外部 dbt 中建可复用激活率及用户/账户激活标记。以经留存提升验证的早期行为组合定义激活，平衡覆盖与预测力，检查次数阈值及 B2B 群组；先读建模基础。
0e89501a30a8b75c079bfb0c05951cabc21f7bd5.source: Build reusable activation models — an activation-rate metric and a per-user/per-account activated flag — on either PostHog data-warehouse views (HogQL) or an external dbt project. Use when the user wants to define, model, or measure activation, the "aha moment", onboarding success, or which early actions predict a user sticking around. The core idea this skill enforces: activation is NOT a single assumed event — it is a retention-validated combination of early actions, chosen by balancing reach (enough users hit it) against predictive power (those who hit it retain much better). Covers finding candidate actions, validating them against retention lift, count thresholds and action combinations, per-product and B2B group-level activation, and modeling the winning definition as a durable activated-flag + activation-rate model. Read modeling-warehouse-foundations first; composes modeling-product-usage-metrics for the retention validation.
0e89501a30a8b75c079bfb0c05951cabc21f7bd5.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

132ffae6cd35ac015b31054dcbcd305734dc7ae7.description_zh: 在 PostHog HogQL 或 dbt 中建漏斗、步骤转化、流失和耗时模型，明确顺序、窗口、用户或群组粒度、整体与步骤转化及归因。PostHog 使用 windowFunnel，dbt 建带测试的 fct_conversion；先读建模基础。
132ffae6cd35ac015b31054dcbcd305734dc7ae7.source: Build reusable conversion models — funnel/step conversion rates, drop-off, and time-to-convert — on either PostHog data-warehouse views (HogQL) or an external dbt project. Use when the user wants to model, define, or compute a conversion rate, funnel, step completion, drop-off, activation-funnel, signup-to-paid, or any "what % of users who did A went on to do B (within N days)" metric. Covers the funnel model (ordered steps, the conversion-window time-box, strict vs any-order), the person-vs-group aggregation unit, overall vs step-to-step conversion (two different numbers), breakdown attribution, and when a saved funnel insight beats a warehouse view. On PostHog, model funnels in HogQL with windowFunnel; in dbt, stage the event stream and compute an fct_conversion mart with tests. Read modeling-warehouse-foundations first for the view-vs-dbt mechanics; pairs with query-funnel for interactive analysis.
132ffae6cd35ac015b31054dcbcd305734dc7ae7.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

5ae2d5b073a95225a6d3abe41d185ef00af860a3.description_zh: 在 HogQL 视图或 dbt 中构建国家、时区、币种、日期、套餐等一实体一行维表，采用别名和保存关联供事实复用，可低频物化。原说明币种使用 convertCurrency()，不手写汇率表；先读建模基础。
5ae2d5b073a95225a6d3abe41d185ef00af860a3.source: Build reusable dimension / lookup tables for a star schema — country/region, timezone, currency, date, plan/product, and other descriptive attributes — on either PostHog data-warehouse views (HogQL) or an external dbt project. Use when the user wants to model dimension tables, lookup tables, a star schema, conformed dimensions, or wants to enrich events/revenue/usage with country, region, timezone, plan, or currency attributes without repeating JOINs. Covers sourcing the dimension data (upload, warehouse source, or derive from events), shaping it into an aliased one-row-per-entity view (optionally materialized on a slow schedule since dimensions change rarely), and attaching it to facts via a saved or person join so its columns read as native fields. Key rule: for currency use the built-in convertCurrency() instead of a hand-rolled rate table. Read modeling-warehouse-foundations first; dimensions here are reused by the revenue, conversion, activation, and product-usage modeling skills.
5ae2d5b073a95225a6d3abe41d185ef00af860a3.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

715addee3c029ae60455cdb59f0815239dd9bb35.description_zh: 在 PostHog 或 dbt 中建留存、粘性及生命周期模型，统一起始/返回事件和周期粒度，分别用于回访矩阵、频率分布及增长质量。dbt 建相应事实集并测试，先读建模基础，也供激活验证复用。
715addee3c029ae60455cdb59f0815239dd9bb35.source: Build reusable product-usage and engagement models — retention, stickiness, and lifecycle — on either PostHog data-warehouse views (HogQL) or an external dbt project. Use when the user wants to model, define, or compute whether users come back (retention / churn), how frequently they engage (stickiness / power users / DAU-WAU-MAU ratio), or the composition of the active base (new / returning / resurrecting / dormant lifecycle). These three are one engagement family sharing a start-event/return-event vocabulary and an interval granularity; this skill treats them together and helps pick the right lens: retention for the return-rate cohort matrix, stickiness for the frequency distribution, lifecycle for growth quality. On PostHog, model them in HogQL (mirroring query-retention / query-stickiness / query-lifecycle); in dbt, build fct_retention / fct_stickiness / fct_lifecycle marts with tests. Read modeling-warehouse-foundations first; feeds the retention validation used by modeling-activation-metrics.
715addee3c029ae60455cdb59f0815239dd9bb35.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

09bf901181dc132732c07749e8bd15d89a4db51a.description_zh: 建立 MRR、ARR、总收入、增扩缩流失、ARPU、LTV 和客户收入模型。PostHog 基于受管 revenue_analytics_* 视图而非原始 Stripe 表，使用 convertCurrency() 并核验订阅配置及人员群组关联；dbt 用来源分层和带测试事实集，先读建模基础。
09bf901181dc132732c07749e8bd15d89a4db51a.source: Build reusable revenue models — MRR, ARR, gross revenue, new/expansion/contraction/churn, ARPU, LTV, and per-customer/per-account revenue — on either PostHog data-warehouse views (HogQL) or an external dbt project. Use when the user wants to model, define, or compute recurring revenue, monthly/annual recurring revenue, churn or retention of revenue, lifetime value, average revenue per user, or revenue by customer, cohort, product, or currency. On PostHog, build on the managed revenue_analytics_* views (revenue_item, mrr, customer, subscription, charge, product) fed by Stripe or custom revenue events — not raw Stripe tables — and normalize money with convertCurrency(). In dbt, stage the payment source and compute fct_mrr / fct_revenue_item / dim_customer marts with tests. Covers picking the right source, the subscription-config gotcha that leaves MRR empty, currency handling, and linking revenue to persons/groups. Read modeling-warehouse-foundations first for the view-vs-dbt mechanics.
09bf901181dc132732c07749e8bd15d89a4db51a.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

e693866ef74aae62585b62f054746b637a9a8675.description_zh: 介绍 PostHog 原生 HogQL 视图/物化视图与外部 dbt 两种可复用建模路径，包括创建物化排期、列别名、dbt 骨架、关联维表、币种转换及数据目录登记。原说明明确没有原生 dbt 集成，为收入等业务模型提供基础。
e693866ef74aae62585b62f054746b637a9a8675.source: Shared foundations for building reusable data models in PostHog, on either of two stacks: PostHog-native data-warehouse views / materialized views (HogQL, via the view-* MCP tools), or an external dbt project (sources.yml + staging/marts + schema tests) run against your own or PostHog's managed warehouse. Read before authoring any specific business model — covers the PostHog-vs-dbt decision, the view-create → view-materialize → sync_frequency workflow and the HogQL column-aliasing rule, the dbt project skeleton and the honest "no native dbt integration" picture, warehouse joins and star-schema dimensions, currency conversion with convertCurrency(), and checking/registering models in the data catalog for reuse. Companion to the domain skills modeling-revenue-metrics, modeling-conversion-metrics, modeling-activation-metrics, modeling-product-usage-metrics, and modeling-dimension-tables. Use when the user asks how to build a view, materialized view, or dbt model in PostHog, or which of the two stacks to use.
e693866ef74aae62585b62f054746b637a9a8675.method: 本地逐条人工意译并核对适用范围

99d1dfa80965b5c0e8520d172cbd8bfd01783f1c.description_zh: 规定 products/conversations/ 文件布局，适用于新增、移动、重命名及评审组件、页面、helper 和测试。React 组件各自置于 frontend/components/ 子目录，不散放在该目录或前端根。
99d1dfa80965b5c0e8520d172cbd8bfd01783f1c.source: File layout for the conversations product. Use when adding, moving, renaming, or reviewing files under products/conversations/ — especially frontend components, scenes, helpers, and tests.
